subject: Movement and Coordination
en: Overview: This section describes motor and coordination skills, and related movement activities that extend and refine notions of body image and the body’s capabilities. It also provides opportunities for enhancing time, space and language concepts, as well as social development (when activities are carried out with others). The basic goals ask the child to stop and start movement according to a signal; maintain balance; move through space, with or without obstacles, in a variety of ways; throw and kick objects; and move cooperatively with others. These goals are achieved through a variety of tasks or traditional childhood games. The child is also asked to use the body to interpret music and to perform pantomimes.
zh: 概述：本节介绍动作与协调技能，以及拓展和完善身体意象与身体能力概念的相关活动。本节也为增强时间、空间和语言概念以及社会性发展（当活动与他人共同进行时）提供机会。基本目标要求儿童：根据信号停止和开始动作；保持平衡；以多种方式在有或无障碍物的空间中移动；投掷和踢物体；与他人合作移动。这些目标通过各种任务或传统儿童游戏来实现。此外还要求儿童用身体表现音乐，并表演哑剧。

subject: Movement and Coordination
en: I-MC1.1 Stop and/or start movement in response to a signal.
zh: I-MC1.1 根据信号停止和/或开始动作。

subject: Movement and Coordination
en: I-MC2.1 Ascend and descend steps, alternating feet.
zh: I-MC2.1 上下台阶，双脚交替。

subject: Movement and Coordination
en: I-MC2.2 Maintain balance while changing body position without moving through space.
zh: I-MC2.2 在原地改变身体姿势时保持平衡（不移动位置）。

subject: Movement and Coordination
en: I-MC2.3a Maintain balance while walking forward on a wide bench or beam.
zh: I-MC2.3a 向前行走时保持平衡。

subject: Movement and Coordination
en: I-MC2.4 Situate oneself within a space of defined boundaries, modifying body configuration and size to fit the space.
zh: I-MC2.4 在边界明确的空间内活动，调整身体形态和大小以适应空间。

subject: Movement and Coordination
en: I-MC2.5a Move through space with or without obstacles—avoiding touching or bumping other individuals or obstacles—by crawling, walking, running, galloping, hopping (same foot and alternate foot) or jumping.
zh: I-MC2.5a 在空间中移动（有或没有障碍物），避免触碰或撞到他人或障碍物：可采用爬行、行走、奔跑、策步跳、单脚跳（同一只脚或双脚交替）或跳跃。

subject: Movement and Coordination
en: I-MC1.2 Relax specific body muscles and/or the whole body, moving from a high activity level to a quiet, focused state.
zh: I-MC1.2 放松身体特定肌肉和/或全身，从高活动水平转为安静、专注的状态。

subject: Movement and Coordination
en: I-MC3.1a Throw or kick an object in the direction indicated.
zh: I-MC3.1a 朝指定方向投掷或踢物体。

subject: Movement and Coordination
en: I-MC3.2a Play catch with a bean bag, with a partner seated or standing 1.5 feet apart.
zh: I-MC3.2a 与同伴相距1.5英尺坐着或站着，玩沙包抛接游戏。

subject: Movement and Coordination
en: I-MC3.5 Coordinate motor activity to carry out a goal with a partner or group.
zh: I-MC3.5 协调动作活动，与同伴或小组共同完成一个目标。

subject: Movement and Coordination
en: I-MC4.1a Play group games such as Farmer in the Dell, Follow the Leader, Hot Potato, London Bridge, Mother May I?, Ring Around the Rosie, Simon Says.
zh: I-MC4.1a 玩团体游戏，如《农夫在谷仓里》（Farmer in the Dell）。

subject: Movement and Coordination
en: I-MC5.1 Imitate the position or action of another person.
zh: I-MC5.1 模仿他人的姿势或动作。

subject: Movement and Coordination
en: I-MC5.2 Act out a simple pantomime.
zh: I-MC5.2 表演简单的哑剧。

subject: Movement and Coordination
en: II-MC3.1b Throw or kick an object with increasing accuracy at identified targets varying in height and distance.
zh: II-MC3.1b 向高度和距离不同的指定目标投掷或踢物体，准确度逐步提高。

subject: Movement and Coordination
en: Note: For a full discussion, please see the “Language of Instruction” section in the “Using the Preschool Sequence” chapter.
zh: 注：完整讨论请参见《使用学前课程》一章中的“教学语言”部分。

subject: Movement and Coordination
en:
Adult: I want to see how many different ways you can move down this (pointing) incline.
Adult: Good—you can roll sideways down the incline. What’s another way? Child crawls down incline
Adult: Right—you can crawl down the incline on your hands and knees, etc.
zh:
成人：我想看看你能想出多少种不同的办法，从这个斜坡上（指着斜坡）下来。
成人：很好——你可以侧身从斜坡上滚下来。还有什么别的办法？（儿童爬下斜坡）
成人：对——你可以用手和膝盖爬下斜坡，等等。

subject: Social and Emotional Development
topic: Social and Emotional Development: Autonomy and Social Skills
en: Overview: The basic goals associated with this section focus on the development of those emotional and social skills that enable the young child to function independently within the social setting of the class group. These include developing a sense of who he or she is and his or her capacities, beginning with a sense of physical body image. The child will also learn those interpersonal, social skills essential to interacting with others, such as the “give and take” of being part of a group and the need to sometimes delay or defer his or her own immediate desires, given the demands of the group. These goals mark the beginning development of an individual who is independent and competent, able to assume responsibility for his or her actions within the context of the group.
zh: 概述：本节的基本目标聚焦于发展使幼儿能够在班级群体的社会环境中独立发挥作用的情绪与社会技能。这些技能包括发展对自我及其能力的认识，从身体意象开始。儿童还将学习与他人互动所必需的人际与社会技能，例如作为群体一员的“给予与索取”，以及根据群体要求有时延迟或推迟自己当下的愿望。这些目标标志着一个独立、有能力、能够在群体情境中为自己的行为负责的个体的初步发展。

subject: Social and Emotional Development
en: I-AS1.1 Recognize and respond to own first and last name, orally and in writing.
zh: I-AS1.1 识别并回应自己的姓和名（口头及书写形式）。

subject: Social and Emotional Development
en: I-AS1.2 Orally provide first name and last name.
zh: I-AS1.2 口头说出自己的名和姓。

subject: Social and Emotional Development
topic: Social and Emotional Development: Autonomy and Social Skills
en: Internalize and conceptualize an image of one’s body
zh: 内化并形成对自己身体的意象。

subject: Social and Emotional Development
en: I-AS2.1 Name parts of the body: arm, ear, eye, face, finger, foot, hair, hand, head, leg, mouth, neck, nose, stomach, toe.
zh: I-AS2.1 说出身体部位的名称：手臂、耳朵、眼睛、脸、手指、脚、头发、手、头、腿、嘴、脖子、鼻子、肚子、脚趾。

subject: Social and Emotional Development
en: I-AS2.2a Draw a simple line drawing (stick figure) of a person, such as a stick figure that includes a head (with eyes, nose, mouth), body, arms and legs.
zh: I-AS2.2a 画一个简单的人物线条画（火柴人），例如包括头（有眼睛、鼻子、嘴）、身体、胳膊和腿的火柴人。

subject: Social and Emotional Development
en: I-AS3.1a Practice good hygiene (use bathroom independently, wash hands, etc.), use appropriate table manners (feed self using fork, spoon and knife; appropriate use of napkin), put on clothing, etc.
zh: I-AS3.1a 练习良好的个人卫生习惯（独立上厕所、洗手等），使用适当的餐桌礼仪（自己用叉子、勺子和刀吃饭；正确使用餐巾），自己穿衣服等。

subject: Social and Emotional Development
en: I-AS5.1a Recognize and call classmates and teacher by name.
zh: I-AS5.1a 认出同学和老师，并叫出他们的名字。

subject: Social and Emotional Development
en: I-AS5.2 Greet adults as “Mr. (name),” “Ms. (name)” or “Mrs. (name).”
zh: I-AS5.2 用“某先生”“某女士”或“某太太”称呼成年人。

subject: Social and Emotional Development
en: I-AS5.3 Acknowledge and return greetings and farewells.
zh: I-AS5.3 回应并回以问候和道别。

subject: Social and Emotional Development
en: I-AS5.4 Make requests and acknowledge attempts to meet requests politely.
zh: I-AS5.4 礼貌地提出请求，并对别人满足请求的做法作出回应。

subject: Social and Emotional Development
en: I-AS5.6 Attend and listen while others speak during a group activity.
zh: I-AS5.6 小组活动中别人讲话时专心倾听。

subject: Social and Emotional Development
en: I-AS5.8 Wait turn to speak in a group.
zh: I-AS5.8 在小组中轮流等待发言。

subject: Social and Emotional Development
en: I-AS6.3a Carry out chores and responsibilities that contribute to the well-being and functioning of the group.
zh: I-AS6.3a 完成有助于群体福祉和运转的杂务与责任。

subject: Social and Emotional Development
en: I-AS6.4 Sit among other children during a group activity, remaining in own physical space.
zh: I-AS6.4 小组活动时坐在其他儿童中间，并保持自己的身体空间。

subject: Social and Emotional Development
en: I-AS6.7 With advance notice, stop when told and change activities, moving cooperatively to another activity.
zh: I-AS6.7 事先得到提醒后，听到指令就停下并转换活动，合作地转到另一项活动。

subject: Social and Emotional Development
en: II-AS5.1b Recognize, call by name and indicate role of school personnel.
zh: II-AS5.1b 认出学校工作人员，叫出他们的名字并说明其职责。

subject: Social and Emotional Development
en: I-AS6.8a Follow rules for simple childhood games.
zh: I-AS6.8a 遵守简单儿童游戏的规则。

subject: Social and Emotional Development
en: II-AS6.8b Follow rules for simple childhood games (board games and group circle games).
zh: II-AS6.8b 遵守简单儿童游戏的规则（棋盘游戏和团体圆圈游戏）。

subject: Social and Emotional Development
topic: Social and Emotional Development: Autonomy and Social Skills
en:
Child: I made a picture.
Adult: Let’s see. What can you tell me about your picture?
Child: It’s me.
Adult: Ahh, you drew a picture of yourself. Can you tell me about the different parts of the drawing—the different parts of the body; what is this (points to head)?
Child: The head.
Adult: You drew a picture of a head. And where is your head? Point to your head. That’s right. Now tell me about the different parts of the head you drew. Where are the eyebrows? Are these the eyebrows?
zh:
儿童：我画了一幅画。
成人：让我看看。你能跟我说说你的画吗？
儿童：这是我。
成人：啊，你画了一幅你自己。你能跟我说说画里的不同部分吗——身体的不同部位；这是什么（指着头部）？
儿童：头。
成人：你画了一个头。那你的头在哪里？指一指你的头。对了。现在跟我说说你画的头的各个部分。眉毛在哪里？这些是眉毛吗？

subject: Social and Emotional Development
topic: Social and Emotional Development: Work Habits
en: Overview: The foundation for the manner in which children will later approach academic work in kindergarten and beyond is established, step by step, through the experiences and expectations that children encounter in play and activities at the preschool level. This section focuses on gently guiding children to develop a methodology for approaching different activities, to develop memory skills, follow directions, persist at a task, identify the materials and steps needed to carry out an activity, evaluate and correct their own work, and so on.
zh: 概述：儿童日后在幼儿园及以后如何对待学业任务，其基础是在学前阶段的游戏和活动中，通过所遇到的经验与期望一步步奠定的。本节着重温和地引导儿童形成开展不同活动的方法：发展记忆技能、听从指令、坚持完成任务、确定活动所需的材料和步骤、评价并修正自己的工作等。

subject: Social and Emotional Development
en: I-AS8.1a Carry out single-step oral directions.
zh: I-AS8.1a 执行单步骤的口头指令。

subject: Social and Emotional Development
en: I-AS8.2a Choose and use a toy or do an activity independently for a sustained period of time (at least ten minutes).
zh: I-AS8.2a 独立选择并使用玩具或从事某项活动，持续一段时间（至少十分钟）。

subject: Social and Emotional Development
en: I-AS8.3 Return toys and materials to their proper location after use.
zh: I-AS8.3 使用后将玩具和材料放回原处。

subject: Social and Emotional Development
en: I-AS8.4 Work in an orderly, persistent fashion in completing a task, even if difficulty is encountered.
zh: I-AS8.4 即使遇到困难，也能有条理、坚持不懈地完成任务。

subject: Social and Emotional Development
en: II-AS7.1 Memorize address, phone number and date of birth.
zh: II-AS7.1 记住地址、电话号码和出生日期。

subject: Social and Emotional Development
topic: Social and Emotional Development: Work Habits
en:
Child: Uh oh! The milk spilled. It’s a big mess.
Adult: Oops, there was an accident and the milk spilled. That’s okay—sometimes accidents happen. Sometimes we make mistakes—everyone does. But now there is a mess. Let’s see—what do we need to do with the mess? What do we need to do to fix or correct what happened?
Child: Clean it up.
Adult: That’s right. And when we make a mess or spill something, it’s our responsibility to clean it up—that means that it’s our job to clean it up. I’ll help you by getting the sponge for you and then you can be responsible for wiping up the milk (hands child the sponge). Do you know how to wipe up the milk or should I show you how to get started?
zh:
儿童：哎呀！牛奶洒了。弄得一团糟。
成人：哎呀，不小心把牛奶洒了。没关系——有时候会发生意外。有时候我们会犯错——每个人都会。但现在弄脏了。让我想想——我们需要怎么处理这团糟？我们要怎么做才能弥补或纠正发生的事？
儿童：把它清理干净。
成人：对了。当我们弄脏或洒了东西时，把它清理干净是我们的责任——也就是说，清理干净是我们的分内之事。我来帮你拿海绵，然后由你负责把牛奶擦干净（把海绵递给儿童）。你知道怎么擦牛奶吗，还是我示范给你看怎么开始？

subject: Language and Literacy
en: Expressing a Point of View/Imagining—giving an opinion, pretending, and assuming the role or perspective of another, making up a story
zh: 表达观点／想象——给出意见、假装、扮演他人的角色或从他人的视角出发、编故事。

subject: Language and Literacy
en: Predicting—anticipating and saying what is likely to happen next
zh: 预测——预期并说出接下来可能发生的事。

subject: Language and Literacy
en: Vocabulary—acquiring increasingly precise and varied ways to express nuances of meaning
zh: 词汇——获得越来越精确、多样的方式表达意义的细微差别。

subject: Language and Literacy
en: Syntax—learning the grammar of language word order in a sentence; word endings to reflect singular and plural, past and present; and specific ways of connecting words and phrases that indicate different relationships, e.g., cause-effect, temporal, etc.
zh: 句法——学习句子中词序的语法；用词的结尾形式表示单复数、过去和现在；以及用特定方式连接词和短语，表示不同关系，如因果、时间等。

subject: Language and Literacy
en: Overview: The basic goals in this section focus on understanding and using spoken language through the development of basic conversational skills, as well as more complex discourse skills: clearly communicating one’s needs; understanding or giving a verbal description of a person, object or experience; sequencing the events of a particular experience in chronological order; giving directions or explaining how to do something; offering a personal opinion; using pretend language; and so on. Children benefit from many experiences and opportunities to listen and talk in a variety of circumstances, moving from using language in strictly contextualized situations, referring to objects or events present in the immediate environment, to use decontextualized language, moving beyond the here and now. Language can then be used symbolically—to talk about the past, answer “what if” questions, link cause and effect, as well as to conceptually sort and classify. Additional goals in this section address mastering the form of oral language, both vocabulary and syntax. While it is beyond the intended purpose of the Preschool Sequence to provide suggestions and activities on how to teach the listed competencies, it is particularly important in this section on oral language to emphasize the teaching of these skills within the context of learning opportunities, in the form of child-adult interactions and conversations, that present themselves continuously on a daily basis. The manner in which adults respond to children’s utterances and subsequent opportunities offered for additional conversation and talk clearly influence children’s language development.
zh: 概述：本节的基本目标聚焦于通过发展基本会话技能以及更复杂的话语技能来理解和运用口语：清楚表达自己的需求；理解或口头描述一个人、物体或经历；按时间顺序排列某次经历的事件；给出指令或解释如何做某事；提出个人观点；使用假想语言等。儿童得益于在各种情境中大量倾听和说话的经验与机会，从在严格依赖语境的情境中使用语言（指称眼前环境中的物体或事件），逐步过渡到使用脱离语境的语言，超越此时此地。语言于是可以被象征性地使用——谈论过去、回答“如果……会怎样”的问题、建立因果联系，以及从概念上分类和归类。本节的其他目标涉及掌握口语的形式，包括词汇和句法。虽然《学前课程》的目的并不在于为如何教授所列能力提供建议和活动，但在口语这一节，尤其要强调在日常不断出现的成人—儿童互动与会话等学习机会中教授这些技能。成人如何回应儿童的话语、以及随后提供多少继续交谈的机会，显然会影响儿童的语言发展。

subject: Language and Literacy
en: Frequent language interaction, with many opportunities to listen and talk
zh: 频繁的语言互动，有大量倾听和说话的机会。

subject: Language and Literacy
en: Adult models of high quality talk that keep in mind children’s need to first hear many “language examples” in order to build a receptive language base: use of a variety of vocabulary, including occasional “rare words” (multi-syllable words that might normally be considered “outside a preschooler’s vocabulary”); use of a variety of syntactical forms such as complex sentences that relate ideas; talk that is informative and illustrates reflection and problem solving; etc.
zh: 成人提供高质量谈话的示范，并牢记儿童需要先听到大量“语言范例”以建立接受性语言基础：使用多种词汇，包括偶尔的“稀有词”（多音节词，通常可能被视为超出学前儿童词汇范围）；使用多种句法形式，如联系想法的复杂句；提供信息性强、体现反思和解决问题的谈话；等等。

subject: Language and Literacy
en: Adult responses that reflect and incorporate what the child has said but also expand upon his or her comments
zh: 成人的回应既反映并接纳儿童所说的话，也对其评论加以扩展。

subject: Language and Literacy
en: Adult comments and behaviors that invite further conversation on the child’s part:
zh: 成人引发儿童进一步交谈的评论和行为：

subject: Language and Literacy
en: Rephrasing of questions, in the absence of a response by the child, in a manner that gives hints about how to respond, moving from open-ended questions to those that offer a structured choice: “Where is the pirate going?” (no answer) “Is he going to look for the buried treasure or is he going to chase the other pirate boat?”
zh: 如果儿童没有回应，以能提供作答提示的方式重述问题，从开放式问题逐步转为提供结构化选择的问题：“海盗要去哪里？”（无回答）“他是要去找埋藏的宝藏，还是去追另一艘海盗船？”

subject: Language and Literacy
en: Opportunities and invitations to use language in decontextualized settings—to talk about objects, events or experiences that are not part of the immediate environment: “What did you do at grandma’s house?” “How did you make the pinwheel?” “What are you going to do when you go on vacation?”
zh: 提供并邀请儿童在脱离语境的情境中使用语言——谈论不属于眼前环境的物体、事件或经历：“你在奶奶家做了什么？”“你是怎么做出风车的？”“你度假时打算做什么？”
work: What did you do at grandma’s house
work_en: What did you do at grandma’s house

subject: Language and Literacy
en: Minimal use of directives (“Do this …,” “Don’t do this …,” etc.)
zh: 尽量少用指令句（“做这个……”“别做这个……”等）。

subject: Language and Literacy
en: I-OL1.1a Adapt the volume of one’s voice to different settings and different purposes.
zh: I-OL1.1a 根据不同的场合和目的调整说话音量。

subject: Language and Literacy
en: I-OL2.1a Carry on a dialogue or conversation with an adult, initiating comments or responding to partner’s comments.
zh: I-OL2.1a 与成人进行对话或交谈，主动发表评论或回应对方的评论。

subject: Language and Literacy
en: I-OL2.2a Answer the telephone appropriately.
zh: I-OL2.2a 恰当地接听电话。

subject: Language and Literacy
en: I-OL3.1 Express personal needs and desires verbally in a comprehensible manner.
zh: I-OL3.1 以清晰易懂的方式用口头语言表达个人需求和愿望。

subject: Language and Literacy
en:
Adult: Here are some pictures of different things. See—here’s a picture of an apple, an ice cream cone, a dress, a cookie, a pair of shoes, a jacket, a pair of pants and a hamburger. Some of these pictures “go together.” They belong to the same group of things; they belong to the same category. See—I can put the apple, the ice cream cone and the cookie all together in a group: they are all things that we can eat; they belong to the food category. Do you see another picture that belongs to the food category?
Child: (points to picture of the hamburger)
Adult: That’s right—we can eat an apple, an ice cream cone, a cookie or a ...? (points to picture of hamburger and pauses expectantly)
Child: Hamburger.
Adult: (nods) ...So they all belong to the food category. Here are some other pictures that belong to another group or category.
zh:
成人：这里有一些不同东西的图片。看——这是一张苹果的图片，一个冰淇淋蛋筒、一条裙子、一块饼干、一双鞋、一件夹克、一条裤子和一个汉堡包。有些图片是“归为一类”的。它们属于同一组东西；属于同一类别。看——我可以把苹果、冰淇淋蛋筒和饼干放在一起组成一组：它们都是我们可以吃的东西；属于食物类别。你看到另一张属于食物类别的图片了吗？
儿童：（指着汉堡包的图片）
成人：对了——我们可以吃苹果、冰淇淋蛋筒、饼干或者……？（指着汉堡包的图片，期待地停顿）
儿童：汉堡包。
成人：（点头）……所以它们都属于食物类别。这里还有一些属于另一组或另一类别的图片。

subject: Language and Literacy
topic: Nursery Rhymes, Poems, Fingerplays and Songs
en: Overview: The goals in this section introduce young children to nursery rhymes, poems, fingerplays and songs—listening to and keeping the beat, listening to and interpreting the simple words of a given selection with gestures and actions, as well as learning about rhyming words. In addition to the sheer enjoyment of listening to and repeating the rhythmic and musical combination of words, learning these selections provides skill and discipline in developing the ability to memorize and further extends children’s understanding and use of both the form and function of language. By listening to and reciting these poems and songs, children have an opportunity to model and practice various oral language skills, including pronunciation, vocabulary and syntax. They can then build upon their familiarity with certain well known rhymes by experimenting with rhyming words. This competency, in turn, focuses attention on the sounds of language, a skill that will enhance later efforts in initial reading. In addition to providing experiences with the form of language, these selections introduce children to hearing some more formal written language. The language of the “little stories” of these poems and songs differs from contextualized language of daily conversations. Their brevity makes them an ideal transition to the narrative language of storybooks.
zh: 概述：本节的目标向幼儿介绍童谣、诗歌、手指谣和歌曲——听并跟着打节拍，听并用动作和手势理解所选内容的简单词句，以及学习押韵词。除了欣赏并重复富有节奏和音乐性的词句组合所带来的纯粹乐趣外，学习这些内容还能培养记忆能力并训练自律，进一步拓展儿童对语言形式和语言功能的理解与运用。通过听和朗诵这些诗歌与歌曲，儿童有机会模仿并练习各种口语技能，包括发音、词汇和句法。他们还能在熟悉某些著名童谣的基础上，尝试押韵词的玩法。这种能力反过来又把注意力引向语言的声音，这项技能将有助于日后最初的阅读学习。这些选段除了提供语言形式方面的经验，还让儿童接触到一些较正式的书面语言。诗歌和歌曲中“小故事”的语言不同于日常会话中依赖语境的语言。它们篇幅短小，是通向故事书叙事语言的理想过渡。

subject: Language and Literacy
topic: Nursery Rhymes, Poems, Fingerplays and Songs
en:
Adult: Listen to this nursery rhyme while I recite it—it has rhyming words: To market, to market, to buy a fat pig (emphasis on pig) Home again, home again, jiggety-jig. (emphasis on jig). Pig and jig are rhyming words. Try to say or echo the rhyming words with me: To market, to market, to buy a fat (pause—child and adult together): p…ig Home again, home again, jiggety (pause—child and adult together): j…ig. Did you hear the two rhyming words? pig and …
Child: jig.
Adult: That’s right—pig and jig are rhyming words. Now listen while I recite another verse—there are some other rhyming words: To market, to market, to buy a fat hog (emphasis on hog) Home again, home again, jiggety-jog. (emphasis on jog), etc.
zh:
成人：听我念这首童谣——里面有押韵的词：去集市呀去集市，买一只肥猪（重读 pig），回家转呀回家转，跳呀跳个不停（重读 jig）。pig 和 jig 是押韵词。试着跟我一起说、跟着念这些押韵词：去集市呀去集市，买一只肥（停顿——儿童和成人一起）p…ig；回家转呀回家转，跳呀跳个（停顿——儿童和成人一起）j…ig。你听到那两个押韵的词了吗？pig 和……
儿童：jig。
成人：对了——pig 和 jig 是押韵词。现在听我念另一段——里面还有别的押韵词：去集市呀去集市，买一只肥猪（重读 hog），回家转呀回家转，跳呀跳个不停（重读 jog），等等。

subject: Language and Literacy
en: Overview: The goals of this section focus on the language skills that children acquire when given the opportunity to hear the language of storybooks. In listening to and talking about stories that are read aloud, children build both listening and speaking skills. They are introduced to new vocabulary and formal written syntax, ways of linking and relating ideas. They also refine skills in: Narrating: understanding and describing illustrations, understanding and describing the setting, characters and events of stories and so on. Predicting: telling what will happen next in a story or suggesting a possible alternative ending. Imagining: telling their own stories, either based on illustrations or creating a story using their imagination. In addition, early experiences with books also lay the foundation for concepts and skills that children will later use as they begin to read and write. They learn about book format—the arrangement of covers, pages, individual printed words and letters—and they gain insight into the elements of a story—setting, characters, the pursuit of a goal or the resolution of a problem in a sequential series of events—an understanding that is instrumental for reading comprehension.
zh: 概述：本节的目标聚焦于儿童在有机会听故事书语言时获得的语言技能。通过听朗读的故事并谈论这些故事，儿童发展听和说的技能。他们接触新词汇和正式的书面句法，学习连接和关联想法的方式，并进一步打磨以下技能：叙述——理解并描述插图，理解并描述故事的背景、人物和事件等；预测——说出接下来可能发生的事，或提出可能的另一种结局；想象——根据自己的想象，或基于插图讲述自己的故事。此外，早期接触书籍也为儿童日后开始读写所需的技能和概念打下基础。他们学习书籍的形式——封面、书页、单个印刷词和字母的排列——并理解故事要素——背景、人物、目标的追求或问题的解决，以及按一系列事件展开的过程；这种理解有助于阅读理解。

en:

subject: Language and Literacy
topic: Emerging Literacy Skills in Reading and Writing
en: Overview: This section builds on the language skills described in the preceding sections. The competencies described here go beyond oral language skills to early reading and writing skills. The goals ask children to add to their prior experiences with printed words in books by recognizing print in the daily environment and some ways it is used: to identify, to name or label (food, toys, streets, stores, etc.), to make lists, to report events, to give directions, to communicate messages, etc. The section focuses on the relation between oral language and print. The goals ask children to associate specific familiar spoken words, such as their own names or names of familiar objects, with specific written words. Children then go on to recognize that the distinct marks that make up each word are letters in our alphabet. Children learn that these letters have names through such means as singing the alphabet song. They learn to identify and name the specific letters in their own names. A crucial part of learning to read is developing phonemic awareness, the understanding that individual sounds are associated with individual letters and combinations of letters. To help children begin to develop phonemic awareness, the goals in this section ask children not only to refine their visual recognition of print but also to attend to the spoken sounds of language (for related topics, see the clapping and rhyming skills described in Nursery Rhymes, Poems, Fingerplays and Songs). Children are asked to take apart and put together smaller and smaller units of sound, from individual words in a sentence, to syllables in words, to the beginning sounds in individual words. The goals here also include the skills needed to produce print, that is, to write. At first, children are asked to perform manual activities that enhance both hand-eye coordination and small muscle control of the hand and fingers. They learn the proper way to hold a writing implement, as well as a variety of small designs and strokes that will eventually be combined to form letters. They are also asked to write their own names.
zh: 概述：本节以前面几节描述的语言技能为基础。这里所描述的能力超越了口语技能，进入早期读写技能。目标要求儿童在以往书中印刷文字经验的基础上，认识日常环境中的印刷文字及其一些用途：用于识别、命名或标注（食物、玩具、街道、商店等）、列清单、报告事件、给出指示、传递信息等。本节关注口语与印刷文字之间的关系。目标要求儿童把特定的熟悉口语词，如自己的名字或熟悉物体的名称，与特定的书面形式对应起来。接着儿童认识到构成每个词的不同记号是字母表中的字母。儿童通过唱字母歌等方式学习这些字母有名称。他们学会识别并说出自己名字中的具体字母。学习阅读的一个关键部分是发展音位意识，即理解单个声音与单个字母及字母组合相对应。为帮助儿童开始发展音位意识，本节目标不仅要求儿童完善对印刷文字的视觉识别，还要求他们注意语言的声音（相关主题见“童谣、诗歌、手指谣和歌曲”中描述的拍手和押韵技能）。要求儿童把声音单位不断拆分和组合，从句子中的单个词，到词中的音节，再到单词的起始音。这里的目标还包括产生印刷文字所需的技能，也就是书写。起初，要求儿童完成一些手工活动，这些活动能增强手眼协调以及手和手指小肌肉的控制。他们学习握笔的正确方式，以及各种最终会组合成字母的小图案和笔画。还要求儿童书写自己的名字。

subject: Language and Literacy
topic: Emerging Literacy Skills in Reading and Writing
en: Note: For clarity in working and communicating with young children, some descriptive terms should be consistently used in describing the individual writing strokes listed on page 32. The specific terms selected have no intrinsic value; the arbitrary names on page 32 are but one possibility. Undue effort should not be expended in teaching these terms to young children as part of their speaking vocabulary. However, when formal writing instruction in letter formation begins (for example, when the child learns to write his or her own name), the same names may be used by the teacher in describing these strokes as the various component elements of individual letters.

topic: Emerging Literacy Skills in Reading and Writing

儿童：（沿着线描画）
成人：很好。你用手指画了一条直线。这里有根绳子。我要把绳子的一头按在一个点上。你能用剩下的绳子拉成一条直线，把两个点连起来吗？

subject: Mathematics
en: Overview: Young children seem to be naturally drawn to touching, manipulating and examining the objects they find around them. The goals of this section build upon this curiosity and desire to explore. In the context of experiences with concrete objects and then with pictures, the child is asked to recognize similarities and differences, classify objects and shapes, recognize/create patterns in sequences of objects and make comparisons among objects, using simple measurement skills. He or she is also asked to quantify small groups of objects, to count and to demonstrate a basic understanding of addition and subtraction as “putting together” and “taking away.” In each instance, the child is asked to move from the concrete experience to representing knowledge symbolically using mathematical language, such as “more than,” “less than,” “longer,” “shorter,” number words (“three” and “four”), numerical symbols (“3” and “4”), and so on.
zh: 概述：幼儿似乎天生就会被周围可以触摸、操作和观察的物体所吸引。本节的目标建立在这种好奇心和探索欲望之上。在先接触具体物体、再接触图片的过程中，儿童被要求识别异同、对物体和形状分类、在物体序列中识别或创造规律，并使用简单的测量技能进行比较。他们还被要求量化小组物体、计数，并展示对“合起来”和“拿走”式加减法的基本理解。在每一种情况下，儿童都被要求从具体经验出发，过渡到用数学语言进行符号化表征，例如“多于”“少于”“更长”“更短”、数词（“三”“四”）、数字符号（“3”“4”）等。

en:
Adult: This group is different from this group. Can you tell me how they are different?
Child: This has red things and this has blue things.

subject: History and Geography
topic: History and Geography: Orientation in Time
en: Overview: The focus of this section is on the development of an inner sense of time; this orientation in time is essential not just as a referent point for future instruction in history, but also as another step towards personal autonomy, which requires that children be able to organize time, monitor behavior and independently accomplish given activities throughout the day, week and so on. The child is asked first to organize and think about everyday experiences in regards to various indices of time: he or she is asked to classify experiences according to the time of day in which they occur, sequence events chronologically and begin to use standard measures of time, such as daily schedules and calendars. The child is also asked to consider the passage of time on a larger scale, developing a sense of the relationship of past-present-future, by sequencing events in his or her own life, considering the relationships within his or her own family, as well as sequencing stages within the life cycle. He or she is also asked to assume a historical perspective outside of his or her immediate experiences by examining familiar contemporary objects with similar objects from the past. Finally, the child is asked to represent these experiences symbolically, both with words and schematically in timelines and drawings.
zh: 概述：本节的焦点是内在时间感的发展；这种时间定向不仅是日后历史教学的参照点，也是通向个人自主的又一步，因为儿童需要能够安排时间、监控行为，并在一天、一周等时间中独立完成给定活动。首先要求儿童围绕各种时间线索组织和思考日常经验：按一天中的时段分类经历、按时间顺序排列事件，并开始使用日程表和日历等标准时间工具。还要求儿童从更大尺度思考时间的流逝，通过排列自己生活中的事件、思考家庭内部的关系以及生命历程中的阶段，发展过去—现在—未来的关系感。儿童还被要求通过把熟悉的当代物品与过去相似物品进行比较，从直接经验之外采取历史视角。最后，要求儿童用语言以及时间线和图画等图示方式象征性地表达这些经验。

subject: History and Geography
en: I-OT1.1a Understand and use temporal words to describe day-to-day occurrences: today-tomorrow, before after, now, first-last, day-morning-afternoon evening-night, current day, week, weekend, once upon a time, finally.
zh: I-OT1.1a 理解并使用时间词描述日常发生的事情：今天—明天、以前—以后、现在、第一—最后、白天—早晨—下午—傍晚—夜晚、当天、星期、周末、从前、最终。

subject: History and Geography
en: I-OT2.1 Classify and describe images of everyday activities according to the time of day with which they are associated: day-night, morning afternoon-evening.
zh: I-OT2.1 按一天中的时段对日常活动图片进行分类并描述：白天—夜晚、早晨—下午—傍晚。

subject: History and Geography
en: I-OT2.2a Sequence chronologically and describe three images of events or phases of a single event, occurring at temporally distinct times that have actually been experienced.
zh: I-OT2.2a 按时间顺序排列并描述三幅亲身经历过的、发生在不同时间的事件图片，或单一事件的三个阶段。

subject: History and Geography
en: II-OT1.1b Understand and use temporal words to describe day-to-day occurrences: today-tomorrow-yesterday, always-never-sometimes, before-after, now immediately, first-last, beginning-middle-end, then-next, already, soon, during-while, etc.
zh: II-OT1.1b 理解并使用时间词描述日常发生的事情：今天—明天—昨天、总是—从不—有时、之前—之后、现在—立刻、第一—最后、开始—中间—结束、然后—接下来、已经、很快、在……期间—当……时等。

subject: History and Geography

zh: I-OT2.9a 使用以图片呈现的日常活动表来描述一天中事件的顺序。

subject: History and Geography

zh: I-OT2.10 使用周历找出并说出今天是星期几。

subject: History and Geography
topic: History and Geography: Orientation in Time
en:
Child: (showing photos brought from home) This is me when I was little.
Adult: Let’s look at them together. Can you tell me about each of these pictures that were taken when you were a baby?
Child: This is me in my crib. I’m drinking a bottle. This is me too.
Adult: What were you doing in that picture?
Child: Don’t know.
Adult: It looks like you were crawling on the floor.
Child: Yeah—crawling. And this is me—outside.
Adult: Ahh, you were going for a ride in the stroller. Who is this adult? Who is pushing the stroller?
Child: Mommy.
Adult: So when you were a baby, Mommy took you for a ride in the stroller? I’m glad you have these pictures of things that you did when you were a baby. They’re things that already happened—they’re things you did in the past. It’s fun to remember things you did in the past. Can you remember any other things you did in the past when you were a baby?
Child: No.
Adult: Here are some drawings of babies doing different things. Maybe, they’ll help you remember something you did in the past when you were a baby (pointing). How about this?
Child: Diapers.
Adult: When you were a baby, you wore diapers. That was something you did in the past. You don’t wear diapers now!
zh:
儿童：（展示从家里带来的照片）这是我小时候。
成人：我们一起看看吧。你能跟我说说这些你还是小宝宝时拍的照片吗？每一张都讲讲。
儿童：这是我在婴儿床里。我在喝奶瓶。这也是我。
成人：那张照片里你在做什么？
儿童：不知道。
成人：看起来你当时在地板上爬。
儿童：对——在爬。这是我在——外面。
成人：啊，你当时坐着婴儿车出去玩。这位大人是谁？谁在推婴儿车？
儿童：妈妈。
成人：所以你还是小宝宝的时候，妈妈推着婴儿车带你出去玩？我很高兴你有这些你小时候做过的事情的照片。这些都是已经发生过的事——是你过去做的事。回忆过去做过的事很有趣。你还记得小时候过去做过的其他事情吗？
儿童：不记得。
成人：这里有一些画着宝宝做各种事情的图。也许它们能帮你想起你小时候过去做过的某件事（指着）。这个怎么样？
儿童：尿布。
成人：你小时候穿尿布。那是你过去的事。现在你不穿尿布啦！

subject: History and Geography
topic: History and Geography: Orientation in Space
en: Overview: The focus in this section is on the development of a sense of orientation in space, which enables the child to situate himself or herself in space in relation to his or her physical movements, as well as provides a context and vocabulary for later instruction in geometry and geography. The child is asked to situate first his or her own body, and then objects, in three-dimensional space in relation to other objects, as well as to follow and give spatially referenced directions. He or she is asked to establish reference points in two-dimensional space, copying various grid-like designs and completing mazes. The child is asked to demonstrate an understanding of several basic geographic features, such as ocean, mountain, island and so on. Finally, he or she is asked to represent these experiences symbolically, both with words and schematically on maps and simple drawings.
zh: 概述：本节的焦点是空间定向感的发展，它使儿童能根据自己的身体动作把自己定位在空间中，也为日后几何和地理教学提供背景和词汇。要求儿童先把自己的身体、再把物体定位在三维空间中与其他物体的相对位置上，并能听从和给出带空间参照的指令。要求儿童在二维空间中建立参照点，临摹各种网格状图案并走迷宫。要求儿童理解若干基本地理特征，如海洋、山脉、岛屿等。最后，要求儿童用语言以及用地图和简单图画以图示方式把这些经验象征性地表达出来。

subject: History and Geography
en: I-OS1.1a Situate oneself in space or situate objects in relation to one another according to the indications given by spatial terms: there-here, in on, in front of-behind, at the top of-at the bottom of, under, next to-in the middle of, near-far, around, etc.
zh: I-OS1.1a 根据空间词给出的提示把自己定位在空间中，或把物体彼此相对定位：那里—这里、里—上、前面—后面、顶部—底部、下面、旁边—中间、近—远、周围等。

subject: History and Geography

zh: I-OS2.1a 用拼花积木、马赛克玩具或小木钉，把物体直接放在图案卡上来复制一个图案。

subject: History and Geography
en: II-OS1.1b Situate oneself in space or situate objects in relation to one another according to the indi cations given by spatial terms: here-there, in-on, in front of-behind, at the top of-at the bottom of, under-over, above-below, next to-in the middle of, etc.
zh: II-OS1.1b 根据空间词给出的提示把自己定位在空间中，或把物体彼此相对定位：这里—那里、里—上、前面—后面、顶部—底部、下面—上面、上方—下方、旁边—中间等。

subject: History and Geography
en: I-OS3.1a On a simple map of a single room showing furniture arrangement, indicate one’s own position with an “X.”
zh: I-OS3.1a 在一张显示家具摆放的单个房间的简易地图上，用“X”标出自己的位置。

subject: History and Geography
en: I-OS4.1a Identify these geographic features and environments by name in real life, photos or drawings: land, water, river, lake, ocean, farm, city.
zh: I-OS4.1a 在现实生活、照片或图画中说出这些地理特征和环境的名称：陆地、水、河流、湖泊、海洋、农场、城市。

subject: History and Geography
topic: History and Geography: Orientation in Space
en:
Child: Look what I made.
Adult: What did you make?
Child: I colored.
Adult: Yes, you made a very pretty design on the graph paper. In your design, did you use the same color or a different color for each little box?

subject: Science
topic: Scientific Reasoning and the Physical World
en: Overview: This section introduces children to a systematic way of looking at, describing and explaining the world around them. Children should be given many opportunities for systematic observation and hands-on investigation of both the living and material world. Building on these experiences, children can progress from describing and explaining what is observed to making predictions based on these observations.
zh: 概述：本节向儿童介绍一种系统观察、描述和解释周围世界的方法。应给予儿童大量机会，对生命世界和物质世界进行系统观察与动手探究。在这些经验的基础上，儿童可以从描述和解释所观察到的内容，进一步根据这些观察作出预测。

subject: Science
topic: Scientific Reasoning and the Physical World
en: I-SC1.1 Identify and describe objects on the basis of specific properties discerned through the five senses.
zh: I-SC1.1 根据通过五种感官辨识出的具体属性来识别和描述物体。

zh: I-SC1.2 说出身体部位的名称：手臂、耳朵、眼睛、脸、手指、脚、头发、手、头、腿、嘴、脖子、鼻子、肚子、脚趾（与 3LD-LA-D1B 和 3SD-AS-A3 目标相同）。

en:
Child: Oh, look—there are green things coming out of the dirt!

subject: Music
en: Overview: This section includes goals that focus both on listening to, enjoying, and appreciating music in all its various forms, as well as producing music. Experiences in listening to and singing songs and fingerplays also provide opportunities to practice oral language skills. Music affords the opportunity to expand and clarify various concepts, such as loud and soft, fast and slow, etc. In addition, efforts that focus attention on discriminating differences in discrete environmental or musical sounds facilitate subsequent attention to phonemic awareness, awareness of the discrete sounds of language. Group musical experiences, performing or singing together, also offer the opportunity to practice social skills. The basic goals of this section ask the child to listen to and identify sounds, indicate whether certain sound pairs are the same or different, imitate sounds and rhythm sequences, sing songs individually and with others, and move interpretatively to music.
zh: 概述：本节的目标既包括聆听、欣赏各种形式的音乐，也包括创作音乐。听歌、唱歌和做手指谣也为练习口语技能提供机会。音乐有助于扩展和澄清各种概念，如大声与小声、快与慢等。此外，把注意力集中在辨别不同的环境声音或音乐声音上，有助于日后发展音位意识，即意识到语言由离散的声音组成。集体音乐活动、共同表演或演唱，也提供练习社交技能的机会。本节的基本目标要求儿童聆听并识别声音，判断成对声音是否相同，模仿声音和节奏序列，单独和与他人一起唱歌，并随音乐进行表现性动作。

subject: Music
en: I-MU1.1 Identify the direction from which a sound originates.
zh: I-MU1.1 识别声音传来的方向。

subject: Music
en: I-MU1.2 Listen to and identify environmental sounds.
zh: I-MU1.2 聆听并识别环境中的声音。

subject: Music
en: I-MU1.3a Listen to pairs of sounds that are either identical or grossly different and indicate whether they are the same or different.
zh: I-MU1.3a 听成对的声音，判断它们是完全相同还是明显不同，并指出相同还是不同。

subject: Music
en: I-MU1.4 Indicate the number of sounds heard (up to four sounds).
zh: I-MU1.4 指出听到声音的数量（最多四个）。

subject: Music
en: I-MU2.1 Vocally or with musical instruments, produce sounds that are loud or soft and long or short according to verbal direction.
zh: I-MU2.1 用声音或乐器，根据口头指令发出响或轻、长或短的声音。

subject: Music
en: I-MU2.2 Vocally imitate isolated sounds produced by others, approximating intensity, duration and pitch.
zh: I-MU2.2 用声音模仿他人发出的孤立声音，近似地表现其强度、时长和音高。

subject: Music
en: II-MU1.3b Listen to pairs of sounds that are either identical or slightly different and indicate whether they are the same or different.
zh: II-MU1.3b 听成对的声音，判断它们是完全相同还是略有不同，并指出相同还是不同。

subject: Music
en: I-MU2.3a Imitate clapping pattern sequences of no more than three claps per pattern.
zh: I-MU2.3a 模仿拍手节奏序列，每个模式不超过三下拍手。

subject: Music
en: I-MU2.4a Use musical instruments or other objects to imitate a sequence of no more than a musical motif of three sounds made by a single instrument or object.
zh: I-MU2.4a 用乐器或其他物体模仿一段序列，不超过由单一乐器或物体发出的三声音乐动机。

subject: Music
en: I-MU2.5 Accompany a story or musical piece by introducing sound effects at the appropriate moment.
zh: I-MU2.5 在适当的时刻加入音效，为故事或乐曲伴奏。

subject: Music
en: I-MU3.1a Listen to, sing and perform children’s songs and fingerplays with others.
zh: I-MU3.1a 与他人一起聆听、演唱和表演儿童歌曲与手指谣。

subject: Music
en: I-MU3.2a Sing a musical dialogue in which two or more groups answer one another.
zh: I-MU3.2a 演唱音乐对话，由两组或两组以上互相应答。

subject: Music
en: I-MU4.1 Move to music individually, interpreting and modifying movements according to the tempo, intensity and rhythm.
zh: I-MU4.1 独自随音乐移动，根据速度、力度和节奏演绎并调整动作。

subject: Music
en: I-MU4.2 Move to music with a partner or group, performing very simple movements.
zh: I-MU4.2 与同伴或小组随音乐移动，做非常简单的动作。

subject: Music
en: II-MU2.3b Imitate clapping pattern sequences of at least four claps per pattern that vary in tempo, number, length of pause between claps, etc.
zh: II-MU2.3b 模仿拍手节奏序列，每个模式至少四下拍手，且在速度、次数、拍手间隔长短等方面有变化。

subject: Music
en:
Adult: Listen—I’m going to clap my hands—I’m going to make a clapping pattern. Listen carefully. When I finish, I’m going to ask you to try to copy it. (clap pattern)
Adult: Okay, I’m going to repeat the clapping pattern, but this time, you try to do it with me. (adult and child clap together)
Adult: Now I’m going to make a new clapping pattern. Listen carefully. When I finish, I will ask you to repeat it by yourself.
zh:
成人：听——我要拍手——我要拍出一个拍手节奏。仔细听。我拍完后，会请你试着跟着拍出来。（拍手节奏）
成人：好，我再把拍手节奏拍一遍，不过这次，你试着和我一起拍。（成人和儿童一起拍手）
成人：现在我要拍一个新的拍手节奏。仔细听。我拍完后，会请你自己重复一遍。

subject: Visual Arts
en: Overview: This section focuses not only on producing art, but also on examining and appreciating examples of various art forms. The use of various media and techniques provides rich opportunities for sensory exploration and manipulation, as well as the development of fine motor skills. In addition, through painting and drawing, children make their first attempts at graphic representation, a precursor to writing. The guided examination of works of art provides practice in focusing attention on visual detail, important for developing skill in discriminating visual differences in objects, images, print and letters, as well as appreciating basic elements of art. The further examination and discussion of works of art also afford rich opportunities for language development. The basic goals of this section ask children to attend to visual details, identify images that are the same or different, create both representational and nonrepresentational art using various media and techniques, create art in the style of a known artist and examine and talk about selected works of art, including their own creations.
zh: 概述：本节不仅关注创作艺术作品，也关注观察和欣赏各种艺术形式的作品。使用各种媒介和技术为感官探索、动手操作以及精细动作技能的发展提供丰富机会。此外，通过绘画，儿童首次尝试图形表征，这是书写的先兆。引导儿童观察艺术作品，有助于练习把注意力集中在视觉细节上；这对区分物体、图像、印刷文字和字母的视觉差异，以及欣赏艺术的基本要素都很重要。进一步观察和讨论艺术作品也为语言发展提供丰富机会。本节的基本目标要求儿童注意视觉细节，识别相同或不同的图像，使用各种媒介和技术创作具象和非具象艺术作品，以已知艺术家的风格创作，并观察、谈论包括自己作品在内的选定艺术作品。

subject: Visual Arts

zh: I-VA1.4a 观察一组物体，将其移开视线、改动后再呈现，识别不同之处，以展示对视觉细节的记忆。

zh: I-VA2.1 撕：使用各种工具和技术完成艺术作品。

subject: Visual Arts
en:
Adult: This is a picture of a sculpture that was created by the artist Edgar Degas. Can you tell me about this sculpture? What do you see?
Child: It’s a person.
Adult: Uh huh, it’s a sculpture of a person. What kind of person? Is it a man or woman? Or is it a girl or boy?
Child: It looks like a girl ‘cause she has a pony tail.
Adult: So it’s a sculpture of a girl. How is she dressed? Is she wearing regular clothes?
Child: No—she looks like she’s wearing a funny short skirt
Adult: Yes, she is. She’s wearing a special costume that’s used for dancing, etc.
zh:
成人：这是一张艺术家埃德加·德加创作的雕塑的图片。你能跟我说说这座雕塑吗？你看到了什么？
儿童：是一个人。
成人：嗯，是一座人物的雕塑。是什么样的人？是男人还是女人？还是女孩或男孩？
儿童：看起来像个女孩，因为她扎着马尾辫。
成人：所以是一座女孩的雕塑。她穿着什么？穿的是普通衣服吗？
儿童：不是——她看起来穿着一条滑稽的短裙。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Shortly after a baby is born, an amazingly complex, interactive communication process begins between the infant and others in his/her environment. While it may seem like an obvious statement, it is nonetheless worth making the point that listening and speaking are the primary means of communication throughout the early years of a young child’s development. It should be equally obvious that reading and writing competencies are predicated on competencies in listening and speaking. When a child enters kindergarten, however, traditional language arts instruction has typically accorded little, if any, attention to the ongoing development of children’s listening and speaking ability. We have acted as if listening and speaking competencies are fully and firmly established and can be left behind as reading and writing instruction begins. Nothing could be further from the truth. This omission in language arts instruction has been a serious oversight. We must remedy this oversight, deliberately elaborating and extending listening and speaking skills, while we simultaneously begin to introduce reading, and then writing. Children who are fortunate enough to participate in language arts instruction that recognizes the importance of continuing to build listening and speaking competency while also beginning reading and writing instruction will, in the end, be far more literate adults.
zh: 婴儿出生后不久，婴儿与其周围环境中的人之间就开始了极其复杂、互动的交流过程。虽然这似乎不言自明，但仍值得指出：在幼儿发展的早期岁月里，听和说是主要的交流方式。同样显而易见的是，读写能力建立在听说能力之上。然而，当孩子进入幼儿园时，传统的语言艺术教学通常很少甚至根本不关注儿童听说能力的持续发展。我们一直仿佛认为听说能力已经完全牢固地确立，可以在开始读写教学时抛在一边。事实再清楚不过并非如此。语言艺术教学中的这一遗漏是严重的疏忽。我们必须补救这一疏忽，有意地拓展和延伸听说技能，同时开始引入阅读，继而是写作。那些有幸参与语言艺术教学、既认识到在启动读写教学的同时继续培养听说能力的重要性、又开始读写教学的孩子，最终将成为文化素养高得多的成年人。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Recite a nursery rhyme, poem or song independently. C. Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—All Texts Teachers: Written text makes use of richer vocabulary and more complex syntax than conversational language. It is important that young children be exposed not only to the language of everyday conversation but also to the richer and more formal language of books. This can be done through frequent reading aloud. Helping young children develop the ability to listen to and understand written texts when they are read aloud must be an integral part of any initiative designed to build literacy. At the kindergarten level, a students’ ability to understand what they hear far outpaces their ability to independently read and understand written text. By listening to stories or nonfiction selections read aloud, students can experience the complexities of written language without expending cognitive energy on decoding; they can likewise access deeper and more complex content knowledge than they are presently able to read independently. Careful consideration should be given to the selection of books read aloud to ensure that the vocabulary and syntax presented is rich and complex. Leveled texts will not provide the rich language experience desired during read-alouds and should only be used as a starting point with students for whom English is a second language. Grade appropriate read-aloud selections for poetry and fiction are included in the Sequence. Nonfiction read-alouds should be selected on the basis of the history, science, music and visual art topics identified for kindergartners in the Core Knowledge Sequence, with emphasis on history and science read-alouds. It is strongly recommended that daily read-alouds focus on a single topic over a sustained period of time—about two weeks—rather than intermingling read-alouds on a variety of subjects. Careful consideration should be given to the order in which nonfiction read-alouds are presented to ensure that knowledge about a topic builds in a progressive and coherent way. Following any read-aloud, students should participate in rich, structured conversations with an adult in response to the written text that has been read aloud. In this way, they can begin to orally practice comparing, analyzing, and synthesizing ideas in written text in much the same way as they will be expected to do as independent readers in the later grades.
zh: 独立朗诵一首童谣、诗歌或歌曲。C. 朗读的理解与讨论——所有文本 教师：书面文本使用的词汇比会话语言更丰富，句法更复杂。重要的是，幼儿不仅要接触日常会话语言，还要接触书籍中更丰富、更正式的语言。这可以通过经常朗读来实现。帮助幼儿发展在书面文本被朗读时倾听并理解的能力，必须是任何旨在培养读写能力的举措的组成部分。在幼儿园阶段，学生理解所听到内容的能力远远超过他们独立阅读和理解书面文本的能力。通过听朗读的故事或非虚构作品，学生可以体验书面语言的复杂性，而不必把认知精力花在解码上；他们同样可以获取比自己目前独立阅读所能达到的更深、更复杂的内容知识。应仔细考虑朗读书籍的选择，确保所呈现的词汇和句法丰富而复杂。分级读物无法提供朗读所期望的丰富语言体验，只应作为英语为第二语言的学生的起点。与本序列中适合幼儿园的诗歌和虚构作品朗读选段已列入其中。非虚构类的朗读应根据《核心知识序列》中为幼儿园确定的历史、科学、音乐和视觉艺术主题来选，重点放在历史和科学的朗读上。强烈建议每日朗读在一段较长时间（约两周）内聚焦单一主题，而不是把各种主题的朗读混在一起。应仔细考虑非虚构类朗读的顺序……

zh: 倾听并理解各种朗读文本，包括虚构故事、童话、寓言、历史叙事、戏剧、说明性文本和诗歌。

subject: English Language Arts
section: Grasping Specific Details and Key Ideas

en: Describe illustrations.

subject: English Language Arts

en: Sequence four to six pictures illustrating events in a read-aloud.

subject: English Language Arts

en: Answer questions requiring literal recall and understanding of the details and/or facts of a read-aloud, i.e., who, what, where, when, etc.
zh: 回答需要字面回忆和理解朗读中细节和/或事实的问题，即“谁、什么、在哪里、什么时候”等。

subject: English Language Arts
section: Grasping Specific Details and Key Ideas
section_zh: 把握具体细节与关键思想
en: Retell key details.
zh: 复述关键细节。

subject: English Language Arts
section: Grasping Specific Details and Key Ideas
section_zh: 把握具体细节与关键思想
en: Ask questions to clarify information in a read-aloud.
zh: 通过提问来澄清朗读中的信息。

subject: English Language Arts
section: Grasping Specific Details and Key Ideas
section_zh: 把握具体细节与关键思想
en: Use narrative language to describe people, places, things, locations, events, actions, a scene or facts in a read-aloud.
zh: 使用叙事性语言描述朗读中的人物、地点、事物、位置、事件、动作、场景或事实。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Understand and use words and phrases heard in read-alouds.
zh: 理解并使用朗读中听到的词语和短语。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Compare and contrast similarities and differences within a single read-aloud or between two or more read-alouds.
zh: 比较和对照单次朗读内部或两次及以上朗读之间的异同。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Make personal connections to events or experiences in a read-aloud and/or make connections among several read-alouds.
zh: 把朗读中的事件或经历与个人建立联系，和/或在多次朗读之间建立联系。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Prior to listening to a read-aloud, identify what they know and have learned that may be related to the specific story or topic to be read aloud.
zh: 在听朗读之前，确认自己所知道的、可能与被朗读的具体故事或主题相关的内容。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Use pictures accompanying the read-aloud to check and support understanding of the read-aloud.
zh: 利用朗读所配的图片来检查和帮助理解朗读内容。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Make predictions prior to and during a read-aloud, based on the title, pictures, and/or text heard thus far and then compare the actual outcomes to predictions.
zh: 在朗读前和朗读过程中，根据标题、图片和/或目前已听到的文本作出预测，然后把实际结果与预测进行比较。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Answer questions that require making interpretations, judgments, or giving opinions about what is heard in a read-aloud, including answering “why” questions that require recognizing cause/effect relationships.
zh: 回答需要作出解释、判断或对朗读中所听内容发表看法的问题，包括回答需要识别因果关系的“为什么”问题。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Identify who is telling a story or providing information in a text.
zh: 识别文本中谁在讲故事或提供信息。

subject: English Language Arts
topic: Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—Fiction, Drama, and Poetry
en: Retell or dramatize a story, using narrative language to describe characters, setting(s), and a beginning, a middle and an end to events of the story in proper sequence.
zh: 复述或表演一个故事，用叙事性语言描述人物、背景，并按恰当顺序描述故事事件的开头、中间和结尾。

subject: English Language Arts
topic: Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—Fiction, Drama, and Poetry
en: Change some story events and provide a different story ending.
zh: 改动某些故事事件，并给出一个不同的故事结局。

subject: English Language Arts
topic: Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—Fiction, Drama, and Poetry
en: Create and tell an original story, using narrative language to describe characters, setting(s), and a beginning, a middle and an end to events of the story in proper sequence
zh: 创作并讲述一个原创故事，用叙事性语言描述人物、背景，并按恰当顺序描述故事事件的开头、中间和结尾

subject: English Language Arts
topic: Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—Fiction, Drama, and Poetry
en: Distinguish fantasy from realistic text in a story.
zh: 区分故事中的幻想情节与现实情节。

subject: English Language Arts
topic: Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—Fiction, Drama, and Poetry
en: Demonstrate understanding of literary language (e.g., author, illustrator, characters, setting, plot, dialogue, personification, simile, and metaphor) and use some of these terms in retelling stories or creating their own stories. E. Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—Nonfiction and Informational Text Teachers: Select nonfiction read-aloud topics from the kindergarten history, science, music, and visual arts topics, with emphasis on history and science.
zh: 展示对文学语言的理解（如作者、插画者、人物、背景、情节、对话、拟人、明喻和隐喻），并能在复述故事或创编自己的故事时使用其中一些术语。E. 朗读的理解与讨论——非虚构与信息类文本 教师：非虚构类朗读主题应从幼儿园的历史、科学、音乐、视觉艺术主题中选取，重点放在历史与科学上。

subject: English Language Arts
topic: Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—Fiction, Drama, and Poetry
en: Retell important facts and information from a nonfiction read-aloud.
zh: 复述非虚构类朗读材料中的重要事实和信息。

subject: English Language Arts
topic: Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—Fiction, Drama, and Poetry
en: With assistance, categorize and organize facts and information within a given topic.
zh: 在帮助下，将给定主题范围内的事实和信息分类整理。

subject: English Language Arts
topic: Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—Fiction, Drama, and Poetry
en: With assistance, create and interpret timelines and lifelines related to read-alouds.
zh: 在帮助下，制作并解读与朗读内容相关的时间线和生平线。

subject: English Language Arts
topic: Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—Fiction, Drama, and Poetry
en: Distinguish read-alouds that describe events that happened long ago from those that describe contemporary or current events
zh: 区分描述久远以前发生事件的朗读材料与描述当代或当前事件的朗读材料。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Demonstrate understanding that what is said can be written and that the writing system is a way of writing down sounds.
zh: 理解说出的话可以被写下来，文字系统就是把声音记录下来的一种方式。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Demonstrate understanding of directionality (left to right, return sweep, top to bottom, front to back).
zh: 理解书写方向（从左到右、换行回扫、从上到下、从前到后）。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Identify the parts of books and function of each part (front cover, back cover, title page, table of contents).
zh: 认识书的各部分及其功能（封面、封底、扉页、目录）。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Demonstrate correct book orientation by holding book correctly and turning pages.
zh: 能正确拿书并正确翻页，表现出正确的书本方向感。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Recognize that sentences in print are made up of separate words.
zh: 认识到印刷出来的句子是由一个个独立的词组成的。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Understand that words are separated by spaces.
zh: 理解词与词之间用空格分隔。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Distinguish letters, words, sentences, and stories.
zh: 区分字母、单词、句子和故事。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Demonstrate understanding of basic print conventions by tracking and following print word for word when listening to text read aloud.
zh: 听朗读时能逐词跟随并指读印刷文字，表现出对基本印刷惯例的理解。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Demonstrate understanding that the sequence of letters in a written word represents the sequence of sounds in the spoken word.
zh: 理解书写单词中字母的顺序代表口语单词中声音的顺序。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Recognize and name the twenty-six letters of the alphabet in both their upper-case and lower-case forms.
zh: 能识别并说出26个字母的大写和小写形式。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Say the letters of the alphabet in order, either in song or recitation
zh: 能用唱歌或背诵的方式按顺序说出字母表。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Identify environmental sounds, e.g., keys jingling, scissors cutting, clapping.
zh: 辨认环境中的声音，如钥匙叮当声、剪刀剪纸声、拍手声。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Identify whether pairs of environmental sounds are the same or different.
zh: 判断成对的环境声音是相同还是不同。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Count the number of environmental sounds heard, e.g., clapping, rhythm band instruments.
zh: 数出听到的环境声音的数量，如拍手声、节奏乐队乐器的声音。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Orally segment sentences into discrete words.
zh: 口头将句子切分成一个个独立的词。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Demonstrate understanding that words are made up of sequences of sounds.
zh: 理解单词是由一串声音组成的。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Demonstrate understanding that vowel sounds are produced with the mouth open and airflow unobstructed, whereas consonant sounds involve closing parts of the mouth and blocking the air flow.
zh: 理解元音是张口、气流不受阻碍发出的音，而辅音则需要闭合口腔的某些部位、阻断气流而发出。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Given a pair of spoken words, select the one that is longer (i.e., contains more phonemes).
zh: 给出一对口头说出的单词，选出较长的那个（即包含更多音素的那个）。

subject: English Language Arts
en: In riddle games, supply words that begin with a target phoneme.
zh: 在猜谜游戏中，说出以目标音素开头的单词。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Indicate whether a target phoneme is or is not present in the initial/medial/final position of a spoken word, e.g., hear /m/ at the beginning of mat and /g/ at the end of bag.
zh: 判断某个目标音素是否出现在口语单词的词首／词中／词尾，例如在 mat 的开头听到 /m/，在 bag 的结尾听到 /g/。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Listen to one-syllable words and tell the beginning or ending sounds, e.g., given dog, identify initial /d/ or final /g/.
zh: 听单音节词并说出其开头或结尾的音，例如给出 dog，能指出开头的 /d/ 或结尾的 /g/。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Recognize the same phoneme in different spoken words, e.g., /b/ in ball, bug, and big.
zh: 在不同的口语单词中识别相同的音素，如 ball、bug、big 中的 /b/。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Identify whether pairs of phonemes are the same or different, including pairs that differ only in voicing, e.g., /b/ and /p/.
zh: 判断成对的音素是相同还是不同，包括仅在清浊上不同的音素对，如 /b/ 和 /p/。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Orally blend two to three sounds to form a word, e.g., given the sounds /k/.../a/... /t/, blend to make cat.
zh: 口头把两到三个音拼合成一个单词，例如给出 /k/…/a/…/t/，拼成 cat。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Segment a spoken word into phonemes, e.g., given bat, produce the segments/b//a//t/.
zh: 把一个口语单词切分成音素，例如给出 bat，切分为 /b//a//t/。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Given a spoken word, produce another word that rhymes, e.g., given hit, supply bit or mitt.
zh: 给出一个口语单词，说出另一个与之押韵的词，例如给出 hit，说出 bit 或 mitt。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Identify the number of syllables in a spoken word
zh: 数出口语单词中的音节数量。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Learning to read requires understanding and mastering the written English code through explicit and systematic phonics instruction. Research suggests that phonics instruction is most effective when specific letter-sound relationships are taught and reinforced by having students both read and write the letter-sound correspondence being studied. Reading and writing—decoding and encoding—are complementary processes that ensure mastery of the written code.
zh: 学会阅读需要通过明确、系统的自然拼读教学来理解和掌握英语书面代码。研究表明，当教师教授具体的字母—音对应关系，并让学生对所学的字母—音对应进行读和写的练习来加以巩固时，自然拼读教学最为有效。阅读与写作——解码与编码——是相辅相成的过程，能确保学生掌握书面代码。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Demonstrate understanding that a systematic, predictable relationship exists between written letters (graphemes) and spoken sounds (phonemes).
zh: 理解书面字母（字素）与口语声音（音素）之间存在系统且可预测的关系。

subject: English Language Arts

subject: English Language Arts

zh: 理解有时两个或更多印刷字母代表一个音。

zh: 能读、写任意 CVC 单词（辅音—元音—辅音），如 sit 或 cat。

zh: 能读、写含有分离元音字母组合（元音加不发音的 e）的单词，如 late、bite、note、cute。

en: Read aloud, alone, or with a partner at least 15 minutes each day. E. Reading Comprehension—All Texts Teachers: It is important to recognize that kindergartners are taught only some of the many letter-sound correspondences a reader needs to know to read a wide range of printed material. As a result, many kindergartners will be able to read only the simplest written text independently. At this grade level, mental energy will be directed primarily to the act of reading, i.e., decoding. A focus on the mechanics of decoding is appropriate and desirable at this early stage in the reading process. In kindergarten, attention to reading comprehension should be directed to ensuring a fundamental understanding of what has been read. At this grade level, it will generally be more effective and efficient to devote time to higher level thinking and comprehension skills at the listening and speaking level in response to written texts that are read aloud.
zh: 每天独自或与同伴一起朗读至少15分钟。E. 阅读理解——所有文本 教师：要认识到，幼儿园孩子只学习了阅读大量印刷材料所需的众多字母—音对应关系中的一部分。因此，许多幼儿园孩子只能独立阅读最简单的书面文本。在这个年级阶段，脑力主要用于阅读行为本身，即解码。在阅读过程的这一早期阶段，重点关注解码技巧是恰当且可取的。在幼儿园，对阅读理解的关注应放在确保对所读内容有基本理解上。在这一年级阶段，通常把时间用于听和说层面的高阶思维与理解技能（针对朗读出来的书面文本）会更有效、更高效。

subject: English Language Arts
en: It is important to recognize that of all the communication skills—listening, speaking, reading, and writing—writing is the most demanding and challenging, especially for kindergartners who are just learning not only the code, but the fine motor skills and letter strokes necessary to put something down on paper. Kindergartners can, however, express themselves in writing by drawing pictures and, as they begin to learn some of the code, copying or writing words, phrases, and sentences. In addition, students can also participate in shared writing exercises modeled and scaffolded by an adult. The focus in shared writing should be on encouraging the students to verbally express themselves coherently and in complete sentences, as the teacher serves as a scribe.
zh: 要认识到，在听、说、读、写四项交流技能中，写是最难、最具挑战性的，对幼儿园孩子尤其如此——他们不仅刚在学习文字代码，还要学习把内容写到纸上所需的精细动作技能和字母笔画。不过，幼儿园孩子可以通过画画来进行书面表达；当他们开始掌握部分代码时，可以抄写或书写单词、短语和句子。此外，学生还可以参加由成人示范和搭建支架的共同写作活动。共同写作的重点应是鼓励学生用连贯、完整的句子口头表达自己，由教师充当记录者（执笔人）。

en: illustrator E. Sayings and Phrases Teachers: Every culture has phrases and proverbs that make no sense when carried over literally into another culture. For many students, this section may not be needed; they will have picked up these sayings by hearing them at home and among friends. But the sayings have been one of the categories most appreciated by teachers who work with students from home cultures that differ from the standard culture of literate American English. A dog is man’s best friend. April showers bring May flowers. Better safe than sorry Do unto others as you would have them do unto you. The early bird gets the worm. Great oaks from little acorns grow. Look before you leap A place for everything and everything in its place Practice makes perfect. \[It’s\] raining cats and dogs. Where there’s a will there’s a way. Note: Children will read more American folk heroes and tall tales in Grade 2.

subject: History and Geography
en: Teachers: In kindergarten, students often study aspects of the world around them: the family, the school, the community, etc. The following guidelines are meant to broaden and complement that focus. The goal of studying selected topics in World History in Kindergarten is to foster curiosity and the beginnings of understanding about the larger world outside the student’s locality, and about varied civilizations and ways of life. This can be done through a variety of means: story, drama, art, music, discussion, and more.
zh: 教师：在幼儿园，学生常常学习周围世界的各个方面：家庭、学校、社区等。以下指南旨在拓宽和补充这一重点。幼儿园学习世界历史中选定主题的目标，是培养孩子的好奇心，并初步理解其所在地区之外的广阔世界，以及各种文明和生活方式。这可以通过多种方式实现：故事、戏剧、艺术、音乐、讨论等等。

subject: History and Geography
topic: An Overview of the Seven Continents
en: Help students gain a beginning geographic vocabulary and a basic sense of how we organize and talk about the world by giving names to some of the biggest pieces of land. Introduce students to the seven continents through a variety of methods and media (tracing, coloring, relief maps, etc.), and associate the continents with familiar wildlife, landmarks, peoples, cultures, etc., for example, penguins in Antarctica; or the Eiffel Tower in Europe. Throughout the school year, reinforce names and locations of continents when potential connections arise in other disciplines, for example, connect Grimm’s fairy tales to Europe, the voyage of Pilgrims to Europe and North America the story of “Momotaro—Peach Boy” to Asia \[Japan\], or the study of Native Americans to North America.
zh: 帮助学生初步掌握地理词汇，并通过给最大的陆地命名来基本理解我们如何组织和谈论世界。通过多种方法和媒介（描摹、涂色、立体地图等）向学生介绍七大洲，并把各大洲与熟悉的野生动物、地标、民族和文化联系起来，例如南极洲的企鹅、欧洲的埃菲尔铁塔。在整个学年中，当其他学科出现可能的联系时，强化各大洲的名称和位置，例如把格林童话与欧洲联系起来，把清教徒的航行与欧洲和北美洲联系起来，把“桃太郎”的故事与亚洲（日本）联系起来，或把美洲原住民的研究与北美洲联系起来。

A more in-depth, chronological study of American history begins again in grade 3 and continues onward. The term “American” here generally, but not always, refers to the lands that became the United States. Other topics regarding North, Central, and South America may be found in the World History and Geography sections of this Sequence.

subject: History and Geography
en: Note: Discussing slavery with younger students is a very challenging task. Slavery, which has existed for thousands of years in many cultures, is by definition an inhumane practice—people are reduced to property, to be bought and sold, and often treated with brutality and violence. Classroom discussion of slavery should acknowledge its cruelty while remaining mindful of the age of the students. Note: No historical evidence exists to confirm Plymouth Rock as the Pilgrims’ steppingstone to the New World. In fact, it is believed that the Pilgrims first made landfall on the tip of Cape Cod in November 1620 before sailing to safer harbors in Plymouth the following month. William Bradford, and his fellow Mayflower passengers, made no written references to setting foot on a rock as they disembarked to start their settlement on a new continent.
zh: 注：与年幼学生讨论奴隶制是一项非常具有挑战性的任务。奴隶制在许多文化中已存在数千年，按其本质就是一种不人道的做法——人被贬为财产，可以被买卖，且常常遭受残暴对待和暴力。课堂上讨论奴隶制时，既要承认其残酷性，也要顾及学生的年龄。注：没有历史证据能够证实普利茅斯岩就是清教徒登陆新大陆的第一块踏脚石。事实上，人们认为清教徒于1620年11月首次在科德角尖端登陆，之后于次月驶往普利茅斯更安全的港口。威廉·布拉德福德和“五月花号”上的同行乘客，在登陆开辟新大陆的定居点时，并没有留下任何关于踏上某块岩石的文字记载。

subject: Mathematics
en: Teachers: Mathematics has its own vocabulary and patterns of thinking. It is a discipline with its own language and conventions. Thus, while some lessons may offer occasional opportunities for linking mathematics to other disciplines, it is critically important to attend to math as math. From the earliest years, mathematics requires incremental review and steady practice: not only the diligent effort required to master basic facts and operations, but also thoughtful and varied practice that approaches problems from a variety of angles, and gives children a variety of opportunities to apply the same concept or operation in different types of situations. While it is important to work toward the development of “higher-order problem-solving skills,” it is equally important—indeed, it is prerequisite to achieving “higher order” skills—to have a sound grasp of basic facts, and an automatic fluency with fundamental operations.
zh: 教师：数学有自己的词汇和思维方式，是一门拥有自身语言和规范的学科。因此，虽然有些课程偶尔会提供把数学与其他学科联系起来的机会，但把数学当作数学来对待至关重要。从最早年级起，数学就需要循序渐进的复习和持续的练习：既要付出努力掌握基本事实和运算，也要进行深思熟虑、形式多样的练习，从多种角度处理问题，并让孩子有各种机会在不同情境中运用同一概念或运算。虽然培养“高阶问题解决能力”很重要，但扎实掌握基本事实、对基本运算达到自动化熟练同样重要——事实上，这是达到“高阶”技能的前提。

subject: Science
en: Teachers: Effective instruction in science requires hands-on experience and observation. In the words of the report from the National Academies of Science, A Framework for K-12 Science Education, “...children entering kindergarten have surprisingly sophisticated ways of thinking about the world, based in part on their direct experiences with the physical environment such as watching objects fall or collide and observing plants and animals. They also learn about the world through everyday activities, such as talking with their families, pursuing hobbies, watching television, and playing with friends. As children try to understand and influence the world around them, they develop ideas about their role in that world and how it works. In fact, the capacity of young children—from all backgrounds and socioeconomic levels—to reason in sophisticated ways is much greater than has long been assumed. Although they may lack deep knowledge and extensive experience, they often engage in a wide range of subtle and complex reasoning about the world. Thus, before they even enter school, children have developed their own ideas about the physical, biological, and social worlds and how they work. By listening to and taking these ideas seriously, educators can build on what children already know and can do.”
zh: 教师：有效的科学教学需要动手体验和观察。正如美国国家科学院《K-12 科学教育框架》报告所说：“……刚进幼儿园的孩子，对世界有着出人意料复杂精细的思考方式，这部分源于他们对物理环境的直接体验，比如观看物体下落或碰撞、观察动植物。他们也通过日常活动认识世界，例如与家人交谈、发展爱好、看电视、和朋友玩耍。当孩子试图理解并影响周围世界时，他们会形成关于自己在其中的角色以及世界如何运作的想法。事实上，幼儿——无论来自何种背景、何种社会经济阶层——进行复杂推理的能力，远比长期以来人们所认为的要强得多。虽然他们可能缺乏深入的知识和丰富的经验，但他们常常会对世界进行各种细致而复杂的推理。因此，甚至在入学之前，儿童就已经对物理世界、生物世界和社会世界及其运作方式形成了自己的看法。通过倾听并认真对待这些想法，教育者可以在儿童已有知识和能力的基础上进行教学。”

zh: 大多数植物有茎、根和叶。

subject: Science
en: Animals are organisms.
zh: 动物是有机体。

subject: Science
en: There are many types of animals .
zh: 动物有很多种。

subject: Science
en: Animals have certain parts for certain functions (structure: exoskeleton or skeleton; movement: legs, fins, wings; nutrition: mouth, digestive tract; protection: fur, shell).
zh: 动物有特定的部位执行特定的功能（结构：外骨骼或骨骼；运动：腿、鳍、翅膀；营养：嘴、消化道；保护：皮毛、外壳）。

subject: Science
subtopic: Plants, Their Needs, and Their Environments
en: Plants need air, water, light, and space.
zh: 植物需要空气、水、光和空间。

subject: Science
subtopic: Plants, Their Needs, and Their Environments
en: Plants get what they need from their environment.
zh: 植物从环境中获取所需的一切。

subject: Science
subtopic: Plants, Their Needs, and Their Environments
en: Different types of plants live in different types of environments.
zh: 不同类型的植物生活在不同的环境中。

subject: Science
subtopic: Plants, Their Needs, and Their Environments
en: Plants make their own food using sunlight and air.
zh: 植物利用阳光和空气自己制造食物。

subject: Science
topic: Animals, Their Needs, and Their Environments
en: Animals need air, food, water, and shelter to survive.
zh: 动物需要空气、食物、水和栖息地才能生存。

subject: Science
topic: Animals, Their Needs, and Their Environments
en: Animals get what they need from their environments.
zh: 动物从环境中获取所需的一切。

subject: Science
topic: Animals, Their Needs, and Their Environments
en: Different types of animals live in different types of environments.
zh: 不同类型的动物生活在不同的环境中。

subject: Science
topic: Animals, Their Needs, and Their Environments
en: Animals get their food from eating other living things.
zh: 动物通过吃其他生物来获取食物。

subject: Science
topic: Humans, Their Needs, and Their Environments
en: Human beings are a type of animal.
zh: 人类是一种动物。

subject: Science
topic: Humans, Their Needs, and Their Environments
en: Humans need air, food, water, shelter to survive.
zh: 人类需要空气、食物、水和住所才能生存。

subject: Science
topic: Humans, Their Needs, and Their Environments
en: Humans get what they need from their environment.
zh: 人类从环境中获取所需的一切。

subject: Science
topic: Humans, Their Needs, and Their Environments
en: Humans are omnivores.
zh: 人类是杂食动物。

subject: Science
en: The emphasis in kindergarten should be on observation, description, and explanation of real world experiences of different environments and the exploration of how natural spaces can change over time. Technical explanations of ecological phenomena and human impacts on the environment should be taken up in later grades; see Grades 2, 3, and 5 for an increasingly more detailed study of Ecology:
zh: 幼儿园阶段的重点应是对不同环境的真实世界体验进行观察、描述和解释，并探索自然空间如何随时间变化。对生态现象及人类影响环境的技术性解释应留待更高年级；生态学日益详细的研究参见二、三、五年级：

subject: Science
en: Plants and animals live in environments that meet their needs.
zh: 动植物生活在能满足其需求的环境中。

subject: Science
en: habitats, ecosystems
zh: 栖息地、生态系统

subject: Science
en: Changes in environment affect the organisms that live there.
zh: 环境的变化会影响生活在那里的生物。

subject: Science
en: Plants, such as water hyacinth and kudzu, can change ecosystems, affecting the ability of other living things in the ecosystem to meet their own needs.
zh: 凤眼莲（水葫芦）和葛藤等植物会改变生态系统，影响生态系统中其他生物满足自身需求的能力。

subject: Science
en: Animals, such as the zebra mussel and the beaver, can change ecosystems, affecting the ability of other living things in the ecosystem to meet their own needs.
zh: 斑马贻贝和海狸等动物会改变生态系统，影响生态系统中其他生物满足自身需求的能力。

subject: Science
en: Humans can change ecosystems through roads, cities, pollution, etc. affecting the ability of other living things in the ecosystem to meet their own needs.
zh: 人类可以通过道路、城市、污染等改变生态系统，影响生态系统中其他生物满足自身需求的能力。

subject: Science
subtopic: People Design Solutions to Reduce Human Impact
en: People can make choices to reduce the amount of change they cause to ecosystems:
zh: 人们可以作出选择，减少自己对生态系统造成的改变：

subject: Science
subtopic: People Design Solutions to Reduce Human Impact
en: Sustainable farming, reforestation, recycling, and pollution reduction Collaborate with your fifth grade colleagues to connect this topic to learning in Grade 5, Protecting Earth’s Resources.
zh: 可持续农业、植树造林、资源回收和减少污染。请与五年级同事协作，将本主题与五年级《保护地球资源》的学习联系起来。

subject: Science
en: The sun is a star that lights the sky during the daytime.
zh: 太阳是一颗恒星，在白天照亮天空。

subject: Science
en: Sunlight warms Earth’s surface.
zh: 阳光使地球表面变暖。

subject: Science
en: Blocking sunlight reduces its warming effect on Earth’s surface and materials.
zh: 遮挡阳光会减弱其对地球表面和物体的升温作用。

subject: Science
en: Weather is what the air is like outside at any one time and place.
zh: 天气是指某一时间、某一地点外面的空气状况。

subject: Science
en: People collect and record weather data, such as temperature, rainfall, wind speed and direction, to reveal patterns.
zh: 人们收集和记录天气数据，如温度、降雨量、风速和风向，以揭示规律。

subject: Science
en: Seasons are repeating patterns of weather within the course of a year.
zh: 季节是一年之中反复出现的天气模式。

subject: Science
en: Weather can be severe and can cause damage, for example, thunder, lightning, heavy rain, high wind, tornadoes, hail, blizzards, hurricanes, drought, and heat waves.
zh: 天气可能很恶劣并造成破坏，例如雷、闪电、暴雨、大风、龙卷风、冰雹、暴风雪、飓风、干旱和热浪。

subject: Science
en: Looking at patterns in weather data helps people predict, or forecast, when severe weather will occur.
zh: 观察天气数据中的规律有助于人们预测（预报）恶劣天气何时出现。

subject: Science
topic: The Human Body: Our Five Senses
en: Vision is the ability to detect objects by light.
zh: 视觉是借助光察觉物体的能力。

subject: Science
topic: The Human Body: Our Five Senses
en: Eyes are the organs of vision.
zh: 眼睛是视觉器官。

subject: Science
topic: The Human Body: Our Five Senses
en: Hearing is the ability to detect sound.
zh: 听觉是察觉声音的能力。

subject: Science
topic: The Human Body: Our Five Senses
en: The ears are the organs of hearing.
zh: 耳朵是听觉器官。

subject: Science
topic: The Human Body: Our Five Senses
en: The senses of sight and hearing enable people to perform many important tasks.
zh: 视觉和听觉使人能够完成许多重要的任务。

subject: Science
topic: The Human Body: Our Five Senses
en: Corrective lenses and hearing aids may help with vision and hearing impairments.
zh: 矫正镜片和助听器有助于改善视力和听力障碍。

subject: Science
topic: The Human Body: Our Five Senses
en: Other ways to help those with impaired hearing or vision include sign language, assistive animals, and braille.
zh: 帮助听力或视力受损者的其他方式包括手语、辅助动物和盲文。

subject: Science
topic: The Human Body: Our Five Senses
en: The sense of smell is the ability to detect scent/odor.
zh: 嗅觉是察觉气味的能力。

subject: Science
topic: The Human Body: Our Five Senses
en: The nose is the organ of smell.
zh: 鼻子是嗅觉器官。

subject: Science
topic: The Human Body: Our Five Senses
en: The sense of taste is the ability to detect chemicals in the environment.
zh: 味觉是察觉环境中化学物质的能力。

subject: Science
topic: The Human Body: Our Five Senses
en: The taste buds enable a sense of taste.
zh: 味蕾使人产生味觉。

subject: Science
topic: The Human Body: Our Five Senses
en: The sense of touch is the ability to feel things in the environment.
zh: 触觉是感知环境中事物的能力。

subject: Science
topic: The Human Body: Our Five Senses
en: Nerves in the skin enable a sense of touch.
zh: 皮肤中的神经使人产生触觉。

subject: Science
en: Proper care of the body helps all senses to work most effectively.
zh: 适当照顾身体有助于各种感官最有效地发挥作用。

zh: 乔治·华盛顿·卡弗——利用植物造福人类

subject: English Language Arts
en: NOTE: The objectives listed in sections I–IV of Language Arts below are consistent with the Core Knowledge Language Arts program and embed all of the skills and concepts within the Common Core State Standards for English Language Arts.
zh: 注：以下语言艺术第 I—IV 节所列的目标与“核心知识语言艺术”课程一致，并涵盖了《共同核心州立标准》英语语言艺术中的全部技能和概念。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Traditional language arts instruction has typically accorded little, if any, attention to the ongoing development of children’s listening and speaking ability. This failure to focus on the development of oral language in language arts instruction has been a serious oversight. Literacy, the ability to read and write written language, is highly correlated with students’ oral language proficiency, and the ability to understand a text read aloud is a prerequisite for making sense of the same text in printed form. It is therefore essential that children build listening and speaking competency while also developing reading and writing skills.
zh: 传统的语言艺术教学通常很少甚至根本不关注儿童听说能力的持续发展。这种在语言艺术教学中忽视口语能力发展的做法是一个严重的疏漏。读写能力，即阅读和书写书面语言的能力，与学生的口语水平高度相关；而听懂朗读文本的能力，是理解同一印刷文本的前提。因此，儿童在发展读写技能的同时，必须培养听说能力。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Participate in age appropriate activities involving listening and speaking.
zh: 参加适合年龄的、涉及听和说的活动。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Speak clearly with volume appropriate to the setting.
zh: 说话清晰，音量适合场合。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Use agreed-upon rules for group discussions, i.e., look at and listen to the speaker, raise hand to speak, take turns, say “excuse me” or “please,” etc.
zh: 遵守约定的小组讨论规则，即：看着并倾听说话者、举手发言、轮流、说“打扰一下”或“请”等。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Ask questions to clarify conversations, directions, exercises, and/or classroom routines.
zh: 通过提问来澄清对话、指令、练习和/或课堂常规。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Carry on and participate in a conversation over at least six turns, staying on topic, initiating comments or responding to a partner’s comments, with either an adult or another child of the same age.
zh: 与成人或同龄儿童进行至少六个来回的对话，保持话题，主动发表意见或回应对方。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Identify and express physical sensations, mental states, and emotions of self and others.
zh: 识别并表达自己和他人的身体感觉、心理状态和情绪。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Understand and use language to express spatial and temporal relationships (up, down, first, last, before, after, etc.).
zh: 理解并使用语言表达空间和时间关系（上、下、第一、最后、以前、以后等）。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Understand and use narrative language to describe people, places, things, locations, events, actions.
zh: 理解并使用叙事性语言描述人物、地点、事物、位置、事件和动作。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Understand and use common sayings and phrases such as “Hit the nail on the head” and “Let the cat out of the bag.”
zh: 理解并使用常见谚语和短语，如“一针见血”（Hit the nail on the head）和“泄露秘密”（Let the cat out of the bag）。

zh: 听从多步骤的口头指令。

zh: 给出简单的指令。

zh: 给出简单的解释。

zh: 独立朗诵童谣、诗歌或唱歌，眼神交流、音量和吐字恰当。

zh: 就个人经历、感兴趣的话题和/或故事作口头陈述，眼神交流、音量和吐字恰当。

topic: Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—All Texts
en: Written text makes use of richer vocabulary and more complex syntax than conversational language. It is important that young children be exposed not only to the language of everyday conversation but also to the richer and more formal language of books.
zh: 书面文本使用的词汇比会话语言更丰富，句法更复杂。幼儿不仅应接触日常会话语言，也应接触书籍中更丰富、更正式的语言。

subject: English Language Arts
topic: Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—All Texts
en: Listen to and understand a variety of texts read aloud, including fictional stories, fairy tales, fables, historical narratives, drama, informational text, and poems.
zh: 听懂各种朗读文本，包括虚构故事、童话、寓言、历史叙述、戏剧、说明性文本和诗歌。

subject: English Language Arts
topic: Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—All Texts

zh: 区分以下文学体裁：小说、非虚构作品和戏剧。

subject: English Language Arts

zh: 在听朗读之前，找出自己已知的、可能与将要朗读的具体故事或主题相关的内容。

subject: English Language Arts

zh: 利用朗读配图检查和帮助理解朗读内容。

zh: 朗读前和朗读中根据标题、图片和/或已听到的文本进行预测，然后将实际结果与预测比较。
