zh: 回答有关非虚构文本细节的问题，并指出文本的哪一部分提供了回答特定问题所需的信息。

subject: English Language Arts
topic: Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—Fiction, Drama, and Poetry
en: With assistance, categorize and organize facts and information within a given topic.
zh: 在帮助下，将给定主题范围内的事实和信息分类整理。

subject: English Language Arts
topic: Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—Fiction, Drama, and Poetry
en: With assistance, create and interpret timelines and lifelines related to read-alouds.
zh: 在帮助下，制作并解读与朗读内容相关的时间线和生平线。

subject: English Language Arts
topic: Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—Fiction, Drama, and Poetry
en: Distinguish read-alouds that describe events that happened long ago from those that describe contemporary or current events.
zh: 区分描述很久以前发生的事件的朗读与描述当代或当前事件的朗读。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Demonstrate understanding that what is said can be written and that the writing system is a way of writing down sounds.
zh: 理解说出的话可以被写下来，文字系统就是把声音记录下来的一种方式。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Demonstrate understanding of directionality (left to right, return sweep, top to bottom, front to back).
zh: 理解书写方向（从左到右、换行回扫、从上到下、从前到后）。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Identify the parts of books and function of each part (front cover, back cover, title page, table of contents).
zh: 认识书的各部分及其功能（封面、封底、扉页、目录）。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Demonstrate correct book orientation by holding book correctly and turning pages.
zh: 能正确拿书并正确翻页，表现出正确的书本方向感。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Recognize that sentences in print are made up of separate words.
zh: 认识到印刷出来的句子是由一个个独立的词组成的。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Understand that words are separated by spaces.
zh: 理解词与词之间用空格分隔。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Distinguish letters, words, sentences, and stories.
zh: 区分字母、单词、句子和故事。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Demonstrate understanding of basic print conventions by tracking and following print word for word when listening to text read aloud.
zh: 听朗读时能逐词跟随并指读印刷文字，表现出对基本印刷惯例的理解。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Demonstrate understanding that the sequence of letters in a written word represents the sequence of sounds in the spoken word.
zh: 理解书写单词中字母的顺序代表口语单词中声音的顺序。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Recognize and name the 26 letters of the alphabet in both their upper-case and lower-case forms.
zh: 识别并说出字母表中 26 个字母的大写和小写形式。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Say the letters of the alphabet in order, either in song or recitation. B. Phonemic Awareness
zh: 以唱歌或背诵的方式按顺序说出字母表。B. 音素意识

subject: English Language Arts
en: Demonstrate understanding that words are made up of sequences of sounds.
zh: 理解单词是由一串声音组成的。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Demonstrate understanding that vowel sounds are produced with the mouth open and airflow unobstructed, whereas consonant sounds involve closing parts of the mouth and blocking the air flow.
zh: 理解元音是张口、气流不受阻碍发出的音，而辅音则需要闭合口腔的某些部位、阻断气流而发出。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Given a pair of spoken words, select the one that is longer (i.e., contains more phonemes).
zh: 给出一对口头说出的单词，选出较长的那个（即包含更多音素的那个）。

subject: English Language Arts
en: In riddle games, supply words that begin with a target phoneme.
zh: 在猜谜游戏中，说出以目标音素开头的单词。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Indicate whether a target phoneme is or is not present in the initial/medial/final position of a spoken word, e.g., hear /m/ at the beginning of mat and /g/ at the end of bag.
zh: 判断某个目标音素是否出现在口语单词的词首／词中／词尾，例如在 mat 的开头听到 /m/，在 bag 的结尾听到 /g/。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Listen to one-syllable words and tell the beginning or ending sounds, e.g., given dog, identify initial /d/ or final /g/.
zh: 听单音节词并说出其开头或结尾的音，例如给出 dog，能指出开头的 /d/ 或结尾的 /g/。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Recognize the same phoneme in different spoken words, e.g., /b/ in ball, bug, and big.
zh: 在不同的口语单词中识别相同的音素，如 ball、bug、big 中的 /b/。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Identify whether pairs of phonemes are the same or different, including pairs that differ only in voicing, e.g., /b/ and /p/.
zh: 判断成对的音素是相同还是不同，包括仅在清浊上不同的音素对，如 /b/ 和 /p/。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Orally blend two to three sounds to form a word, e.g., given the sounds /k/... /a/.../t/, blend to make cat.
zh: 口头把两三个音拼合成一个词，例如给出 /k/…/a/…/t/，拼成 cat。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Segment a spoken word into phonemes, e.g., given bat, produce the segments/b//a//t/.
zh: 把一个口语单词切分成音素，例如给出 bat，切分为 /b//a//t/。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Given a spoken word, produce another word that rhymes, e.g., given hit, supply bit or mitt.
zh: 给出一个口语单词，说出另一个与之押韵的词，例如给出 hit，说出 bit 或 mitt。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Identify the number of syllables in a spoken word.
zh: 识别口头单词中的音节数量。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Learning to read requires understanding and mastering the written English code through explicit and systematic phonics instruction. Research suggests that phonics instruction is most effective when specific letter-sound relationships are taught and reinforced by having students both read and write the letter-sound correspondence being studied. Reading and writing—decoding and encoding—are complementary processes that ensure mastery of the written code.
zh: 学会阅读需要通过明确、系统的自然拼读教学来理解和掌握英语书面代码。研究表明，当教师教授具体的字母—音对应关系，并让学生对所学的字母—音对应进行读和写的练习来加以巩固时，自然拼读教学最为有效。阅读与写作——解码与编码——是相辅相成的过程，能确保学生掌握书面代码。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Demonstrate understanding that a systematic, predictable relationship exists between written letters (graphemes) and spoken sounds (phonemes).
zh: 理解书面字母（字素）与口语声音（音素）之间存在系统且可预测的关系。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Blend individual phonemes to pronounce printed words.
zh: 把单个音素拼合起来，读出印刷的单词。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Understand that sometimes two or more printed letters stand for a single sound.
zh: 理解有时两个或更多印刷字母代表一个音。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Read one to two syllable words containing any of the grapheme-phoneme correspondences listed below.
zh: 读含有一到两个音节、包含下列任一字素—音素对应关系的单词。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Read and write words with inflectional endings, i.e., -s, -ed, -ing, -er, -est.
zh: 读写带有屈折词尾的单词，即 -s、-ed、-ing、-er、-est。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Read, understand, and write contractions, i.e., isn’t, I’m, can’t, etc.
zh: 读写并理解缩写形式，如 isn’t、I’m、can’t 等。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Sort and classify words according to the spelling used to represent a specific phoneme.
zh: 根据表示特定音素的拼写对单词进行分类。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Read tricky spellings that can be sounded two ways, e.g., the letter ‘s’ sounded /s/ as in cats and /z/ as in dogs.
zh: 能读有两种读音的棘手拼写，例如字母 s 在 cats 中读 /s/，在 dogs 中读 /z/。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Read and spell chains of one-syllable words in which one sound is added, substituted, or omitted, i.e., read at > cat > bat > bad > bid.
zh: 读写单音节词链，其中一个音被添加、替换或省略，例如读 at > cat > bat > bad > bid。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Read at least 30 words generally identified as high frequency words. Consonant Sounds and Spellings Taught in First Grade /b/ spelled ‘b’ as in boy, ‘bb’; as in tubby /d/ spelled ‘d’ as in dog, ‘dd’ as in madder, ‘ed’ as in filled /f/ spelled ‘f’ as in fun, ‘ff’ as in stuff /g/ spelled ‘g’ as in get, ‘gg’ as in egg /h/ spelled ‘h’ as in him /j/ spelled ‘j’ as in jump, ‘g’ as in gem, ‘ge’ as in fringe /k/ spelled ‘c’ as in cat, ‘k’ as in kitten, ‘ck’ as in sick, ‘cc’ as in moccasin Vowel Sounds and Spellings Taught in First Grade /a/ spelled ‘a’ as in cat /e/ spelled ‘e’ as in get /i/ spelled ‘i’ as in hit /o/ spelled ‘o’ as in hot /u/ spelled ‘u’ as in but /ae/ spelled ‘a\_e’ as in cake, ‘ai’ as in wait, ‘ay’ as in day, ‘a’ as in paper /ee/ spelled ‘ee’ as in bee, ‘e’ as in me, ‘y’ as in funny, ‘ea’ as in beach, ‘e\_e’ as in Pete, ‘ie’ as in cookie /ie/ spelled ‘i\_e’ as in bike, ‘i’ as in biting, ‘y’ as in try, ‘ie’ as in tie, ‘igh’ as in night /oe/ spelled ‘o\_e’ as in note, ‘oa’ as in boat, ‘oe’ as in toe, ‘o’ as in open, ‘ow’ as in snow /ue/ spelled ‘u\_e’ as in cute /aw/ spelled ‘aw’ as in paw /oo/ spelled ‘oo’ as in look, /oo/ spelled ‘oo’ as in soon /ou/ spelled ‘ou’ as in shout /oi/ spelled ‘oi’ as in oil /er/ spelled ‘er’ as in her /ar/ spelled ‘ar’ as is car /or/ spelled ‘or’ as in for
zh: 至少认读 30 个通常被认定为高频词的单词。一年级教授的辅音与拼写：/b/ 拼作“b”（如 boy）、“bb”（如 tubby）；/d/ 拼作“d”（如 dog）、“dd”（如 madder）、“ed”（如 filled）；/f/ 拼作“f”（如 fun）、“ff”（如 stuff）；/g/ 拼作“g”（如 get）、“gg”（如 egg）；/h/ 拼作“h”（如 him）；/j/ 拼作“j”（如 jump）、“g”（如 gem）、“ge”（如 fringe）；/k/ 拼作“c”（如 cat）、“k”（如 kitten）、“ck”（如 sick）、“cc”（如 moccasin）。一年级教授的元音与拼写：/a/ 拼作“a”（如 cat）；/e/ 拼作“e”（如 get）；/i/ 拼作“i”（如 hit）；/o/ 拼作“o”（如 hot）；/u/ 拼作“u”（如 but）；/ae/ 拼作“a_e”（如 cake）、“ai”（如 wait）、“ay”（如 day）、“a”（如 paper）；/ee/ 拼作“ee”（如 bee）、“e”（如 me）、“y”（如 funny）、“ea”（如 beach）、“e_e”（如 Pete）、“ie”（如 cookie）；/ie/ 拼作“i_e”（如 bike）、“i”（如 biting）、“y”（如 try）、“ie”（如 tie）、“igh”（如 night）；/oe/ 拼作“o_e”（如 note）、“oa”（如 boat）、“oe”（如 toe）、“o”（如 open）、“ow”（如 snow）；/ue/ 拼作“u_e”（如 cute）；/aw/ 拼作“aw”（如 paw）；/oo/ 拼作“oo”（如 look），/oo/ 拼作“oo”（如 soon）；/ou/ 拼作“ou”（如 shout）；/oi/ 拼作“oi”（如 oil）；/er/ 拼作“er”（如 her）；/ar/ 拼作“ar”（如 car）；/or/ 拼作“or”（如 for）。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Read decodable stories that incorporate the specific code knowledge that has been taught.
zh: 阅读包含已教授的特定拼写解码知识的可解码故事。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Demonstrate increased accuracy, fluency, and expression on successive reading of a decodable text (50 wpm by the end of the year).
zh: 在反复朗读可解码文本时表现出更高的准确性、流利度和表现力（到学年末达到每分钟 50 词）。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Use phonics skills in conjunction with context to confirm or self-correct word recognition and understanding, rereading as necessary.
zh: 结合自然拼读技巧与上下文来确认或自我纠正字词识别和理解，必要时重读。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Demonstrate understanding of and use of commas and end punctuation while reading orally.
zh: 在口头朗读时理解并使用逗号和句末标点。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Read aloud, alone, or with a partner at least 15 minutes each day. E. Reading Comprehension—All Texts Teachers: During the beginning of first grade, most students will still need to devote considerable energy when reading to deciphering the written text. Over the course of this year, they will learn even more elements of the code, meaning that the decodable texts that they can read independently will increasingly resemble “real stories” and trade books. With practice and repeated readings of the same text, students will develop increasing automaticity, allowing them to focus more intently on the meaning of what they are reading. Both of these factors, i.e., the student’s increasing fluency and the use of more authentic text—which is now decodable because of the student’s increasing code knowledge—mean that attention to reading comprehension can move to a higher level than just the rudimentary understanding of text expected at the kindergarten level. This expectation is reflected in the increased number of objectives below that have been added to the kindergarten level objectives. However, it is important to remember that listening comprehension still far exceeds reading comprehension and that children’s ability to talk about what they have heard and/or read will exceed their ability to demonstrate that understanding in writing.
zh: 每天独自或与同伴一起朗读至少 15 分钟。E. 所有文本的理解 教师：在一年级刚开始时，大多数学生在阅读时仍需把大量精力用于解码书面文本。在这一年中，他们将学习更多的代码要素，因此他们能独立阅读的可解码文本将越来越接近“真正的故事”和通俗读物。通过练习和反复阅读同一文本，学生的自动化程度会不断提高，从而能更专注地理解所读内容。这两个因素——学生流利度的提高以及更真实文本的使用（由于学生代码知识的增加而变得可解码）——意味着对阅读理解的要求可以提升到高于幼儿园阶段所期望的对文本的基本理解。这一点反映在下面目标数量的增加上，这些目标是在幼儿园目标基础上新增的。但重要的是要记住，听力理解仍然远超阅读理解，儿童谈论所听和/或所读内容的能力将超过他们以书写形式展示这种理解的能力。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Demonstrate understanding of completely decodable text after reading independently.
zh: 独立阅读后理解完全可解码的文本。

subject: English Language Arts
section: Grasping Specific Details and Key Ideas
section_zh: 把握具体细节与核心观点
en: Sequence four to six pictures illustrating events from a text that has been read independently.
zh: 将四到六幅描绘独立阅读文本中事件的图片排序。

subject: English Language Arts
section: Grasping Specific Details and Key Ideas
section_zh: 把握具体细节与核心观点
en: Answer questions requiring literal recall and understanding of the details and/or facts (i.e., who, what, where, when, etc.) about a text that has been read independently.
zh: 回答需要直接回忆并理解所读文本细节和／或事实的问题（如谁、什么、哪里、何时等）。

subject: English Language Arts
section: Grasping Specific Details and Key Ideas
section_zh: 把握具体细节与核心观点
en: Retell key details from a text that has been read independently.
zh: 复述独立阅读文本中的关键细节。

subject: English Language Arts
section: Grasping Specific Details and Key Ideas
section_zh: 把握具体细节与核心观点
en: Ask questions to clarify information about a text that has been read independently.
zh: 通过提问弄清独立阅读文本中的信息。

subject: English Language Arts
section: Grasping Specific Details and Key Ideas
section_zh: 把握具体细节与核心观点
en: Use narrative language to describe people, places, things, locations, events, actions, a scene or facts from a text that has been read independently.
zh: 用叙述性语言描述独立阅读的文本中的人物、地点、事物、场所、事件、动作、场景或事实。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Identify basic text features and what they mean, including title, table of contents, and chapters.
zh: 识别基本的文本特征及其含义，包括标题、目录和章节。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Understand and use words and phrases from a text that has been read independently.
zh: 理解并使用独立阅读的文本中的单词和短语。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Compare and contrast similarities and differences within a single text or between multiple texts read independently.
zh: 比较和对比单篇文本内或多篇独立阅读文本之间的异同。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Make personal connections to events or experiences in a text that has been read independently and/or make connections among several texts that have been read independently.
zh: 将个人经历与独立阅读文本中的事件或体验联系起来，和/或在多篇独立阅读文本之间建立联系。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Prior to reading, identify what they know and have learned that may be related to the specific story or topic to be read.
zh: 阅读前，说出自己已知和已学的、可能与将要读的故事或主题相关的内容。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Use pictures accompanying the written text to check and support understanding.
zh: 利用随文配图来检验和帮助理解。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Make predictions prior to and while reading, based on the title, pictures, and/or text read thus far and then compare the actual outcomes to predictions.
zh: 阅读前和阅读中根据标题、图片和／或已读到的文本做出预测，然后把实际结果与预测进行比较。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Answer questions that require making interpretations, judgments, or giving opinions about what is read independently, including answering “why” questions that require recognizing cause/effect relationships.
zh: 回答需要对独立阅读内容作出解读、判断或发表看法的问题，包括需要识别因果关系的“为什么”类问题。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Identify who is telling a story or providing information in a text.
zh: 识别文本中是谁在讲故事或提供信息。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Identify temporal words that link and sequence events, i.e., first, next, then, etc.
zh: 识别连接和排序事件的时间词，即首先、接着、然后等。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Identify words that link ideas, i.e., for example, also, in addition.
zh: 识别连接观点的词，例如“例如”“也”“此外”。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Retell or dramatize a story, using narrative language to describe characters, setting(s), and a beginning, a middle and an end to events of the story in proper sequence.
zh: 用叙述性语言复述或表演故事，描述人物、场景，并按正确顺序讲出故事的开头、中间和结局。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Compare and contrast characters from different stories.
zh: 比较和对比不同故事中的人物。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Change some story events and provide a different story ending.
zh: 改动故事中的某些情节，给出不同的故事结局。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Distinguish fantasy from realistic text in a story.
zh: 区分故事中的幻想内容与现实内容。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Identify the moral or lesson of a fable, folktale, or myth.
zh: 找出寓言、民间故事或神话的寓意或教训。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Demonstrate understanding of literary language (e.g., author, illustrator, characters, setting, plot, dialogue, personification, simile, and metaphor) and use some of these terms in retelling stories or creating their own stories.
zh: 理解文学语言（如作者、插画家、人物、场景、情节、对话、拟人、明喻和暗喻），并在复述故事或创作自己的故事时使用其中一些术语。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Identify sensory language and how it is used to describe people, objects, places and events. G. Reading Comprehension—Nonfiction and Informational Text Teachers: Select nonfiction topics from the first grade history, science, music and visual arts topics listed on pages 35–47, with emphasis on history and science.
zh: 识别感官语言及其如何用于描述人物、物体、地点和事件。G. 阅读理解——非虚构与说明性文本 教师：从第 35–47 页列出的一年级历史、科学、音乐和视觉艺术主题中选择非虚构主题，重点为历史和科学。

subject: English Language Arts
en: With assistance, create and interpret timelines and lifelines related to text read independently.
zh: 在帮助下，制作并解读与独立阅读文本相关的时间线和生命线。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Distinguish text that describes events that happened long ago from text that describes contemporary or current events.
zh: 区分描述很久以前发生的事件的文本与描述当代或当前事件的文本。

subject: English Language Arts
en: It is important to recognize that of all the communication skills—listening, speaking, reading, and writing—writing is the most demanding and challenging. During the beginning of first grade, students still need to devote much of their focus and cognitive energy to the code itself, as well as the fine motor act of writing. During this period, teachers should continue to support written expression through shared writing experiences that are modeled and scaffolded by an adult.
zh: 重要的是要认识到，在所有交流技能——听、说、读、写——中，写是最难、最具挑战性的。在一年级刚开始时，学生仍需把大量注意力和认知精力放在代码本身以及书写的精细动作上。在此期间，教师应通过成人示范和搭建支架的共同写作活动，继续支持书面表达。

subject: English Language Arts
section: Writing to Reflect Audience, Purpose and Task
section_zh: 写作要体现读者对象、目的和任务
en: Add details to writing
zh: 为写作添加细节

subject: English Language Arts
section: Writing to Reflect Audience, Purpose and Task
section_zh: 写作要体现读者对象、目的和任务
en: Begin to use tools, including technology, to plan, draft, and edit writing
zh: 开始使用工具（包括技术）来构思、起草和修改写作

subject: English Language Arts
en: Gather information from experiences or provided text sources.
zh: 从经历或提供的文本来源中收集信息。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Write or retell a story that includes characters, setting(s), and a beginning, a middle and an end to events of the story in proper sequence.
zh: 写或复述一个故事，包含人物、场景，并按正确顺序描述故事的开头、中间和结尾。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Write a descriptive paragraph using sensory language.
zh: 用感官语言写一段描述性文字。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Create a title and an ending that are relevant to the narrative. B. Informative/Explanatory Writing
zh: 创作一个与叙事相关的标题和结尾。B. 说明/解释性写作

en: theater, stage, audience E. Sayings and Phrases Teachers: Every culture has phrases and proverbs that make no sense when carried over literally into another culture. For many students, this section may not be needed; they will have picked up these sayings by hearing them at home and among friends. But the sayings have been one of the categories most appreciated by teachers who work with students from home cultures that differ from the standard culture of literate American English. a.m. and p.m. An apple a day keeps the doctor away. Do unto others as you would have them do unto you. \[also in Kindergarten\] Fish out of water Hit the nail on the head. If at first you don’t succeed, try, try again. Land of Nod Let the cat out of the bag. The more the merrier Never leave till tomorrow what you can do today. Practice makes perfect. \[also in Kindergarten\] Sour grapes There’s no place like home. Wolf in sheep’s clothing Note: Students should learn terms relating to drama as part of their participation in a play appropriate for first graders—possibly a dramatized version of one of the stories listed above.
zh: 戏剧、舞台、观众 E. 谚语与短语 教师：每种文化都有一些按字面直译到另一种文化中就讲不通的短语和谚语。对许多学生来说，这一节可能没有必要；他们已经在家中和朋友之间听到这些说法而学会了。但对于来自与标准美国英语读写文化不同的家庭文化的学生，这些谚语一直是教师最欣赏的类别之一。a.m.（上午）和 p.m.（下午）；An apple a day keeps the doctor away.（一天一苹果，医生远离我。）；Do unto others as you would have them do unto you.（己所不欲，勿施于人。）\[幼儿园也有\]；Fish out of water（如鱼离水，形容不自在）；Hit the nail on the head.（一针见血。）；If at first you don’t succeed, try, try again.（如果一开始没成功，就再试、再试。）；Land of Nod（梦乡）；Let the cat out of the bag.（泄露秘密。）；The more the merrier（人越多越热闹）；Never leave till tomorrow what you can do today.（今日事今日毕。）；Practice makes perfect.（熟能生巧。）\[幼儿园也有\]；Sour grapes（酸葡萄）；There’s no place like home.（没有比家更好的地方。）；Wolf in sheep’s clothing（披着羊皮的狼）。注：学生应通过参加适合一年级的戏剧演出——可能是上面所列某个故事的改编剧本——来学习与戏剧相关的术语。

subject: History and Geography
en: Teachers: In first grade, students often study aspects of the world around them: the family, the school, the community, etc. The following guidelines are meant to broaden and complement that focus. The goal of studying selected topics in World History in first grade is to foster curiosity and the beginnings of understanding about the larger world outside the child’s locality, and about varied civilizations and ways of life. This can be done through a variety of means: story, drama, art, music, discussion, and more.
zh: 教师：一年级时，学生常常学习周围世界的各个方面：家庭、学校、社区等。以下指南旨在拓宽和补充这一重点。一年级学习世界历史中选定主题的目标，是培养孩子的好奇心，并初步理解其所在地区之外的广阔世界，以及各种文明和生活方式。这可以通过多种方式实现：故事、戏剧、艺术、音乐、讨论等等。

en: Since religion is a shaping force in the story of civilization, the Core Knowledge Sequence introduces students in the early grades to major world religions, beginning with a focus on geography and major symbols and figures. The purpose is not to explore matters of theology but to provide a basic vocabulary for understanding many events and ideas in history. The goal is to familiarize, not proselytize; to be descriptive, not prescriptive. The tone should be one of respect and balance: no religion should be disparaged by implying that it is a thing of the past. To the question, “Which one is true?” an appropriate response is: “People of different faiths believe different things to be true. The best people to guide you on this right now are your parents or someone at home.”
zh: 由于宗教是文明故事中一股塑造性的力量，核心知识序列在低年级向学生介绍世界主要宗教，首先从地理和主要象征与人物入手。目的不是探讨神学问题，而是提供理解历史上许多事件和思想的基本词汇。目标是让学生熟悉而非传教，是描述而非规定。语气应尊重且平衡：不应暗示任何宗教是过去的事物而贬低它。对于“哪一个才是真的？”这一问题，恰当的回答是：“不同信仰的人相信不同的事物为真。眼下最能引导你的是你的父母或家里的长辈。”

en: Teachers: The study of American history begins in grades K–2 with a brief overview of major events and figures, from the earliest days to recent times. A more in-depth, chronological study of American history begins again in Grade 3 and continues onward. en: Pocahontas and Powhatan Archaeological discoveries in North and South America, dating back 14,000 to 15,000 years, show that humans arrived on the continent 1,000 or even 2,000 years earlier than previously believed. According to a new theory, known as “Kelp Highway,” massive ice sheets covering western North America retreated allowing the first humans to arrive on the continent not only by foot but by boat. They traveled down the Pacific shore and subsisted on abundant coastal resources. Note: Early exploration and the colonial years will be studied in greater depth and detail in Grade 3. First grade teachers should examine the Grade 3 guidelines to see how these topics build in the later grades.
zh: 波卡洪塔斯与波瓦坦 考古发现表明，北美和南美的考古遗迹可追溯到 14000 至 15000 年前，这说明人类到达该大陆的时间比此前认为的早 1000 甚至 2000 年。根据一种被称为“海藻高速路”的新理论，覆盖北美西部的巨大冰盖消退，使最早的人类不仅可以通过步行、还可以乘船到达该大陆。他们沿着太平洋海岸航行，依靠丰富的沿海资源生存。注：早期探索和殖民时期将在三年级进行更深入、详细的学习。一年级教师应查阅三年级指南，了解这些主题如何在更高年级逐步展开。

subject: Mathematics
en: Teachers: Mathematics has its own vocabulary and patterns of thinking. It is a discipline with its own language and conventions. Thus, while some lessons may offer occasional opportunities for linking mathematics to other disciplines, it is critically important to attend to math as math. From the earliest years, mathematics requires incremental review and steady practice: not only the diligent effort required to master basic facts and operations, but also thoughtful and varied practice that approaches problems from a variety of angles, and gives students a variety of opportunities to apply the same concept or operation in different types of situations. While it is important to work toward the development of “higher-order problem-solving skills,” it is equally important—indeed, it is prerequisite to achieving “higher order” skills—to have a sound grasp of basic facts, and an automatic fluency with fundamental operations.
zh: 教师须知：数学有其自身的词汇和思维方式，是一门有自己语言和规范的学科。因此，虽然有些课程偶尔可以把数学与其他学科联系起来，但把数学当作数学来讲至关重要。从最初几年起，数学就需要循序渐进的复习和持续练习：既要努力掌握基本事实和运算，也要进行深思熟虑、形式多样的练习，从多种角度处理问题，让学生在不同类型的情境中多次运用同一概念或运算。虽然培养“高阶解题技能”很重要，但牢固掌握基本事实、对基本运算达到自动化熟练程度同样重要——事实上，这是达到“高阶”技能的前提。

subject: Science
en: Teachers: Effective instruction in science requires hands-on experience and observation. In the words of the report from the National Academies of Science, A Framework for K-12 Science Education, “...children have surprisingly sophisticated ways of thinking about the world, based in part on their direct experiences with the physical environment, such as watching objects fall or collide and observing plants and animals. They also learn about the world through everyday activities, such as talking with their families, pursuing hobbies, watching television, and playing with friends. As children try to understand and influence the world around them, they develop ideas about their role in that world and how it works. In fact, the capacity of young children—from all backgrounds and socioeconomic levels—to reason in sophisticated ways is much greater than has long been assumed. Although they may lack deep knowledge and extensive experience, they often engage in a wide range of subtle and complex reasoning about the world. Thus, before they even enter school, children have developed their own ideas about the physical, biological, and social worlds and how they work. By listening to and taking these ideas seriously, educators can build on what children already know and can do.”
zh: 教师须知：有效的科学教学需要动手体验和观察。用美国国家科学院报告《K-12 科学教育框架》的话来说：“……孩子们以令人惊讶的复杂方式思考世界，这部分基于他们对物质环境的直接体验，比如观看物体下落或碰撞、观察动植物。他们也通过日常活动了解世界，比如与家人交谈、从事爱好、看电视、和朋友玩耍。当孩子们试图理解和影响周围的世界时，他们会形成关于自己在世界中的角色以及世界如何运作的想法。事实上，幼儿——无论来自何种背景、何种社会经济水平——进行复杂推理的能力远超长期以来的设想。尽管他们可能缺乏深入知识和丰富经验，但他们常常对世界进行广泛而细致的复杂推理。因此，甚至在入学之前，孩子们就已经对物理、生物和社会世界及其运作方式形成了自己的想法。通过倾听并认真对待这些想法，教育者可以在儿童已有知识和能力的基础上进行教学。”

subject: Science
en: Through reading aloud, observation, and activities such as describing how the moon appears to change at different times of the month, explore the following with students:

subject: Science
subtopic: The Sun and Its Predictable Patterns
en: The sun is a star.
zh: 太阳是一颗恒星。

subject: Science
subtopic: The Sun and Its Predictable Patterns

zh: 地球从太阳获得光和热（热能）。

subject: Science
subtopic: The Sun and Its Predictable Patterns
en: An Earth day (daytime and night together) is twenty-four hours.
zh: 地球上的一天（白天和夜晚合在一起）是24小时。

subject: Science
subtopic: The Sun and Its Predictable Patterns
en: Sunrise and sunset happen because Earth, which is ball-shaped, rotates.
zh: 日出和日落是因为球形的地球在自转。

subject: Science
subtopic: Annual Patterns of Sunrise and Sunset

zh: 日出和日落的时间每天略有变化，并呈现出可预测的模式。

subject: Science
topic: The Moon and Its Predictable Patterns

zh: 月球是球形的，夜晚在天空中可见，白天也常常可见。

subject: Science

subject: Science

zh: 恒星是遥远的、自身发光的天体。

subject: Science

zh: 人们利用一些恒星的位置画出想象中的图案，称为星座（北斗七星、猎户座）。

subject: Science

subject: English Language Arts
en: Traditional language arts instruction has typically accorded little, if any, attention to the ongoing development of children’s listening and speaking ability. This failure to focus on the development of oral language in language arts instruction has been a serious oversight. Literacy, the ability to read and write written language, is highly correlated with students’ oral language proficiency, and the ability to understand a text read aloud is a prerequisite for making sense of the same text in printed form. It is therefore essential that children build listening and speaking competency while also developing reading and writing skills.
zh: 传统的语言艺术教学通常很少甚至根本不关注儿童听说能力的持续发展。这种在语言艺术教学中忽视口语能力发展的做法是一个严重的疏漏。读写能力，即阅读和书写书面语言的能力，与学生的口语水平高度相关；而听懂朗读文本的能力，是理解同一印刷文本的前提。因此，儿童在发展读写技能的同时，必须培养听说能力。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Give oral presentations about personal experiences, topics of interest, stories, and summaries of factual information that have been presented orally, visually or through multimedia, using appropriate eye contact, volume and clear enunciation. C. Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—All Texts Teachers: Written text makes use of richer vocabulary and more complex syntax than conversational language. It is important that young children be exposed not only to the language of everyday conversation but also to the richer and more formal language of books. This can be done through frequent reading aloud. Helping young children develop the ability to listen to and understand written texts read aloud must be an integral part of any initiative designed to build literacy. At the second grade level, students are becoming increasingly skilled as independent readers. Nevertheless, research indicates that reading comprehension ability does not catch up to listening comprehension until the middle school grades. It is therefore still important to provide second graders with extensive read aloud experiences of both fiction and nonfiction texts. Careful consideration should be given to the selection of books read aloud to ensure that the vocabulary and syntax presented is rich and complex. Leveled texts will not provide the rich language experience desired during read-alouds and should only be used as a starting point with students for whom English is a second language. Nonfiction read-alouds should be selected on the basis of the history, science, music and visual art topics identified for Grade 2 students in the Core Knowledge Sequence, with emphasis on history and science read-alouds. It is strongly recommended that daily read-alouds focus on a single topic over a sustained period of time—about two weeks—rather than intermingling read-alouds on a variety of subjects. Careful consideration should be given to the order in which nonfiction read-alouds are presented to ensure that knowledge about a topic builds in a progressive and coherent way. Following any read-aloud, students should participate in rich, structured conversations with an adult in response to the written text that has been read aloud. In this way, they can begin to orally practice comparing, analyzing, and synthesizing ideas in written text in much the same way as they will be expected to do as independent readers in the later grades.
zh: 就个人经历、感兴趣的话题、故事，以及对通过口头、视觉或多媒体呈现的事实信息进行概述，做口头报告，眼神交流、音量和吐字清晰恰当。C. 朗读的理解与讨论——所有文本 教师须知：书面文本使用的词汇比日常会话更丰富，句法更复杂。幼儿不仅应接触日常会话语言，也应接触书籍中更丰富、更正式的语言，这可以通过经常朗读来实现。帮助幼儿培养听懂朗读的书面文本的能力，必须成为一切培养读写能力举措的组成部分。到了二年级，学生作为独立阅读者的能力日益提高。然而研究表明，阅读理解能力直到中学阶段才能赶上听力理解能力。因此，仍有必要让二年级学生大量接触虚构类和非虚构类文本的朗读。应仔细选择朗读书目，确保所呈现的词汇和句法丰富而复杂。分级读物无法提供朗读所需的丰富语言体验，只应作为英语为第二语言学生的起点。非虚构类朗读材料应根据核心知识序列中为二年级学生确定的历史、科学、音乐和视觉艺术主题来选择，并侧重历史和科学类朗读。强烈建议每日朗读在较长一段时间（约两周）内专注于单一主题，而不是混合朗读多种主题。还应仔细考虑非虚构类朗读的呈现顺序，确保关于某一主题的知识以渐进、连贯的方式积累。每次朗读之后，学生应与成人围绕所朗读的书面文本进行丰富、有结构的对话。这样，他们就能开始口头练习比较、分析和综合书面文本中的观点，就像日后作为独立阅读者被期望做到的那样。

zh: 使用叙事性语言描述朗读中的人物、地点、事物、位置、事件、动作、场景或事实。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Understand and use words and phrases heard in read-alouds.
zh: 理解并使用朗读中听到的词语和短语。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Compare and contrast similarities and differences within a single read-aloud or between two or more read-alouds.
zh: 比较和对照单次朗读内部或两次及以上朗读之间的异同。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Make personal connections to events or experiences in a read-aloud and/or make connections among several read-alouds.
zh: 把朗读中的事件或经历与个人建立联系，和/或在多次朗读之间建立联系。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Prior to listening to a read-aloud, identify what they know and have learned that may be related to the specific story or topic to be read aloud.
zh: 在听朗读之前，确认自己所知道的、可能与被朗读的具体故事或主题相关的内容。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Use pictures accompanying the read-aloud to check and support understanding of the read-aloud.
zh: 利用朗读所配的图片来检查和帮助理解朗读内容。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Make predictions prior to and during a read-aloud, based on the title, pictures, and/or text heard thus far and then compare the actual outcomes to predictions.
zh: 在朗读前和朗读过程中，根据标题、图片和/或目前已听到的文本作出预测，然后把实际结果与预测进行比较。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Answer questions that require making interpretations, judgments, or giving opinions about what is heard in a read-aloud, including answering “why” questions that require recognizing cause/effect relationships.
zh: 回答需要作出解释、判断或对朗读中所听内容发表看法的问题，包括回答需要识别因果关系的“为什么”问题。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Interpret information that is presented orally and then ask additional questions to clarify information or the topic in the read-aloud.
zh: 理解口头呈现的信息，然后进一步提问以澄清朗读中的信息或主题。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Identify who is telling a story or providing information in a text.
zh: 识别文本中谁在讲故事或提供信息。

subject: English Language Arts
topic: Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—Fiction, Drama, and Poetry
en: Retell a story, using narrative language to describe characters, setting(s), and the plot of the story in proper sequence.
zh: 复述故事，用叙述性语言按正确顺序描述人物、场景和故事情节。

subject: English Language Arts
topic: Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—Fiction, Drama, and Poetry
en: Compare and contrast characters from different stories.
zh: 比较和对比不同故事中的人物。

subject: English Language Arts
topic: Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—Fiction, Drama, and Poetry
en: Describe characters in increasing depth by referring to their dialogue and/or actions in the story.
zh: 通过引用人物的对话和/或故事中的行为，越来越深入地描述人物。

subject: English Language Arts
topic: Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—Fiction, Drama, and Poetry
en: Change some story events and provide a different story ending.
zh: 改动某些故事事件，并给出一个不同的故事结局。

subject: English Language Arts
topic: Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—Fiction, Drama, and Poetry
en: Create and tell an original story, using narrative language to describe characters, setting(s), and the plot of the story in proper sequence.
zh: 创作并讲述原创故事，用叙述性语言按正确顺序描述人物、场景和情节。

subject: English Language Arts
topic: Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—Fiction, Drama, and Poetry
en: Distinguish fantasy from realistic text in a story.
zh: 区分故事中的幻想情节与现实情节。

subject: English Language Arts
topic: Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—Fiction, Drama, and Poetry
en: Identify the moral or lesson of a fable, folktale, or myth.
zh: 找出寓言、民间故事或神话的寓意或教训。

subject: English Language Arts
topic: Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—Fiction, Drama, and Poetry
en: Demonstrate understanding of literary language (e.g., author, illustrator, characters, setting, plot, dialogue, personification, simile, and metaphor) and use some of these terms in retelling stories or creating their own stories.
zh: 理解文学语言（如作者、插画家、人物、场景、情节、对话、拟人、明喻和暗喻），并在复述故事或创作自己的故事时使用其中一些术语。

subject: English Language Arts
topic: Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—Fiction, Drama, and Poetry
en: Identify repetitions in phrases, refrains, or sounds in poems or songs.
zh: 找出诗歌或歌曲中重复的短语、副歌或声音。

subject: English Language Arts
topic: Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—Fiction, Drama, and Poetry
en: Identify sensory language and how it is used to describe people, objects, places, and events.
zh: 识别感官语言及其如何用于描述人物、物体、地点和事件。

subject: English Language Arts
topic: Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—Fiction, Drama, and Poetry
en: Describe the use of rhyme, rhythm and sensory images used in poetry. E. Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—Nonfiction and Informational Text Teachers: Select nonfiction read-aloud topics from the second grade history, science, music, and visual arts topics, with emphasis on history and science.
zh: 描述诗歌中押韵、节奏和感官意象的运用。E. 朗读的理解与讨论——非虚构与说明性文本 教师须知：从二年级的历史、科学、音乐和视觉艺术主题中选择非虚构类朗读主题，并侧重历史和科学。

subject: English Language Arts
topic: Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—Fiction, Drama, and Poetry
en: Generate questions and seek information from multiple sources to answer questions.
zh: 提出问题，并从多个来源寻找信息来回答问题。

subject: English Language Arts
topic: Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—Fiction, Drama, and Poetry
en: Answer questions about the details of a nonfiction text, indicating which part of the text provided the information needed to answer specific questions.
zh: 回答有关非虚构文本细节的问题，并指出文本的哪一部分提供了回答特定问题所需的信息。

subject: English Language Arts
topic: Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—Fiction, Drama, and Poetry
en: With assistance, categorize and organize facts and information within a given topic.
zh: 在帮助下，将给定主题范围内的事实和信息分类整理。

subject: English Language Arts
topic: Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—Fiction, Drama, and Poetry
en: With assistance, create and interpret timelines and lifelines related to read-alouds.
zh: 在帮助下，制作并解读与朗读内容相关的时间线和生平线。

subject: English Language Arts
topic: Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—Fiction, Drama, and Poetry
en: Interpret information presented in diagrams, charts, graphs, etc.
zh: 解读图表、曲线图等呈现的信息。

subject: English Language Arts
topic: Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—Fiction, Drama, and Poetry
en: Distinguish read-alouds that describe events that happened long ago from those that describe contemporary or current events.
zh: 区分描述很久以前发生的事件的朗读与描述当代或当前事件的朗读。

subject: English Language Arts
topic: Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—Fiction, Drama, and Poetry
en: Demonstrate understanding that a systematic, predictable relationship exists between written letters (graphemes) and spoken sounds (phonemes).
zh: 理解书面字母（字素）与口头语音（音素）之间存在系统、可预测的关系。

subject: English Language Arts
topic: Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—Fiction, Drama, and Poetry
en: Blend individual phonemes to pronounce printed words.
zh: 将单个音素拼合起来读出印刷文字。

subject: English Language Arts
topic: Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—Fiction, Drama, and Poetry
en: Understand that sometimes two or more printed letters stand for a single sound.
zh: 理解有时两个或更多印刷字母代表一个音。

subject: English Language Arts
topic: Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—Fiction, Drama, and Poetry
en: Read multi-syllable words containing any of the grapheme-phoneme correspondences listed below.
zh: 读出包含以下任一字素—音素对应关系的多音节词。

subject: English Language Arts
topic: Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—Fiction, Drama, and Poetry
en: Read and write words with inflectional endings, i.e., -s, -ed, -ing, -er, -est.
zh: 读写带屈折词尾的单词，即 -s、-ed、-ing、-er、-est。

subject: English Language Arts
topic: Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—Fiction, Drama, and Poetry
en: Read, understand, and write contractions, i.e., isn’t, I’m, can’t, etc.
zh: 读写并理解缩写形式，例如 isn't、I'm、can't 等。

subject: English Language Arts
topic: Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—Fiction, Drama, and Poetry
en: Sort and classify words according to the spelling used to represent a specific phoneme.
zh: 根据表示特定音素的拼写方式对单词进行分类。

subject: English Language Arts
topic: Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—Fiction, Drama, and Poetry
en: Read tricky spellings that can be sounded two ways, e.g., the letter ‘s’ sounded /s/ as in cats and /z/ as in dogs.
zh: 读出有两种发音的棘手拼写，例如字母“s”在 cats 中发 /s/，在 dogs 中发 /z/。

subject: English Language Arts
topic: Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—Fiction, Drama, and Poetry
en: Read and spell chains of one-syllable words in which one sound is added, substituted, or omitted, i.e., read at > cat > bat > bad > bid.
zh: 读写单音节词词链，每次增加、替换或去掉一个音，例如读 at > cat > bat > bad > bid。

subject: English Language Arts
topic: Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—Fiction, Drama, and Poetry
en: Read at least 100 words generally identified as high frequency words. Consonant Sounds and Spellings Taught in Second Grade /b/ spelled ‘b’ as in boy, ‘bb’, as in tubby /d/ spelled ‘d’ as in dog, ‘dd’ as in madder, ‘ed’ as in filled /f/ spelled ‘f’ as in fun, ‘ff’ as in stuff /g/ spelled ‘g’ as in get, ‘gg’ as in egg /h/ spelled ‘h’ as in him /j/ spelled ‘j’ as in jump, ‘g’ as in gem, ‘ge’ as in fringe /k/ spelled ‘c’ as in cat, ‘k’ as in kitten, ‘ck’ as in sick, ‘cc’ as in moccasin /l/ spelled ‘l’ as in lip, ‘ll’ as in sell /m/ spelled ‘m’ as in mad, ‘mm’ as in hammer /n/ spelled ‘n’ as in net, ‘nn’ as in funny, ‘kn’ as in knock /p/ spelled ‘p’ as in pet, ‘pp’ as in happy /r/ spelled ‘r’ as in red, ‘rr’ as in earring, ‘wr’ as in wrist /s/ spelled ‘s’ as in sit, ‘ss’ as in dress, ‘c’ as in cent, ‘ce’ as in prince, ‘se’ as in rinse /t/ spelled ‘t’ as in top, ‘tt’ as in butter, ‘ed’ as in asked /v/ spelled ‘v’ as in vet, ‘ve’ as in twelve /w/ spelled ‘w’ as in wet, ‘wh’ as in when /x/ spelled ‘x’ as in tax /y/ spelled ‘y’ as in yes /z/ spelled ‘z’ as in zip, ‘zz’ as in buzz, ‘s’ as in dogs /ch/ spelled ‘ch’ as in chop, ‘tch’ as in itch /sh/ spelled ‘sh’ as in ship /th/ spelled ‘th’ as in thin /th/ spelled ‘th’ as in then /qu/ spelled ‘qu’ as in quick /ng/ spelled ‘ng’ as in sing, ‘n’ as in pink Vowel Sounds and Spellings Taught in Second Grade /a/ spelled ‘a’ as in cat /e/ spelled ‘e’ as in get, ‘ea’ as in head /i/ spelled ‘i’ as in hit, ‘y’ as in myth /o/ spelled ‘o’ as in hot, ‘a’ as in wall /u/ spelled ‘u’ as in but, ‘o’ as in son /ae/ spelled ‘a\_e’ as in cake, ‘ai’ as in wait, ‘ay’ as in day, ‘a’ as in paper, ‘ey’ as in hey, ‘ei’ as in weight, ‘ea’ as in great /ee/ spelled ‘ee’ as in bee, ‘e’ as in me, ‘y’ as in funny, ‘ea’ as in beach, ‘e\_e’ as in Pete, ‘ie’ as in cookie, ‘i’ as in ski, ‘ey’ as in key /ie/ spelled ‘i\_e’ as in bike, ‘i’ as in biting, ‘y’ as in try, ‘ie’ as in tie, ‘igh’ as in night
zh: 认读至少100个通常被认为是高频词的单词。二年级教授的辅音发音与拼写：/b/ 拼作 'b'（如 boy）、'bb'（如 tubby）；/d/ 拼作 'd'（如 dog）、'dd'（如 madder）、'ed'（如 filled）；/f/ 拼作 'f'（如 fun）、'ff'（如 stuff）；/g/ 拼作 'g'（如 get）、'gg'（如 egg）；/h/ 拼作 'h'（如 him）；/j/ 拼作 'j'（如 jump）、'g'（如 gem）、'ge'（如 fringe）；/k/ 拼作 'c'（如 cat）、'k'（如 kitten）、'ck'（如 sick）、'cc'（如 moccasin）；/l/ 拼作 'l'（如 lip）、'll'（如 sell）；/m/ 拼作 'm'（如 mad）、'mm'（如 hammer）；/n/ 拼作 'n'（如 net）、'nn'（如 funny）、'kn'（如 knock）；/p/ 拼作 'p'（如 pet）、'pp'（如 happy）；/r/ 拼作 'r'（如 red）、'rr'（如 earring）、'wr'（如 wrist）；/s/ 拼作 's'（如 sit）、'ss'（如 dress）、'c'（如 cent）、'ce'（如 prince）、'se'（如 rinse）；/t/ 拼作 't'（如 top）、'tt'（如 butter）、'ed'（如 asked）；/v/ 拼作 'v'（如 vet）、've'（如 twelve）；/w/ 拼作 'w'（如 wet）、'wh'（如 when）；/x/ 拼作 'x'（如 tax）；/y/ 拼作 'y'（如 yes）；/z/ 拼作 'z'（如 zip）、'zz'（如 buzz）、's'（如 dogs）；/ch/ 拼作 'ch'（如 chop）、'tch'（如 itch）；/sh/ 拼作 'sh'（如 ship）；/th/ 拼作 'th'（如 thin）；/th/ 拼作 'th'（如 then）；/qu/ 拼作 'qu'（如 quick）；/ng/ 拼作 'ng'（如 sing）、'n'（如 pink）。二年级教授的元音发音与拼写：/a/ 拼作 'a'（如 cat）；/e/ 拼作 'e'（如 get）、'ea'（如 head）；/i/ 拼作 'i'（如 hit）、'y'（如 myth）；/o/ 拼作 'o'（如 hot）、'a'（如 wall）；/u/ 拼作 'u'（如 but）、'o'（如 son）；/ae/ 拼作 'a_e'（如 cake）、'ai'（如 wait）、'ay'（如 day）、'a'（如 paper）、'ey'（如 hey）、'ei'（如 weight）、'ea'（如 great）；/ee/ 拼作 'ee'（如 bee）、'e'（如 me）、'y'（如 funny）、'ea'（如 beach）、'e_e'（如 Pete）、'ie'（如 cookie）、'i'（如 ski）、'ey'（如 key）；/ie/ 拼作 'i_e'（如 bike）、'i'（如 biting）、'y'（如 try）、'ie'（如 tie）、'igh'（如 night）。

subject: English Language Arts
topic: Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—Fiction, Drama, and Poetry
en: Read decodable stories that incorporate the specific code knowledge that has been taught.
zh: 阅读包含已教授的特定拼读知识的可解码故事。

subject: English Language Arts
topic: Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—Fiction, Drama, and Poetry
en: Demonstrate increased accuracy, fluency, and expression on successive reading of a decodable text (90 wpm by the end of the year).
zh: 在反复朗读同一篇可解码文本时，表现出准确度、流利度和表达力的提升（到学年末达到每分钟90词）。

subject: English Language Arts
topic: Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—Fiction, Drama, and Poetry
en: Use phonics skills in conjunction with context to confirm or self-correct word recognition and understanding, rereading as necessary.
zh: 结合拼读技能与上下文，确认或自我纠正字词识别与理解，必要时重读。

subject: English Language Arts
topic: Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—Fiction, Drama, and Poetry
en: Demonstrate understanding of and use commas and end punctuation while reading orally.
zh: 在朗读时理解并正确使用逗号和句末标点。

subject: English Language Arts
topic: Comprehension and Discussion of Read-Alouds—Fiction, Drama, and Poetry
en: Read aloud, alone, or with a partner at least 20 minutes each day.
zh: 每天至少朗读20分钟，可独自朗读，也可与同伴一起朗读。

subject: English Language Arts
en: At the second grade level, students should be demonstrating ever-increasing code knowledge and fluency in their independent reading, allowing them to focus more intently on the meaning of what they are reading. This increased focus on reading comprehension is reflected in the number and complexity of the objectives below, as compared to earlier grades. However, it is important to remember that listening comprehension still far exceeds reading comprehension and that students’ ability to talk about what they have heard and/or read will exceed their ability to demonstrate that understanding in writing.
zh: 在二年级阶段，学生的独立阅读应展现出不断增强的解码知识和流利度，从而能更专注地理解所读内容。与更早的年级相比，以下目标的数量和复杂性正体现了这种对阅读理解日益增强的重视。但要记住，听力理解仍远远超过阅读理解；学生谈论所听和/或所读内容的能力，会超过他们以书面形式展示这种理解的能力。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Demonstrate understanding of text—the majority of which is decodable—after independent reading.
zh: 独立阅读后，能展示对文本的理解（所读文本大多为可拼读文本）。

subject: English Language Arts
section: Grasping Specific Details and Key Ideas
section_zh: 掌握具体细节与关键观点
en: Sequence four to six pictures illustrating events from a text that has been read independently.
zh: 将四到六幅描绘所读文本中事件的图片按顺序排列。

subject: English Language Arts
section: Grasping Specific Details and Key Ideas
section_zh: 掌握具体细节与关键观点
en: Answer questions requiring literal recall and understanding of the details and/or facts (i.e., who, what, where, when, etc.) about a text that has been read independently.
zh: 回答需要逐字回忆并理解所读文本细节和/或事实的问题（即谁、什么、哪里、何时等）。

subject: English Language Arts
section: Grasping Specific Details and Key Ideas
section_zh: 掌握具体细节与关键观点
en: Retell key details from a text that has been read independently.
zh: 复述独立阅读文本中的关键细节。

subject: English Language Arts
section: Grasping Specific Details and Key Ideas
section_zh: 掌握具体细节与关键观点
en: Summarize in one’s own words selected parts of a text.
zh: 用自己的话概括文本的选定部分。

subject: English Language Arts
section: Grasping Specific Details and Key Ideas
section_zh: 掌握具体细节与关键观点
en: Ask questions to clarify information about a text that has been read independently.
zh: 通过提问来澄清所读独立文本中的信息。

subject: English Language Arts
section: Grasping Specific Details and Key Ideas
section_zh: 掌握具体细节与关键观点
en: Use narrative language to describe people, places, things, locations, events, actions, a scene or facts from a text that has been read independently.
zh: 运用叙述性语言，描述独立阅读文本中的人物、地点、事物、方位、事件、动作、场景或事实。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Identify basic text features and what they mean, including title, table of contents, chapter headings and captions.
zh: 识别基本的文本特征及其含义，包括标题、目录、章节标题和图注。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Understand and use words and phrases from a text that has been read independently.
zh: 理解并运用独立阅读文本中的单词和短语。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Compare and contrast similarities and differences within a single text or between multiple texts read independently.
zh: 比较并对比单篇文本内部或多篇独立阅读文本之间的异同。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Make personal connections to events or experiences in a text that has been read. independently and/or make connections among several texts that have been read independently.
zh: 把所读文本中的事件或经历与个人建立联系，和/或在多篇独立阅读文本之间建立联系。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Prior to reading, identify what they know and have learned that may be related to the specific story or topic to be read.
zh: 阅读前，识别出自己已知的、可能与将要阅读的故事或主题相关的内容。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Use pictures accompanying the written text to check and support understanding.
zh: 利用文本所配的图片来检验并支持理解。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Make predictions prior to and while reading, based on the title, pictures, and/or text read thus far and then compare the actual outcomes to predictions.
zh: 根据标题、图片和/或迄今读到的文本，在阅读前和阅读中作出预测，然后将实际结果与预测进行比较。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Answer questions that require making interpretations, judgments, or giving opinions about what is read independently, including answering “why” questions that require recognizing cause/effect relationships.
zh: 回答需要作出解释、判断或对独立阅读内容发表看法的问题，包括需要识别因果关系的“为什么”类问题。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Interpret information that is read independently and then ask questions to clarify this information.
zh: 解读独立阅读获得的信息，然后提问以澄清这些信息。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Identify who is telling a story or providing information in a text.
zh: 识别文本中是谁在讲故事或提供信息。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Identify temporal words that link and sequence events, i.e., first, next, then, etc.
zh: 识别连接并排序事件的时序词，即 first（首先）、next（接着）、then（然后）等。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Identify words that link ideas, i.e., for example, also, in addition.
zh: 识别连接观点的词语，即 for example（例如）、also（也）、in addition（此外）。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Retell a story, using narrative language to describe characters, setting(s), and the plot of the story in proper sequence.
zh: 复述故事，运用叙述性语言按正确顺序描述人物、场景和故事情节。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Compare and contrast characters from different stories.
zh: 比较和对比不同故事中的人物。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Describe characters in increasing depth by referring to dialogue and/or their actions in the story.
zh: 通过引用对话和/或人物在故事中的行为，越来越深入地描述人物。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Change some story events and provide a different story ending.
zh: 改动某些故事事件，并给出一个不同的故事结局。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Distinguish fantasy from realistic text in a story.
zh: 区分故事中的幻想内容与写实内容。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Identify the moral or lesson of a fable, folktale, or myth.
zh: 找出寓言、民间故事或神话中的寓意或教训。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Demonstrate understanding of literary language (e.g., author, illustrator, characters, setting, plot, dialogue, personification, simile, and metaphor) and use some of these terms in retelling stories or creating their own stories.
zh: 理解文学语言（例如 author 作者、illustrator 插画家、characters 人物、setting 背景、plot 情节、dialogue 对话、personification 拟人、simile 明喻、metaphor 暗喻），并在复述故事或创作自己的故事时使用其中一些术语。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Identify sensory language and how it is used to describe people, objects, places, and events.
zh: 识别感官语言及其如何用于描写人物、物体、地点和事件。

subject: English Language Arts

en: The titles listed below are available in a variety of editions, including both adaptations for novice readers and others that lend themselves to reading aloud to children—for example, Charlotte’s Web or “How the Camel Got His Hump.” It is recommended that you provide a mixture of texts. Editions designed for beginning readers can help students practice decoding skills. Read-aloud texts, which the students may not be capable of reading on their own, can be understood when the words are read aloud and talked about with a helpful adult. Such active listening to vocabulary and syntax that go beyond the limits of grade-level readability formulas is an important part of developing an increasingly sophisticated verbal sense.
zh: 下面列出的书名有多种版本，既有为初学者改编的版本，也有适合给孩子朗读的版本——例如《夏洛的网》(Charlotte's Web) 或《骆驼是怎么长出驼峰的》("How the Camel Got His Hump")。建议提供多种文本的组合。为初级读者设计的版本可以帮助学生练习解码技能。朗读书籍（学生自己可能还无法阅读）在朗读者读出词语并与有帮助的成人一起讨论时是可以理解的。这种积极聆听超出年级可读性公式限制的词汇和句法的过程，是培养日益成熟的语感的重要部分。

en: Every culture has phrases and proverbs that make no sense when carried over literally into another culture. For many students, this section may not be needed; they will have picked up these sayings by hearing them at home and among friends. But the sayings have been one of the categories most appreciated by teachers who work with students from home cultures that differ from the standard culture of literate American English. Back to the drawing board Better late than never Cold feet Don’t cry over spilled milk. Don’t judge a book by its cover. Easier said than done Eaten out of house and home Get a taste of your own medicine. Get up on the wrong side of the bed. In hot water Note: Students will read more myths in third grade; see Language Arts Grade 3.
zh: 每种文化都有一些习语和谚语，直译到另一种文化中会毫无意义。对许多学生来说，这一节可能并非必需；他们会在家里和朋友之间听到这些说法而自然习得。然而，对于来自不同于标准美式英语书面文化的家庭背景的学生，这些说法一直是老师们最欣赏的类别之一。推倒重来（Back to the drawing board）；迟做总比不做好（Better late than never）；临阵退缩（Cold feet）；别为打翻的牛奶哭泣／覆水难收（Don't cry over spilled milk.）；不要以貌取人（Don't judge a book by its cover.）；说起来容易做起来难（Easier said than done）；把家吃空（Eaten out of house and home）；自食其果（Get a taste of your own medicine.）；一大早就心情不好（Get up on the wrong side of the bed.）；陷入麻烦（In hot water）注意：学生将在三年级阅读更多神话；见《语言艺术三年级》。

subject: History and Geography
en: Teachers: In second grade, students often study aspects of the world around them: the family, the school, the community, etc. The following guidelines are meant to broaden and complement that focus. The goal of studying selected topics in World History in second grade is to foster curiosity and the beginnings of understanding about the larger world outside the student’s locality, and about varied civilizations and ways of life. This can be done through a variety of means: story, drama, art, music, discussion, and more.
zh: 教师：二年级时，学生常常学习周围世界的各个方面：家庭、学校、社区等。以下指南旨在拓宽和补充这一重点。二年级学习世界历史中选定主题的目标，是培养孩子的好奇心，并初步理解其所在地区之外的广阔世界，以及各种文明和生活方式。这可以通过多种方式实现：故事、戏剧、艺术、音乐、讨论等等。

en: Since religion is a shaping force in the story of civilization, the Core Knowledge Sequence introduces students in the early grades to major world religions, beginning with a focus on geography and major symbols and figures. The purpose is not to explore matters of theology but to provide a basic vocabulary for understanding many events and ideas in history. The goal is to familiarize, not proselytize; to be descriptive, not prescriptive. The tone should be one of respect and balance: no religion should be disparaged by implying that it is a thing of the past. To the question, “Which one is true?” an appropriate response is: “People of different faiths believe different things to be true. The best people to guide you on this right now are your parents or someone at home.”

subject: Visual Arts
en: Teachers: In schools, lessons on the visual arts should illustrate important elements of making and appreciating art, and emphasize important artists, works of art, and artistic concepts. When appropriate, topics in the visual arts may be linked to topics in other disciplines. The following guidelines specify a variety of artwork in different media and from various cultures in order to expose students to a wide range of art and artists. While the list is robust, it may require teachers to narrow the selection in order to adequately address the works and related skills within an academic year.
zh: 教师：学校的视觉艺术课程应展示艺术创作与欣赏的重要元素，并重点介绍重要艺术家、艺术作品和艺术概念。在适当的时候，视觉艺术主题可以与其他学科主题相联系。以下指导方针列举了不同媒介和不同文化的多种艺术作品，以让学生接触广泛的艺术和艺术家。这份清单内容相当丰富，教师可能需要缩小选择范围，以便在一个学年内充分讲解这些作品及相关技能。

subject: Music
en: Teachers: In schools, lessons on music should feature activities and works that illustrate important musical concepts and terms, and should introduce important composers and works. When appropriate, topics in music may be linked to topics in other disciplines. The following guidelines focus on content, not performance skills, though many concepts are best learned through active practice (singing, clapping rhythms, playing instruments, etc.).
zh: 教师：学校的音乐课应包含能够体现重要音乐概念和术语的活动与作品，并应介绍重要作曲家和作品。在适当的时候，音乐主题可以与其他学科主题相联系。以下指导方针侧重内容而非表演技能，不过许多概念最好通过积极实践来学习（唱歌、拍节奏、演奏乐器等）。

subject: Mathematics
en: Teachers: Mathematics has its own vocabulary and patterns of thinking. It is a discipline with its own language and conventions. Thus, while some lessons may offer occasional opportunities for linking mathematics to other disciplines, it is critically important to attend to math as math. From the earliest years, mathematics requires incremental review and steady practice: not only the diligent effort required to master basic facts and operations, but also thoughtful and varied practice that approaches problems from a variety of angles, and gives students a variety of opportunities to apply the same concept or operation in different types of situations. While it is important to work toward the development of “higher-order problem-solving skills,” it is equally important—indeed, it is prerequisite to achieving higher order skills— to have a sound grasp of basic facts, and an automatic fluency with fundamental operations.
zh: 教师提示：数学有其自身的词汇和思维方式，是一门拥有自己语言与规范的学科。因此，虽然有些课程偶尔会有机会将数学与其他学科联系起来，但把数学当作数学来对待至关重要。从最初几年起，数学就需要循序渐进的复习和持续不断的练习：既要努力掌握基本事实和运算，也要进行周密而多样的练习，从不同角度处理问题，并让学生有多种机会在不同类型的情境中运用同一概念或运算。虽然努力培养“高阶解题技能”很重要，但同样重要的是——事实上这是达成高阶技能的前提——牢固掌握基本事实，并对基本运算达到自动化的熟练程度。

subject: Science
en: Teachers: Effective instruction in science requires hands-on experience and observation. In the words of the report from the National Academies of Science, A Framework for K-12 Science Education, “...children have surprisingly sophisticated ways of thinking about the world, based in part on their direct experiences with the physical environment, such as watching objects fall or collide and observing plants and animals. They also learn about the world through everyday activities, such as talking with their families, pursuing hobbies, watching television, and playing with friends. As children try to understand and influence the world around them, they develop ideas about their role in that world and how it works. In fact, the capacity of young children—from all backgrounds and socioeconomic levels—to reason in sophisticated ways is much greater than has long been assumed. Although they may lack deep knowledge and extensive experience, they often engage in a wide range of subtle and complex reasoning about the world. Thus, before they even enter school, children have developed their own ideas about the physical, biological, and social worlds and how they work. By listening to and taking these ideas seriously, educators can build on what children already know and can do.”
zh: 教师须知：有效的科学教学需要动手体验和观察。用美国国家科学院报告《K-12 科学教育框架》的话来说：“……孩子们以令人惊讶的复杂方式思考世界，这部分基于他们对物质环境的直接体验，比如观看物体下落或碰撞、观察动植物。他们也通过日常活动了解世界，比如与家人交谈、从事爱好、看电视、和朋友玩耍。当孩子们试图理解和影响周围的世界时，他们会形成关于自己在世界中的角色以及世界如何运作的想法。事实上，幼儿——无论来自何种背景、何种社会经济水平——进行复杂推理的能力远超长期以来的设想。尽管他们可能缺乏深入知识和丰富经验，但他们常常对世界进行广泛而细致的复杂推理。因此，甚至在入学之前，孩子们就已经对物理、生物和社会世界及其运作方式形成了自己的想法。通过倾听并认真对待这些想法，教育者可以在儿童已有知识和能力的基础上进行教学。”
