subject: Science
en: Through reading aloud, observation, and activities such as developing models of the shapes and kinds of land and water in an area, help students to explore the following:
zh: 通过朗读、观察以及制作某一地区陆地和水域形状与种类的模型等活动，帮助学生探究以下内容：

subject: Science
en: Earth’s surface has various landforms such as:
zh: 地球表面有多种地貌，例如：

subject: Science
en: plains, hills, plateaus, mountains, valleys, canyons, buttes, basins, cliffs, beaches, dunes, underwater mountains and valleys
zh: 平原、丘陵、高原、山脉、山谷、峡谷、孤丘、盆地、悬崖、海滩、沙丘、水下山脉与山谷。

subject: Science
en: Maps are models of Earth’s surface.
zh: 地图是地球表面的模型。

subject: Science
en: A globe is a spherical map of Earth that helps to visualize locations of continents, the poles, and the equator.
zh: 地球仪是地球的球形地图，有助于直观了解各大洲、两极和赤道的位置。

subject: Science
en: Most of Earth’s surface is covered with water.
zh: 地球表面大部分被水覆盖。

subject: Science
en: Most of Earth’s water is liquid; some is solid (ice); some is fresh water (rivers, lakes, groundwater, glaciers); most is salt water (ocean).
zh: 地球上的水大部分是液态；有些是固态（冰）；有些是淡水（河流、湖泊、地下水、冰川）；大部分是咸水（海洋）。

subject: Science
topic: Effects of Wind and Water on Land
en: Wind and water can change the shape of land.
zh: 风和水可以改变土地的形状。

subject: Science
topic: Effects of Wind and Water on Land
en: Wind and water produce many distinctive landforms:
zh: 风和水造就许多独特的地貌：

subject: Science
topic: Effects of Wind and Water on Land
en: dunes, beaches, cliffs, hoodoos, arches, oxbows and meanders, canyons, mesas
zh: 沙丘、海滩、悬崖、石柱（hoodoos）、拱门、牛轭湖与曲流、峡谷、方山

subject: Science
topic: Effects of Wind and Water on Land
en: Wind and water cause relatively slow changes to Earth’s crust.
zh: 风和水使地壳发生较为缓慢的变化。

subject: Science
topic: Effects of Wind and Water on Land
en: Scientists and engineers work together to design solutions that slow or prevent unwanted weathering and erosion.
zh: 科学家与工程师合作设计解决方案，减缓或防止不需要的风化和侵蚀。

subject: Science
en: The emphasis in Grade 2 should be on observation, description, and explanation of real world applications of electricity and magnetism; technical explanations of electromagnetism should be taken up in later grades; see Grades 4, 5, 6, and 8 for an increasingly detailed study of energy, electricity, and magnetism. Students should also engage with the engineering design process and its relationship to scientific knowledge. Contextualized design challenges should be embedded across multiple topics of study such as this domain, including in the later grades; for example, see Grades 3, 4, and 5 for an increasingly detailed study of engineering design. At this grade level, explore the following with students:
zh: 二年级的重点应放在观察、描述和解释电与磁在现实世界中的应用；电磁学的机理性解释应留到以后年级学习；关于能量、电和磁逐步深入的学习见四、五、六和八年级。学生还应参与工程设计过程，并理解其与科学知识的关系。情境化的设计挑战应融入多个学习主题之中，包括本主题，并延续到以后的年级；例如，工程设计逐步深入的学习见三、四、五年级。在本年级，与学生一起探究以下内容：

subject: Science
en: Electricity is a form of energy; it can cause changes.
zh: 电是能量的一种形式；电可以引起变化。

subject: Science
en: Matter contains two types of electrical charges: positive and negative.
zh: 物质含有两种电荷：正电荷和负电荷。

subject: Science
en: Types of electricity:
zh: 电的种类：

subject: Science
en: Static electricity: electric charges on the surface of things
zh: 静电：物体表面的电荷

subject: Science
en: Current electricity: electrical charges flowing in a circuit through wires and other devices
zh: 电流：电荷在电路中通过导线和其他装置流动

subject: Science
en: Magnet: a metal object that can exert a force through a distance on certain types of metal objects.
zh: 磁铁：一种金属物体，能对某些种类的金属物体产生远距离作用力。

subject: Science
en: A magnet has two poles: north and south.
zh: 磁铁有两个磁极：北极和南极。

subject: Science
en: Similar magnetic poles attract each other; opposite magnetic poles repel each other.
zh: 相同的磁极相互吸引；相反的磁极相互排斥。

subject: Science
en: Electricity and magnetism are used in many useful devices.
zh: 电和磁被应用于许多有用的装置中。

subject: Science
en: All useful devices are developed through engineering design, a process which includes:
zh: 所有有用的装置都通过工程设计开发，这一过程包括：

subject: Science
en: Defining a problem
zh: 明确问题

subject: Science
en: Developing possible solutions
zh: 提出可能的解决方案

subject: Science
en: Refining (optimizing) the design solution
zh: 改进（优化）设计方案

subject: Science
en: Scientists and engineering designers often work together in teams to solve problems and design effective solutions.
zh: 科学家与工程设计师常常在团队中合作，解决问题并设计有效的方案。

subject: Science
topic: Safe Use of Electricity and Magnetism
en: Electricity is potentially dangerous. Collaborate with your fourth grade colleagues regarding future expectations and definitions of energy, transfer, and the transformation of energy (Grade 4, Energy Transfer and Transformation).
zh: 电有潜在危险。请与四年级同事协作，商定后续对能量、能量传递与能量转化的要求和定义（四年级“能量传递与转化”）。

subject: Science
topic: Safe Use of Electricity and Magnetism
en: Safety rules for electricity include:
zh: 用电安全规则包括：

subject: Science
topic: Safe Use of Electricity and Magnetism
en: never put your finger or anything metallic in an electrical outlet.
zh: 绝不要把手指或任何金属物插入电源插座。

subject: Science
topic: Safe Use of Electricity and Magnetism
en: never touch a switch or electrical appliance when your hand or body is wet.
zh: 手或身体潮湿时，绝不要触摸开关或电器。

subject: Science
topic: Safe Use of Electricity and Magnetism
en: never put your finger in a lamp socket.
zh: 绝不要把手指伸进灯座。

subject: Science
topic: The Human Body: Cells and Digestion
en: All living things are made up of cells too small to be seen without a microscope.
zh: 所有生物都由细胞构成，细胞小到必须借助显微镜才能看见。

subject: Science
topic: The Human Body: Cells and Digestion
en: The human body is made up of different types of cells including: stem, bone, blood, muscle, fat, skin, nerve.
zh: 人体由多种类型的细胞构成，包括：干细胞、骨细胞、血细胞、肌细胞、脂肪细胞、皮肤细胞、神经细胞。

subject: Science
topic: The Human Body: Cells and Digestion
en: Cells combine to form tissues.
zh: 细胞结合形成组织。

subject: Science
topic: The Human Body: Cells and Digestion
en: Tissues combine to form organs.
zh: 组织结合形成器官。

subject: Science
topic: The Human Body: Cells and Digestion
en: Organs combine to form organ systems.
zh: 器官结合形成器官系统。

subject: Science
topic: The Human Body: Cells and Digestion
en: The human body has complex systems, including the digestive and excretory systems.
zh: 人体有复杂的系统，包括消化系统和排泄系统。

subject: Science
topic: The Human Body: Cells and Digestion
en: The digestive system includes body parts that take in and process food (salivary glands, taste buds, teeth, esophagus, stomach, liver, small intestine, large intestine).
zh: 消化系统包括摄入和处理食物的身体部位（唾液腺、味蕾、牙齿、食道、胃、肝、小肠、大肠）。

subject: Science
topic: The Human Body: Cells and Digestion
en: The excretory system includes those body parts that eliminate some kinds of wastes (kidneys, bladder, urethra).
zh: 排泄系统包括排出某些废物的身体部位（肾、膀胱、尿道）。

subject: Science
en: A healthy lifestyle involves performing certain behaviors and avoiding other behaviors.
zh: 健康的生活方式包括采取某些行为并避免另一些行为。

subject: Science
en: The body needs specific foods, vitamins, and minerals in certain quantities to function properly.
zh: 身体需要特定数量的某些食物、维生素和矿物质才能正常运转。

subject: Science
en: Organizations make recommendations about what nutrients people need to stay healthy.
zh: 一些机构会就人们保持健康所需的营养素提出建议。

subject: Science
en: Vaccinations can help protect health.
zh: 接种疫苗有助于保护健康。

subject: Science
en: Through reading aloud and activities, explore with students the stories and accomplishments of these scientists and engineers. This list of science biographies is by no means exhaustive. Other individuals can be incorporated into learning during a corresponding topic of study for this grade level, and should include:
zh: 通过朗读和活动，与学生一起探究这些科学家和工程师的故事与成就。这份科学家传记清单并不详尽。在学习本年级相应主题时，还可以加入其他人物，应包括：

subject: Science
en: Dmitri Mendeleev—developed the periodic table
zh: 德米特里·门捷列夫——编制了元素周期表

subject: Science
en: John James Audubon—artist specializing in American birds
zh: 约翰·詹姆斯·奥杜邦——专画美洲鸟类的艺术家

subject: Science
en: Marie Tharp—pioneer in mapping the ocean floor
zh: 玛丽·萨普——绘制海底地图的先驱

subject: Science
en: Louis Pasteur—explored bacteria and the safety of foods Emphasis at this grade is to introduce the hierarchy of structures in the body. Review and extend learning from Kindergarten and Grade 1, Our Five Senses and Human Body Systems
zh: 路易斯·巴斯德——研究细菌与食品安全。本年级的重点是介绍身体的结构层次。复习并拓展幼儿园和一年级“我们的五种感官”与“人体系统”所学内容。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Maintain attention and actively participate in discussions about a variety of topics, ideas, and texts in a variety of settings including partners, small and large groups, and teacher-led groups.
zh: 在同伴、小组、大组和教师主导的多种情境中，都能保持专注并积极参与关于各种话题、想法和文本的讨论。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Prepare for discussions in advance, including reading about the topic and organizing information for the discussion. Draw on preparations during the discussion.
zh: 提前为讨论做准备，包括阅读相关话题材料并整理讨论所需信息；讨论时运用这些准备成果。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Use agreed-upon rules for group discussions, e.g., look at and listen attentively to the speaker, raise hand to speak, take turns, keep discussions on-topic, and say “excuse me” or “please.”
zh: 遵守小组讨论的共同规则，例如：注视并认真倾听发言者、举手发言、轮流发言、紧扣讨论主题，并说“打扰一下”或“请”。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Ask relevant questions to clarify conversations and ideas and to build upon remarks made by others.
zh: 提出相关问题，以澄清谈话和想法，并在他人发言的基础上进一步展开。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Participate in a discussion by explaining their own ideas relevant to the topic or conversation.
zh: 通过解释自己与话题或谈话相关的想法来参与讨论。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Understand and use narrative language to describe main ideas and supporting details in a text read aloud, such as people, places, things, locations, events, and actions.
zh: 理解并运用叙述性语言，描述朗读文本中的主要观点和支撑细节，如人物、地点、事物、场所、事件和动作。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Understand and use narrative language to describe texts read aloud or presented in different formats, such as videos, recordings, pictures, graphs, and charts.
zh: 理解并运用叙述性语言，描述以不同形式呈现或朗读的文本，如视频、录音、图片、曲线图和图表。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Ask and answer questions about information presented orally, providing appropriate on-topic elaboration and detail.
zh: 就口头呈现的信息提问并回答，给出切题的适当阐述和细节。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Give a presentation about a topic or text, tell a story, or orally relate a personal experience including relevant details and facts.
zh: 就某个话题或文本做展示、讲故事，或口头讲述个人经历，并包含相关细节和事实。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Make audio recordings of poems and stories, reading fluently and at an understandable volume and pace.
zh: 录制诗歌和故事的音频，朗读流畅，音量和语速便于理解。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Add visual displays to enhance certain facts and details in oral readings or presentations.
zh: 添加视觉展示材料，以强化口头朗读或展示中的某些事实和细节。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Speak in complete sentences, providing appropriate details and clarification for multiple tasks and situations.
zh: 用完整句子说话，在多种任务和场合中提供适当的细节和说明。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Identify and understand the meaning of common prefixes and suffixes.
zh: 识别并理解常见前缀和后缀的含义。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Decode words with common Latin suffixes.
zh: 拼读带常见拉丁语后缀的单词。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Decode and read multisyllable words at grade level.
zh: 拼读并朗读符合年级水平的多音节词。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Read irregularly spelled words at grade level.
zh: 朗读符合年级水平的拼写不规则词。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Note: Students should read outside of school at least 20 minutes daily.
zh: 注：学生每天应在课外至少阅读20分钟。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Read grade-level text fluently and accurately to support comprehension.
zh: 流利、准确地朗读年级水平的文本，以帮助理解。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Understand the purpose for reading a particular text.
zh: 理解阅读某一特定文本的目的。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Orally read and reread grade-level poetry and prose to develop accuracy, appropriate pacing, and expression.
zh: 口头朗读并反复朗读年级水平的诗歌和散文，以培养准确性、恰当的节奏和表达力。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Self-correct and develop understanding by rereading as necessary.
zh: 必要时通过重读进行自我纠正并加深理解。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Independently read and comprehend longer works of fiction (chapter books, stories, plays, and poems) and nonfiction (science, history, and social studies) appropriately written for third grade or beyond.
zh: 独立阅读并理解适合三年级及以上水平的较长虚构作品（章节书、故事、戏剧和诗歌）和非虚构作品（科学、历史和社会研究）。

subject: English Language Arts
section: Grasping Specific Details and Key Ideas
section_zh: 把握具体细节与关键观点
en: Ask and pose plausible answers to how, why, and what-if questions in interpreting fiction and nonfiction texts read independently.
zh: 在解读独立阅读的虚构与非虚构文本时，就“如何”“为什么”“假如……会怎样”等问题提问并给出合理答案。

subject: English Language Arts
section: Grasping Specific Details and Key Ideas
section_zh: 把握具体细节与关键观点
en: Orally summarize main points from fiction and nonfiction readings.
zh: 口头总结虚构和非虚构阅读材料的主要观点。

subject: English Language Arts
section: Grasping Specific Details and Key Ideas
section_zh: 把握具体细节与关键观点
en: Make inferences, draw conclusions, and trace the development of themes.
zh: 进行推断、得出结论，并梳理主题的发展脉络。

subject: English Language Arts
section: Grasping Specific Details and Key Ideas
section_zh: 把握具体细节与关键观点
en: Support inferences, conclusions, and themes with evidence from the text.
zh: 用文本中的证据支持推断、结论和主题。

subject: English Language Arts
section: Grasping Specific Details and Key Ideas
section_zh: 把握具体细节与关键观点
en: Understand how ideas develop in a text and the interactions between ideas, people, places, and events, and why they are important.
zh: 理解文本中观点如何展开，以及观点、人物、地点和事件之间的相互作用及其重要性。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Point to specific words or passages that are causing difficulties in comprehension.
zh: 指出造成理解困难的具体词语或段落。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Determine the meaning of words and phrases from a text that has been read independently, including denotative, connotative, and figurative meanings.
zh: 确定独立阅读文本中词语和短语的含义，包括字面意义、内涵意义和比喻意义。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Identify and use text features to locate and understand information (e.g., table of contents, index, chapters, scenes, stanzas, sidebars, captions, and key words).
zh: 识别并利用文本特征来查找和理解信息（如目录、索引、章节、场景、诗节、边栏、图注和关键词）。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Determine their own point of view about a text and understand how it differs from that of the author, narrator, or characters in a text.
zh: 确定自己对文本的观点，并理解它与作者、叙述者或书中人物的观点有何不同。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Prior to reading, identify what they know and have learned that may be related to the specific story or topic to be read.
zh: 阅读前，找出自己已知的、可能与所读故事或话题相关的知识和经验。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Make predictions prior to and while reading, based on the title, pictures, and/or text read thus far and then compare the actual outcomes to predictions.
zh: 根据标题、图片和/或已读到的文本，在阅读前和阅读中做出预测，然后把实际结果与预测进行比较。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Use images accompanying the written text (e.g., illustrations, photographs, charts, and maps) to check and support understanding.
zh: 利用伴随文字的图片（如插图、照片、图表和地图）来检验和辅助理解。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Answer questions that require making interpretations, making judgments, or giving opinions about what is read independently.
zh: 回答需要对独立阅读内容进行解读、判断或发表看法的问题。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Interpret information that is read independently and then ask questions to clarify this information.
zh: 解读独立阅读的信息，然后提问以澄清这些信息。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Identify the important themes or key ideas in a text.
zh: 找出文本中的重要主题或关键观点。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Compare and contrast themes or key ideas across texts.
zh: 比较和对比不同文本中的主题或关键观点。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Retell a story, using narrative language to describe characters, setting(s), and the plot of the story in proper sequence.
zh: 复述故事，用叙述性语言按正确顺序描述人物、场景和故事情节。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Identify the moral or lesson of a fable, folktale, or myth and identify the components that build it, including details such as the title, setting, characters, and how the story plays out.
zh: 找出寓言、民间故事或神话的寓意或教训，并识别构成它的要素，包括标题、背景、人物以及故事如何展开等细节。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Describe characters in increasing depth by referring to dialogue and/or their actions in the story.
zh: 借助故事中的对话和/或人物行为，逐步深入地描述人物。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Explain how characters’ actions, words, and motivations affect the plot of a story.
zh: 解释人物的行为、言语和动机如何影响故事情节。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Demonstrate understanding of literary language (e.g., author, illustrator, characters, setting, plot, dialogue, personification, simile, and metaphor) and use some of these terms when discussing fiction, drama, or poetry.
zh: 展示对文学语言的理解（如作者、插画者、人物、背景、情节、对话、拟人、明喻和隐喻），并在讨论虚构作品、戏剧或诗歌时使用其中一些术语。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Distinguish between literal and figurative language and be able to explain the meaning of figurative language in a text.
zh: 区分字面语言和修辞性语言，并能解释文本中修辞性语言的含义。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Distinguish between poems, plays, and stories, including the components of each (e.g., stanzas, scenes and acts, and chapters) and how the components affect the whole.
zh: 区分诗歌、戏剧和故事，包括各自的组成部分（如诗节、场景与幕、章节），以及这些组成部分如何影响整体。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Identify the point(s) of view of the narrator(s) and characters in a text; distinguish their own opinion or point of view from that of the narrator or characters.
zh: 识别文本中叙述者和人物的视角；区分自己的观点与叙述者或人物的观点。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Understand and explain how illustrations impact stories by showing aspects of a character or setting and creating a specific mood.
zh: 理解并解释插图如何通过展示人物或场景的某些方面、营造特定氛围来影响故事。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Identify and describe the theme, setting, and plot of a story; compare the themes, settings, and plots of stories written by the same author (as in a series).
zh: 识别并描述故事的主题、背景和情节；比较同一作者所写故事（如系列作品）的主题、背景和情节。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Answer questions about the details of a nonfiction text, indicating which part of the text provides the information needed to answer specific questions.
zh: 回答关于非虚构文本细节的问题，并指出文本的哪一部分提供了回答特定问题所需的信息。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Locate the main ideas in a text and distinguish them from details. Explain how details support big ideas.
zh: 找出文本中的主要观点并将其与细节区分开；解释细节如何支撑重要观点。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Identify the structure of a text, section of text, paragraph, or sentence (e.g., comparison, cause/effect, problem/solution, compare/contrast, sequence, or main idea and details) and describe how it connects and communicates ideas in the text.
zh: 识别文本、文本部分、段落或句子的结构（如比较、因果、问题/解决、对比、顺序或主旨与细节），并描述它如何连接和传达文本中的观点。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Understand how historical events, scientific ideas, or steps in a procedure are related in a text and use language pertaining to sequence or cause/effect to explain how or why they happened.
zh: 理解历史事件、科学观点或操作步骤在文本中如何关联，并使用表示顺序或因果的语言解释它们如何或为何发生。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Identify and determine the meaning of Tier 2 academic vocabulary and Tier 3 domain specific vocabulary in informational text.
zh: 识别并确定信息类文本中“第二层”学术词汇和“第三层”学科专用词汇的含义。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Locate relevant information in a print or digital text using text features and search tools such as key words, sidebars, and hyperlinks.
zh: 利用文本特征和搜索工具（如关键词、边栏和超链接），在纸质或数字文本中定位相关信息。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Understand the author’s point of view or opinion about a nonfiction subject and distinguish it from their own.
zh: 理解作者对非虚构主题的观点或看法，并将其与自己的观点区分开。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Use both words and images (e.g., photos, maps, and diagrams) in an informational text to answer where, when, why, and how questions relevant to the text.
zh: 利用信息类文本中的文字和图像（如照片、地图和示意图），回答与文本相关的“在哪里”“何时”“为什么”和“如何”的问题。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Compare and contrast the information in nonfiction texts on similar subjects.
zh: 比较和对比关于相似主题的非虚构文本中的信息。

subject: English Language Arts
subtopic: Writing to Reflect Audience, Purpose, and Task
en: Write routinely, completing both short and long assignments focused on a range of different tasks, purposes, and audiences.
zh: 坚持经常写作，完成围绕各种任务、目的和读者的长短作业。

subject: English Language Arts
subtopic: Writing to Reflect Audience, Purpose, and Task
en: Produce a variety of types of writing—such as stories, reports, poems, letters, descriptions, and arguments—and make reasonable judgments about what to include in their own written works based on the purpose and type of composition.
zh: 写出多种类型的作品——如故事、报告、诗歌、书信、描写和议论文——并根据写作目的和文体，合理判断自己的作品中应包含哪些内容。

subject: English Language Arts
subtopic: Writing to Reflect Audience, Purpose, and Task
en: Know how to use established conventions when writing a friendly letter: heading, salutation (greeting), closing, and signature.
zh: 知道写友好书信时的既定格式：信头、称呼（问候语）、结尾敬语和署名。

subject: English Language Arts
subtopic: Writing to Reflect Audience, Purpose, and Task
en: Organize material in paragraphs and understand
zh: 把材料组织成段落，并理解

subject: English Language Arts
subtopic: Writing to Reflect Audience, Purpose, and Task
en: how to use a topic sentence.
zh: 如何使用主题句。

subject: English Language Arts
subtopic: Writing to Reflect Audience, Purpose, and Task
en: how to develop a paragraph with examples and details.
zh: 如何用实例和细节展开段落。

subject: English Language Arts
subtopic: Writing to Reflect Audience, Purpose, and Task
en: that each new paragraph is indented.
zh: 每个新段落都要缩进。

subject: English Language Arts
subtopic: Writing to Reflect Audience, Purpose, and Task
en: In some writings, proceed with guidance through a process of gathering information, organizing thoughts, composing a draft, revising to clarify and refine their meaning, and proofreading with attention to spelling, mechanics, and presentation of a final draft.
zh: 在某些写作中，在指导下完成如下过程：收集信息、整理思路、起草初稿、修改以澄清并完善意思，以及校订终稿并注意拼写、书写规范和呈现效果。

subject: English Language Arts
subtopic: Writing to Reflect Audience, Purpose, and Task
en: Use keyboards, tablets, and other technologies to produce and publish writing as well as to collaborate and communicate with others.
zh: 使用键盘、平板电脑和其他技术来创作和发布作品，并与他人协作和交流。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Conduct short research projects to demonstrate knowledge gathered and learned about a topic.
zh: 开展小型研究项目，展示围绕某一主题收集和学到的知识。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Gather information from personal experiences as well as from print and digital sources (e.g., a children’s encyclopedia, approved online sources, videos, and recordings).
zh: 从个人经历以及纸质和数字资源（如儿童百科全书、经批准的在线资源、视频和录音）中收集信息。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Take notes from sources.
zh: 从资料来源中做笔记。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Organize information from research notes into categories provided by the teacher.
zh: 把研究笔记中的信息按老师提供的类别进行整理。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Produce narrative pieces that reflect real-life or imagined experiences
zh: 写出反映真实生活或想象经历的叙事作品

subject: English Language Arts
en: Introduce a narrator and characters and develop them through dialogue and exposition, including actions, thoughts, feelings, and reactions to events in the plot.
zh: 引入叙述者和人物，并通过对话和说明展开刻画，包括动作、想法、感受以及对情节中事件的反应。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Organize a logical sequence of plot events, using time-order words to indicate event order.
zh: 按逻辑顺序组织情节事件，并用表示时间顺序的词标明事件先后。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Provide a beginning that introduces the story, a middle that develops story events, and an ending that gives a sense of closure.
zh: 写出引入故事的开头、展开故事事件的中段，以及带来完整收束感的结尾。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Write a short report that clearly presents ideas and information in their own words.
zh: 写一篇简短的报告，用自己的话清楚地呈现观点和资料。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Introduce a topic with information organized in related sections or paragraphs and developed with facts, definitions, and details.
zh: 引入一个主题，把信息组织在相关的部分或段落中，并用事实、定义和细节加以展开。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Include visual elements such as photos, drawings, or diagrams to help explain or present ideas or information when appropriate.
zh: 在适当处加入照片、绘图或图表等视觉元素，以帮助解释或呈现观点和信息。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Use linking words to connect ideas (e.g., also, another, and, more, but, however, therefore, in addition).
zh: 使用连接词连接观点（如 also、another、and、more、but、however、therefore、in addition）。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Write a conclusion that wraps up ideas in the text.
zh: 写出总结全文观点的结尾。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Introduce an opinion and support it with reasons or evidence.
zh: 提出一个观点，并用理由或证据加以支持。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Use linking words to connect their opinion with reasons (e.g., another, more, but, also, however, therefore, in addition).
zh: 使用连接词把观点与理由连接起来（如 another、more、but、also、however、therefore、in addition）。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Write a conclusion that wraps up the argument.
zh: 写出总结论证的结尾。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Use knowledge of language conventions when reading, writing, speaking, and listening.
zh: 在阅读、写作、口语和倾听中运用语言规范知识。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Identify differences between written and spoken English.
zh: 识别书面英语与口语英语之间的差异。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Apply word choices to create meaning and effect.
zh: 运用选词来创造意义与效果。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Spell most words correctly or with a highly probable spelling.
zh: 大多数单词拼写正确，或拼出极有可能正确的形式。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Apply current code knowledge to spelling.
zh: 把当前学到的拼读规则知识运用于拼写。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Spell most grade-level high-frequency words correctly.
zh: 正确拼写大多数年级高频词。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Spell words correctly when adding plurals, suffixes, and other known endings.
zh: 在添加复数、后缀和其他已知词尾时正确拼写单词。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Use knowledge of word patterns, word families, word parts, and ending rules to spell correctly.
zh: 利用词形模式、词族、词的组成部分和词尾规则来正确拼写。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Use dictionaries or glossaries—print and digital—to check and correct spellings about which they are uncertain.
zh: 使用纸质或电子词典、词汇表，检查并改正不确定的拼写。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Understand what a complete sentence is, and
zh: 理解什么是完整句，并

subject: English Language Arts
en: identify subject and predicate in single-clause sentences.
zh: 在只含一个分句的句子中识别主语和谓语。

subject: English Language Arts
en: distinguish complete sentences from fragments.
zh: 区分完整句与残句（片段）。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Identify and use different sentence types:
zh: 识别并使用不同的句型：

subject: English Language Arts
en: simple (contains one subject and one predicate)
zh: 简单句（含一个主语和一个谓语）

subject: English Language Arts
en: compound (contains more than one subject or predicate)
zh: 并列句（含不止一个主语或谓语）

subject: English Language Arts
en: complex (contains a subordinate clause)
zh: 复杂句（含一个从句）

subject: English Language Arts
en: Correctly use coordinating and subordinating conjunctions in sentences.
zh: 在句子中正确使用并列连词和从属连词。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Know the following parts of speech and how they are used:
zh: 了解以下词类及其用法：

subject: English Language Arts
en: nouns (concrete and abstract; regular and irregular plural)
zh: 名词（具体名词与抽象名词；规则复数与不规则复数）

subject: English Language Arts
en: pronouns (singular and plural)
zh: 代词（单数与复数）

subject: English Language Arts
en: verbs (action verbs and auxiliary or helping verbs; regular and irregular verbs; verb tenses)
zh: 动词（实义动词与助动词；规则动词与不规则动词；动词时态）

subject: English Language Arts
en: adjectives (including articles: a before a consonant, an before a vowel, and the)
zh: 形容词（包括冠词：辅音前用 a，元音前用 an，以及定冠词 the）

subject: English Language Arts
en: adverbs
zh: 副词

subject: English Language Arts
en: Understand and use correct subject-verb agreement.
zh: 理解并正确使用主谓一致。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Understand and use correct pronoun-antecedent agreement.
zh: 理解并正确使用代词与其先行词的一致关系。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Correctly form and use comparative and superlative adjectives and adverbs.
zh: 正确构成并使用形容词和副词的比较级与最高级。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Use capital letters correctly, including at the beginning of sentences, proper nouns, and words in titles.
zh: 正确使用大写字母，包括句首、专有名词以及标题中的主要单词。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Know how to use the following punctuation:
zh: 掌握以下标点符号的用法：

subject: English Language Arts
en: comma: between city and state in an address; in dialogue
zh: 逗号：用于地址中城市与州之间；用于对话中

subject: English Language Arts
en: apostrophe: in singular and plural possessive nouns
zh: 撇号：用于单数和复数名词的所有格

subject: English Language Arts
en: quotation marks: in dialogue
zh: 引号：用于对话

subject: English Language Arts
en: Use context clues to figure out the meaning of words and phrases in a sentence.
zh: 利用上下文线索推断句中单词和短语的含义。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Know what prefixes and suffixes are and how the following affect word meaning:
zh: 了解前缀和后缀是什么，以及它们如何影响词义：

subject: English Language Arts
en: Prefixes:
zh: 前缀：
details: re– meaning “again” (as in reuse, refill) | pre– meaning “before” (as in preview) | pro– meaning “for” or “forward” (as in propel) | mis– meaning “incorrectly” (as in misplaced) | un– meaning “not” (as in unfriendly) | dis–, non– meaning “not” (as in dishonest, nonsense) | un–, dis– meaning “opposite of” (as in untie, disappear) | anti– meaning “against” (as in antiviral) | uni– meaning “one” (as in universe) | bi– meaning “two” (as in bicycle) | tri– meaning “three” (as in triangle) | multi– meaning “many” (as in multiple) | mid– meaning “middle” (as in midsection)

subject: English Language Arts
en: Suffixes:
zh: 后缀：
details: –er and –or meaning “someone who” (as in singer, actor) | –ful meaning “having” or “full of” (as in careful) | –less meaning “without” (as in careless) | –able, –ible meaning “able to” (as in breakable, visible) | –ly meaning “in the manner of” (as in quickly) Note: Review and reinforce from Grade 2: singular and plural nouns; making words plural with /s/ or /es/; irregular plurals; correct usage of irregular verbs (be, have, do, go, come, etc.); regular past tense with -ed and past tense of irregular verbs.

subject: English Language Arts
en: Note: Review from Grade 2: capital letters for the first word of a sentence; proper nouns; the pronoun I; holidays and months and days of the week; names of countries, cities, states; main words in titles; initials.
zh: 注意：复习二年级内容：句子首字母大写；专有名词；代词 I；节假日、月份和星期几；国家、城市、州的名称；标题中的主要单词；姓名首字母缩写。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Note: Teach only words that can be clearly analyzed into prefix and base word; for example, do not teach “discover” or “display” as prefixed words.
zh: 注意：只教能够清楚拆分为前缀和词根的单词；例如，不要把 discover（发现）或 display（展示）当作带前缀的词来教。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Figure out the meaning of a new word based on the meaning of a known word with the same root (e.g., vision, visible, visualize).
zh: 根据词根相同的已知词的含义推断新词的意思（例如 vision 视力、visible 可见的、visualize 想象）。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Use a dictionary or glossary to answer questions regarding meaning and usage of unfamiliar words.
zh: 使用词典或词汇表来回答有关生词含义和用法的问题。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Differentiate between literal and figurative word choices, as in the phrase “hold your head up high.”
zh: 区分词语的字面含义与比喻含义，如短语 hold your head up high（昂首挺胸）。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Make connections between words and real-world examples (e.g., describe something enjoyable; give an example of a disappointment).
zh: 在词语和真实世界的事例之间建立联系（例如描述令人愉快的事物；举出令人失望的例子）。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Distinguish shades and degrees of meaning in related words (e.g. happy, pleased, overjoyed).
zh: 区分相关词语之间意义的细微差别和程度差异（如 happy 开心、pleased 满意、overjoyed 欣喜若狂）。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Acquire grade-level academic words (e.g., compare, infer, describe).
zh: 掌握本年级的学术词汇（如 compare 比较、infer 推断、describe 描述）。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Acquire grade-level words related to specific domains or subject areas (e.g., gravity, atmosphere, environment).
zh: 掌握与本年级特定领域或学科相关的词汇（如 gravity 重力、atmosphere 大气、environment 环境）。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Understand and use words that signal time and spatial relationships (e.g., later, earlier that day, after breakfast yesterday.)
zh: 理解并使用表示时间和空间关系的词语（如 later 稍后、earlier that day 当天早些时候、after breakfast yesterday 昨天早饭后）。

subject: English Language Arts
en: The poems listed here constitute a selected core of poetry for this grade. You are encouraged to expose students to more poetry, old and new, and to have students write their own poems. To bring students into the spirit of poetry, read it aloud and encourage them to read it aloud so they can experience the music in the words. At this grade, poetry should be a source of delight; technical analysis should be delayed until later grades.
zh: 此处列出的诗歌构成本年级精选的核心诗篇。鼓励学生接触更多诗歌，无论古今，并让学生自己写诗。为带领学生进入诗歌的意境，请大声朗读，并鼓励学生也大声朗读，让他们体会文字中的韵律之美。在本年级，诗歌应当成为快乐的源泉；技巧性的分析应留到以后的年级再进行。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Every culture has phrases and proverbs that make no sense when carried over literally into another culture. For many students, this section may not be needed; they will have picked up these sayings by hearing them at home and among friends. But the sayings have been one of the categories most appreciated by teachers who work with students from home cultures that differ from the standard culture of literate American English. Actions speak louder than words. His bark is worse than his bite. Beat around the bush Beggars can’t be choosers. Clean bill of health Cold shoulder A feather in your cap Last straw Let bygones be bygones. One rotten apple spoils the whole barrel. On its last legs Rule the roost The show must go on. Touch and go When in Rome do as the Romans do. Rome wasn’t built in a day. See also World History Grade 3: Vikings.

subject: History and Geography
en: Teachers: The study of geography embraces many topics throughout the Core Knowledge Sequence, including topics in history and science. Geographic knowledge includes a spatial sense of the world, an awareness of the physical processes that shape life, a sense of the interactions between humans and their environment, an understanding of the relations between place and culture, and an awareness of the characteristics of specific regions and cultures. It is important that students learn about the people who shaped our world, as well as those who continue to do so. Thus, it is recommended that students read biographies. Reading stories about the individuals listed in the Sequence, and others, allows students to draw from a broader perspective.
zh: 教师：地理学贯穿核心知识序列中的许多主题，包括历史和科学主题。地理知识包括对世界的空间感、对塑造生活的自然过程的认识、对人类与环境相互作用的理解、对地方与文化关系的理解，以及对特定地区和文化特征的认识。让学生了解塑造我们世界的人以及仍在塑造世界的人是很重要的。因此，建议让学生阅读传记。阅读关于序列中所列人物及其他人物的故事，能让学生从更广阔的视角出发。

subject: Mathematics
en: Teachers: Mathematics has its own vocabulary and patterns of thinking. It is a discipline with its own language and conventions. Thus, while some lessons may offer occasional opportunities for linking mathematics to other disciplines, it is critically important to attend to math as math. From the earliest years, mathematics requires incremental review and steady practice: not only the diligent effort required to master basic facts and operations, but also thoughtful and varied practice that approaches problems from a variety of angles, and gives students a variety of opportunities to apply the same concept or operation in different types of situations. While it is important to work toward the development of “higher-order problem-solving skills,” it is equally important—indeed, it is prerequisite to achieving “higher order” skills—to have a sound grasp of basic facts, and an automatic fluency with fundamental operations.
zh: 教师须知：数学有其自身的词汇和思维方式，是一门有自己语言和规范的学科。因此，虽然有些课程偶尔可以把数学与其他学科联系起来，但把数学当作数学来讲至关重要。从最初几年起，数学就需要循序渐进的复习和持续练习：既要努力掌握基本事实和运算，也要进行深思熟虑、形式多样的练习，从多种角度处理问题，让学生在不同类型的情境中多次运用同一概念或运算。虽然培养“高阶解题技能”很重要，但牢固掌握基本事实、对基本运算达到自动化熟练程度同样重要——事实上，这是达到“高阶”技能的前提。

zh: 认识菱形、长方形和正方形都是四边形的例子。
details: Draw examples of quadrilaterals that do not belong to any of these subcategories.

subject: Mathematics
en: Partition shapes into parts with equal areas.
zh: 把图形分割成面积相等的部分。
details: Express the area of each part as a unit fraction of the whole. Square cm., square m., square in., square ft., and improvised units.

subject: Science
en: Teachers: Effective instruction in science requires hands-on experience and observation. In the words of the report from the National Academies of Science, A Framework for K-12 Science Education, “...children have surprisingly sophisticated ways of thinking about the world, based in part on their direct experiences with the physical environment, such as watching objects fall or collide and observing plants and animals. They also learn about the world through everyday activities, such as talking with their families, pursuing hobbies, watching television, and playing with friends. As children try to understand and influence the world around them, they develop ideas about their role in that world and how it works. In fact, the capacity of young children—from all backgrounds and socioeconomic levels—to reason in sophisticated ways is much greater than has long been assumed. Although they may lack deep knowledge and extensive experience, they often engage in a wide range of subtle and complex reasoning about the world. Thus, before they even enter school, children have developed their own ideas about the physical, biological, and social worlds and how they work. By listening to and taking these ideas seriously, educators can build on what children already know and can do.”
zh: 教师须知：有效的科学教学需要动手体验和观察。用美国国家科学院报告《K-12 科学教育框架》的话来说：“……孩子们以令人惊讶的复杂方式思考世界，这部分基于他们对物质环境的直接体验，比如观看物体下落或碰撞、观察动植物。他们也通过日常活动了解世界，比如与家人交谈、从事爱好、看电视、和朋友玩耍。当孩子们试图理解和影响周围的世界时，他们会形成关于自己在世界中的角色以及世界如何运作的想法。事实上，幼儿——无论来自何种背景、何种社会经济水平——进行复杂推理的能力远超长期以来的设想。尽管他们可能缺乏深入知识和丰富经验，但他们常常对世界进行广泛而细致的复杂推理。因此，甚至在入学之前，孩子们就已经对物理、生物和社会世界及其运作方式形成了自己的想法。通过倾听并认真对待这些想法，教育者可以在儿童已有知识和能力的基础上进行教学。”

subject: Science
en: Through reading aloud, observation, and activities such as planning and conducting investigations of colliding objects, explore the following with students:
zh: 通过朗读、观察，以及设计并实施对碰撞物体的探究等活动，带领学生探索以下内容：

subject: Science
en: A force is a push or a pull.
zh: 力是推或拉。

subject: Science
en: Forces can cause changes in an object’s motion.
zh: 力能使物体的运动状态发生改变。

subject: Science
en: Forces can change an object’s direction and speed, sometimes starting or stopping the object’s motion.
zh: 力能改变物体的方向和速度，有时还能使物体开始或停止运动。

subject: Science
en: Gravity is a force that pulls objects toward each other.
zh: 重力是把物体相互吸引的力。

subject: Science
en: Forces on an object may be balanced or unbalanced.
zh: 作用在物体上的力可能是平衡的，也可能是不平衡的。

subject: Science
en: If an object is at rest the forces acting on it are balanced.
zh: 如果物体处于静止状态，作用在其上的力是平衡的。

subject: Science
en: Friction is a force that occurs when objects are in contact with one another.
zh: 摩擦力是物体相互接触时产生的一种力。

subject: Science
en: Friction opposes motion.
zh: 摩擦力阻碍运动。

subject: Science
en: Friction can create heat (for example, rubbing hands together).
zh: 摩擦能产生热（例如双手互相摩擦）。

subject: Science
en: Friction can be helpful (bicycle brakes) or harmful (in automobile engines).
zh: 摩擦力可能有益（自行车刹车），也可能有害（汽车发动机中）。

subject: Science
en: Lubricants reduce friction.
zh: 润滑剂能减少摩擦。

subject: Science
en: If an object moves in regular patterns, we can predict the object’s future motion.
zh: 如果物体按规律的模式运动，我们就能预测它未来的运动。

subject: Science
en: Magnetism is a force that can push or pull.
zh: 磁力是一种能推或拉的力。

subject: Science
en: Only certain metals can be or become magnetic or be affected by magnetism (for example, iron).
zh: 只有某些金属能带有磁性、被磁化或受磁力影响（例如铁）。

subject: Science
en: The strength of a magnetic force depends on the distance between the magnet and the object.
zh: 磁力的大小取决于磁铁与物体之间的距离。

subject: Science
en: Unlike poles (north and south) attract, like poles repel.
zh: 异极（南极和北极）相吸，同极相斥。

subject: Science
en: People use magnets to solve problems (refrigerator magnets, cabinet locks, maglev trains). Review and extend learning from Kindergarten, Pushes and Pulls.
zh: 人们利用磁铁解决问题（冰箱贴、柜门锁、磁悬浮列车）。复习并拓展幼儿园“推与拉”的学习内容。

subject: Science
en: Life cycles are the patterns of changes that organisms go through during their lives.
zh: 生命周期是生物在一生中所经历的变化模式。

subject: Science
en: Different organisms have different life cycles, but all life cycles share common stages: birth, growth, reproduction, death.
zh: 不同生物有不同的生命周期，但所有生命周期都有共同的阶段：出生、生长、繁殖、死亡。

subject: Science
en: The life cycle of a typical flowering plant:
zh: 典型开花植物的生命周期：

subject: Science
en: birth (germination of seeds) > growth > reproduction (flowering) > death
zh: 出生（种子萌发）> 生长 > 繁殖（开花）> 死亡

subject: Science
en: Metamorphosis is the process some animals go through involving a great change in form in becoming an adult, such as:
zh: 变态发育是某些动物在长大为成体的过程中形态发生巨大变化的过程，例如：

subject: Science
en: butterfly (egg, larva, pupa, adult)
zh: 蝴蝶（卵、幼虫、蛹、成虫）

subject: Science
en: frog (egg, tadpole, adult)
zh: 青蛙（卵、蝌蚪、成体）

subject: Science
en: An organism is any individual life form.
zh: 生物体是任何单个的生命形式。

subject: Science
en: A community of organisms of the same species within an ecosystem is a population.
zh: 生态系统中同一物种的生物群体称为种群。

subject: Science
en: Traits can vary to help certain individuals survive and reproduce.
zh: 性状会发生变化，以帮助某些个体生存和繁殖。

subject: Science
en: Organisms are divided into species, which share specific traits.
zh: 生物被划分为不同的物种，同一物种具有特定的共同性状。

subject: Science
en: Traits are the characteristics of living things, including structures, functions, and behaviors; traits we can observe are called physical traits.
zh: 性状是生物的特征，包括结构、功能和行为；能观察到的性状称为外在（形态）性状。

subject: Science
en: Offspring and siblings generally look like, but are not identical to, their parents or one another.
zh: 子代和兄弟姐妹通常长得像父母或彼此，但并不完全相同。

subject: Science
en: Inheritance is the traits that are passed from parents to offspring.
zh: 遗传是从父母传递给子代的性状。

subject: Science
en: A population is a group of organisms of the same species that live in the same area.
zh: 种群是生活在同一地区的同一物种生物群体。

subject: Science
en: Variations are the differences among specific traits in a population.
zh: 变异是种群中特定性状之间的差异。

subject: Science
en: The environment can influence an organism’s traits.
zh: 环境会影响生物的性状。

subject: Science
en: The environment can affect all stages of an organism’s life cycle.
zh: 环境会影响生物生命周期的所有阶段。

subject: Science
en: Cause and effect relationships exist between populations and their ecosystems.
zh: 种群与其生态系统之间存在因果关系。

subject: Science
en: In a changing environment, some traits help some living things (advantageous) while other traits do not help (disadvantageous).
zh: 在变化的环境中，某些性状对某些生物有利（有利性状），而另一些性状则无益（不利性状）。

subject: Science
en: Some individuals in a population may reproduce more successfully than others if their traits help them thrive in their specific environment.
zh: 如果某些个体的性状有助于它们在特定环境中繁盛，它们就可能比其他个体繁殖得更成功。

subject: Science
en: Through reading aloud, observation, and activities such as developing models of the shapes and kinds of land and water in an area, help students to explore the following:
zh: 通过朗读、观察，以及制作某地区陆地和水域的形状与种类模型等活动，帮助学生探索以下内容：

subject: Science
en: Living things are adapted to the environment in which they live.
zh: 生物适应其生存的环境。

subject: Science
en: Adaptations promote survival.
zh: 适应性有助于生存。

subject: Science
en: Organisms have traits that indicate they are adapted to live in their environment, and able to survive.
zh: 生物具有一些性状，表明它们已适应所处环境并能够生存。

subject: Science
en: Organisms have adaptations to specific habitats (tundra, seashore, desert and underground).
zh: 生物具有适应特定栖息地（苔原、海岸、沙漠和地下）的特征。

subject: Science
en: Some animals form groups to help them survive in their habitats. Review and extend learning from Grade 2, Organisms and Their Habitats. B. Ecosystems and Environmental Change
zh: 有些动物组成群体，以帮助自己在栖息地中生存。复习并拓展二年级“生物及其栖息地”的学习内容。

subject: Science
en: An ecosystem is all the biotic and abiotic factors in a specific environment.
zh: 生态系统是特定环境中的全部生物因素和非生物因素。

subject: Science
en: Ecosystems undergo natural and human-induced changes over time.
zh: 生态系统会随时间经历自然变化和人为引起的变化。

subject: Science
en: When an ecosystem changes, some organisms survive while others may not.
zh: 当生态系统发生变化时，有些生物能存活，另一些则可能无法存活。

subject: Science
en: Describe specific evidence that shows what a habitat and a specific organism in that habitat were like before and after a significant environmental change.
zh: 描述具体证据，说明在重大环境变化前后，某栖息地及其中某种生物的状态。

subject: Science
en: Humans can cause threats to the environment (air pollution: emissions, smog; water pollution: industrial waste, run-off from farming).
zh: 人类可能对环境造成威胁（空气污染：排放物、烟雾；水污染：工业废料、农业径流）。

subject: Science
en: Debate the merits of solutions for reconstructing an ecosystem after a significant environmental change.
zh: 就重大环境变化后重建生态系统的各种方案的优劣展开辩论。

subject: Science
topic: Evidence of How Organisms and Environments Have Changed Over Time
en: Fossils: Scientists analyze and interpret fossils (bones, amber, traces, impressions) for evidence of how organisms and environments have changed over time.
zh: 化石：科学家分析和解读化石（骨骼、琥珀、痕迹、印痕），以寻找生物和环境随时间变化的证据。

subject: Science
topic: Evidence of How Organisms and Environments Have Changed Over Time
en: As a past environment changed, so did the organisms that continue to live there (coral reefs, grasslands).
zh: 随着过去环境的改变，继续生活在那里的生物也发生了改变（如珊瑚礁、草原）。

subject: Science
topic: Evidence of How Organisms and Environments Have Changed Over Time
en: Many organisms that once existed are now extinct.
zh: 许多曾经存在的生物如今已经灭绝。

subject: Science
en: Air is a mixture of gases.
zh: 空气是多种气体的混合物。

subject: Science
en: Air is matter and takes up space.
zh: 空气是物质，会占据空间。

subject: Science
en: The most common gases in the atmosphere are nitrogen and oxygen.
zh: 大气中最常见的气体是氮气和氧气。

subject: Science
en: The atmosphere grows thinner as you move upward from Earth’s surface.
zh: 从地球表面向上，大气变得越来越稀薄。

subject: Science
en: Air pressure is the weight of air in the atmosphere.
zh: 气压是大气中空气的重量。

subject: Science
en: Humidity is the amount of water vapor in the air.
zh: 湿度是空气中水蒸气的含量。

subject: Science
en: Evaporation is the sun’s energy changing liquid water to gas.
zh: 蒸发是太阳的能量把液态水变成气态。

subject: Science
en: Condensation of water vapor in the atmosphere forms clouds and fog.
zh: 大气中的水蒸气凝结形成云和雾。

subject: Science
en: Precipitation is water that falls from clouds, such as rain, snow, sleet, or hail.
zh: 降水是从云中落下的水，如雨、雪、雨夹雪或冰雹。

subject: Science
en: Energy from the sun warms Earth unevenly, which creates areas of warm air (lower air pressure) and areas of cool air (higher air pressure).
zh: 太阳的能量使地球受热不均，形成暖空气区域（气压较低）和冷空气区域（气压较高）。

subject: Science
en: Winds are the result of air moving from areas of high air pressure to areas of low air pressure.
zh: 风是空气从高气压区域向低气压区域移动的结果。

subject: Science
en: Prevailing winds are regular patterns of wind flow across Earth’s surface.
zh: 盛行风是地球表面上规则的风流模式。

subject: Science
en: Weather is the conditions in the lowest layer of the atmosphere at a specific time and place.
zh: 天气是特定时间和地点大气最低层的状况。

subject: Science
en: Weather conditions vary from place to place and over time.
zh: 天气状况因地点和时间而异。

subject: Science
en: Meteorologists are scientists who study weather and climate.
zh: 气象学家是研究天气和气候的科学家。

subject: Science
en: Climate is the pattern of weather conditions in a large area over a long time.
zh: 气候是大范围内长时间内的天气状况模式。

subject: Science
en: Climate varies from place to place.
zh: 气候因地点而异。

subject: Science
en: Climate in one location varies over a year’s time.
zh: 同一地点的气候在一年中也会变化。

subject: Science
en: Climatologists are scientists who study long-term weather data.
zh: 气候学家是研究长期天气数据的科学家。

subject: Science
topic: Reducing the Impact of Hazardous Weather
en: Storms: high winds, heavy rains, lightning, thunder
zh: 暴风雨：强风、暴雨、闪电、雷声

subject: Science
topic: Reducing the Impact of Hazardous Weather
en: Extreme weather events: tornadoes, hurricanes, blizzards, drought Collaborate with your fifth grade colleagues regarding future expectations within, Energy and Matter in Ecosystems and Protecting Earth's Resources. Fossils are explored in more depth in Grade 4, Processes That Shape Earth. Review and extend learning from Kindergarten, Weather Patterns.
zh: 极端天气事件：龙卷风、飓风、暴风雪、干旱。与五年级同事协作，了解“生态系统中的能量与物质”和“保护地球资源”方面的后续要求。化石将在四年级“塑造地球的过程”中更深入地探讨。复习并拓展幼儿园“天气模式”的学习内容。

subject: Science
topic: Reducing the Impact of Hazardous Weather
en: Flooding can occur during and after storms.
zh: 洪水可能在暴风雨期间和之后发生。

subject: Science
topic: Reducing the Impact of Hazardous Weather
en: Extreme weather conditions can endanger people and cause destruction.
zh: 极端天气会危及人类并造成破坏。

subject: Science
topic: Reducing the Impact of Hazardous Weather
en: People can plan and take steps to reduce damage and avoid danger from weather hazards (levies, warning systems, lightning rods, special buildings).
zh: 人们可以制定计划并采取措施，减少天气灾害造成的损失、避免危险（堤坝、预警系统、避雷针、特殊建筑）。

zh: 肌肉

en: Involuntary and voluntary muscles
zh: 不随意肌和随意肌

en: Skeleton, bones, marrow
zh: 骨骼、骨头、骨髓

en: Skull, cranium, spinal column, vertebrae
zh: 头骨、颅骨、脊柱、椎骨

en: Joints
zh: 关节

zh: 肋骨、胸廓、胸骨

zh: 肩胛骨（肩胛）、骨盆、胫骨、腓骨

en: Broken bones, x-rays
zh: 骨折、X光

subject: Science

en: Musculo-skeletal connections
zh: 肌肉与骨骼的连接

en: Ligaments
zh: 韧带

topic: The Human Body: Human Senses and Movement
en: Cartilage
zh: 软骨

zh: 脑：延髓、小脑、大脑、大脑皮层

subject: Science

zh: 脊髓

subject: Science
en: Nerves
zh: 神经

subject: Science

zh: 反射

subject: Science
en: Parts of the eye: cornea, iris and pupil, lens, retina
zh: 眼睛的构造：角膜、虹膜和瞳孔、晶状体、视网膜

en: Optic nerve
zh: 视神经

subject: Science
en: Farsighted and nearsighted vision
zh: 远视和近视

subject: Science
en: Ways to help those with impaired vision, including corrective lens, assistive animals, and braille
zh: 帮助视力障碍者的方式，包括矫正镜片、导盲犬和盲文

subject: Science
en: Sound as vibration
zh: 声音是振动

subject: Science
en: Outer ear, ear canal
zh: 外耳、耳道

subject: Science
en: Eardrum
zh: 鼓膜

subject: Science
en: Three tiny bones (hammer, anvil, and stirrup) pass vibrations to the cochlea
zh: 三块小骨（锤骨、砧骨和镫骨）将振动传递到耳蜗

subject: Science
en: Auditory nerve
zh: 听觉神经

subject: Science
en: Ways to help those with impaired hearing, including sign language, cochlear implants, and other hearing aids.
zh: 帮助听力障碍者的方式，包括手语、人工耳蜗和其他助听器。

subject: Science
en: Through reading aloud and activities, explore with students the stories and accomplishments of these scientists and engineers. This list of science biographies is by no means exhaustive. Other individuals can be incorporated into learning during a corresponding topic of study for this grade level, and should include: Emphasis at this grade is to build on prior knowledge and to explore how our body systems and senses work together.
zh: 通过朗读和相关活动，与学生一起了解这些科学家和工程师的故事与成就。这份科学家传记清单并不详尽；在学习本年级相应主题时，还可以加入其他人物。本年级的重点是在已有知识的基础上，探索我们的身体系统和各种感官是如何协同工作的。

subject: Science
en: Petrus Peregrinus de Maricourt—French scholar who worked on compasses
zh: 佩特鲁斯·佩雷格里努斯·德·马里库尔——研究指南针的法国学者

subject: Science
en: Elijah McCoy—American inventor, invented lubrication devices to improve the efficiency of train travel.
zh: 伊莱贾·麦科伊——美国发明家，发明了润滑装置以提高火车运行效率。

subject: Science
en: Gregor Mendel—Austrian monk who studied pea plants, and developed models of simple inheritance.
zh: 格雷戈尔·孟德尔——奥地利修道士，研究豌豆植物，提出了简单遗传的模型。

subject: Science
en: Rachel Carson—warned of the environmental impacts of pesticides in her book Silent Spring.
zh: 蕾切尔·卡逊——在《寂静的春天》一书中警示了农药对环境的影响。

subject: Science
en: John Muir—studied wilderness areas and worked to convince people to protect them.
zh: 约翰·缪尔——研究荒野地区，并努力说服人们加以保护。

subject: Science
en: Edward D. Cope and Othniel C. Marsh—paleontologists and competitors whose competition started “the Bone Wars,” also known as the Great Dinosaur Rush of the late 19th century.
zh: 爱德华·D·科普与奥塞内尔·C·马什——古生物学家，也是竞争对手；他们的竞争引发了“骨头战争”，即19世纪末的“恐龙淘金热”。

subject: Science
en: Evangelista Torricelli—invented the barometer and studied air pressure.
zh: 埃万杰利斯塔·托里拆利——发明了气压计，并研究气压。

subject: Science
en: Benjamin Franklin—invented a lightning rod to protect people, buildings, and other structures.
zh: 本杰明·富兰克林——发明了避雷针，以保护人、建筑物和其他结构。

subject: Science
en: Tetsuya Fujita and Alan Pearson—researched storms and rated the severity of tornadoes.
zh: 藤田哲也和艾伦·皮尔逊——研究风暴，并对龙卷风的强度进行评级。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Maintain attention and actively participate in discussions about a variety of topics, ideas, and texts in a variety of settings, including partners, small and large groups, and teacher-led groups.
zh: 在两人、小组、大组以及教师带领的多种场合中，就各种话题、观点和文本保持专注并积极参与讨论。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Prepare for discussions in advance, including reading about the topic and organizing information for the discussion. Draw on preparations during the discussion.
zh: 提前为讨论做准备，包括阅读相关话题材料并整理讨论所需信息；讨论时运用这些准备成果。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Use agreed-upon rules for group discussions, keep discussions on topic, and carry out specific roles appropriate to a discussion, such as an interviewer or historical figure.
zh: 遵守商定的小组讨论规则，使讨论紧扣主题，并承担适合讨论的特定角色，如采访者或历史人物。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Ask relevant questions to clarify conversations and ideas, and to build upon remarks made by others.
zh: 提出相关问题，以澄清谈话和观点，并在他人发言的基础上进一步展开。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Understand and restate the key ideas in a discussion and distinguish them from their own ideas.
zh: 理解并复述讨论中的关键观点，并将其与自己的想法区分开来。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Restate or paraphrase information read aloud or delivered visually, quantitatively, or in other formats, such as videos, recordings, etc.
zh: 重述或转述朗读的信息，或以图像、数据及其他形式（如视频、录音等）呈现的信息。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Determine the evidence and reasons a speaker uses to support their main points.
zh: 判断说话者用哪些证据和理由来支持其主要观点。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Give a presentation about a topic or text, tell a story, or orally relate a personal experience in a logical and organized manner, including relevant details and facts that support main ideas or themes.
zh: 有条理、逻辑清晰地就某个话题或文本做展示、讲故事或口头讲述个人经历，并包含支持主旨或主题的相关细节和事实。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Speak clearly at an understandable volume and pace.
zh: 以清晰易懂的音量、语速说话。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Develop main ideas and themes by adding displays, images, videos, and recordings to enhance presentations.
zh: 通过添加展品、图片、视频和录音来增强展示效果，从而展开主旨和主题。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Switch between formal and informal English as appropriate to the situation or task—for example, presentations (formal) and group discussions (informal).
zh: 根据情境或任务在正式英语与非正式英语之间切换，例如展示（正式）与小组讨论（非正式）。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Use grade-level phonics and word analysis skills to decode words.
zh: 运用年级对应的自然拼读和词汇分析技能来解码单词。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Use combined knowledge of letter-sound correspondences, syllabication patterns, and morphology (e.g., roots, prefixes, and suffixes) to read unfamiliar multisyllabic words in context and out of context.
zh: 综合运用字母与读音对应关系、音节划分模式和词法知识（如词根、前缀和后缀），在上下文和脱离上下文的情况下读出陌生的多音节词。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Read grade-level text fluently and accurately to support comprehension.
zh: 流利、准确地朗读年级水平的文本，以帮助理解。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Read text with purpose.
zh: 带着目的阅读文本。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Self-correct and develop understanding by using context and rereading as necessary.
zh: 必要时利用上下文和重读来自我纠正并加深理解。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Read grade-level prose and poetry orally with accuracy, appropriate rate, and expression.
zh: 准确、语速适当、带感情地朗读年级对应的散文和诗歌。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Independently read and comprehend longer works of fiction (chapter books, stories, plays, and poems) and nonfiction (science, history, social studies, and technical subjects) appropriately written for fourth grade or beyond.
zh: 独立阅读并理解适合四年级及以上水平的较长虚构作品（章节书、故事、戏剧和诗歌）和非虚构作品（科学、历史、社会研究和科技类文本）。

subject: English Language Arts
section: Grasping Specific Details and Key Ideas
section_zh: 把握具体细节与关键观点
en: Use details and examples when explaining literal elements in a text or making inferences.
zh: 在解释文本的字面内容或进行推断时，运用细节和例子。

subject: English Language Arts
section: Grasping Specific Details and Key Ideas
section_zh: 把握具体细节与关键观点
en: Use details to summarize texts.
zh: 用细节概括文本。

subject: English Language Arts
section: Grasping Specific Details and Key Ideas
section_zh: 把握具体细节与关键观点
en: Identify the topic or theme of a text.
zh: 确定文本的主题或主旨。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Determine the meaning of words and phrases from a text by using context clues, asking questions, or consulting a reference source such as a dictionary or glossary.
zh: 通过上下文线索、提问或查阅词典、词汇表等参考工具，确定文本中单词和短语的含义。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Understand how text elements (such as chapters and headings) and visual elements (such as photos and illustrations) contribute to the organization and understanding of a text.
zh: 理解文本要素（如章节和标题）与视觉要素（如照片和插图）如何帮助文本的组织和理解。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Explain how visual elements contribute to the understanding of a text.
zh: 说明视觉要素如何帮助理解文本。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Compare a written text to an oral or visual version.
zh: 将书面文本与口头或影像版本进行比较。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Compare and contrast different texts with the same topic or genre.
zh: 比较和对比主题或体裁相同的不同文本。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Use details to trace the themes in literary works, such as poems, plays, and fiction.
zh: 用细节梳理文学作品（如诗歌、戏剧和小说）中的主题。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Use details to describe and build an in-depth understanding of the elements of fiction or plays, such as setting, dialogue, plot, and character motivations.
zh: 用细节描述并深入理解小说或戏剧的要素，如背景、对话、情节和人物动机。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Know the basic structural differences when writing or speaking about different kinds of literary works, such as plays, poems, and novels.
zh: 了解在写作或谈论不同类型文学作品（如戏剧、诗歌和小说）时的基本结构差异。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Know the basic elements of poems, such as verse, rhythm, rhyme, and meter.
zh: 了解诗歌的基本要素，如诗节、节奏、韵脚和格律。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Know the basic elements of plays, such as stage directions, cast lists, and dialogue.
zh: 了解戏剧的基本要素，如舞台说明、演员表和对话。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Recognize allusions to Greek and Roman mythology and use this understanding to determine the meaning of words (e.g., chronology, echo, Herculean).
zh: 识别对希腊和罗马神话的典故，并借此判断词义（如 chronology、echo、Herculean）。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Examine different types of stories to compare the points of view of various narrators, including different narrators telling the same story.
zh: 考察不同类型的故事，比较不同叙述者的视角，包括不同叙述者讲述同一个故事的情况。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Identify whether a story is told in the first or third person.
zh: 判断故事是第一人称还是第三人称叙述。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Relate the written versions of stories and plays to oral or visual presentations, including locating specifically in the text any corresponding elements, such as scene descriptions, stage directions, or dialogue.
zh: 将故事和戏剧的书面版本与口头或影像呈现联系起来，包括在文本中准确找出对应的要素，如场景描写、舞台说明或对话。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Answer questions about the details of a nonfiction text, indicating which part of the text provides the information needed to answer specific questions.
zh: 回答关于非虚构文本细节的问题，并指出文本的哪一部分提供了回答特定问题所需的信息。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Locate the main ideas in a text and identify key details that support them.
zh: 找出文本中的主旨，并确定支持主旨的关键细节。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Effectively summarize all types of informational texts.
zh: 有效地概括各类信息类文本。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Identify and determine the meaning of Tier 2 and Tier 3 vocabulary words in informational text.
zh: 识别并确定信息类文本中二级（Tier 2）和三级（Tier 3）词汇的含义。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Identify the structure of a text, section of text, paragraph, or sentence (e.g., comparison, cause/effect, problem/solution, compare/contrast, sequence, and main idea and details) and describe how it connects and communicates ideas in the text.
zh: 识别文本、章节、段落或句子的结构（如比较、因果、问题解决、对比、顺序以及主旨与细节），并说明它如何连接和传达文本中的观点。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Understand how historical events, scientific ideas, concepts, or steps in a procedure are related in a text and use language pertaining to sequence or cause/effect to explain how or why they happened.
zh: 理解文本中历史事件、科学观点、概念或操作步骤之间的关系，并使用表示顺序或因果的语言解释其发生的过程或原因。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Examine firsthand and secondhand sources for the same topic and explain the differences in perspective, facts, and details between them.
zh: 考察关于同一话题的第一手和第二手资料，并说明它们在视角、事实和细节上的差异。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Understand the characteristics of charts, timelines, bar graphs, animations, and other text features and use them to gather information.
zh: 了解图表、时间线、条形图、动画及其他文本特征的特点，并利用它们收集信息。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Explain how charts, time lines, bar graphs, animations, and other visual and quantitative text features enhance a text and/or provide additional information, including on websites.
zh: 说明图表、时间线、条形图、动画及其他视觉和数据类文本特征如何增强文本或提供额外信息，包括网站上的情况。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Explain how an author supports their claims in a text by giving reasons (opinions) and evidence, such as facts, examples, and expert opinions from reliable sources.
zh: 说明作者如何通过给出理由（观点）和证据（如事实、例子以及可靠来源的专家意见）来支持文本中的主张。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Synthesize information from two or more sources on the same topic, then speak or write about the topic with mastery of the subject matter.
zh: 综合同一主题的两个或多个来源的信息，然后对该主题进行口头或书面表达，体现出对内容的掌握。

subject: English Language Arts
subtopic: Writing to Reflect Audience, Purpose, and Task
en: Write routinely, clearly, and coherently, completing both short and long assignments focused on a range of different tasks, purposes, and audiences.
zh: 定期、清晰、连贯地写作，完成针对各种任务、目的和读者的长短篇作业。

subject: English Language Arts
subtopic: Writing to Reflect Audience, Purpose, and Task
en: Incorporate planning, research, editing, and revision into writing practice.
zh: 把计划、研究、编辑和修改纳入写作练习。

subject: English Language Arts
subtopic: Writing to Reflect Audience, Purpose, and Task
en: Use keyboards, tablets, the Internet, and other technologies to produce and publish writing and collaborate and communicate with others.
zh: 使用键盘、平板电脑、互联网及其他技术来创作和发布作品，并与他人协作和交流。

subject: English Language Arts
subtopic: Writing to Reflect Audience, Purpose, and Task
en: Type a minimum of one page in a single attempt.
zh: 一次至少打出一页内容。

subject: English Language Arts
subtopic: Writing to Analyze and Understand Text
en: Analyze literature in writing:
zh: 通过写作分析文学作品：

subject: English Language Arts
subtopic: Writing to Analyze and Understand Text
en: Trace a theme.
zh: 梳理一个主题。

subject: English Language Arts
subtopic: Writing to Analyze and Understand Text
en: Show in-depth understanding of characters, setting, and plot events.
zh: 展现对人物、背景和情节事件的深入理解。

subject: English Language Arts
subtopic: Writing to Analyze and Understand Text
en: Describe how different literary elements interact within the text.
zh: 描述不同文学要素在文本中如何相互作用。

subject: English Language Arts
subtopic: Writing to Analyze and Understand Text
en: Analyze informational texts in writing by describing how authors make and support their points with reasons and factual evidence.
zh: 通过描述作者如何提出观点并用理由和事实证据加以支持，以写作方式分析信息类文本。

subject: English Language Arts
subtopic: Writing to Analyze and Understand Text
en: Draw upon appropriate literary elements, details, or facts as evidence for writing analysis.
zh: 选取恰当的文学要素、细节或事实作为写作分析的证据。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Conduct short research projects to demonstrate knowledge gathered and learned about a topic.
zh: 开展小型研究项目，展示围绕某一主题收集和学到的知识。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Gather information from personal experiences as well as from print and digital sources (such as an encyclopedias, magazines, approved online sources, videos, interviews, and recordings).
zh: 从个人经历以及纸质和数字资源（如百科全书、杂志、获批的在线资源、视频、访谈和录音）中收集信息。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Take notes from sources.
zh: 从资料来源中做笔记。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Provide a rudimentary bibliography.
zh: 提供一份简单的参考文献目录。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Produce narrative text based on real-life or imagined experiences.
zh: 基于真实或想象的经历写出叙述性文本。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Introduce a narrator, a situation, and characters, and develop them through dialogue and exposition, including actions, thoughts, feelings, and reactions to events in the plot.
zh: 介绍叙述者、情境和人物，并通过对话和叙述加以展开，包括动作、思想、情感以及对情节中事件的反应。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Organize a logical or natural sequence of plot events following from the situation, using time-order words to indicate event order.
zh: 按照情境安排合乎逻辑或自然的情节事件顺序，并用表示时间顺序的词标明事件先后。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Include sensory details to make writing vivid and precise; convey a sense of experiences and/or the sensations that accompany experiences.
zh: 加入感官细节，使写作生动准确；传达体验本身及伴随体验的感受。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Provide a sense of closure that follows logically or artfully from the situation, character responses, and sequence of events.
zh: 给出合乎逻辑或巧妙的结尾，与情境、人物反应和事件顺序相呼应。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Write reports and other types of informational texts that clearly present ideas and information in their own words.
zh: 写报告及其他类型的信息类文本，用自己的话清晰地呈现观点和资料。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Introduce a topic with information organized in related sections or paragraphs and developed with facts, definitions, quotations, and details.
zh: 引入一个主题，把信息组织在相关的部分或段落中，并用事实、定义、引文和细节加以展开。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Include visual elements such as photos, drawings, or diagrams to help explain or present ideas or information when appropriate.
zh: 在适当的时候加入照片、图画或图表等视觉要素，以帮助解释或呈现观点和信息。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Use linking words to connect ideas (e.g., also, another, and, more, but, however, therefore, in addition).
zh: 使用连接词连接观点（如 also、another、and、more、but、however、therefore、in addition）。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Use Tier 2 and/or Tier 3 vocabulary to explain or elaborate topics.
zh: 使用二级（Tier 2）和/或三级（Tier 3）词汇来解释或展开主题。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Write a conclusion that wraps up ideas in the text.
zh: 写出总结全文观点的结论。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Introduce a topic and opinion and support a point of view with reasons, details, and evidence.
zh: 引入主题和观点，并用理由、细节和证据支持某一立场。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Follow through with an organizational structure that supports the purpose of the text, grouping ideas in a logical way.
zh: 采用有助于实现文本目的的组织结构，按逻辑对观点进行分组。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Use linking words to connect the opinion with reasons and evidence (e.g., another, furthermore, but, also, however, therefore, in addition, for example).
zh: 使用连接词把观点与理由和证据连接起来（如 another、furthermore、but、also、however、therefore、in addition、for example）。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Write a conclusion that wraps up the argument.
zh: 写出总结论证的结论。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Use knowledge of language conventions when reading, writing, speaking, and listening.
zh: 在阅读、写作、口语和倾听中运用语言规范知识。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Apply word choices and punctuation to create meaning and effect.
zh: 运用选词和标点来创造意义与效果。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Identify differences between written and spoken English.
zh: 识别书面英语与口语英语之间的差异。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Switch between formal and informal English as appropriate to the situation or task—for example, presentations (formal) and group discussions (informal).
zh: 根据情境或任务在正式英语与非正式英语之间切换，例如展示（正式）与小组讨论（非正式）。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Spell most words correctly or with a highly probable spelling.
zh: 大多数单词拼写正确，或拼出极有可能正确的形式。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Apply current code knowledge to spelling.
zh: 把当前学到的拼读规则知识运用于拼写。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Spell most grade-level high-frequency words correctly.
zh: 正确拼写大多数年级高频词。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Use dictionaries or glossaries—print and digital—to check and correct spellings about which they are uncertain.
zh: 使用纸质或电子词典、词汇表，检查并改正不确定的拼写。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Understand the basic rules of English grammar and conventions when writing or speaking.
zh: 在写作或口语中理解英语语法和语言规范的基本规则。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Know the following parts of speech and how they are used: nouns, pronouns, verbs (action verbs and auxiliary or helping verbs: can, could, may, must, ought, shall, should), adjectives (including articles), adverbs, conjunctions (and, but, or), interjections.
zh: 掌握下列词性及其用法：名词、代词、动词（实义动词和助动词/情态动词：can、could、may、must、ought、shall、should）、形容词（包括冠词）、副词、连词（and、but、or）、感叹词。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Use relative pronouns (who, whose, whom, which, that) and relative adverbs (where, when, why).
zh: 使用关系代词（who、whose、whom、which、that）和关系副词（where、when、why）。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Form and use the progressive (e.g., I was running; I am running; I will be running) verb tenses.
zh: 构成并使用进行时动词时态（如 I was running；I am running；I will be running）。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Form and use prepositional phrases.
zh: 构成并使用介词短语。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Understand what a complete sentence is and
zh: 理解什么是完整的句子，并

subject: English Language Arts
en: identify subject and predicate in single-clause sentences.
zh: 在单句（单分句）中识别主语和谓语。

subject: English Language Arts
en: distinguish complete sentences from fragments.
zh: 区分完整句子与残缺句（片段）。

subject: English Language Arts
en: identify and correct run-on sentences.
zh: 识别并改正连写句（一逗到底的句子）。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Produce complete sentences.
zh: 写出完整的句子。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Identify subject and verb in a sentence and understand that they must agree.
zh: 识别句子中的主语和动词，并理解二者必须保持一致。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Correctly use frequently confused words (e.g., to, too, two; there, their, they’re).
zh: 正确使用容易混淆的词（如 to、too、two；there、their、they're）。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Understand and apply the basic rules of capitalization and punctuation when writing or speaking.
zh: 在写作或口语中理解并运用大小写和标点的基本规则。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Use capital letters correctly, including at the beginning of sentences, when using proper nouns, and for words in titles.
zh: 正确使用大写字母，包括句首、专有名词和标题中的单词。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Correctly use commas and quotation marks when writing dialogue.
zh: 写对话时正确使用逗号和引号。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Correctly use quotation marks when quoting from a source.
zh: 引用资料时正确使用引号。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Use a comma before a coordinating conjunction (and, but, for, nor, or, so, yet) in a compound sentence.
zh: 在并列句中，并列连词（and、but、for、nor、or、so、yet）前使用逗号。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Effectively use synonyms and antonyms.
zh: 有效地使用同义词和反义词。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Use context clues to figure out the meaning of words and phrases in a sentence.
zh: 利用上下文线索推断句中单词和短语的含义。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Know how to look for synonyms and antonyms in nearby words to use as context clues.
zh: 知道如何在附近的词中寻找同义词和反义词作为上下文线索。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Know how to look for examples and definitions in nearby words to use as context clues.
zh: 知道如何在附近的词中寻找例子和定义作为上下文线索。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Understand words by thinking of them in terms of other words that mean the same (synonyms) or opposite (antonyms); understand degrees of difference, degrees of similarity, and degrees of contrast in word choices.
zh: 通过意思相同（同义词）或相反（反义词）的其他词来理解单词；理解选词中差异、相似和对比的程度。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Use knowledge of Greek and Latin roots and affixes to figure out the meaning of a new word (e.g., autograph, photograph).
zh: 利用希腊语和拉丁语词根及词缀知识推断新词的含义（如 autograph、photograph）。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Use a dictionary or glossary, print or digital, to answer questions about the meanings and usage of unfamiliar words.
zh: 使用纸质或电子词典、词汇表，回答有关陌生词含义和用法的问题。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Know how to use a dictionary, print or digital, to pronounce words correctly.
zh: 知道如何使用纸质或电子词典来正确发音。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Use a dictionary to find the precise meaning of words and phrases.
zh: 使用词典查找单词和短语的确切含义。

subject: English Language Arts
en: The poems listed here constitute a selected core of poetry for this grade. You are encouraged to expose students to more poetry, old and new, and to have students write their own poems. subject: English Language Arts
en: Every culture has phrases and proverbs that make no sense when carried over literally into another culture. For many students, this section may not be needed; they will have picked up these sayings by hearing them at home and among friends. But the sayings have been one of the categories most appreciated by teachers who work with students from home cultures that differ from the standard culture of literate American English. An ounce of prevention is worth a pound of cure. As the crow flies Beauty is only skin deep. The bigger they are, the harder they fall. Birds of a feather flock together. Blow hot and cold Break the ice Bull in a china shop Bury the hatchet Can’t hold a candle to Don’t count your chickens before they hatch. Don’t put all your eggs in one basket. Etc. Go to pot Half a loaf is better than none. Haste makes waste. Laugh and the world laughs with you. Lightning never strikes twice in the same place. Live and let live. Make ends meet. Make hay while the sun shines. Money burning a hole in your pocket Once in a blue moon One picture is worth a thousand words. On the warpath RSVP Run-of-the-mill Seeing is believing. Shipshape Through thick and thin Timbuktu Two wrongs don’t make a right. When it rains, it pours. You can lead a horse to water, but you can’t make it drink.
zh: 每种文化都有一些短语和谚语，直译到另一种文化中就会失去意义。对许多学生而言，这部分可能并非必需；他们在家里和朋友交往中早已听过这些说法。但对于那些面对家庭文化与标准美式书面英语文化不同的学生的老师来说，这类俗语一直是最受好评的内容之一。An ounce of prevention is worth a pound of cure.（一分预防胜于十分治疗。）As the crow flies（直线距离）Beauty is only skin deep.（美貌只是肤浅的外表。）The bigger they are, the harder they fall.（爬得越高，摔得越重。）Birds of a feather flock together.（物以类聚。）Blow hot and cold（反复无常）Break the ice（打破僵局）Bull in a china shop（莽撞闯祸的人）Bury the hatchet（言归于好）Can't hold a candle to（远远比不上）Don't count your chickens before they hatch.（别高兴得太早。）Don't put all your eggs in one basket.（不要孤注一掷。）Etc.（等等）Go to pot（走下坡路）Half a loaf is better than none.（聊胜于无。）Haste makes waste.（欲速则不达。）Laugh and the world laughs with you.（笑口常开，好运自来。）Lightning never strikes twice in the same place.（同一地点不会两次遭雷劈。）Live and let live.（己所不欲，勿施于人。）Make ends meet.（量入为出。）Make hay while the sun shines.（趁热打铁。）Money burning a hole in your pocket（有钱就忍不住花）Once in a blue moon（千载难逢）One picture is worth a thousand words.（一图胜千言。）On the warpath（气势汹汹）RSVP（请回复）Run-of-the-mill（平平无奇）Seeing is believing.（眼见为实。）Shipshape（井井有条）Through thick and thin（同甘共苦）Timbuktu（遥远的地方）Two wrongs don't make a right.（以错纠错还是错。）When it rains, it pours.（祸不单行。）You can lead a horse to water, but you can't make it drink.（牵马到水边易，逼马喝水难。）

subject: History and Geography
en: Teachers: The study of geography embraces many topics throughout the Core Knowledge Sequence, including topics in history and science. Geographic knowledge includes a spatial sense of the world, an awareness of the physical processes that shape life, a sense of the interactions between humans and their environment, an understanding of the relations between place and culture, and an awareness of the characteristics of specific regions and cultures. Many geographic topics are listed below in connection with historical topics.

en: Examine some of the basic values and principles of American democracy, in both theory and practice, as defined in the Declaration of Independence and the U. S. Constitution, both in historical context and in terms of present-day practice. In examining the significance of the U. S. Constitution, introduce students to the unique nature of the American experiment, the difficult task of establishing a democratic government, the compromises the framers of the Constitution were willing to make, and the persistent threats to success. In order to appreciate the boldness and fragility of the American attempt to establish a republican government based on a constitution, students should know that republican governments were rare at this time. Discuss with students basic questions and issues about government, such as: Why do societies need government? Why does a society need laws? Who makes the laws in the United States? What might happen in the absence of government and laws?

subject: Visual Arts
en: Teachers: In schools, lessons on the visual arts should illustrate important elements of making and appreciating art, and emphasize important artists, works of art, and artistic concepts. When appropriate, topics in the visual arts may be linked to topics in other disciplines. The following guidelines specify a variety of artwork in different media and from various cultures in order to expose students to a wide range of art and artists. While the list is robust, it may require teachers to narrow the selection in order to adequately address the works and related skills within an academic year. In studying the works of art specified below, and in creating their own art, students should review, develop, and apply concepts introduced in previous grades, such as line, shape, form, space, texture, color, light, design, and symmetry
zh: 教师提示：在学校的视觉艺术课程中，应阐明创作与鉴赏艺术的重要元素，并强调重要的艺术家、艺术作品和艺术概念。在适当的时候，视觉艺术主题可与其他学科的主题相联系。以下指导原则列出了不同媒介、不同文化的多种艺术作品，以让学生接触广泛的艺术和艺术家。这份清单虽然丰富，但教师可能需要缩小选择范围，以便在一个学年内充分讲清这些作品及相关技能。在学习下列艺术作品和创作自己的作品时，学生应复习、发展并运用前几个年级引入的概念，如线条、形状、形体、空间、肌理、色彩、光线、设计和对称。

en: Teachers: In schools, lessons on music should feature activities and works that illustrate important musical concepts and terms, and should introduce important composers and works. en: Teachers: Mathematics has its own vocabulary and patterns of thinking. It is a discipline with its own language and conventions. Thus, while some lessons may offer occasional opportunities for linking mathematics to other disciplines, it is critically important to attend to math as math. From the earliest years, mathematics requires incremental review and steady practice: not only the diligent effort required to master basic facts and operations, but also thoughtful and varied practice that approaches problems from a variety of angles, and gives students a variety of opportunities to apply the same concept or operation in different types of situations. While it is important to work toward the development of “higher-order problem-solving skills,” it is equally important—indeed, it is prerequisite to achieving “higher order” skills—to have a sound grasp of basic facts, and an automatic fluency with fundamental operations.
zh: 教师须知：数学有其自身的词汇和思维方式，是一门有自己语言和规范的学科。因此，虽然有些课程偶尔可以把数学与其他学科联系起来，但把数学当作数学来讲至关重要。从最初几年起，数学就需要循序渐进的复习和持续练习：既要努力掌握基本事实和运算，也要进行深思熟虑、形式多样的练习，从多种角度处理问题，让学生在不同类型的情境中多次运用同一概念或运算。虽然培养“高阶解题技能”很重要，但牢固掌握基本事实、对基本运算达到自动化熟练程度同样重要——事实上，这是达到“高阶”技能的前提。
