subject: Science
en: Teachers: Effective instruction in science requires hands-on experience and observation. In the words of the report from the National Academies of Science, A Framework for K-12 Science Education, “...children have surprisingly sophisticated ways of thinking about the world, based in part on their direct experiences with the physical environment, such as watching objects fall or collide and observing plants and animals. They also learn about the world through everyday activities, such as talking with their families, pursuing hobbies, watching television, and playing with friends. As children try to understand and influence the world around them, they develop ideas about their role in that world and how it works. In fact, the capacity of young children—from all backgrounds and socioeconomic levels—to reason in sophisticated ways is much greater than has long been assumed. Although they may lack deep knowledge and extensive experience, they often engage in a wide range of subtle and complex reasoning about the world. Thus, before they even enter school, children have developed their own ideas about the physical, biological, and social worlds and how they work. By listening to and taking these ideas seriously, educators can build on what children already know and can do.”
zh: 教师须知：有效的科学教学需要动手体验和观察。用美国国家科学院报告《K-12 科学教育框架》的话来说：“……孩子们以令人惊讶的复杂方式思考世界，这部分基于他们对物质环境的直接体验，比如观看物体下落或碰撞、观察动植物。他们也通过日常活动了解世界，比如与家人交谈、从事爱好、看电视、和朋友玩耍。当孩子们试图理解和影响周围的世界时，他们会形成关于自己在世界中的角色以及世界如何运作的想法。事实上，幼儿——无论来自何种背景、何种社会经济水平——进行复杂推理的能力远超长期以来的设想。尽管他们可能缺乏深入知识和丰富经验，但他们常常对世界进行广泛而细致的复杂推理。因此，甚至在入学之前，孩子们就已经对物理、生物和社会世界及其运作方式形成了自己的想法。通过倾听并认真对待这些想法，教育者可以在儿童已有知识和能力的基础上进行教学。”

subject: Science
en: The emphasis in Grade 4 should be on observation, description, and explanation of real world applications of energy; technical explanations of energy transfer and transformation should be taken up in later grades; see Grades 5, 6, and 8 for an increasingly detailed study of energy:
zh: 四年级的重点应放在观察、描述和解释能量在现实世界中的应用；能量转移与转化的技术性解释应放到以后年级；关于能量由浅入深的研究参见五、六、八年级：

subject: Science
en: Energy is the ability to cause change.
zh: 能量是引起变化的能力。

subject: Science
en: Energy has many forms, including mechanical, light, sound, thermal (heat), and electrical.
zh: 能量有多种形式，包括机械能、光能、声能、热能（热）和电能。

subject: Science
en: Stored energy is the potential to cause change (holding a ball at a height, or the stored chemical energy of a battery).
zh: 储存的能量是引起变化的潜能（把球举到高处，或电池中储存的化学能）。

subject: Science
en: All moving objects possess energy of motion.
zh: 所有运动的物体都具有动能。

subject: Science
en: The faster an object is moving, the greater its energy.
zh: 物体运动得越快，其能量越大。

subject: Science
en: People use motion energy to cause changes that accomplish useful tasks.
zh: 人们利用动能引起变化，从而完成有用的任务。

subject: Science
en: Energy can be transferred.
zh: 能量可以转移。

subject: Science
en: Sound is transferred from a faraway bell or siren.
zh: 声音从远处的钟或警笛传过来。

subject: Science
en: Light is transferred from the Sun to Earth.
zh: 光从太阳传到地球。

subject: Science
en: Thermal energy (heat) is transferred from a campfire to a camper.
zh: 热能（热）从篝火传给露营者。

subject: Science
en: Electrical currents establish the energy that is then converted into sound, light, or thermal energy.
zh: 电流产生能量，随后转化为声能、光能或热能。

subject: Science
en: Hydroelectric power plants convert the energy of moving water into electrical energy.
zh: 水力发电站把流动的水的能量转化为电能。

subject: Science
en: Moving objects transfer energy from place to place.
zh: 运动的物体把能量从一处转移到另一处。

subject: Science
en: When objects collide, the energy of motion can be transferred or transformed.
zh: 物体碰撞时，动能可以转移或转化。

subject: Science
en: In a collision, some energy is transferred from the objects to the air as sound or heat. Review and extend learning from Grade 2: Electricity and Magnetism. E. Energy Transformation and Engineering
zh: 在碰撞中，一部分能量以声或热的形式从物体转移到空气中。复习并拓展二年级所学内容：电与磁。E. 能量转化与工程

subject: Science
en: One form of energy can be converted into another form of energy.
zh: 一种形式的能量可以转化为另一种形式的能量。

subject: Science
en: Many useful devices convert one form of energy into another.
zh: 许多有用的设备把一种形式的能量转化为另一种。

subject: Science
en: For example, toasters convert electrical energy to heat energy, and solar panels convert light energy to electrical energy.
zh: 例如，烤面包机把电能转化为热能，太阳能板把光能转化为电能。

subject: Science
en: Through reading aloud, observation, and activities such as planning and conducting investigations of light and sound, help students to explore the following:
zh: 通过朗读、观察，以及规划和开展光与声的探究等活动，帮助学生探索以下内容：

subject: Science
en: Waves carry energy from one place to another.
zh: 波把能量从一处带到另一处。

subject: Science
en: Waves are characterized by amplitude, frequency, and wavelength.
zh: 波的特征用振幅、频率和波长来描述。

subject: Science
en: Sound waves transfer energy from one place to another and can cause changes (musical instruments, whale calls).
zh: 声波把能量从一处传到另一处，并能引起变化（乐器、鲸的叫声）。

subject: Science
en: Sound waves are produced when objects vibrate.
zh: 物体振动时会产生声波。

subject: Science
en: Sound waves can travel through most solids, liquids, and gases.
zh: 声波能在大多数固体、液体和气体中传播。

subject: Science
en: Properties of sound waves are pitch and intensity.
zh: 声波的属性是音高和强度。

subject: Science
en: Animals have specialized structures for detecting sound waves (the ears of bats, the lateral line in fish).
zh: 动物有专门探测声波的结构（蝙蝠的耳朵、鱼类的侧线）。

subject: Science
en: Light waves transfer energy from one place to another and can cause changes.
zh: 光波把能量从一处传到另一处，并能引起变化。

subject: Science
en: Sources of light include the sun and electrical devices.
zh: 光源包括太阳和电气设备。

subject: Science
en: Light waves can travel through empty space and through matter.
zh: 光波能在真空中和物质中传播。

subject: Science
en: Light waves are characterized by amplitude, frequency, and wavelength.
zh: 光波的特征用振幅、频率和波长来描述。

subject: Science

zh: 动物有专门探测光的结构（鹰的眼睛）。

zh: 声波的模式可以传递信息（摩尔斯电码、鼓声信号）。

subject: Science

zh: 光波的模式可以传递信息（烟雾信号、船与船之间的信号）。

subject: Science
topic: People use Waves to Transfer Information

zh: 声波和光波可以转换为数字信号以传递信息（广播、电视、手机）。

en: Exploring Light and Sound (Grade 1)
zh: 探索光与声（一年级）

subject: Science
topic: Structures and Functions of Living Things
en: Simple Machines (Grade 1)
zh: 简单机械（一年级）

subject: Science
topic: Structures and Functions of Living Things
en: Exploring Land and Water (Grade 2)
zh: 探索陆地与水（二年级）

subject: Science
topic: Structures and Functions of Living Things
en: Electricity and Magnetism (Grade 2)
zh: 电与磁（二年级）

subject: Science
topic: Structures and Functions of Living Things
en: Structure of Living Things (Grade 3)
zh: 生物体的结构（三年级）

subject: Science
topic: Structures and Functions of Living Things
en: Different structures work together in systems to support survival (heart and lungs in many animals; roots and stems in many plants).
zh: 不同的结构在系统中协同工作以支持生存（许多动物的心脏和肺；许多植物的根和茎）。

subject: Science
topic: Structures and Functions of Living Things
en: Some animals form groups to help them survive in their habitat.
zh: 有些动物组成群体，以帮助自己在栖息地中生存。

subject: Science
topic: Structures and Functions of Living Things
subtopic: The Structure and Function of the Eyes and Ears
en: Light enters through the eye after being reflected off objects.
zh: 光从物体反射后通过眼睛进入。

subject: Science
topic: Structures and Functions of Living Things
subtopic: The Structure and Function of the Eyes and Ears
en: Structures in the eyes focus and receive the light.
zh: 眼睛中的结构聚焦并接收光。

subject: Science
topic: Structures and Functions of Living Things
subtopic: The Structure and Function of the Eyes and Ears
en: The optic nerve carries electrical signals to the brain.
zh: 视神经把电信号传送到大脑。

subject: Science
topic: Structures and Functions of Living Things
subtopic: The Structure and Function of the Eyes and Ears
en: The outer ear captures sound waves.
zh: 外耳收集声波。

subject: Science
topic: Structures and Functions of Living Things
subtopic: The Structure and Function of the Eyes and Ears
en: In the middle ear, sound waves hit the eardrum and are passed to three small bones.
zh: 在中耳，声波撞击鼓膜并传到三块小骨头。

subject: Science
topic: Structures and Functions of Living Things
subtopic: The Structure and Function of the Eyes and Ears
en: In the inner ear, vibrations move tiny hairs that create nerve signals.
zh: 在内耳，振动使微小的毛细胞移动，从而产生神经信号。

subject: Science
topic: Structures and Functions of Living Things
subtopic: The Structure and Function of the Eyes and Ears
en: Auditory nerve sends signals to the brain.
zh: 听觉神经把信号传送到大脑。

subject: Science
en: Stimulus is something that causes living tissue to respond.
zh: 刺激是引起活组织产生反应的事物。

subject: Science
en: Response is the reaction an organism has to a stimulus.
zh: 反应是生物体对刺激作出的应答。

subject: Science
en: Organisms have sensory organs that detect different kinds of information about the environment.
zh: 生物体有感觉器官，能探测有关环境的不同信息。

subject: Science
en: In most animals, sensory organs transmit information to the brain.
zh: 在大多数动物中，感觉器官把信息传送到大脑。

subject: Science
en: The brain processes this information as perceptions and stores them as memories.
zh: 大脑把这些信息处理为知觉，并作为记忆储存起来。

subject: Science
en: Plants also respond to stimuli.
zh: 植物也会对刺激作出反应。

subject: Science
en: Response to stimuli helps survival, growth, reproduction, and behavior.
zh: 对刺激作出反应有助于生存、生长、繁殖和行为。

subject: Science
en: Geologists are scientists who study Earth’s surface and its interior, and the processes that change it.
zh: 地质学家是研究地球表面、地球内部以及改变它们的过程的科学家。

subject: Science
en: Earth’s layers: crust, mantle, outer core, and inner core
zh: 地球的圈层：地壳、地幔、外核和内核

subject: Science
en: Features of Earth’s surface: mountains and ranges, seamounts and ocean trenches, volcanoes
zh: 地球表面的特征：山和山脉、海山和海沟、火山

subject: Science
en: Geologists use maps to study patterns of Earth’s changing surface.
zh: 地质学家用地图研究地球表面变化的模式。

subject: Science
subtopic: Evidence that Earth’s Surface Has Changed Over Time
en: Rocks and rock layers provide evidence of how Earth’s surface has changed over time.
zh: 岩石和岩层为地球表面随时间的变化提供了证据。

subject: Science
subtopic: Evidence that Earth’s Surface Has Changed Over Time
en: Geologists study evidence in rocks and rock layers to create models of what Earth was like in the past.
zh: 地质学家研究岩石和岩层中的证据，建立地球过去样貌的模型。

subject: Science
subtopic: Evidence that Earth’s Surface Has Changed Over Time
en: Rock classification: sedimentary, metamorphic, and igneous
zh: 岩石分类：沉积岩、变质岩和火成岩

subject: Science
subtopic: Evidence that Earth’s Surface Has Changed Over Time
en: Fossils are often found in and among rock layers.
zh: 化石常常在岩层中或岩层之间被发现。

subject: Science
subtopic: Evidence that Earth’s Surface Has Changed Over Time
en: Fossils provide evidence that Earth’s surface has changed over time.
zh: 化石为地球表面随时间发生变化提供了证据。

subject: Science
en: Different processes create and break down different types of mountains.
zh: 不同的过程形成并破坏不同类型的山。

subject: Science
en: Mountains form when plates of Earth’s surface press against one another.
zh: 当地球表面的板块相互挤压时，就会形成山脉。

subject: Science
en: Weathering is the breaking down of rocks on Earth’s surface.
zh: 风化是地球表面岩石破碎分解的过程。

subject: Science
en: Agents of weathering: wind, water, ice, plants, and animals
zh: 风化的作用力：风、水、冰、植物和动物

subject: Science
en: Erosion: movement of rocks and soil primarily caused by wind, water, or glaciers
zh: 侵蚀：主要由风、水或冰川引起的岩石和土壤的移动

subject: Science
topic: How Geologic Events can Affect People
en: Geologic events that Can affect humans include:
zh: 可能影响人类的地质事件包括：

subject: Science
topic: How Geologic Events can Affect People
en: Earthquakes and tsunamis Review and extend learning from third grade regarding how the eyes and ears work to include new understandings of light and sound waves as forms of energy. Students should engage with and discuss possible design solutions that prepare for geologic events and processes.
zh: 地震和海啸 复习并拓展三年级关于眼睛和耳朵如何工作的学习，加入对光波和声波作为能量形式的新理解。学生应参与并讨论应对地质事件和地质过程的可能设计解决方案。

subject: Science
topic: How Geologic Events can Affect People
en: Volcanoes: ash clouds and lava flows
zh: 火山：火山灰云和熔岩流

subject: Science
topic: How Geologic Events can Affect People
en: Avalanches and mudslides
zh: 雪崩和泥石流

subject: Science
topic: How Geologic Events can Affect People
en: People build hazard-resistant structures to prepare for possible danger.
zh: 人们建造抗灾建筑，为可能的危险做好准备。

subject: Science
topic: How Geologic Events can Affect People
en: People use data and tools to predict disasters and minimize damage.
zh: 人们利用数据和工具预测灾害并把损害降到最低。

subject: Science
en: Through reading aloud and activities, introduce students to examples of how humans use the natural world to meet our needs and create sources for energy such as fuel. Help students to explore:
zh: 通过朗读和活动，向学生介绍人类如何利用自然界满足自身需求并创造燃料等能源的例子。帮助学生探索：

subject: Science
en: Humans use natural resources to provide energy for much of modern life (coal, oil, and gasoline).
zh: 人类利用自然资源为现代生活的大部分活动提供能量（煤、石油和汽油）。

subject: Science
en: Renewable resources can be replaced relatively quickly.
zh: 可再生资源能较快得到补充。

subject: Science
en: Nonrenewable resources cannot be replaced quickly.
zh: 不可再生资源无法快速补充。

subject: Science
en: Renewable resources:
zh: 可再生资源：

subject: Science
en: wind energy
zh: 风能

subject: Science
en: water behind dams
zh: 大坝拦蓄的水

subject: Science
en: geothermal energy
zh: 地热能

subject: Science
en: sunlight
zh: 阳光

subject: Science
en: biofuels
zh: 生物燃料

subject: Science
en: Nonrenewable resources:
zh: 不可再生资源：

subject: Science
en: fossil fuels (including coal, oil, and natural gas)
zh: 化石燃料（包括煤、石油和天然气）

subject: Science
en: nuclear fuels
zh: 核燃料

subject: Science
en: Fuel: material burned to produce heat
zh: 燃料：通过燃烧产生热量的物质

subject: Science
en: Fossil fuels are formed from the remains of once-living organisms.
zh: 化石燃料由曾存活生物的遗骸形成。

subject: Science
en: Fossil fuels must be extracted from beneath Earth's surface (mining, drilling, fracking).
zh: 化石燃料必须从地表以下开采出来（采矿、钻井、水力压裂）。

subject: Science
en: Crude oil must be refined into products that are usable.
zh: 原油必须经过提炼才能成为可用的产品。

subject: Science
en: Much of our electricity is generated by burning coal.
zh: 我们很大一部分电力是通过烧煤产生的。

subject: Science
en: Air pollution often results from burning fossil fuels.
zh: 空气污染往往由燃烧化石燃料造成。

subject: Science
en: Major sources of pollution include cars and trucks, coal-fired power plants, large industries, and ships and airplanes.
zh: 主要污染源包括小汽车和卡车、燃煤发电厂、大型工业以及船舶和飞机。

subject: Science
en: Nuclear power plants use heat released from splitting uranium atoms to make electricity.
zh: 核电站利用铀原子裂变释放的热量发电。

subject: Science
en: Environmental benefits include lower emissions than those from fossil fuels.
zh: 环境方面的好处包括比化石燃料更低的排放。

subject: Science
en: Environmental risks include escape of dangerous nuclear waste and risk of catastrophic disasters.
zh: 环境风险包括危险核废料的泄漏以及发生灾难性事故的风险。

subject: Science
en: New and evolving technologies for using renewable resources for energy:
zh: 利用可再生资源获取能源的新兴及发展中的技术：

subject: Science
en: hydroelectric power plants
zh: 水力发电站

subject: Science
en: wind turbines
zh: 风力涡轮机

subject: Science
en: solar panels
zh: 太阳能板

subject: Science
en: Environmental benefits of using renewable resources for energy:
zh: 利用可再生资源作为能源的环境益处：

subject: Science
en: reduced need for fossil fuels
zh: 减少对化石燃料的需求

subject: Science
en: less need for major construction such as oil fields, offshore platforms, or refineries and storage facilities
zh: 减少对油田、海上平台、炼油厂和储存设施等大型建设的需求

subject: Science
en: reduced cost of the transportation of fossil fuels
zh: 降低化石燃料的运输成本

subject: Science
en: Environmental risks: building dams for hydroelectric energy affects water habitats; wind turbines may be harmful to birds that fly into them
zh: 环境风险：为水力发电修建水坝会影响水域栖息地；风力涡轮机可能伤及撞上它们的鸟类

subject: Science
en: The respiratory system functions to bring oxygen gas into the body and release carbon dioxide from the body.
zh: 呼吸系统的功能是把氧气带入体内并把二氧化碳排出体外。

subject: Science
en: Strenuous activity causes changes in respiration and heart rate.
zh: 剧烈活动会引起呼吸和心率的变化。

subject: Science
en: Upper parts of the respiratory system: nose, throat, voice box, and the trachea
zh: 呼吸系统的上部：鼻、咽、喉和气管

subject: Science
en: Lower parts of the respiratory system: lungs, bronchi, bronchial tubes, diaphragm, ribs, and alveoli
zh: 呼吸系统的下部：肺、主支气管、支气管、膈、肋骨和肺泡

subject: Science
en: Damage to the respiratory system can occur because of smoking and breathing polluted air.
zh: 吸烟和吸入污染空气会损害呼吸系统。

subject: Science
en: The circulatory system functions to bring oxygen gas from the lungs to the body cells and release carbon dioxide from the lungs to the environment.
zh: 循环系统的功能是把氧气从肺输送到全身细胞，并把二氧化碳从肺排出到环境中。

subject: Science
en: The circulatory system transports important chemicals throughout the body.
zh: 循环系统把重要的化学物质输送到全身。

subject: Science
en: Parts of the respiratory system: the heart and blood vessels, including arteries, veins, and capillaries
zh: 循环系统的组成部分：心脏和血管，包括动脉、静脉和毛细血管

subject: Science
en: Circulation: the movement of blood through vessels caused by contractions of the heart
zh: 血液循环：由心脏收缩引起的血液在血管中的流动

subject: Science
en: Blood pressure: measure of the stress blood places on the vessels
zh: 血压：血液对血管壁压力的度量

subject: Science
en: The structure of heart, its chambers and valves, reflect the function of the heart.
zh: 心脏的结构——心腔和瓣膜——体现了心脏的功能。

subject: Science
en: People can make lifestyle-related decisions that positively affect the respiratory and circulatory systems.
zh: 人们可以作出对呼吸系统和循环系统有益的生活方式选择。

subject: Science
en: Through reading aloud and activities, explore with students the stories and accomplishments of these scientists and engineers. This list of science biographies is by no means exhaustive. Other individuals can be incorporated into learning during a corresponding topic of study for this grade level, and should include:
zh: 通过朗读和活动，与学生一起探究这些科学家和工程师的故事与成就。这份科学家传记清单并不详尽。在学习本年级相应主题时，还可以加入其他人物，应包括：

subject: Science
en: Thomas Edison—invented an electric light bulb and investigated storing energy for practical uses.
zh: 托马斯·爱迪生——发明了电灯泡，并研究了将能量储存起来用于实际用途。

subject: Science
en: Lewis H. Latimer—electrical engineer who, among other things, secured patents that improved Edison’s lightbulb.
zh: 刘易斯·H·拉蒂默——电气工程师，他的众多成就之一是通过专利改进了爱迪生的灯泡。

subject: Science
en: Helen Keller—led a remarkable life as an author and champion of those with disabilities, although she could not see or hear.
zh: 海伦·凯勒——虽然看不见也听不见，却作为作家和残障人士的倡导者度过了非凡的一生。

subject: Science
en: Louis Braille—French inventor of the Braille systems, which allowed blind people to read by touching a pattern of dots. Note: The lymphatic system will be studied in Grade 6.
zh: 路易·布莱尔——法国发明家，发明了盲文系统，使盲人能通过触摸点字图案阅读。注：淋巴系统将在六年级学习。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Maintain attention and actively participate in discussions about a variety of topics, ideas, and texts in a variety of settings, including partners, small and large groups, and teacher-led groups.
zh: 在两人、小组、大组以及教师带领的多种场合中，就各种话题、观点和文本保持专注并积极参与讨论。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Prepare for discussions in advance, including reading about the topic and organizing information for the discussion. Draw on preparations during the discussion.
zh: 提前为讨论做准备，包括阅读相关话题材料并整理讨论所需信息；讨论时运用这些准备成果。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Use agreed-upon rules for group discussions, keep discussions on topic, and carry out specific roles appropriate to a discussion.
zh: 遵守小组讨论的共同规则，使讨论紧扣主题，并承担适合讨论的具体角色。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Ask relevant questions to clarify conversations and ideas and to build upon remarks made by others.
zh: 提出相关问题，以澄清谈话和想法，并在他人发言的基础上进一步展开。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Understand and summarize the key ideas in a discussion or oral presentation and draw conclusions from new information introduced during discussions.
zh: 理解并总结讨论或口头报告中的主要观点，并从讨论中引入的新信息得出结论。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Restate or paraphrase information read aloud or delivered visually, quantitatively, or in other formats, such as videos, recordings, and multimedia.
zh: 重述或转述朗读的信息，或以图表、数据及其他形式（如视频、录音、多媒体）呈现的信息。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Determine the evidence and reasons a speaker uses to support their main claim.
zh: 判断说话者为支持主要观点所使用的证据和理由。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Give a presentation about a topic or text, tell a story, or orally relate a personal experience in a logical and organized manner, including relevant details and facts that support main ideas or themes.
zh: 有条理、逻辑清晰地就某个话题或文本做展示、讲故事或口头讲述个人经历，并包含支持主旨或主题的相关细节和事实。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Speak clearly at an understandable volume and pace.
zh: 以清晰易懂的音量、语速说话。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Develop main ideas and themes by adding displays, images, videos, and recordings to enhance presentations.
zh: 通过添加展品、图片、视频和录音来增强展示效果，从而展开主旨和主题。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Switch between formal and informal English as appropriate to the situation or task—for example, presentations (formal) and group discussions (informal).
zh: 根据情境或任务在正式英语与非正式英语之间切换，例如展示（正式）与小组讨论（非正式）。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Use grade-level phonics and word analysis skills to decode words.
zh: 运用年级对应的自然拼读和词汇分析技能来解码单词。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Use combined knowledge of letter-sound correspondences, syllabication patterns, and morphology (e.g., roots, prefixes, and suffixes) to read unfamiliar multisyllabic words in context and out of context.
zh: 综合运用字母与读音对应关系、音节划分模式和词法知识（如词根、前缀和后缀），在上下文和脱离上下文的情况下读出陌生的多音节词。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Read grade-level text fluently and accurately to support comprehension.
zh: 流利、准确地朗读年级水平的文本，以帮助理解。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Read text with purpose.
zh: 带着目的阅读文本。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Self-correct and develop understanding by using context and rereading as necessary.
zh: 必要时利用上下文和重读来自我纠正并加深理解。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Read grade-level prose and poetry orally with accuracy, appropriate rate, and expression.
zh: 准确、语速适当、带感情地朗读年级对应的散文和诗歌。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Independently and proficiently read and comprehend longer works of fiction (chapter books, stories, plays, and poems) and nonfiction (science, history, social studies, and technical subjects) written at the high end of fourth to fifth grade or beyond.
zh: 独立而熟练地阅读并理解较长的虚构作品（章节书、故事、戏剧和诗歌）和非虚构作品（科学、历史、社会研究和科技类），其难度相当于四至五年级较高水平或更高。

subject: English Language Arts
section: Grasping Specific Details and Key Ideas
section_zh: 把握具体细节与核心观点
en: Use details and examples when explaining a text, making inferences, or drawing conclusions.
zh: 在解释文本、进行推断或得出结论时使用细节和例子。

subject: English Language Arts
section: Grasping Specific Details and Key Ideas
section_zh: 把握具体细节与核心观点
en: Quote from a text with accuracy when explaining or making inferences from works of literature or informational texts.
zh: 在解释或推断文学作品或说明性文本时准确引用原文。

subject: English Language Arts
section: Grasping Specific Details and Key Ideas
section_zh: 把握具体细节与核心观点
en: Use details to summarize texts.
zh: 用细节概括文本。

subject: English Language Arts
section: Grasping Specific Details and Key Ideas
section_zh: 把握具体细节与核心观点
en: Identify the topic or theme of a text.
zh: 确定文本的话题或主题。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Determine the meaning of words and phrases in a text, including
zh: 确定文本中词语和短语的含义，包括

subject: English Language Arts
en: Tier 2 academic vocabulary.
zh: 第二层（Tier 2）学术词汇。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Tier 3 subject-area vocabulary.
zh: 第三层（Tier 3）学科领域词汇。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Analyze the structure of a text and how the parts (sentences, paragraphs, chapters, and sections) relate to the whole.
zh: 分析文本的结构，以及各部分（句子、段落、章节和部分）与整体的关系。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Explain how the point of view of a narrator or speaker affects how events are described in a text.
zh: 解释叙述者或说话者的视角如何影响文本中事件的描述。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Compare a written text to an oral or visual version.
zh: 把书面文本与口头或视觉版本进行比较。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Compare and contrast different texts with the same topic, themes, or genre.
zh: 比较和对比主题、题材或体裁相同的不同文本。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Trace arguments and claims and determine whether the reasoning, evidence, and logic are adequate.
zh: 梳理论证和主张，判断推理、证据和逻辑是否充分。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Use information from multiple sources (e.g., print or digital) to find answers and solve problems.
zh: 利用多个来源（如纸质或数字资料）的信息寻找答案并解决问题。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Use details to trace the themes in literary works, such as poems, plays, and fiction.
zh: 用细节梳理文学作品（如诗歌、戏剧和小说）中的主题。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Effectively summarize works of literature, such as poems, plays, and fiction.
zh: 有效地概括文学作品，如诗歌、戏剧和小说。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Use details to describe and build an in-depth understanding of the elements of fiction or plays, such as setting, dialogue, plot, and character motivations.
zh: 用细节描述并深入理解小说或戏剧的要素，如背景、对话、情节和人物动机。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Use details to describe how characters respond to problems and challenges.
zh: 用细节描述人物如何面对问题和挑战。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Use details to compare and contrast the settings, events, and characters in stories and dramas, including how characters interact.
zh: 用细节比较和对比故事与戏剧中的背景、事件和人物，包括人物之间的互动。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Use details to examine how the speaker of a poem reflects or comments on the topic of the poem.
zh: 用细节考察诗歌中的说话者如何反映或评论诗的主题。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Examine how the point of view of a speaker (poem) or narrator (fiction) affects how events are described.
zh: 考察说话者（诗歌）或叙述者（小说）的视角如何影响事件的描述。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Determine the meaning of words and phrases in a text, including figurative language, such as metaphors and similes.
zh: 确定文本中词语和短语的含义，包括比喻性语言，如暗喻和明喻。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Examine how the basic structures of plays, poems, and fiction, such as scenes, stanzas, and chapters, work together to create an overall cohesive structure.
zh: 考察戏剧、诗歌和小说的基本结构（如场景、诗节和章节）如何共同构成连贯的整体结构。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Explain how visual and multimedia elements create tone or add beauty to literary works, such as graphic novels, fiction, myths, and poetry.
zh: 解释视觉和多媒体元素如何营造语气或增添文学作品的美感，如图画小说、小说、神话和诗歌。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Compare and contrast stories across genres, such as mystery and adventure, including their topics and themes. E. Reading Comprehension—Nonficton and Informational Text
zh: 跨体裁比较和对比故事，如推理小说和冒险小说，包括其话题和主题。E. 阅读理解——非虚构与说明性文本

subject: English Language Arts
en: Answer questions about the details of a nonfiction text, indicating which part of the text provides the information needed to answer specific questions.
zh: 回答关于非虚构文本细节的问题，并指出文本的哪一部分提供了回答特定问题所需的信息。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Locate the main ideas in a text and identify key details that support them.
zh: 找出文本中的主旨，并确定支持主旨的关键细节。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Effectively summarize all types of informational texts.
zh: 有效地概括各类信息类文本。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Understand and explain the relationships and interactions between two or more individuals, events, ideas, concepts, or steps in a procedure in historical, scientific, and technical texts.
zh: 在历史、科学和技术类文本中，理解并解释两个或多个个人、事件、观点、概念或操作步骤之间的关系与相互作用。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Identify and determine the meaning of grade-appropriate Tier 2 and Tier 3 vocabulary words in informational texts.
zh: 识别并确定说明性文本中符合本年级水平的第二层（Tier 2）和第三层（Tier 3）词汇的含义。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Identify the structure of two or more texts (e.g., comparison, cause/effect, problem/ solution, compare/contrast, sequence, and main idea and details) and compare and contrast them.
zh: 识别两篇或多篇文本的结构（如比较、因果、问题/解决、对比、顺序、主旨与细节），并进行比较和对比。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Examine multiple accounts of the same topics and events and explain the differences in their perspectives.
zh: 考察对同一话题和事件的多种叙述，并解释其视角的差异。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Explain how an author supports their claims in a text by giving reasons (opinions) and evidence, such as facts, examples, and expert opinions from reliable sources.
zh: 说明作者如何通过给出理由（观点）和证据（如事实、例子以及可靠来源的专家意见）来支持文本中的主张。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Understand how specific evidence supports specific claims.
zh: 理解具体证据如何支持具体主张。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Synthesize information from two or more sources on the same topic, then speak or write about the topic with mastery of the subject matter.
zh: 综合同一主题的两个或多个来源的信息，然后对该主题进行口头或书面表达，体现出对内容的掌握。

subject: English Language Arts
subtopic: Writing to Reflect Audience, Purpose, and Task
en: Write routinely, clearly, and coherently, completing both short and long assignments focused on a range of different tasks, purposes, and audiences.
zh: 定期、清晰、连贯地写作，完成针对各种任务、目的和读者的长短篇作业。

subject: English Language Arts
subtopic: Writing to Reflect Audience, Purpose, and Task
en: Produce a variety of types of writing—including reports, summaries, letters, descriptions, research essays, essays that explain a process, stories, and poems—with a coherent structure or story line.
zh: 写出多种类型的作品——包括报告、摘要、书信、描述文、研究论文、解释过程的文章、故事和诗歌——并具有连贯的结构或故事线。

subject: English Language Arts
subtopic: Writing to Reflect Audience, Purpose, and Task
en: Incorporate planning, research, editing, rewriting, and revision into writing practice.
zh: 把构思、研究、编辑、重写和修改纳入写作实践。

subject: English Language Arts
subtopic: Writing to Reflect Audience, Purpose, and Task
en: Incorporate trying a new approach as part of the editing process.
zh: 把尝试新方法作为编辑过程的一部分。

subject: English Language Arts
subtopic: Writing to Reflect Audience, Purpose, and Task
en: Use keyboards, tablets, the Internet, and other technologies to produce and publish writing and collaborate and communicate with others.
zh: 使用键盘、平板电脑、互联网及其他技术来创作和发布作品，并与他人协作和交流。

subject: English Language Arts
subtopic: Writing to Reflect Audience, Purpose, and Task
en: Type a minimum of two pages in a single attempt.
zh: 一次连续打字至少两页。

subject: English Language Arts
subtopic: Writing to Analyze and Understand Text
en: Analyze literature in writing:
zh: 通过写作分析文学作品：

subject: English Language Arts
subtopic: Writing to Analyze and Understand Text
en: Trace a theme.
zh: 梳理一个主题。

subject: English Language Arts
subtopic: Writing to Analyze and Understand Text
en: Show in-depth understanding of characters, setting, and plot events.
zh: 展现对人物、背景和情节事件的深入理解。

subject: English Language Arts
subtopic: Writing to Analyze and Understand Text
en: Describe how different literary elements interact within the text.
zh: 描述不同文学要素在文本中如何相互作用。

subject: English Language Arts
subtopic: Writing to Analyze and Understand Text
en: Compare and contrast two or more settings, events, or characters, drawing upon specific evidence, such as details of the setting or how characters interact.
zh: 利用具体证据（如背景细节或人物互动方式）比较和对比两个或多个背景、事件或人物。

subject: English Language Arts
subtopic: Writing to Analyze and Understand Text
en: Analyze informational texts in writing:
zh: 在写作中分析说明性文本：

subject: English Language Arts
subtopic: Writing to Analyze and Understand Text
en: Describe how authors make and support particular points with reasons and factual evidence.
zh: 描述作者如何用理由和事实证据提出并支持特定观点。

subject: English Language Arts
subtopic: Writing to Analyze and Understand Text
en: Identify how specific reasons and evidence support specific claims.
zh: 指出具体理由和证据如何支持具体主张。

subject: English Language Arts
subtopic: Writing to Analyze and Understand Text
en: Draw upon appropriate literary elements, details, or facts as evidence for writing analysis.
zh: 选取恰当的文学要素、细节或事实作为写作分析的证据。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Conduct short research projects to gather information from several different sources (such as an encyclopedia, magazines, interviews, observations, an atlas, or approved online sources) and write short reports that synthesize the information.
zh: 开展小型研究项目，从多个不同来源（如百科全书、杂志、访谈、观察、地图集或经批准的在线资源）收集信息，并写出综合这些信息的简短报告。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Build knowledge through researching and investigating multiple topics.
zh: 通过研究和探究多个主题来积累知识。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Gather information from personal experiences as well as from print and digital sources (such as an encyclopedia, magazines, approved online sources, videos, interviews, and recordings).
zh: 从个人经历以及纸质和数字来源（如百科全书、杂志、经批准的在线资源、视频、访谈和录音）收集信息。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Take notes from sources and condense them by paraphrasing and/or summarizing.
zh: 从资料来源做笔记，并通过转述和/或概括进行精简。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Paraphrase and summarize completed reports and other written assignments.
zh: 转述并概括已完成的报告和其他书面作业。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Provide a rudimentary bibliography.
zh: 提供一份简单的参考文献目录。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Produce narrative pieces that reflect real-life or imagined experiences.
zh: 写出反映真实生活或想象经历的记叙文。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Introduce a narrator, a situation, and characters, and develop them through dialogue, pacing, and exposition, including actions, thoughts, feelings, and reactions to events in the plot.
zh: 介绍叙述者、情境和人物，并通过对话、节奏和说明加以展开，包括动作、思想、情感以及对情节中事件的反应。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Organize a logical or natural sequence of plot events following from the situation, using time-order and transitional words, phrases, and clauses to indicate and manage the event order.
zh: 按照情境组织合乎逻辑或自然的情节事件顺序，使用时序词和过渡词、短语及从句来标示和掌控事件顺序。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Include concrete and sensory details to make writing vivid and precise; convey a sense of experiences and/or the sensations that accompany experiences.
zh: 加入具体和感官细节，使写作生动准确；传达体验感及伴随体验的感受。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Provide a sense of closure that follows logically or artfully from the situation, character responses, and sequence of events.
zh: 给出合乎逻辑或巧妙的结尾，与情境、人物反应和事件顺序相呼应。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Write reports and other types of informational texts that clearly focus ideas and information, and make general observations.
zh: 写报告和其他类型的信息类文本，明确聚焦观点和资讯，并作出总体观察。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Introduce a topic with information organized in related sections or paragraphs and developed with facts, definitions, quotations, and details.
zh: 引入一个主题，把信息组织在相关的部分或段落中，并用事实、定义、引文和细节加以展开。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Group related information logically and incorporate formatting features, such as headings.
zh: 按逻辑把相关信息分组，并加入标题等格式要素。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Include visual elements such as photos, drawings, or diagrams to help explain or present ideas or information when appropriate.
zh: 在适当的时候加入照片、图画或图表等视觉要素，以帮助解释或呈现观点和信息。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Use linking words, phrases, and clauses to connect ideas from distinct categories (e.g., in contrast, especially).
zh: 使用连接词、短语和从句连接不同类别的观点（例如：相比之下、尤其）。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Use Tier 2 and/or Tier 3 vocabulary to explain or elaborate topics.
zh: 使用二级（Tier 2）和/或三级（Tier 3）词汇来解释或展开主题。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Write a conclusion that wraps up ideas in the text.
zh: 写出总结全文观点的结论。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Introduce a topic and opinion clearly and support a point of view with reasons, details, and evidence.
zh: 清楚地引入话题和观点，并用理由、细节和证据支持某种立场。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Follow through with an organizational structure that supports the purpose of the text, grouping ideas, reasons, and evidence in a logical way.
zh: 采用有助于实现文本目的的组织结构，按逻辑将观点、理由和证据分组。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Use linking words, phrases, and clauses to connect opinions with reasons and evidence (e.g., consequently, specifically).
zh: 使用连接词、短语和从句把观点与理由和证据连接起来（例如：因此、具体而言）。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Write a conclusion that wraps up the argument.
zh: 写出总结论证的结论。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Use knowledge of language conventions when reading, writing, speaking, and listening.
zh: 在阅读、写作、口语和倾听中运用语言规范知识。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Rework sentences by shortening, combining, and lengthening them to
zh: 通过缩短、合并和扩展句子来改写句子，从而

subject: English Language Arts
en: create meaning and interest for readers or listeners
zh: 为读者或听众创造意义和兴趣

subject: English Language Arts
en: engage the interest of readers or listeners
zh: 吸引读者或听众的兴趣

subject: English Language Arts
en: create a desired style
zh: 营造所需的风格

subject: English Language Arts
en: Identify a variety of similarities and differences in how the English language is portrayed in stories, dramas, and poems by examining dialects, accents, and registers (i.e., styles and modes of speaking and other variations).
zh: 通过考察方言、口音和语域（即说话的风格和方式及其他变体），找出故事、戏剧和诗歌中英语呈现方式的各种异同。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Spell most words correctly or with a highly probable spelling.
zh: 大多数单词拼写正确，或拼出极有可能正确的形式。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Apply current code knowledge to spelling.
zh: 把当前学到的拼读规则知识运用于拼写。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Spell most grade-level high-frequency words correctly.
zh: 正确拼写大多数年级高频词。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Use dictionaries or glossaries—print and digital—to check and correct spellings about which they are uncertain.
zh: 使用纸质或电子词典、词汇表，检查并改正不确定的拼写。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Understand the basic rules of English grammar and conventions when writing or speaking.
zh: 在写作或口语中理解英语语法和语言规范的基本规则。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Know the following parts of speech and how they are used: conjunctions, interjections, and prepositions.
zh: 了解以下词性及其用法：连词、感叹词和介词。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Form and use the perfect (e.g., I had jogged; I have jogged; I will have jogged) verb tenses.
zh: 构成并使用完成时（例如：I had jogged；I have jogged；I will have jogged）的动词时态。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Identify subject and verb in a sentence and understand that they must agree.
zh: 识别句子中的主语和动词，并理解二者必须保持一致。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Use verb tenses correctly in a variety of ways, including times, sequences, states, and conditions.
zh: 正确运用各种动词时态，包括表示时间、先后顺序、状态和条件。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Identify and correct erroneous tense shifts.
zh: 识别并纠正错误的时态转换。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Use correlative conjunctions (e.g., either/or, neither/nor).
zh: 使用关联连词（例如：either/or、neither/nor）。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Understand and apply the basic rules of capitalization and punctuation when writing or speaking.
zh: 在写作或口语中理解并运用大小写和标点的基本规则。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Correctly use commas after introductory words (e.g., After you bake the cake, let it cool before applying the icing Or, In 1920, the League of Nations was established.)
zh: 正确使用引导语后的逗号（例如：After you bake the cake, let it cool before applying the icing；或者：In 1920, the League of Nations was established.）

subject: English Language Arts
en: Correctly use punctuation when separating words in a series, including colons before a list, commas, and semicolons.
zh: 在分隔一系列词语时正确使用标点，包括列表前的冒号、逗号和分号。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Use underlining, quotation marks, or italics for titles.
zh: 用下划线、引号或斜体表示标题。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Use a comma to set off the words yes and no (e.g., Yes, I would like a glass of water.), to set off a tag question from the rest of the sentence (e.g., That can’t possibly be true, could it?), and to indicate direct address (e.g., What are your thoughts on the matter, Derek?).
zh: 用逗号把 yes 和 no 隔开（例如：Yes, I would like a glass of water.），用逗号把附加问句与句子其余部分隔开（例如：That can't possibly be true, could it?），并用逗号表示直接称呼（例如：What are your thoughts on the matter, Derek?）。

subject: English Language Arts

zh: 运用多种策略弄清词语和短语的含义，例如以下方法：

en: Use knowledge of Greek and Latin roots and affixes to figure out the meaning of a new word (e.g., photograph, photosynthesis).
zh: 利用希腊语和拉丁语词根及词缀的知识推断新词的含义（例如：photograph、photosynthesis）。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Use a dictionary or glossary—print or digital—to answer questions about the meanings and usage of unfamiliar words.
zh: 使用纸质或电子词典、词汇表回答有关陌生词含义和用法的问题。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Know how to use a dictionary—print or digital—to pronounce words correctly.
zh: 知道如何使用纸质或电子词典来正确发音。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Use a dictionary to find the precise meaning of words and phrases.
zh: 使用词典查找单词和短语的确切含义。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Make accurate interpretations of similes and metaphors and other types of figurative language based on context.
zh: 根据上下文准确理解明喻、暗喻及其他修辞性语言的含义。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Discern nuances in word meanings.
zh: 辨别词义的细微差别。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Understand word relationships, such as synonyms, antonyms, and homographs, and use word relationships to better understand words.
zh: 理解词语之间的关系，如同义词、反义词和同形异义词，并利用这些关系更好地理解词语。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Recognize and explain the meaning of grade-appropriate idioms, adages, and proverbs.
zh: 识别并解释符合年级水平的习语、格言和谚语的含义。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Acquire grade-level Tier 3 words and phrases related to specific domains or subject areas.
zh: 掌握与本年级特定领域或学科相关的第三层（Tier 3）词语和短语。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Acquire grade-level Tier 2 words and phrases, including words that signal contrast, addition, and other logical relationships (e.g., however, although, nevertheless, similarly, moreover, in addition).
zh: 掌握本年级第二层（Tier 2）词语和短语，包括表示对比、递进及其他逻辑关系的词（例如：however、although、nevertheless、similarly、moreover、in addition）。

subject: English Language Arts
en: The poems listed here constitute a selected core of poetry for this grade. Expose students to more poetry, old and new, and have students write their own poems. To bring students into the spirit of poetry, read it aloud and encourage them to read it aloud so they can experience the music in the words. At this grade, poetry should be primarily a source of delight. This is also an appropriate grade at which to begin looking at poems in more detail, asking questions about the poet’s use of language, noting the use of devices such as simile, metaphor, alliteration, etc.
zh: 这里列出的诗歌构成了本年级精选的核心诗歌。应让学生接触更多新旧诗歌，并尝试自己写诗。为引导学生进入诗歌的意境，要朗读诗歌，并鼓励他们朗读，从而体会文字中的音乐性。在这个年级，诗歌应主要是快乐的源泉。这个年级也适合开始更细致地研读诗歌，就诗人如何运用语言提出问题，并留意明喻、隐喻、头韵等修辞手法的运用。

subject: History and Geography
en: Teachers: The study of geography embraces many topics throughout the Core Knowledge Sequence, including topics in history and science. Geographic knowledge includes a spatial sense of the world, an awareness of the physical processes that shape life, a sense of the interactions between humans and their environment, an understanding of the relations between place and culture, and an awareness of the characteristics of specific regions and cultures. Many geographic topics are listed below in connection with historical topics.

subject: Visual Arts
en: Teachers: In schools, lessons on the visual arts should illustrate important elements of making and appreciating art, and emphasize important artists, works of art, and artistic concepts. When appropriate, topics in the visual arts may be linked to topics in other disciplines. The following guidelines specify a variety of artwork in different media and from various cultures in order to expose students to a wide range of art and artists. While the list is robust, it may require teachers to narrow the selection in order to adequately address the works and related skills within an academic year. In studying the works of art specified below, and in creating their own art, students should review, develop, and apply concepts introduced in previous grades, such as line, shape, form, space, texture, color, light, design, and symmetry

en: St Basil's Cathedral Moscow See also American History Grade 5: Civil War, re photographs by Brady; and African American troops in the Civil War: Shaw and the Massachusetts 54th, re Saint-Gaudens’s Shaw Memorial. See also World History Grade 5: Feudal Japan. A mirrored room was intended to be occupied and viewed by only one person at a time This celebrates the coronation Tsar Nicholas II, who was the last emperor of Russia St. Basil’s Cathedral was built as a symbol of the new Russia. Previous architecture in the Kremlin in Moscow had been inspired by the Renaissance. St Basil’s Cathedral was an attempt to make a uniquely Russian style. It referred back to traditional timber architecture from the 9th and 10th centuries an incorporated onion style domes.
zh: 莫斯科圣瓦西里大教堂。另见美国历史五年级：南北战争，关于布雷迪的摄影作品；以及南北战争中的非裔美军：肖与马萨诸塞第54团，关于圣高登斯的《肖纪念碑》。另见世界历史五年级：封建日本。镜厅仅供一人同时进入观赏。此彩蛋为庆祝沙皇尼古拉二世加冕而作，他是俄国最后一位皇帝。圣瓦西里大教堂是作为新俄罗斯的象征而建的。莫斯科克里姆林宫先前的建筑受文艺复兴启发，而圣瓦西里大教堂则试图创造一种独特的俄罗斯风格，它回溯到9世纪和10世纪的传统木结构建筑，并融入洋葱式圆顶。

en: Teachers: In schools, lessons on music should feature activities and works that illustrate important musical concepts and terms, and should introduce important composers and works. subject: Mathematics
en: Teachers: Mathematics has its own vocabulary and patterns of thinking. It is a discipline with its own language and conventions. Thus, while some lessons may offer occasional opportunities for linking mathematics to other disciplines, it is critically important to attend to math as math. From the earliest years, mathematics requires incremental review and steady practice: not only the diligent effort required to master basic facts and operations, but also thoughtful and varied practice that approaches problems from a variety of angles, and gives students a variety of opportunities to apply the same concept or operation in different types of situations. While it is important to work toward the development of “higher-order problem-solving skills,” it is equally important—indeed, it is prerequisite to achieving “higher order” skills—to have a sound grasp of basic facts, and an automatic fluency with fundamental operations.
zh: 教师须知：数学有其自身的词汇和思维方式，是一门有自己语言和规范的学科。因此，虽然有些课程偶尔可以把数学与其他学科联系起来，但把数学当作数学来讲至关重要。从最初几年起，数学就需要循序渐进的复习和持续练习：既要努力掌握基本事实和运算，也要进行深思熟虑、形式多样的练习，从多种角度处理问题，让学生在不同类型的情境中多次运用同一概念或运算。虽然培养“高阶解题技能”很重要，但牢固掌握基本事实、对基本运算达到自动化熟练程度同样重要——事实上，这是达到“高阶”技能的前提。
