zh: 将体积与乘法、加法运算联系起来，解决涉及体积的实际问题和数学问题。• 求边长为整数的直长方体的体积。• 把三个整数相乘的积表示为体积。• 运用长方体公式 V = l × w × h 和 V = b × h，求棱长为整数的直长方体的体积。• 认识到体积具有可加性。• 求由两个互不重叠的直长方体组成的立体图形的体积。

subject: Mathematics
en: Graph Points on the Coordinate Plane to Solve Real World and Mathematical Problems
zh: 在坐标平面上描点，解决实际问题与数学问题

subject: Mathematics
en: Use a pair of perpendicular number lines (axes), to define a coordinate system.
zh: 用两条互相垂直的数轴（坐标轴）定义坐标系。
details: Understand that the first number indicates how far to travel from the origin in the direction of one axis. | Understand that the second number indicates how far to travel in the direction of the second axis.

subject: Mathematics
en: Represent real world and mathematical problems by graphing points in the first quadrant of the coordinate plane. • Interpret coordinate values of points in the context of the situation.
zh: 通过在坐标平面第一象限内描点来表示实际问题和数学问题。• 在具体情境中解释点的坐标值的含义。

subject: Mathematics
en: Classify two-dimensional figures into categories based on their properties.
zh: 根据属性将二维图形分类。

subject: Mathematics
en: Understand that attributes belonging to a category of two-dimensional figures also belong to all subcategories of that category.
zh: 理解某一类二维图形所具有的属性也适用于该类别的所有子类。

subject: Mathematics
en: Classify two-dimensional figures in a hierarchy based on properties. Pack right rectangular prism with unit cubes, and show that the volume is the same as would be found by multiplying the edge lengths, equivalently by multiplying the height by the area of the base Add the volumes of the non-overlapping parts, applying this technique to solve real world problems The intersection of the lines (the origin) are arranged to coincide with the 0 on each line and a given point in the plane can be located by using an ordered pair of numbers (coordinates). The names of the two axes and the coordinates correspond (e.g., x-axis and x-coordinate, y-axis and y-coordinate).
zh: 根据属性将二维图形按层级分类。用单位立方体填充直长方体，表明其体积与将各棱长相乘所得的结果相同，也等于用高乘以底面积。把互不重叠各部分的体积相加，并运用这一方法解决实际问题。两条轴的交点（原点）与每条轴上的0重合，平面上的任一点可用一对有序数字（坐标）来确定。两条轴的名称与坐标相对应（例如，x轴与x坐标，y轴与y坐标）。

subject: Science
en: Teachers: Effective instruction in science requires hands-on experience and observation. In the words of the report from the National Academies of Science, A Framework for K-12 Science Education, “...children have surprisingly sophisticated ways of thinking about the world, based in part on their direct experiences with the physical environment, such as watching objects fall or collide and observing plants and animals. They also learn about the world through everyday activities, such as talking with their families, pursuing hobbies, watching television, and playing with friends. As children try to understand and influence the world around them, they develop ideas about their role in that world and how it works. In fact, the capacity of young children—from all backgrounds and socioeconomic levels—to reason in sophisticated ways is much greater than has long been assumed. Although they may lack deep knowledge and extensive experience, they often engage in a wide range of subtle and complex reasoning about the world. Thus, before they even enter school, children have developed their own ideas about the physical, biological, and social worlds and how they work. By listening to and taking these ideas seriously, educators can build on what children already know and can do.”
zh: 教师须知：有效的科学教学需要动手体验和观察。用美国国家科学院报告《K-12 科学教育框架》的话来说：“……孩子们以令人惊讶的复杂方式思考世界，这部分基于他们对物质环境的直接体验，比如观看物体下落或碰撞、观察动植物。他们也通过日常活动了解世界，比如与家人交谈、从事爱好、看电视、和朋友玩耍。当孩子们试图理解和影响周围的世界时，他们会形成关于自己在世界中的角色以及世界如何运作的想法。事实上，幼儿——无论来自何种背景、何种社会经济水平——进行复杂推理的能力远超长期以来的设想。尽管他们可能缺乏深入知识和丰富经验，但他们常常对世界进行广泛而细致的复杂推理。因此，甚至在入学之前，孩子们就已经对物理、生物和社会世界及其运作方式形成了自己的想法。通过倾听并认真对待这些想法，教育者可以在儿童已有知识和能力的基础上进行教学。”

subject: Science
en: Through reading aloud, observation, and activities such as planning and conducting investigations of interacting types of matter, explore the following with students:
zh: 通过朗读、观察，以及规划和实施关于不同物质相互作用的研究等活动，与学生一起探究以下内容：

subject: Science
en: Matter is anything that has mass.
zh: 物质是任何有质量的东西。

subject: Science
en: Basic properties of matter include its mass, volume, and weight.
zh: 物质的基本属性包括质量、体积和重量。

subject: Science
en: Materials can be identified and described in terms of many properties, such as hardness, color, malleability, and density.
zh: 可以根据多种属性来识别和描述材料，如硬度、颜色、延展性和密度。

subject: Science
en: Matter is made of particles too small to be seen.
zh: 物质由小到看不见的微粒构成。

subject: Science
en: Observations that demonstrate and model that matter is made of particles:
zh: 证明并模拟物质由微粒构成的观察实例：

subject: Science
en: Sugar cubes dissolve in water.
zh: 方糖在水中溶解。

subject: Science
en: A balloon expands when air is blown into it.
zh: 往气球里吹气时气球会膨胀。

subject: Science
en: Salt water can be evaporated when boiled.
zh: 盐水煮沸时会蒸发。

subject: Science
en: Physical change: a physical characteristic of the matter changes but the type of matter remains the same.
zh: 物理变化：物质的某种物理特性发生改变，但物质的种类保持不变。

subject: Science
en: Solid matter has definite shape and volume.
zh: 固态物质有固定的形状和体积。

subject: Science
en: A liquid takes the shape of its container.
zh: 液体会呈现容器的形状。

subject: Science
en: A gas has no definite shape; it fills its container.
zh: 气体没有固定的形状，会充满整个容器。

subject: Science
en: Matter can change states; water is a common example.
zh: 物质可以改变状态；水是一个常见例子。

subject: Science
en: Other physical changes: dividing an object into pieces, dissolving a substance, and mixing substances.
zh: 其他物理变化：把物体分成小块、溶解某种物质以及混合不同物质。

subject: Science
en: When substances undergo physical change, the total weight of matter is conserved. Review and extend learning from Science Grade 2, Properties of Matter.
zh: 物质发生物理变化时，物质的总重量保持不变。复习并拓展二年级科学《物质的属性》中所学内容。

subject: Science
en: Chemical change: two types of matter interact to form a new substance
zh: 化学变化：两种物质相互作用形成新物质

subject: Science
en: Evidence that a chemical change has occurred:
zh: 发生化学变化的证据：

subject: Science
en: formation of a gas, and changes in odor, color, or temperature.
zh: 气体生成，以及气味、颜色或温度的变化。

subject: Science
en: Examples of chemical changes:
zh: 化学变化的例子：

subject: Science
en: burning wood, rusting metal, and digesting foods
zh: 燃烧木材、金属生锈以及消化食物

subject: Science
en: When substances undergo chemical change, the total weight of matter is conserved.
zh: 物质发生化学变化时，物质的总重量保持不变。

subject: Science
en: Chemistry: the scientific study of what matter is made of and how matter changes
zh: 化学：对物质由什么构成以及物质如何变化进行的科学研究

subject: Science
en: Matter is made of particles too small to be seen (atoms).
zh: 物质由小到看不见的微粒（原子）构成。

subject: Science
en: Atoms can join to form molecules.
zh: 原子可以结合形成分子。

subject: Science
en: Models of common molecules (such as water and carbon dioxide)
zh: 常见分子的模型（如水和二氧化碳）

subject: Science
en: Through reading aloud, observation, and activities such as creating models of food webs, help students to explore the following:
zh: 通过朗读、观察，以及制作食物网模型等活动，帮助学生探究以下内容：

subject: Science
en: Living things need chemical energy from food for all life processes.
zh: 生物的所有生命活动都需要来自食物的化学能。

subject: Science
en: The energy in animals’ food originated as energy from the sun.
zh: 动物食物中的能量最初来自太阳的能量。

subject: Science
en: Producers: use energy from the sun to make their own food
zh: 生产者：利用太阳的能量自己制造食物

subject: Science
en: Consumers: get their food by eating other organisms
zh: 消费者：通过吃其他生物获取食物

subject: Science
en: Decomposers: break down the tissues of dead organisms for food and function as recyclers
zh: 分解者：分解死亡生物的组织作为食物，充当“回收者”的角色

subject: Science
en: Life cycles are the patterns of changes that organisms go through during their lives.
zh: 生命周期是生物一生中经历的变化模式。

subject: Science
en: Plants need sunlight, water, and air to grow.
zh: 植物生长需要阳光、水和空气。

subject: Science
en: Plants get the substances they need for growth mainly from air and water.
zh: 植物生长所需的物质主要来自空气和水。

subject: Science
en: Photosynthesis: Plants use air, water, and the energy of sunlight to make glucose.
zh: 光合作用：植物利用空气、水和阳光的能量制造葡萄糖。

subject: Science
en: Plants use glucose as the fundamental food for all life processes.
zh: 植物把葡萄糖作为所有生命活动的基本食物。

subject: Science
en: Animals get their food energy by eating other organisms.
zh: 动物通过吃其他生物获取食物能量。

subject: Science
en: Herbivores: animals that eat only plants
zh: 草食动物：只吃植物的动物

subject: Science
en: Carnivores: animals that eat other animals
zh: 肉食动物：吃其他动物的动物

subject: Science
en: Omnivores: animals that eat both plants and animals
zh: 杂食动物：既吃植物也吃动物的动物

subject: Science
en: Energy is transferred from the sun to producers and then to consumers.
zh: 能量从太阳转移到生产者，再转移到消费者。

subject: Science
en: Ecosystems: the living and nonliving things in an area
zh: 生态系统：某一区域内的生物与非生物

subject: Science
en: Producers make food; the chemical energy of food cycles moves from producers to consumers.
zh: 生产者制造食物；食物中的化学能沿循环从生产者转移到消费者。

subject: Science
en: Food chain and food web: models of how matter and energy flow through an ecosystem
zh: 食物链和食物网：表示物质和能量如何在生态系统中流动的模型

subject: Science
en: As matter cycles through an ecosystem, the interactions of producers, consumers, and decomposers meet the needs of living things in the ecosystem.
zh: 当物质在生态系统中循环时，生产者、消费者和分解者之间的相互作用满足了生态系统中生物的需求。

subject: Science
en: Anything that disrupts food webs may harm an ecosystem.
zh: 任何破坏食物网的事物都可能危害生态系统。

subject: Science
en: Invasive plants and animals (zebra mussels or kudzu)
zh: 入侵植物和动物（斑马贻贝或葛藤）

subject: Science
en: Humans
zh: 人类

subject: Science
en: Environmental changes Review and extend learning about the life cycles of particular organisms from Science Grade 3, Life Cycles, Traits, and Variations. III. Modeling Earth’s Systems Teachers: Through reading aloud, observation, and activities such as creating models of the different spheres of Earth, help students to explore the following:
zh: 环境变化。复习并拓展三年级科学《生命周期、性状与变异》中关于特定生物生命周期的学习内容。III. 地球系统建模 教师：通过朗读、观察，以及制作地球各圈层模型等活动，帮助学生探究以下内容：

subject: Science
en: Hydrosphere: all the water in all its forms
zh: 水圈：各种形态的所有水

subject: Science
en: Oceans hold nearly all of Earth’s water.
zh: 海洋蕴藏着地球几乎全部的水。

subject: Science
en: Ocean water is salt water, not suitable for drinking.
zh: 海水是咸水，不适合饮用。

subject: Science
en: Brackish water: a mix of salt water and fresh water
zh: 半咸水：咸水与淡水的混合

subject: Science
en: Earth’s fresh water is in glaciers or underground; much less is found in streams, lakes, wetlands, and the atmosphere.
zh: 地球的淡水存在于冰川或地下；河流、湖泊、湿地和大气中的淡水要少得多。

subject: Science
en: Geosphere: All rocks, minerals, and landforms
zh: 岩石圈：所有岩石、矿物和地貌

subject: Science
en: Earth’s crust and upper mantle move slowly over time.
zh: 地壳和上地幔会随时间缓慢移动。

subject: Science
en: Evidence of changes to Earth’s surface can be found in rocks and rock layers.
zh: 在岩石和岩层中可以找到地球表面变化的证据。

subject: Science
en: Atmosphere is all the air around us and all that it contains.
zh: 大气层是我们周围所有的空气及其包含的一切。

subject: Science
en: The air is a mixture of gases, including nitrogen, oxygen, carbon dioxide, and water vapor.
zh: 空气是多种气体的混合物，包括氮气、氧气、二氧化碳和水蒸气。

subject: Science
en: Nitrogen makes up the most abundant gas in our atmosphere (approximately 78%).
zh: 氮是大气中含量最丰富的气体（约占78%）。

subject: Science
en: Biosphere: All living things
zh: 生物圈：所有生物

subject: Science
en: Biome: a large region with a specific climate and with living things adapted to that climate
zh: 生物群系：具有特定气候、且生物适应了这种气候的大片区域

subject: Science
en: Major biomes include tundra, forests, grasslands, and desert.
zh: 主要生物群系包括苔原、森林、草原和荒漠。

subject: Science
en: Living things rely on their habitats to meet their needs.
zh: 生物依靠其栖息地来满足自身需求。

subject: Science
en: Hydrosphere interactions
zh: 水圈的相互作用

subject: Science
en: Water shapes Earth’s surface over time (erosion by rivers, oceans, and weather).
zh: 水会随时间塑造地球表面（河流、海洋和气候造成的侵蚀）。

subject: Science
en: The sun’s energy evaporates water into the atmosphere.
zh: 太阳的能量使水蒸发进入大气。

subject: Science
en: Oceans influence climate and weather.
zh: 海洋影响气候和天气。

subject: Science
en: Atmosphere interactions
zh: 大气圈的相互作用

subject: Science
en: Wind and weather cause the weathering and erosion of rock.
zh: 风和天气造成岩石的风化与侵蚀。

subject: Science
en: Weather and climate affect habitats and ecosystems.
zh: 天气和气候影响栖息地与生态系统。

subject: Science
en: Water vapor forms rain, which falls to the ground and forms freshwater reservoirs for living things to use.
zh: 水蒸气形成雨，雨水落到地面，形成供生物使用的淡水库。

subject: Science
en: Nitrogen gas in the air enters the ground and is chemically transformed by bacteria for plant use.
zh: 空气中的氮气进入土壤，被细菌转化为可供植物利用的化学形态。

subject: Science
en: Geosphere interactions
zh: 岩石圈的相互作用

subject: Science
en: Mountain ranges affect the formation of clouds and other weather events.
zh: 山脉影响云的形成和其他天气现象。

subject: Science
en: Living things can cause erosion in a specific environment.
zh: 生物会在特定环境中造成侵蚀。

subject: Science
en: Certain rock layers provide the necessary space for the formation of aquifers.
zh: 某些岩层为含水层的形成提供了必要的空间。

subject: Science
en: Biosphere interactions
zh: 生物圈的相互作用

subject: Science
en: Freshwater lakes provide a habitat for fish and algae.
zh: 淡水湖泊为鱼类和藻类提供栖息地。

subject: Science
en: Minerals in soils are absorbed into plants through their roots to provide important chemicals for life.
zh: 土壤中的矿物质通过根部被植物吸收，为生命活动提供重要的化学物质。

subject: Science
en: All living things depend on water (fresh or salt water) to survive.
zh: 所有生物都依赖水（淡水或咸水）才能生存。

subject: Science
en: Water pollution can be harmful to living things.
zh: 水污染会危害生物。

subject: Science
en: Unlimited use of fresh water sources may result in shortages (including during droughts) resulting in:
zh: 无限制地使用淡水资源可能导致短缺（包括在干旱期间），从而造成：

subject: Science
en: Destruction of ecosystems This topic draws upon background knowledge developed across all previous grades. This is an opportunity for students to demonstrate their cumulative knowledge within the context of systems thinking. Using the models created in the previous topic, Modeling Earth's Systems, work with students to create scientific arguments about Earth's resources.
zh: 生态系统遭到破坏。本主题利用此前各个年级所积累的背景知识，是学生运用系统思维展示其累积知识的机会。借助上一主题“地球系统建模”中创建的模型，与学生一起就地球资源提出科学论证。

subject: Science
en: Reduction of biodiversity
zh: 生物多样性减少

subject: Science
en: Loss of recreational and living space
zh: 休闲与生活空间的丧失

subject: Science
en: Conservation practices include:
zh: 保护措施包括：

subject: Science
en: Using only as much water as necessary
zh: 只使用必需的水量

subject: Science
en: Protecting river systems and watersheds by managing the use of water by industries, agriculture, and residential areas
zh: 通过管理工业、农业和居民区的用水来保护河流系统与流域

subject: Science
en: Regulations to prevent and reduce water pollution (Clean Water Act)
zh: 防止和减少水污染的法规（《清洁水法》）

subject: Science
en: Many organisms depend on the atmosphere to survive.
zh: 许多生物依靠大气才能生存。

subject: Science
en: Air pollution includes:
zh: 空气污染包括：

subject: Science
en: Emissions from automobiles and other forms of transportation ( nitrogen oxides and carbon monoxide)
zh: 汽车及其他交通工具的排放物（氮氧化物和一氧化碳）

subject: Science
en: Emissions from industry and burning fossil fuels (sulfur dioxide)
zh: 工业排放和化石燃料燃烧产生的排放物（二氧化硫）

subject: Science
en: Consequences:
zh: 后果：

subject: Science
en: Acid rain
zh: 酸雨

subject: Science
en: Ozone destruction
zh: 臭氧层破坏

subject: Science
en: Average temperature changes
zh: 平均气温变化

subject: Science
en: Solutions:
zh: 解决办法：

subject: Science
en: Smog reduction and transportation incentives
zh: 减少烟雾及交通激励措施

subject: Science
en: Technologies to reduce emission of harmful gases in automotive exhaust
zh: 减少汽车尾气中有害气体排放的技术

subject: Science
en: Regulations to prevent and reduce air pollution ( Clean Air Act)
zh: 防止和减少空气污染的法规（《清洁空气法》）

subject: Science
en: Many living things depend on the land around them to meet their needs.
zh: 许多生物依靠周围的土地来满足自身需求。

subject: Science
en: Sources of land pollution: solid waste, pesticides, construction and mining waste
zh: 土地污染源：固体废弃物、农药、建筑和采矿废弃物

subject: Science
en: Consequences:
zh: 后果：

subject: Science
en: Habitat destruction
zh: 栖息地破坏

subject: Science
en: Chemical pollution
zh: 化学污染

subject: Science
en: Solutions:
zh: 解决办法：

subject: Science
en: Reducing waste in landfills
zh: 减少填埋场的废弃物

subject: Science
en: Chemical testing of hazardous waste
zh: 对危险废弃物进行化学检测

subject: Science
en: Satellite tracking of soil erosion
zh: 用卫星追踪土壤侵蚀

subject: Science
en: Environmental Impact Assessments
zh: 环境影响评估

subject: Science
en: Overuse or misuse of water, air, and land resources can harm living organisms and the environment.
zh: 过度使用或不当使用水、空气和土地资源会危害生物和环境。

subject: Science
en: Monitoring is needed to detect ecosystem changes.
zh: 需要进行监测以发现生态系统的变化。

subject: Science
en: Endangered species and extinction
zh: 濒危物种与灭绝

subject: Science
en: Community activism: applying knowledge about how ecosystems interact with other systems of Earth to help protect them
zh: 社区行动：运用有关生态系统如何与地球其他系统相互作用的知识来帮助保护生态系统

subject: Science
en: Regulations to protect and conserve ecosystems and wildlife: the Endangered Species Act and The Clean Air Act
zh: 保护和保存生态系统与野生动物的法规：《濒危物种法案》和《清洁空气法案》。

subject: Science
en: The universe is all matter and energy.
zh: 宇宙是所有的物质和能量。

subject: Science
en: Astronomical distance is measured in light years. Review and extend learning from Grade 3, Habitats and Change.
zh: 天文距离以光年为单位。复习并拓展三年级《栖息地与变化》的学习内容。

subject: Science
en: Galaxies: huge collections of stars, dust, and gas
zh: 星系：由恒星、尘埃和气体组成的巨大集合

subject: Science
en: There are hundreds of billions of galaxies in the universe.
zh: 宇宙中有数以千亿计的星系。

subject: Science
en: Our galaxy is the Milky Way.
zh: 我们所在的星系是银河系。

subject: Science
en: Andromeda Galaxy is near the Milky Way.
zh: 仙女座星系位于银河系附近。

subject: Science
en: Our solar system includes:
zh: 我们的太阳系包括：

subject: Science
en: Sun: source of energy
zh: 太阳：能量来源

subject: Science
en: The eight planets: Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune
zh: 八大行星：水星、金星、地球、火星、木星、土星、天王星、海王星

subject: Science
en: Other objects in space: dwarf planets, asteroids, meteors, comets
zh: 太空中的其他天体：矮行星、小行星、流星、彗星

subject: Science
en: The ways we know about our solar system and the universe include:
zh: 我们了解太阳系和宇宙的方式包括：

subject: Science
en: Earth-based observations
zh: 地面观测

subject: Science
en: Space probes and space-based telescopes (the Hubble Space Telescope, Mars rovers)
zh: 太空探测器和太空望远镜（哈勃太空望远镜、火星车）

subject: Science
en: Human space flights (Apollo 11, the first landing on the moon)
zh: 载人航天飞行（阿波罗11号，首次登月）

subject: Science
en: Earth-moon-sun make a system.
zh: 地球—月球—太阳构成一个系统。

subject: Science
en: Earth rotates around its axis, resulting in:
zh: 地球绕地轴自转，产生：

subject: Science
en: Sun appears to move east to west across the sky.
zh: 太阳看起来在天空中自东向西移动。

subject: Science
en: Stars appear to move in the night sky.
zh: 星星看起来在夜空中移动。

subject: Science
en: Shadows change in length and direction throughout the day.
zh: 影子在一天中的长度和方向会发生变化。

subject: Science
en: Earth orbits the sun, resulting in:
zh: 地球绕太阳公转，产生：

subject: Science
en: Changing seasons
zh: 季节变化

subject: Science
en: Seasonal changes in the length and direction of shadows
zh: 影子长度和方向的季节性变化

subject: Science
en: Stars give off their own light.
zh: 恒星自身发光。

subject: Science
en: Stars vary in size and brightness.
zh: 恒星的大小和亮度各不相同。

subject: Science
en: The perceived brightness of a star depends on:
zh: 恒星的视亮度取决于：

subject: Science
en: size
zh: 大小

subject: Science
en: energy (actual brightness)
zh: 能量（实际亮度）

subject: Science
en: distance from Earth
zh: 与地球的距离
details: The sun appears brighter than other stars because it is the closest star to Earth. | Stars brighter and bigger than the sun appear dimmer and smaller because they are farther away.

subject: Science
en: Constellations: recognizable patterns of stars
zh: 星座：可辨认的恒星图案

subject: Science
en: Some stars and constellations are only visible in certain seasons because of the position of Earth as it orbits the sun.
zh: 由于地球在公转轨道上的位置，某些恒星和星座只能在特定季节看到。

subject: Science
en: Gravity: a universal force that pulls objects toward each other
zh: 引力：使物体相互吸引的普遍作用力

subject: Science
en: A gravitational force is an attraction force that two masses exert on each other (the Sun and Earth; Earth and Moon; Earth and all objects close to its mass).
zh: 引力是两个有质量的物体之间相互施加的吸引力（太阳与地球；地球与月球；地球与附近所有有质量的物体）。

subject: Science
en: Earth’s gravitational force is perceived as pulling “down.”
zh: 地球的引力被感知为向“下”拉。

subject: Science
en: Predictable orbits of the planets is the result of the sun’s gravity pulling on all the objects in our solar system.
zh: 行星轨道的可预测性，是太阳引力作用于太阳系中所有物体的结果。

subject: Science
en: The earth-moon-sun gravitational forces cause ocean tides on Earth.
zh: 地球—月球—太阳之间的引力作用引起地球上的海洋潮汐。

subject: Science
topic: The Human Body: Human Hormones and Reproduction
en: Humans undergo changes from infancy to adulthood.
zh: 人类会从婴儿期到成年期经历变化。

subject: Science
topic: The Human Body: Human Hormones and Reproduction
en: Puberty involves changes in glands and hormones. Review and extend learning from Grade 1, Sun, Moon, and Stars. Review and extend learning from Grade 3, Investigating Forces.
zh: 青春期涉及腺体和激素的变化。复习并拓展一年级《太阳、月亮和星星》的学习内容；复习并拓展三年级《探究力》的学习内容。

subject: Science
topic: The Human Body: Human Hormones and Reproduction
en: The human body has two types of glands: duct glands (salivary glands), and ductless glands (endocrine glands).
zh: 人体有两类腺体：有管腺（如唾液腺）和无管腺（内分泌腺）。

subject: Science
topic: The Human Body: Human Hormones and Reproduction
en: Endocrine gland: secrete (give off) chemicals called hormones:
zh: 内分泌腺：分泌（释放）称为激素的化学物质：

subject: Science
topic: The Human Body: Human Hormones and Reproduction
en: Different hormones control different body processes
zh: 不同的激素控制不同的身体过程

subject: Science
topic: The Human Body: Human Hormones and Reproduction
en: Pituitary gland: secretes hormones that control other glands, and hormones that regulate growth
zh: 垂体：分泌控制其他腺体的激素，以及调节生长的激素

subject: Science
topic: The Human Body: Human Hormones and Reproduction
en: Thyroid gland: secretes a hormone that controls the rate at which the body burns and uses food
zh: 甲状腺：分泌一种激素，控制身体燃烧和利用食物的速率

subject: Science
topic: The Human Body: Human Hormones and Reproduction
en: Pancreas: secretes a hormone called insulin that regulates how the body uses and stores sugar • Diabetes is a condition caused by the pancreas not producing enough insulin.
zh: 胰腺：分泌一种叫胰岛素的激素，调节身体如何利用和储存糖分。• 糖尿病是由于胰腺分泌胰岛素不足引起的疾病。

subject: Science
topic: The Human Body: Human Hormones and Reproduction
en: Adrenal gland: secretes a hormone called adrenaline; occurs when a person experiences heightened emotion (fear, anger), causing rapid heartbeat and breathing.
zh: 肾上腺：分泌一种叫肾上腺素的激素；当人经历强烈情绪（恐惧、愤怒）时产生，导致心跳和呼吸加快。

subject: Science
topic: The Human Body: Human Hormones and Reproduction
en: Female reproductive organs: ovaries, fallopian tubes, uterus, and vagina
zh: 女性生殖器官：卵巢、输卵管、子宫和阴道

subject: Science
topic: The Human Body: Human Hormones and Reproduction
en: Menstruation: the monthly release of an unfertilized egg and associated uterine tissue (after puberty)
zh: 月经：每月排出未受精的卵子及相关的子宫组织（青春期后）

subject: Science
topic: The Human Body: Human Hormones and Reproduction
en: Male reproductive organs: testes, scrotum, penis
zh: 男性生殖器官：睾丸、阴囊、阴茎

subject: Science
topic: The Human Body: Human Hormones and Reproduction
en: Semen is the fluid that contains sperm cells.
zh: 精液是含有精子的液体。

subject: Science
topic: The Human Body: Human Hormones and Reproduction
en: Sexual reproduction involves intercourse, fertilization, zygote, implantation of zygote in the uterus, pregnancy, embryo, fetal development, and birth.
zh: 有性生殖包括性交、受精、受精卵、受精卵在子宫内着床、怀孕、胚胎、胎儿发育和分娩。

subject: Science
en: Through reading aloud and activities, explore with students the stories and accomplishments of these scientists and engineers. This list of science biographies is by no means exhaustive. Other individuals can be incorporated into learning during a corresponding topic of study for this grade level, and should include:
zh: 通过朗读和活动，与学生一起探究这些科学家和工程师的故事与成就。这份科学家传记清单并不详尽。在学习本年级相应主题时，还可以加入其他人物，应包括：

subject: Science
en: Democritus—ancient philosopher who argued that there are small indivisible bodies from which everything else is composed
zh: 德谟克利特——古代哲学家，认为存在不可再分的微小粒子，万物皆由它们构成

subject: Science
en: John Dalton—developed the theory of atomism
zh: 约翰·道尔顿（John Dalton）——提出原子论

subject: Science
en: Eugene Odum—pioneered studies on the ecology of ecosystems
zh: 尤金·奥德姆（Eugene Odum）——开创生态系统生态学研究

subject: Science
en: Charles Elton—ecologist and expert in the role of invasive species
zh: 查尔斯·埃尔顿（Charles Elton）——生态学家，入侵物种作用方面的专家

subject: Science
en: Beatrix Potter—author of The Tales of Peter Rabbit, was also a respected illustrator and naturalist specializing in mushrooms and other fungi.
zh: 比阿特丽克斯·波特（Beatrix Potter）——《彼得兔的故事》的作者，也是备受尊敬的插画家和博物学家，专门研究蘑菇及其他真菌。

subject: Science
en: E.O. Wilson—a leading authority on the ecology of ants
zh: E.O. 威尔逊（E.O. Wilson）——蚂蚁生态学领域的权威专家

subject: Science
en: Robert T. Paine—developed the concept of keystone species in ecosystems
zh: 罗伯特·T·佩恩（Robert T. Paine）——提出生态系统中关键种的概念

subject: Science
en: Henry A. Gleason—known for his work in ecological succession
zh: 亨利·A·格里森（Henry A. Gleason）——以生态演替方面的研究著称

subject: Science
en: Boyan Slat—Dutch inventor, developed a system for removing floating garbage from the ocean surface.
zh: 博扬·斯拉特（Boyan Slat）——荷兰发明家，开发出清除海面漂浮垃圾的系统。

subject: Science
en: Valentina Tereshkova—Russian cosmonaut who was the first woman in space
zh: 瓦莲京娜·捷列什科娃（Valentina Tereshkova）——俄罗斯宇航员，第一位进入太空的女性

subject: Science
en: Sally Ride—astronaut who was the first American woman in space
zh: 萨莉·莱德（Sally Ride）——宇航员，第一位进入太空的美国女性

subject: Science
en: Mae Jemison—physician and biologist who was the first African American woman astronaut
zh: 梅·杰米森（Mae Jemison）——内科医生兼生物学家，第一位非裔美国女性宇航员

subject: Science
en: Nancy Grace Roman—one of the first female executives at NASA, particularly known for her planning of the Hubble Space Telescope
zh: 南希·格雷斯·罗曼——美国宇航局最早的高层女性管理者之一，尤其以主持规划哈勃太空望远镜而闻名

subject: Science
en: Katherine Johnson—African American mathematician who was critical to the success of NASA’s early orbital missions
zh: 凯瑟琳·约翰逊——对美国宇航局（NASA）早期轨道任务成功至关重要的非裔美国数学家。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Actively participate in discussions about a variety of Grade 6 topics, ideas, and texts in a variety of settings, including partners, small and large groups, and teacher-led groups.
zh: 在多种场合（包括两人结对、小组和大组以及教师主导的小组）中，积极参与关于六年级各种主题、观点和文本的讨论。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Prepare for discussions in advance, including reading about the topic and organizing information for the discussion. Draw on preparations during the discussion.
zh: 提前为讨论做准备，包括阅读相关话题材料并整理讨论所需信息；讨论时运用这些准备成果。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Set goals, deadlines, and specific roles appropriate to a discussion; set and follow rules for productive social engagement among peers.
zh: 为讨论设定合适的目标、时限和具体角色；制定并遵守规则，促进同伴之间富有成效的互动交流。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Ask relevant questions to clarify conversations and ideas and to build upon remarks made by others.
zh: 提出相关问题，以澄清谈话和想法，并在他人发言的基础上进一步展开。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Use details to elaborate and comment on a topic, text, or issue being discussed; add insight to discussions or move discussions forward.
zh: 运用细节对所讨论的主题、文本或问题进行阐述和评论；为讨论增添见解或推动讨论深入。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Restate the key ideas in a discussion and draw conclusions that show a range of complexities, including understanding multiple perspectives relevant to the topic, text, or issue.
zh: 重述讨论中的关键观点，并得出体现一定复杂性的结论，包括理解与主题、文本或问题相关的多种视角。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Interpret information from an array of media formats, such as visual (paintings, pictures, and animations), quantitative (graphs, charts, and diagrams), videos, and recordings.
zh: 解读多种媒体形式呈现的信息，如视觉类（绘画、图片和动画）、数据类（曲线图、图表和示意图）、视频以及录音。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Explain how information from media formats reflects, enhances, or is otherwise suitable for the discussion, issue, or topic at hand.
zh: 说明媒体形式的信息如何反映、增强或以其他方式适用于当前的讨论、问题或主题。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Explain a speaker’s argument, distinguishing the claims, evidence, and reasons speakers give and whether the claims are adequately supported.
zh: 解释说话者的论点，区分其提出的主张、证据和理由，并判断这些主张是否得到充分支持。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Give a presentation about a topic or text, tell a story, or orally relate a personal experience in a logical and organized manner, including relevant descriptions, details, and facts that support main ideas or themes.
zh: 以条理清晰、逻辑严密的方式就某一主题或文本作报告、讲故事或口头讲述个人经历，包括支持主要观点或主题的相关描述、细节和事实。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Orally present a claim-based argument supported by research/findings.
zh: 口头陈述以研究/发现为支撑的、基于主张的论证。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Speak clearly at an understandable volume and pace; maintain eye contact.
zh: 以清晰、易于理解的音量和语速讲话；保持眼神交流。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Enhance presentations by adding relevant multimedia such as displays, images, videos, graphics, music, and recordings.
zh: 通过添加相关的多媒体（如演示文稿、图片、视频、图形、音乐和录音）来增强展示效果。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Switch between formal and informal English as appropriate to the situation or task; adapt speech to a variety of contexts.
zh: 根据情境或任务在正式与非正式英语之间恰当切换；使言语适应各种语境。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Show proficiency when using formal English, such as standard pronunciation when giving speeches or speaking to large groups and in formal circumstances, such as a job interview.
zh: 在使用正式英语时表现出熟练能力，例如在演讲、面对大群人讲话或在求职面试等正式场合使用标准发音。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Independently and proficiently read and comprehend longer works of fiction (stories, plays, and poems) and literary nonfiction written at the high end of Grades 6 through 8.
zh: 独立且熟练地阅读并理解难度处于6至8年级高段的较长虚构作品（故事、戏剧和诗歌）以及文学性非虚构作品。

subject: English Language Arts
section: Grasping Specific Details and Key Ideas
section_zh: 把握具体细节与核心观点
en: Draw evidence from texts when explaining them or making inferences.
zh: 在解释文本或进行推断时，从文本中提取证据。

subject: English Language Arts
section: Grasping Specific Details and Key Ideas
section_zh: 把握具体细节与核心观点
en: Quote or cite accurately from texts when explaining them or making inferences.
zh: 在解释文本或进行推断时，准确引用或标注文本出处。

subject: English Language Arts
section: Grasping Specific Details and Key Ideas
section_zh: 把握具体细节与核心观点
en: Use details to summarize texts objectively without personal opinions or judgments.
zh: 运用细节客观地概括文本，不掺杂个人观点或判断。

subject: English Language Arts
section: Grasping Specific Details and Key Ideas
section_zh: 把握具体细节与核心观点
en: Identify the central ideas or themes in a text and explain how details help develop big ideas.
zh: 确定文本的中心思想或主题，并说明细节如何帮助展开重要观点。

subject: English Language Arts
section: Grasping Specific Details and Key Ideas
section_zh: 把握具体细节与核心观点
en: Determine the meaning of words and phrases in a text, including
zh: 确定文本中词语和短语的含义，包括

subject: English Language Arts
section: Grasping Specific Details and Key Ideas
section_zh: 把握具体细节与核心观点
en: Tier 2 academic vocabulary
zh: 第二层（Tier 2）学术词汇

subject: English Language Arts
section: Grasping Specific Details and Key Ideas
section_zh: 把握具体细节与核心观点
en: Tier 3 subject-area vocabulary
zh: 第三层（Tier 3）学科领域词汇

subject: English Language Arts
section: Grasping Specific Details and Key Ideas
section_zh: 把握具体细节与核心观点
en: figurative language, such as metaphors and similes
zh: 修辞性语言，如暗喻和明喻

subject: English Language Arts
section: Grasping Specific Details and Key Ideas
section_zh: 把握具体细节与核心观点
en: connotative meanings
zh: 引申含义（内涵意义）

subject: English Language Arts
section: Grasping Specific Details and Key Ideas
section_zh: 把握具体细节与核心观点
en: Consider the impact of word choices on meaning and tone.
zh: 考虑用词选择对意义和语气的影响。

subject: English Language Arts
section: Grasping Specific Details and Key Ideas
section_zh: 把握具体细节与核心观点
en: Analyze the structure of a text and how the parts (sentences, stanzas, paragraphs, chapters, scenes, and sections) relate to the whole.
zh: 分析文本的结构，以及各部分（句子、诗节、段落、章节、场景和部分）与整体的关系。

subject: English Language Arts
section: Grasping Specific Details and Key Ideas
section_zh: 把握具体细节与核心观点
en: Analyze how a text’s structure helps build on themes and big ideas.
zh: 分析文本结构如何帮助深化主题和重要观点。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Compare a written text to an oral, visual, or audio version, focusing on the explicit difference in what is read, seen, or heard.
zh: 将书面文本与口头、视觉或音频版本进行比较，重点关注所读、所见或所闻内容中的明显差异。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Examine the different experiences and perceptions readers, listeners, and viewers might have of written, visual, or audio versions of the same texts.
zh: 考察读者、听众和观众对同一文本的书面、视觉或音频版本可能产生的不同体验和感受。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Compare and contrast different texts with the same topic, themes, or genre.
zh: 比较和对比主题、题材或体裁相同的不同文本。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Trace arguments and claims and determine whether the reasoning, evidence, and logic are adequate.
zh: 梳理论证和主张，判断推理、证据和逻辑是否充分。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Synthesize information from multiple sources (e.g., print or digital) and formats (e.g., visual or quantitative) to develop a deep understanding of a topic or issue.
zh: 综合来自多种来源（如纸质或数字）和形式（如视觉或数据）的信息，以深入理解某一主题或问题。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Understand how the plots in stories and dramas build episodically or serially.
zh: 理解故事和戏剧中的情节如何以片段式或连续式逐步展开。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Examine how characters respond to circumstances and how they change as a plot unfolds and moves toward its resolution.
zh: 考察人物如何应对环境，以及随着情节展开并走向结局他们如何变化。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Examine how the basic structures of plays, poems, and fiction, such as scenes, stanzas, and chapters, work together to create an overall cohesive structure.
zh: 考察戏剧、诗歌和小说的基本结构（如场景、诗节和章节）如何共同作用，形成一个整体连贯的结构。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Examine how the structure of a literary work helps develop the settings, plot, and themes.
zh: 考察文学作品的结构如何帮助展开背景、情节和主题。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Explain how authors develop the points of view of narrators or speakers.
zh: 解释作者如何刻画叙述者或说话者的观点。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Examine how an author develops the point of view of a speaker (poem) or narrator (fiction) over the course of a literary work.
zh: 考察作者在文学作品的进程中如何逐步展现说话者（诗歌）或叙述者（小说）的观点。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Compare and contrast the experience of reading a text versus hearing an audio version or seeing a performance of the same story.
zh: 比较和对比阅读文本与聆听音频版本或观看同一故事演出这三种体验的异同。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Compare and contrast how different literary genres, such as poems, historical novels, and fantasies, approach similar topics and themes.
zh: 比较和对比不同文学体裁（如诗歌、历史小说和奇幻作品）如何处理相似的主题和题材。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Locate the central ideas in a text and identify key details that support them.
zh: 找出文本的中心思想，并确定支持这些中心思想的关键细节。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Effectively summarize all types of informational texts; differentiate between an objective summary and one’s opinions and judgments.
zh: 有效地概括各类说明性文本；区分客观概括与个人观点和判断。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Understand and explain in depth how a topic is introduced, illustrated, and elaborated.
zh: 深入理解并解释一个主题是如何被引入、说明和展开的。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Understand and explain the relationships and interactions between two or more individuals, events, or ideas in a text (e.g., examples and anecdotes).
zh: 理解并解释文本中两个或更多人、事件或观点之间的关系和相互作用（如例子和轶事）。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Identify and determine the meaning of grade-appropriate Tier 2 and Tier 3 vocabulary words in informational texts, including connotative, figurative, and technical meanings.
zh: 识别并确定说明性文本中符合年级水平的第二层和第三层词汇的含义，包括引申义、比喻义和专业术语义。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Identify the structure of a text (e.g., sentences, paragraphs, chapters, and text and graphic features) and how the structure helps develop big ideas.
zh: 识别文本的结构（如句子、段落、章节以及文字和图表特征），以及该结构如何帮助展开重要观点。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Identify an author’s point of view and purpose in a text.
zh: 识别作者在文本中的观点和写作目的。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Explain how an author conveys their point of view and purpose in a text.
zh: 解释作者如何在文本中表达自己的观点和目的。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Recognize how visual information (illustrations, photographs, maps, and charts) adds to the text, and integrate this information with the written information to gain a deeper understanding.
zh: 认识到视觉信息（插图、照片、地图和图表）如何为文本增色，并将这些信息与文字信息结合，以获得更深入的理解。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Explain how an author supports arguments or claims in a text by giving reasons (opinions) and evidence, such as facts, examples, and expert opinions from reliable sources.
zh: 解释作者如何通过给出理由（观点）和证据（如事实、例子以及可靠来源的专家意见）来支持文本中的论证或主张。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Distinguish between claims that are supported and those that are not.
zh: 区分有证据支持的主张和没有证据支持的主张。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Compare and contrast different authors’ approaches to the same subject matter (e.g., a memoir versus a biography).
zh: 比较和对比不同作者处理同一题材的方式（如回忆录与传记）。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Students should be given many opportunities for writing, both imaginative and expository, with teacher guidance that strikes a balance between encouraging creativity and requiring correct use of conventions. In sixth grade, it is appropriate to emphasize revision, with the expectation that students will revise and edit to produce (in some cases) a finished product that is thoughtful, well-organized, and reasonably correct in grammar, mechanics, and spelling.
zh: 应为学生提供大量写作机会，包括想象性写作和说明性写作，教师的指导应在鼓励创造力与要求正确使用写作规范之间取得平衡。在六年级，应适当强调修改，期望学生通过修订和编辑，（在某些情况下）完成内容深思熟虑、条理清晰，且语法、写作技巧和拼写基本正确的成品。

subject: English Language Arts
subtopic: Writing to Reflect Audience, Purpose, and Task
en: Write routinely, clearly, and coherently, completing both short-term and long-term assignments focused on a range of different tasks, purposes, and audiences.
zh: 定期、清晰且连贯地写作，完成短期和长期作业，这些作业围绕各种不同的任务、目的和读者对象展开。

subject: English Language Arts
subtopic: Writing to Reflect Audience, Purpose, and Task
en: Strengthen existing writing skills (sentences, paragraphs, transitions, introductions, and conclusions) by applying them to longer and genre-specific writing assignments.
zh: 通过将这些技能应用于更长、更具体裁特点的写作任务，巩固已有的写作技能（句子、段落、过渡、开头和结尾）。

subject: English Language Arts
subtopic: Writing to Reflect Audience, Purpose, and Task
en: Use the steps of the writing process to develop and strengthen writing: plan, draft, share, evaluate, revise, edit, and publish.
zh: 运用写作过程的各个步骤来发展和强化写作能力：计划、起草、分享、评价、修订、编辑和发表。

subject: English Language Arts
subtopic: Writing to Reflect Audience, Purpose, and Task
en: Use conventional language standards when editing.
zh: 编辑时遵循规范的语言标准。

subject: English Language Arts
subtopic: Writing to Reflect Audience, Purpose, and Task
en: Maintain a consistent style and tone appropriate to the genre of writing and audience.
zh: 保持与写作体裁和读者对象相适应的统一风格和语气。

subject: English Language Arts
subtopic: Writing to Reflect Audience, Purpose, and Task
en: Use keyboards, tablets, the Internet, and other technologies to produce and publish writing and collaborate and communicate with others.
zh: 使用键盘、平板电脑、互联网及其他技术来创作和发布作品，并与他人协作和交流。

subject: English Language Arts
subtopic: Writing to Reflect Audience, Purpose, and Task
en: Type a minimum of three pages in a single sitting.
zh: 一次连续打字至少三页。

subject: English Language Arts
subtopic: Writing to Analyze and Understand Text
en: Analyze literature in writing: compare and contrast authors’ approaches in literary works across genres (e.g., stories and poems, historical novels, and fantasies).
zh: 以书面形式分析文学作品：比较和对比不同体裁（如故事与诗歌、历史小说与奇幻作品）中作者的处理方式。

subject: English Language Arts
subtopic: Writing to Analyze and Understand Text
en: Compare and contrast, in writing, themes and topics across genres (e.g., stories and poems, historical novels, and fantasies).
zh: 以书面形式比较和对比不同体裁（如故事与诗歌、历史小说与奇幻作品）的主题和题材。

subject: English Language Arts
subtopic: Writing to Analyze and Understand Text
en: Use literary elements as evidence for analyzing literature to strengthen reflection and analysis skills.
zh: 运用文学要素作为分析文学作品的证据，以增强思考和分析能力。

subject: English Language Arts
subtopic: Writing to Analyze and Understand Text
en: Describe an analysis of informational texts in writing:
zh: 以书面形式描述对说明性文本的分析：

subject: English Language Arts
subtopic: Writing to Analyze and Understand Text
en: Explain how authors make and support their points or claims with reasons and factual evidence.
zh: 解释作者如何提出观点或主张，并用理由和事实证据加以支持。

subject: English Language Arts
subtopic: Writing to Analyze and Understand Text
en: Explain how specific pieces of evidence support specific claims.
zh: 解释具体的证据如何支持具体的主张。

subject: English Language Arts
subtopic: Writing to Analyze and Understand Text
en: Distinguish, in writing, between claims that are supported and those that are not.
zh: 在写作中区分有证据支持的主张和没有证据支持的主张。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Conduct short research projects focused on answering a specific research question.
zh: 开展小型研究项目，专注于回答某个具体的研究问题。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Gather relevant information from several different print and digital sources and use it to support research.
zh: 从多种不同的纸质和数字来源收集相关信息，并用于支持研究。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Adjust the research question as appropriate throughout the information-gathering process.
zh: 在信息收集过程中酌情调整研究问题。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Determine the credibility of information gathered from print and digital sources.
zh: 判断从纸质和数字来源收集的信息的可信度。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Accurately quote or paraphrase from sources without plagiarizing.
zh: 准确地引用或转述来源内容，避免抄袭。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Cite sources and provide a basic bibliography.
zh: 标注引用来源，并提供基本的参考文献书目。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Produce narrative pieces that reflect real-life or imagined experiences.
zh: 创作反映真实生活或想象经历的记叙文。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Introduce a narrator, a situation, and characters, and develop them through dialogue, pacing, and exposition, including actions, thoughts, feelings, and reactions to events in the plot.
zh: 介绍叙述者、情境和人物，并通过对话、节奏和说明加以展开，包括动作、思想、情感以及对情节中事件的反应。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Organize a well-structured logical or natural sequence of plot events following from the situation, using time-order and transitional words, phrases, and clauses to indicate and manage the event order.
zh: 围绕情境组织结构良好、逻辑或自然的情节事件顺序，使用时序词和过渡词、短语及从句来表明和安排事件顺序。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Incorporate shifts in time and multiple settings.
zh: 融入时间转换和多个场景。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Include concrete and sensory details to make writing vivid and precise; convey a sense of experiences and/or the sensations that accompany experiences.
zh: 加入具体和感官细节，使写作生动准确；传达体验感以及/或伴随体验的感受。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Provide a sense of closure that follows logically or artfully from the situation, character responses, and sequence of events.
zh: 提供一个从情境、人物反应和事件顺序中自然或巧妙得出的结局感。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Write reports and other types of informational texts that clearly focus ideas and information.
zh: 撰写报告和其他类型的信息类文本，清晰地突出观点和信息。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Introduce a topic with information organized in related sections or paragraphs and developed with facts, definitions, quotations, examples, and details.
zh: 引入一个主题，将信息按相关部分或段落组织，并用事实、定义、引文、例子和细节加以展开。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Organize ideas, concepts, and information using strategies such as definition, classification, comparison/contrast, and cause/effect.
zh: 运用定义、分类、比较/对比和因果等策略来组织观点、概念和信息。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Group related information logically and incorporate formatting features, such as headings, graphics, charts, and other multimedia.
zh: 按逻辑将相关信息归类，并加入格式元素，如标题、图形、图表和其他多媒体。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Include visual elements such as photos, drawings, or diagrams to help explain or present ideas or information when appropriate.
zh: 在适当的时候加入照片、图画或图表等视觉元素，以帮助解释或呈现观点或信息。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Use transitions to connect ideas and concepts from distinct categories and to clarify relationships.
zh: 使用过渡手段连接不同类别的观点和概念，并澄清它们之间的关系。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Establish and maintain a formal style.
zh: 确立并保持正式的文体风格。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Use Tier 2 and/or Tier 3 domain-specific vocabulary to explain or elaborate topics.
zh: 使用第二层和/或第三层学科专业词汇来解释或展开主题。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Write a conclusion that wraps up ideas in the text.
zh: 写出总结全文观点的结论。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Apply informative/explanatory writing skills to writing standard business communication.
zh: 将说明/解释性写作技能应用于撰写标准的商务文书。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Write persuasive essays with well-defined theses and arguments that use clear reasons, examples, and evidence to support claims.
zh: 撰写说服性文章，提出明确的论点和论证，用清晰的理由、例子和证据支持主张。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Follow through with an organizational structure that supports the purpose of the text, grouping ideas, reasons, and evidence in a logical way.
zh: 采用有助于实现文本目的的组织结构，按逻辑将观点、理由和证据分组。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Distinguish evidence from opinion.
zh: 区分证据与观点。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Demonstrate a clear understanding of the topic and argument.
zh: 展示对话题和论证的清晰理解。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Use linking words, phrases, and clauses to connect opinions with reasons and evidence.
zh: 使用连接词、短语和从句将观点与理由和证据联系起来。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Establish and maintain a formal style and reasonable tone.
zh: 确立并保持正式的文体风格和合理的语气。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Anticipate and answer counterarguments.
zh: 预判并回应反驳论点。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Identify and use credible sources.
zh: 识别并使用可信的来源。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Write a conclusion that effectively and logically wraps up the argument.
zh: 写出能有效且合乎逻辑地总结论证的结论。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Use knowledge of language conventions when reading, writing, speaking, and listening.
zh: 在阅读、写作、口语和听力中运用语言规范知识。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Rework sentences by shortening, combining, and lengthening them to
zh: 通过缩短、合并和扩展句子来改写句子，从而

subject: English Language Arts
en: create meaning and effect for readers or listeners
zh: 为读者或听者创造意义和效果

subject: English Language Arts
en: engage the interest of readers or listeners
zh: 吸引读者或听众的兴趣

subject: English Language Arts
en: create a desired style
zh: 营造所需的风格

subject: English Language Arts
en: maintain consistency in tone and style
zh: 保持语气和风格的一致性

subject: English Language Arts
en: Apply known morphology skills (roots, prefixes, suffixes, and spelling changes) to correctly spell words.
zh: 运用已掌握的构词法知识（词根、前缀、后缀和拼写变化）正确拼写单词。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Continue work with spelling, with special attention to commonly misspelled words.
zh: 继续加强拼写练习，特别关注常见拼写错误的单词。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Understand the basic rules of English grammar and conventions when writing or speaking.
zh: 在写作或口语中理解英语语法和语言规范的基本规则。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Use pronouns correctly, including
zh: 正确使用代词，包括

subject: English Language Arts
en: the proper case (objective, subjective, or possessive)
zh: 正确的格（宾格、主格或所有格）

subject: English Language Arts
en: intensive pronouns (e.g., myself, ourselves)
zh: 强调用法的反身代词（如 myself、ourselves）

subject: English Language Arts
en: Recognize incorrect use of pronouns, including
zh: 识别代词的错误用法，包括

subject: English Language Arts
en: inappropriate shifts (numbers and persons)
zh: 不恰当的切换（数和人称）

subject: English Language Arts
en: unclear pronouns with ambiguous antecedents
zh: 先行词不明确、指代不清的代词

subject: English Language Arts
en: Know how to correct erroneous pronouns.
zh: 知道如何改正错误的代词用法。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Understand what a complete sentence is and
zh: 理解什么是完整的句子，并

subject: English Language Arts
en: identify subject and predicate
zh: 识别主语和谓语

subject: English Language Arts
en: identify independent and dependent clauses
zh: 识别独立分句和从属分句

subject: English Language Arts
en: correct fragments and run-ons
zh: 改正残句和连写句

subject: English Language Arts
en: Identify different sentence types and write for variety by using
zh: 识别不同的句型，并通过使用以下句式使写作富有变化：

subject: English Language Arts
en: simple sentences
zh: 简单句

subject: English Language Arts
en: compound sentences
zh: 并列句

subject: English Language Arts
en: complex sentences
zh: 复合句

subject: English Language Arts
en: compound-complex sentences
zh: 并列复合句

subject: English Language Arts
en: Recognize verbs in active voice and passive voice, and avoid unnecessary use of passive voice.
zh: 识别主动语态和被动语态的动词，避免不必要地使用被动语态。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Recognize troublesome verbs and how to use them correctly (e.g., sit/set; rise/raise).
zh: 识别容易混淆的动词及其正确用法（如 sit/set；rise/raise）。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Correctly use frequently confused words (e.g., good/well; accept/except; principle/ principal; affect/effect; who/whom; their/there/they’re).
zh: 正确使用经常混淆的词（如 good/well；accept/except；principle/principal；affect/effect；who/whom；their/there/they're）。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Recognize incorrect usage of standard English in one’s own writing and speaking.
zh: 识别自己写作和口语中标准英语的错误用法。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Recognize incorrect usage of standard English in others’ writing and speaking.
zh: 识别他人写作和口语中标准英语的错误用法。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Apply various strategies in conventional language usage to improve expression.
zh: 运用各种规范语言运用的策略来改进表达。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Understand the basic rules of capitalization and punctuation when writing or speaking.
zh: 在写作或口语中理解大小写和标点符号的基本规则。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Correctly use punctuation introduced in earlier grades and learn how to use a semicolon or comma with and, but, or or to separate the sentences that form a compound sentence.
zh: 正确使用低年级已学过的标点符号，并学习如何使用分号，或用逗号配合 and、but、or 来分隔构成并列句的分句。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Correctly use commas, parentheses, and dashes to set off nonrestrictive phrases.
zh: 正确使用逗号、括号和破折号来分隔非限定性短语。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Apply a variety of strategies to figure out the meaning of Grade 6 words and phrases, such as the following:
zh: 运用多种策略来理解六年级词汇和短语的含义，例如以下几种：

subject: English Language Arts
en: context clues
zh: 上下文线索

subject: English Language Arts
en: examples
zh: 例子

subject: English Language Arts
en: definitions
zh: 定义

subject: English Language Arts
en: cause-and-effect relationships
zh: 因果关系

subject: English Language Arts
en: comparisons
zh: 比较

subject: English Language Arts
en: synonyms and antonyms
zh: 同义词和反义词

subject: English Language Arts
en: Use the overall meaning of a sentence as a clue to the meaning of words within a sentence.
zh: 利用句子的整体意思作为理解句中单词含义的线索。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Figure out the meaning of words based on the word’s position and function within a sentence, such as part of speech, subject, predicate, object, etc.
zh: 根据单词在句子中的位置和作用来判断其含义，如词性、主语、谓语、宾语等。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Use a dictionary, thesaurus, or glossary—print or digital—to answer questions about the meanings and usage of unfamiliar words.
zh: 使用词典、同义词词典或词汇表（纸质或数字版）来回答有关生词含义和用法的问题。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Know how to use a dictionary—print or digital—to pronounce words correctly and determine a word’s part of speech.
zh: 知道如何使用词典（纸质或数字版）正确发音并确定单词的词性。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Use a dictionary to find the precise meaning of words and phrases.
zh: 使用词典查找单词和短语的确切含义。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Check hunches about the meaning of words by using inferences based on context or a dictionary.
zh: 通过基于上下文或词典的推断来检验对词义的猜测。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Make accurate interpretations of similes and metaphors and other types of figurative language, such as personification, based on context.
zh: 根据上下文准确理解明喻、暗喻以及其他修辞手法（如拟人）的含义。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Interpret figures of speech based on context.
zh: 根据上下文理解修辞格。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Discern nuances in word meanings.
zh: 辨别词义的细微差别。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Use word relationships such as cause/effect, part/whole, and item/category to better understand the meaning of known and unknown words.
zh: 利用因果、部分/整体、个体/类别等词与词之间的关系，更好地理解已知和未知单词的含义。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Distinguish connotations, or shades of meaning, among words with similar denotations (e.g., cranky, grumpy, grouchy, and mean).
zh: 区分外延意义相近的词语之间的内涵或语义细微差别（如 cranky、grumpy、grouchy 和 mean）。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Acquire grade-level Tier 2 general academic and Tier 3 domain-specific words and phrases and use them with accuracy.
zh: 掌握符合年级水平的第二层通用学术词汇和第三层学科专业词汇及短语，并准确使用。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Use knowledge of Greek and Latin roots and affixes to figure out the meaning of a new word, such as Latin/Greek Word Meaning Examples annus \[L\] year annual, anniversary ante \[L\] before antebellum, antecedent aqua \[L\] water aquarium astron \[G\] star astronaut, astronomy bi \[L \] two bisect, bipartisan bios \[G\] life biology, biography centum \[L\] hundred cent, percent decem \[L\] ten decade, decimal dico, dictum \[L\] say, thing said dictation, dictionary duo \[G, L\] two duplicate ge \[G\] earth geology, geography hydor \[G\] water hydrant, hydroelecrtric magnus \[L\] large, great magnificent, magnify mega \[G\] large, great megaphone, megalomania mikros \[G\] small microscope, microfilm minus \[L\] smaller diminish, minor monos \[G\] single monologue, monarch, monopoly omnis \[L\] all omnipotent, omniscient phileo \[G\] to love philosophy, philanthropist phone \[G\] sound, voice phonograph, telephone photo \[from G phos\] light photograph, photocopy poly \[G\] many polygon Note: More Latin and Greek words and roots are listed in Grades 7 and 8. en: Every culture has phrases and proverbs that make no sense when carried over literally into another culture. For many students, this section may not be needed; they will have picked up these sayings by hearing them at home and among friends. But the sayings have been one of the categories most appreciated by teachers who work with children from home cultures that differ from the standard culture of literate American English.

subject: History and Geography
en: Teachers: The World History guidelines for sixth grade begin with a study of ancient civilizations introduced in earlier grades in the Core Knowledge Sequence. Topics include Judaism, Christianity, and the civilizations of ancient Greece and Rome. The focus in sixth grade should be on the legacy of enduring ideas from these civilizations—ideas about democracy and government, for example, or about right and wrong. After this study of lasting ideas from ancient civilizations, the World History guidelines pick up the chronological thread from earlier grades with a study of the Enlightenment. You are encouraged to use timelines and engage students in a brief review of some major intervening events in order to help students make a smooth transition across the gap in centuries between the ancient civilizations and the Enlightenment. In sixth grade, the World History guidelines catch up chronologically with the American History guidelines. The World History guidelines take students up to the consequences of industrialization in the mid nineteenth century, and this is where the American History guidelines begin.
zh: 教师：六年级世界史指南从学习核心知识序列中更早年级已介绍过的古代文明开始。主题包括犹太教、基督教以及古希腊和古罗马文明。六年级的重点应放在这些文明持久思想的遗产上——例如关于民主与政府的思想，或关于对错的观念。在学习了古代文明的持久思想之后，世界史指南承接更早年级的时间线索，转向启蒙运动。鼓励使用时间线，并让学生简要回顾其间的重要事件，以帮助他们顺利跨越古代文明与启蒙运动之间的数百年间隔。在六年级，世界史指南在时间顺序上与美国史指南接轨。世界史指南把学生带到十九世纪中叶工业化的后果，而这正是美国史指南的起点。

subject: History and Geography
en: By sixth grade, students should have a good working knowledge of map-reading skills, as well as geographic terms and features introduced in earlier grades. The study of geography embraces many topics throughout the Core Knowledge Sequence, including topics in history and science. Geographic knowledge includes a spatial sense of the world, an awareness of the physical processes that shape life, a sense of the interactions between humans and their environment, an understanding of the relations between place and culture, and an awareness of the characteristics of specific regions and cultures. Many geographic topics are listed below in connection with historical topics.
zh: 到六年级时，学生应已具备良好的地图阅读技能知识，并熟悉更早年级引入的地理术语和地貌。地理学贯穿核心知识序列中的许多主题，包括历史和科学主题。地理知识包括对世界的空间感、对塑造生活的自然过程的认识、对人类与环境相互作用的理解、对地方与文化关系的理解，以及对特定地区和文化特征的认识。下面列出许多与历史主题相关的地理主题。

subject: Visual Arts
en: Teachers: In schools, lessons on the visual arts should illustrate important elements of making and appreciating art, and emphasize important artists, works of art, and artistic concepts. When appropriate, topics in the visual arts may be linked to topics in other disciplines. The following guidelines specify a variety of artwork in different media and from various cultures in order to expose students to a wide range of art and artists. While the list is robust, it may require teachers to narrow the selection in order to adequately address the works and related skills within an academic year. In studying the works of art specified below, and in creating their own art, students should review, develop, and apply concepts introduced in previous grades, such as line, shape, form, space, texture, color, light, design, and symmetry.
zh: 教师提示：在学校里，视觉艺术课程应阐明创作与欣赏艺术的重要元素，并强调重要艺术家、艺术作品和艺术概念。在适当的时候，视觉艺术的主题可与其他学科的主题相联系。以下指南指定了不同媒介、不同文化的多种艺术作品，以使学生接触广泛的艺术与艺术家。虽然这份清单内容充实，但教师可能需要缩小选择范围，以便在一个学年内充分讲授这些作品及相关技能。在学习下列艺术作品以及创作自己的作品时，学生应复习、发展并运用之前各年级引入的概念，如线条、形状、形体、空间、质感、色彩、光线、设计和对称。

subject: Visual Arts
en: The focus here is intended to combine art history with analysis of specific illustrative works. Introduce the idea of classifying Western art by periods and schools, with major characteristics of each period and school. Timelines may help students situate the periods and schools. Note that the periods and characteristics are not absolute distinctions but generally helpful categories (to which there are always exceptions) often used in discussions of art. The following topics extend to the mid-nineteenth century. In later grades, students will examine late-nineteenth and twentieth-century art movements.
zh: 这里的重点旨在把艺术史与对具体范画的分析结合起来。引入按时期和流派划分西方艺术的概念，以及每个时期和流派的主要特征。时间线可帮助学生定位各时期和流派。请注意，这些时期和特征并非绝对区分，而是讨论艺术时常用的、大体有用的分类（总有例外）。以下主题延伸至十九世纪中叶。在更高年级，学生将学习十九世纪末和二十世纪的艺术运动。

subject: Mathematics
en: Teachers: Mathematics has its own vocabulary and patterns of thinking. It is a discipline with its own language and conventions. Thus, while some lessons may offer occasional opportunities for linking mathematics to other disciplines, it is critically important to attend to math as math. From the earliest years, mathematics requires incremental review and steady practice: not only the diligent effort required to master basic facts and operations, but also thoughtful and varied practice that approaches problems from a variety of angles, and gives students a variety of opportunities to apply the same concept or operation in different types of situations. While it is important to work toward the development of “higher-order problem-solving skills,” it is equally important—indeed, it is prerequisite to achieving “higher order” skills—to have a sound grasp of basic facts, and an automatic fluency with fundamental operations.
zh: 教师须知：数学有其自身的词汇和思维方式，是一门有自己语言和规范的学科。因此，虽然有些课程偶尔可以把数学与其他学科联系起来，但把数学当作数学来讲至关重要。从最初几年起，数学就需要循序渐进的复习和持续练习：既要努力掌握基本事实和运算，也要进行深思熟虑、形式多样的练习，从多种角度处理问题，让学生在不同类型的情境中多次运用同一概念或运算。虽然培养“高阶解题技能”很重要，但牢固掌握基本事实、对基本运算达到自动化熟练程度同样重要——事实上，这是达到“高阶”技能的前提。

subject: Mathematics
en: Understand ratio concepts and use ratio reasoning to solve problems.
zh: 理解比的概念，并运用比推理解决问题。

subject: Mathematics
en: Understand the concept of a ratio and use ratio language to describe a ratio relationship between two quantities.
zh: 理解比的概念，并能用比的语言描述两个数量之间的比关系。

subject: Mathematics

zh: 理解与比 a:b（b ≠ 0）相关联的单位率 a/b 的概念，并在比关系的情境中使用率的语言。

subject: Mathematics
en: Use ratio and rate reasoning to solve real-world and mathematical problems.
zh: 运用比和比率推理解决实际问题与数学问题。
details: Use equivalent ratios, tape diagrams, double number line diagrams or equations. | Make tables of equivalent ratios relating quantities with whole-number measurements. | Solve unit rate problems including those involving unit pricing and constant speed. | Find a percent of a quantity as a rate per 100. | Solve problems involving finding the whole, given a part and the percent. | Use ratio reasoning to convert measurement units; manipulate and transform units appropriately when multiplying or dividing quantities.

subject: Mathematics
en: Apply and extend previous understandings of multiplication and division to divide fractions by fractions.
zh: 运用并拓展之前对乘法和除法的理解，用分数除以分数。

subject: Mathematics
en: Interpret and compute quotients of fractions, and solve word problems involving division of fractions by fractions.
zh: 解释并计算分数的商，解决涉及分数除以分数的应用题。

subject: Mathematics
en: Compute fluently with multi-digit numbers and find common factors and multiples.
zh: 熟练进行多位数运算，并求公因数与公倍数。

subject: Mathematics
en: Fluently divide multi-digit numbers using the standard algorithm.
zh: 运用标准算法熟练进行多位数除法。

subject: Mathematics
en: Fluently add subtract, multiply, and divide multi-digit decimals using the standard algorithm for each operation.
zh: 运用每种运算的标准算法，熟练进行多位小数的加、减、乘、除运算。

subject: Mathematics
en: Find the greatest common factor of two whole numbers less than or equal to 100.
zh: 求两个不超过100的整数的最大公因数。

subject: Mathematics
en: Find the least common multiple of two whole numbers less than or equal to 12.
zh: 求两个不超过12的整数的最小公倍数。

subject: Mathematics
en: Use the distributive property to express a sum of two whole numbers 1–100 with a common factor as a multiple of a sum of two whole numbers with no common factor.
zh: 运用分配律，把一个有公因数的1–100整数之和表示为两个互质整数之和的倍数。

subject: Mathematics
en: Apply and extend previous understandings of numbers to the system of rational numbers.
zh: 把之前对数的理解运用并拓展到有理数系统。

subject: Mathematics
en: Understand that positive and negative numbers are used together to describe quantities having opposite directions or values.
zh: 理解正数和负数可一起用来描述具有相反方向或相反值的量。

subject: Mathematics
en: Use positive and negative numbers to represent quantities in real-world contexts, explaining the meaning of 0 in each situation.
zh: 在实际情境中用正数和负数表示量，并解释每种情境中0的含义。

subject: Mathematics
en: Understand a rational number as a point on the number line.
zh: 把有理数理解为数轴上的一个点。

subject: Mathematics
en: Extend number line diagrams and coordinate axes familiar from previous grades to represent points on the line and in the plane with negative number coordinates. • Recognize opposite signs of numbers as indicating locations on opposite sides of 0 on the number line. • Recognize that the opposite of the opposite of a number is the number itself. • Recognize that 0 is its own opposite. • Understand signs of numbers in ordered pairs as indicating locations in quadrants of the coordinate plane. • Recognize that when two ordered pairs differ only by signs, the locations of the points are related by reflections across one or both axes. • Find and position integers and other rational numbers on a horizontal or vertical number line diagram. • Find and position pairs of integers and other rational numbers on a coordinate plane.
zh: 把之前各年级熟悉的数轴图和坐标轴加以扩展，用负数坐标表示数轴上和平面中的点。• 认识到数的符号相反表示它们在数轴上位于0的两侧。• 认识到一个数的相反数的相反数就是它本身。• 认识到0的相反数是它自己。• 理解有序数对中数的符号表示点在坐标平面象限中的位置。• 认识到当两个有序数对仅符号不同时，两点的位置关于一条或两条轴对称。• 在水平或垂直数轴图上找出并标出整数及其他有理数。• 在坐标平面上找出并标出整数及其他有理数组成的数对。

subject: Mathematics
en: Understand ordering and absolute value of rational numbers.
zh: 理解有理数的大小比较与绝对值。
details: Interpret statements of inequality as statements about the relative position of two numbers on a number line diagram. | Write, interpret, and explain statements of order for rational numbers in real-world contexts. | Understand the absolute value of a rational number as its distance from 0 on the number line. | Interpret absolute value as magnitude for a positive or negative quantity in a real world situation. | Distinguish comparisons of absolute value from statements about order.

subject: Mathematics
en: Solve real-world and mathematical problems by graphing points in all four quadrants of the coordinate plane. • Include use of coordinates and absolute value to find distances between points with the same first coordinate or the same second coordinate.
zh: 通过在坐标平面全部四个象限中描点，解决实际问题和数学问题。• 包括利用坐标和绝对值求第一坐标相同或第二坐标相同的两点之间的距离。

subject: Mathematics
en: Apply and extend previous understandings of arithmetic to algebraic expressions.
zh: 把之前对算术的理解运用并拓展到代数表达式。

subject: Mathematics
en: Write and evaluate numerical expressions involving whole-number exponents.
zh: 写出并求含整数指数的数值表达式的值。

subject: Mathematics

zh: 写出、读出并求含有字母代表数的表达式的值。
details: Write expressions that record operations with numbers and with letters standing for numbers. | Identify parts of an expression using mathematical terms (sum, term, product, factor, quotient, coefficient). | View one or more parts of an expression as a single entity. | Evaluate expressions at specific values of their variables. Include expressions that arise from real world problems and use order of operations when no parentheses are present.

subject: Mathematics

zh: 运用运算性质生成等价表达式。

subject: Mathematics
en: Identify when two expressions are equivalent.
zh: 判断两个表达式何时等价。

subject: Mathematics

subject: Mathematics

zh: 把解方程或不等式理解为回答一个问题的过程：在指定的集合中，哪些值（如果有）能使方程或不等式成立？

subject: Mathematics
en: Use substitution to determine whether a given number in a specified set makes an equation or inequality true.
zh: 用代入法判断指定集合中的某个数是否能使方程或不等式成立。

subject: Mathematics

zh: 在解决实际或数学问题时，用变量表示数并写出表达式。

subject: Mathematics
en: Understand that a variable can represent an unknown number, or, depending on the purpose at hand, any number in a specified set.
zh: 理解变量可以代表一个未知数，或者根据当前目的，代表指定集合中的任意一个数。

subject: Mathematics
en: Solve real-world and mathematical problems by writing and solving equations of them form x + p = q and px = q for cases in which p, q and x are all nonnegative rational numbers. Equivalent expressions = when the two expressions name the same number regardless of which value is substituted into them.
zh: 通过写出并求解 x + p = q 和 px = q 形式的方程来解决实际与数学问题（其中 p、q、x 均为非负有理数）。等价表达式＝无论代入什么值，两个表达式表示的都是同一个数。

subject: Mathematics
en: Write an inequality of the form x > c or x < c to represent a constraint or condition in a real-world or mathematical problem.
zh: 写出 x > c 或 x < c 形式的不等式，表示实际或数学问题中的约束或条件。

subject: Mathematics
en: Recognize that inequalities of the form x > c or x < c have infinitely many solutions; represent solutions of such inequalities on number line diagrams.
zh: 认识到 x > c 或 x < c 形式的不等式有无穷多个解；在数轴图上表示这类不等式的解。

subject: Mathematics
en: Represent and analyze quantitative relationships between dependent and independent variables.
zh: 表示并分析因变量与自变量之间的数量关系。

subject: Mathematics
en: Use variables to represent two quantities in a real-world problem that change in relationship to one another write an equation to express one quantity.
zh: 用变量表示实际问题中相互关联的两个量，写出一个表达式表示其中一个量。

subject: Mathematics
en: Thought of as the dependent variable, in terms of the other quantity, thought of as the independent variable.
zh: 把它看作因变量，用另一个量（看作自变量）来表示。

subject: Mathematics
en: Analyze the relationship between the dependent and independent variables using graphs and tables, and relate these to the equation.
zh: 用图表和表格分析因变量与自变量之间的关系，并把它们与方程联系起来。

subject: Mathematics
en: Solve real-world and mathematical problems involving area, surface area, and volume.
zh: 解决涉及面积、表面积和体积的实际问题与数学问题。

subject: Mathematics
en: Find the area of right triangles, other triangles, special quadrilaterals, and polygons by decomposing into triangles or other shapes.

subject: Mathematics

zh: 求棱长为分数的直长方体的体积。
details: Show that the volume is the same as would be found by multiplying the edge lengths of the prism. | Apply the formulas Volume = length x width x height (V=l x w x h) and Volume = base x height (V=b x h) to find volumes of right rectangular prisms with fractional edge lengths.

subject: Mathematics

details: Use coordinates to find the length of a side joining points with the same first coordinate or the same second coordinate.

subject: Mathematics
en: Represent three-dimensional figures using nets made up of rectangles and triangles, and use the nets to find the surface area of these figures.
zh: 用由长方形和三角形组成的展开图表示三维图形，并利用展开图求这些图形的表面积。

subject: Mathematics
en: Develop understanding of statistical variability.
zh: 发展对统计变异性的理解。

subject: Mathematics

zh: 认识到统计问题是指能预判与该问题相关的数据存在变异性，并在答案中体现这种变异性的问题。

subject: Mathematics
en: Understand that a set of data collected to answer a statistical question has a distribution which can be described by its center, spread, and overall shape.
zh: 理解为回答统计问题而收集的一组数据具有一个分布，可以用其中心、离散程度和整体形状来描述。

subject: Mathematics
en: Recognize that a measure of center for a numerical data set summarizes all of its values with a single number, while a measure of variation describes how its values vary with a single number.
zh: 认识到数值数据集的集中趋势度量用一个数概括其所有取值，而变异程度度量用一个数描述其取值的差异情况。

subject: Mathematics
en: Summarize and describe distributions.

subject: Mathematics

subject: Mathematics

details: Reporting the number of observations. | Describing the nature of the attribute under investigation, including how it was measured and its units of measurement. | Giving quantitative measures of center (median and/or mean) and variability (interquartile range and/or mean absolute deviation), as well as describing any overall pattern and any striking deviations from the overall pattern with reference to the context in which the data were gathered. | Relating the choice of measures of center and variability to the shape of the data distribution and the context in which the data were gathered. Apply these techniques in the context of solving real-world and mathematical problems.

details: Reporting the number of observations. | Describing the nature of the attribute under investigation, including how it was measured and its units of measurement. | Giving quantitative measures of center (median and/or mean) and variability (interquartile range and/or mean absolute deviation), as well as describing any overall pattern and any striking deviations from the overall pattern with reference to the context in which the data were gathered. | Relating the choice of measures of center and variability to the shape of the data distribution and the context in which the data were gathered. subject: Science
en: Teachers: Effective instruction in science requires not only hands-on experience and observation but also book learning, which helps bring coherence and order to a student’s scientific knowledge. only when topics are presented systematically and clearly can students make steady and secure progress in their scientific learning. The Science sequence for the middle school grades aims for more intensive and selective study of topics, a number of which were introduced in earlier grades. It also continues the practice of studying topics from each of the major realms of science (physical, life, and earth science). Students are expected to do experiments and write reports on their findings.
zh: 教师提示：有效的科学教学不仅需要有动手体验和观察，还需要书本学习，后者有助于使学生的科学知识连贯有序。只有系统而清晰地呈现主题，学生才能在科学学习上稳步而扎实地进步。中学各年级的科学序列旨在对若干主题进行更深入、更有选择性的学习，其中一些主题在更早的年级已经引入。它还延续了从科学的各大领域（物理科学、生命科学和地球科学）分别学习主题的做法。学生应做实验并撰写实验报告，汇报发现。
