zh: 反射：
details: Light from a flashlight reflects off a mirror at the exact angle the light hits the mirror. | Lenses can be concave or convex, changing the angle of reflection, used in many practical devices. | Sometimes we can see both through a window and see a reflection at the same time.

subject: Science
en: Any movement of an electrically charged particle produces an electromagnetic wave.
zh: 带电粒子的任何运动都会产生电磁波。

subject: Science
en: This wave alternates between the establishment of an electrical field and a magnetic field.
zh: 这种波在电场与磁场的建立之间交替变化。

subject: Science
en: Some waves, such as sound and water, transfer energy through matter, but electromagnetic radiation travels through empty space as well as through some kinds of matter.
zh: 有些波，如声波和水波，通过物质传递能量，而电磁辐射既能在真空中传播，也能在某些物质中传播。

subject: Science
en: All electromagnetic waves have the same speed in a vacuum, about 300,000 kilometers per second or 186,000 miles per second; labeled c.
zh: 所有电磁波在真空中的速度相同，约为每秒300,000公里或每秒186,000英里；记作 c。

subject: Science
en: Electromagnetic waves carry energy through space and are used to transmit information, e.g., through devices such as radio, television, cellular phones, and Bluetooth technology.
zh: 电磁波携带能量穿过太空，用于传递信息，例如通过收音机、电视、手机和蓝牙技术等设备。

subject: Science
en: Electromagnetic waves vary in their frequency, resulting in a continuous spectrum of waves, called the electromagnetic spectrum.
zh: 电磁波的频率各不相同，形成连续的波谱，称为电磁波谱。

subject: Science
en: The longest wavelengths on the spectrum: radio waves
zh: 波谱中波长最长的波：无线电波

subject: Science
en: Shorter wavelengths: microwaves, infrared waves, visible light, ultraviolet light, X rays, and gamma rays
zh: 较短的波长：微波、红外线、可见光、紫外线、X射线和伽马射线

subject: Science
en: Visible light is the small portion of the electromagnetic spectrum that we see.
zh: 可见光是电磁波谱中我们能看见的一小部分。

subject: Science
en: Visible light ranges along the spectrum: red, orange, yellow, green, blue, to violet.
zh: 可见光在波谱中的范围：红、橙、黄、绿、蓝，直到紫。

subject: Science
en: Definition of energy
zh: 能量的定义

subject: Science
en: Forms of energy
zh: 能量的形式

subject: Science
en: Kinetic and potential energy
zh: 动能与势能

subject: Science
en: Forms of energy can be transformed into one another:
zh: 各种形式的能量可以相互转化：

subject: Science
en: The energy of sound waves → mechanical energy of breaking glass
zh: 声波的能量 → 击碎玻璃的机械能

subject: Science
en: The energy of light waves hitting a solar panel → into electrical energy
zh: 照射到太阳能板上的光波能量 → 转化为电能

subject: Science
en: The chemical energy → into fireworks
zh: 化学能 → 转化为烟花的能量

subject: Science
en: Joules: metric unit measure
zh: 焦耳：公制计量单位

subject: Science
en: Thermal energy
zh: 热能

subject: Science
en: Understanding how heat passes through, or is kept from passing though, the walls of a container can give us evidence of the movement of thermal energy.
zh: 了解热量如何穿过容器壁或被容器壁阻隔，能为我们提供热能运动的证据。

subject: Science
en: Scientific meaning of heat is the movement of thermal energy from one place to another.
zh: 热在科学上的含义是热能从一地转移到另一地。

subject: Science
en: Temperature: related to how rapidly particles are moving
zh: 温度：与粒子运动的快慢有关

subject: Science
en: Conduction, convection, and radiation: ways thermal energy is transferred
zh: 传导、对流和辐射：热能传递的方式

subject: Science
en: The passive direction of heat transfer is hotter to colder.
zh: 热量传递的自发方向是从热到冷。

subject: Science
en: Role of heating of the earth in establishing air and ocean currents
zh: 地球受热在形成气流和洋流中的作用

subject: Science
en: How ocean currents such as the Gulf Stream and Kuroshio are kept in motion
zh: 像墨西哥湾流和黑潮这样的洋流是如何保持运动的

subject: Science
en: Variations of ocean temperatures and salinity help drive ocean currents.
zh: 海洋温度和盐度的变化有助于驱动洋流。

subject: Science
en: Definition and causes of weather
zh: 天气的定义及成因

subject: Science
en: Definition and cause of air masses
zh: 气团的定义及成因

subject: Science
en: Role of air masses in changing weather conditions
zh: 气团在天气变化中的作用

subject: Science
en: Colliding air masses can cause sudden changes in the weather.
zh: 气团相撞会导致天气突变。

subject: Science
en: Weather conditions: air temperature, air pressure, humidity, precipitation, warm and cold weather fronts, wind speed and direction
zh: 天气状况：气温、气压、湿度、降水、暖锋与冷锋、风速与风向

subject: Science
en: Weather data can be obtained by visual observation, instruments on the earth, radar, weather balloons, and satellites.
zh: 天气数据可通过目测观察、地面仪器、雷达、气象气球和卫星获得。

subject: Science
en: Examination of weather patterns can lead to weather prediction.
zh: 对天气模式的研究可以带来天气预报。

subject: Science
en: Definition of climate
zh: 气候的定义

subject: Science
en: Climate conditions—how long they last and how they change over time
zh: 气候状况——它们持续多久以及如何随时间变化

subject: Science
en: The Koppen system
zh: 柯本气候分类法

subject: Science
en: Familiar climates: tundra, rainforest, temperate, desert, and humid continental
zh: 熟悉的气候类型：苔原、雨林、温带、沙漠和湿润大陆性气候

subject: Science
en: Climate from millions of years ago can be determined by various scientific methods.
zh: 数百万年前的气候可以通过多种科学方法确定。

subject: Science
en: Definition and causes of the water (hydrologic) cycle
zh: 水（水文）循环的定义及成因

subject: Science
en: Diagram all parts of the water cycle
zh: 画出水循环所有组成部分的示意图

subject: Science
en: Relationship to weather
zh: 与天气的关系

subject: Science
en: Formation of the sun, Earth, and other planets
zh: 太阳、地球及其他行星的形成

subject: Science
en: Makeup and thickness of Earth’s crust and mantle
zh: 地壳与地幔的组成及厚度

subject: Science
en: Earth’s outer and inner cores
zh: 地球的外核与内核

subject: Science
en: The cycling of Earth’s materials as exemplified by the rock cycle
zh: 以岩石循环为例说明地球物质的循环

subject: Science
en: Mountains rise and fall.
zh: 山脉有升有降。

subject: Science
en: Volcanoes
zh: 火山

subject: Science
en: Earthquakes
zh: 地震

subject: Science
en: Large areas of Earth move over time.
zh: 地球的广大区域随时间推移而移动。

subject: Science
en: Effect of plate tectonics on the surface of Earth
zh: 板块构造对地球表面的影响

subject: Science
en: Causes and speed of the movement of the plates
zh: 板块运动的原因和速度

subject: Science
en: Evidence for long-term movement of plates: fit of continents and matches of rock types, fossils, ocean floor age, topography, ancient climate zones, locations of earthquakes, volcanoes, mountain ranges, and magnetic directions in ancient rocks
zh: 板块长期运动的证据：大陆的吻合、岩性的匹配、化石、海底年龄、地形、古气候带、地震、火山、山脉的位置，以及古代岩石中的磁极方向

subject: Science
en: The continents were once joined into a continent called Pangaea.
zh: 各大洲曾经连在一起，形成一个名为盘古大陆（Pangaea）的大陆。

subject: Science
en: Tsunamis are caused most often by earthquakes.
zh: 海啸最常由地震引发。

subject: Science
en: People can predict the movement of tsunamis and thereby prepare for their arrivals and reduce damage to people and property.
zh: 人们可以预测海啸的移动，从而为其到来做好准备，减少人员和财产损失。

subject: Science
en: Landslides often happen quickly and can be massive movements of soil and rocks that can inflict major damage to roads and homes.
zh: 山体滑坡往往发生迅速，可能是土壤和岩石的大规模运动，会对道路和房屋造成重大破坏。

subject: Science
en: Floods, including flash floods, are a major hazard in many parts of the world.
zh: 洪水，包括山洪暴发，是世界上许多地区的主要灾害。

subject: Science
en: Definition of fronts, and their role in creation of hazardous weather
zh: 锋面的定义及其在危险天气形成中的作用

subject: Science
en: Atmospheric conditions that lead to hurricanes (cyclones)
zh: 导致飓风（气旋）的大气条件

subject: Science
en: Importance of accurate weather predictions in planning for severe weather conditions
zh: 准确天气预报在应对恶劣天气的规划中的重要性

subject: Science
en: Earthquakes caused by stress of plate boundaries moving against each other.
zh: 板块边界相互挤压产生的应力引发地震。

subject: Science
en: Earthquake vibrations cause waves.
zh: 地震的振动产生波。

subject: Science
en: Focus: the point below the surface where the quake begins
zh: 震源：地表以下地震开始的位置

subject: Science
en: Epicenter: the point on the surface above the focus
zh: 震中：地表上位于震源正上方的点

subject: Science
en: Richter scale
zh: 里氏震级

subject: Science
en: Most volcanoes are caused by plate boundaries pulling apart or coming together.
zh: 大多数火山是由板块边界张裂或碰撞造成的。

subject: Science
en: Some caused by plates moving over hot spots (e.g., the Hawaiian Islands)
zh: 有些是由板块在热点上方移动形成（如夏威夷群岛）

subject: Science
en: Cells are the basis of all living things.
zh: 细胞是一切生物的基础。

subject: Science
en: Differences between unicellular and multicellular organisms
zh: 单细胞生物与多细胞生物的区别

subject: Science
en: Types and function of cellular membranes
zh: 细胞膜的类型与功能

subject: Science
en: Membranes, cytoplasm, and organelle are cell components.
zh: 膜、细胞质和细胞器都是细胞的组成部分。

subject: Science
en: Cell organelles include the nucleus, mitochondria, and chloroplasts.
zh: 细胞器包括细胞核、线粒体和叶绿体。

subject: Science
en: Chromosomes and their role in cell function and reproduction
zh: 染色体及其在细胞功能与繁殖中的作用

subject: Science
en: DNA,
zh: DNA（脱氧核糖核酸）

subject: Science
en: Mutations
zh: 突变

subject: Science
en: Role of cell division in growth and reproduction
zh: 细胞分裂在生长与繁殖中的作用

subject: Science
en: Types of cell division
zh: 细胞分裂的类型

subject: Science
en: Mitosis
zh: 有丝分裂

subject: Science
en: Meiosis and its association with sexual reproduction.
zh: 减数分裂及其与有性繁殖的关联。

subject: Science
en: Sexual reproduction involves meiosis and the fusion of gametes (egg and sperm).
zh: 有性繁殖涉及减数分裂和配子（卵子与精子）的融合。

subject: Science
en: Sexual reproduction allows for variation between parent and offspring due to crossing over, mutations, and other factors.
zh: 由于染色体交叉互换、突变及其他因素，有性繁殖使亲代与子代之间产生差异。

subject: Science
en: A group of similar cells usually performing one function is called a tissue.
zh: 一群相似、通常执行某一功能的细胞称为组织。

subject: Science
en: Tissues work together to form organs in both plants and animals.
zh: 在植物和动物体内，组织共同协作形成器官。

subject: Science
en: Organs work together to form organ systems, such as the muscular and skeletal system of humans.
zh: 器官共同协作形成器官系统，如人类的肌肉系统和骨骼系统。

subject: Science
en: Marie Curie — discoveries in radioactivity, and the elements polonium and radium
zh: 玛丽·居里——放射性方面的发现，以及钋和镭元素

subject: Science
en: Lewis Howard Latimer — aided in inventions of telephone and light bulb
zh: 刘易斯·霍华德·拉蒂默——协助发明了电话和白炽灯

subject: Science
en: Isaac Newton — nature of motion and laws of gravity
zh: 艾萨克·牛顿——运动的本质与万有引力定律

subject: Science
en: Alfred Wegener — Pangaea and the science of continental drift
zh: 阿尔弗雷德·魏格纳——泛大陆与大陆漂移学说

subject: English Language Arts
en: Actively participate in discussions about a variety of Grade 7 topics, ideas, and texts in a variety of settings, including partners, small and large groups, and teacher-led groups.
zh: 在多种场合（包括两人结对、小组、大组和教师主导的小组）积极参与关于七年级各种主题、观点和文本的讨论。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Prepare for discussions in advance, including researching the topic and organizing information for the discussion. Draw on preparations during the discussion to analyze ideas and explore the topic further.
zh: 提前为讨论做准备，包括研究主题和整理讨论所需信息；在讨论中运用这些准备来分析观点并进一步探讨主题。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Manage goals and deadlines, and define specific roles appropriate to a discussion; follow rules for productive social engagement among peers.
zh: 管理目标和时限，明确适合讨论的具体角色；遵守同伴之间富有成效的互动规则。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Ask relevant questions to clarify conversations and ideas and to build upon remarks made by others.
zh: 提出相关问题，以澄清谈话和想法，并在他人发言的基础上进一步展开。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Use details to elaborate and comment on a topic, text, or issue being discussed; add insight to discussions or move discussions forward.
zh: 运用细节对所讨论的主题、文本或问题进行阐述和评论；为讨论增添见解或推动讨论深入。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Demonstrate a willingness to change one’s own point of view when presented with new information during a discussion.
zh: 在讨论中接触到新信息时，表现出愿意改变自己观点的态度。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Interpret information from an array of media formats, such as visual (paintings, pictures, and animations), quantitative (graphs, charts, and diagrams), videos, and recordings.
zh: 解读多种媒体形式呈现的信息，如视觉类（绘画、图片和动画）、数据类（曲线图、图表和示意图）、视频以及录音。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Explain how information from media formats reflects, enhances, or is otherwise suitable to the discussion, issue, or topic at hand.
zh: 说明媒体形式的信息如何反映、增强或以其他方式契合当前的讨论、问题或主题。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Find and analyze the main ideas and details in information from multimedia formats.
zh: 找出并分析多媒体信息中的主旨和细节。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Explain a speaker’s argument, distinguishing the claims, evidence, and reasons speakers give and whether the claims are adequately supported.
zh: 解释说话者的论点，区分其提出的主张、证据和理由，并判断这些主张是否得到充分支持。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Evaluate the overall quality of the reasoning used in an argument and the relevancy of the evidence provided.
zh: 评估论证中推理的整体质量以及所提供证据的相关性。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Give a presentation about a topic or text, tell a story, or orally relate a personal experience in a logical and organized manner, including relevant descriptions, details, and facts that support main ideas or themes.
zh: 以条理清晰、逻辑严密的方式就某一主题或文本作报告、讲故事或口头讲述个人经历，包括支持主要观点或主题的相关描述、细节和事实。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Orally present a claim-based argument that is supported by research and demonstrates a focused emphasis on the essential points.
zh: 口头陈述以主张为核心、有研究支撑的论证，并突出强调要点。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Speak clearly at an understandable volume and pace; maintain eye contact.
zh: 以清晰、易于理解的音量和语速讲话；保持眼神交流。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Enhance presentations by adding relevant multimedia such as displays, images, videos, graphics, music, and recordings.
zh: 通过添加相关的多媒体（如演示文稿、图片、视频、图形、音乐和录音）来增强展示效果。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Switch between formal and informal English as appropriate to the situation or task; adapt speech to a variety of contexts.
zh: 根据情境或任务在正式与非正式英语之间恰当切换；使言语适应各种语境。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Show proficiency when using formal English, such as standard pronunciation when giving speeches or speaking to large groups and in formal circumstances, such as a job interview.
zh: 在使用正式英语时表现出熟练能力，例如在演讲、面对大群人讲话或在求职面试等正式场合使用标准发音。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Independently and proficiently read and comprehend longer works of fiction (stories, plays, and poems) and literary nonfiction written at the high end of grades 6 through 8.
zh: 独立且熟练地阅读并理解难度达到6至8年级上限的较长虚构作品（故事、戏剧和诗歌）以及文学性非虚构作品。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Draw multiple pieces of evidence from texts when explaining them or making inferences.
zh: 在解释文本或进行推断时，从文本中找出多条证据。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Quote or cite accurately from texts when explaining them or making inferences.
zh: 在解释文本或进行推断时，准确引用或标注文本出处。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Identify the central ideas or themes in a text and explain how they develop.
zh: 识别文本的中心思想或主题，并解释其如何展开。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Summarize texts objectively.
zh: 客观地概括文本。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Determine the meaning of words and phrases in a literary or nonfiction text, including Tier 2 academic vocabulary and Tier 3 subject-area vocabulary.
zh: 确定文学或非虚构文本中词语和短语的含义，包括二级学术词汇和三级学科词汇。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Consider the impact of word choices on meaning and tone.
zh: 考虑用词选择对意义和语气的影响。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Analyze the structure of a text and how the larger sections relate to the whole.
zh: 分析文本结构以及较大章节与整体的关系。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Analyze how a text’s structure helps build on themes and big ideas.
zh: 分析文本结构如何帮助深化主题和重要观点。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Compare and contrast a text to several audio, video, or multimedia versions of it, focusing on how the medium affects its impact.
zh: 将文本与其音频、视频或多媒体版本进行比较和对比，重点关注媒介如何影响其效果。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Trace arguments and claims and determine whether the reasoning, evidence, and logic are adequate.
zh: 梳理论证和主张，判断推理、证据和逻辑是否充分。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Analyze what different authors emphasize about the same topic/s and how they present information to create emphasis.
zh: 分析不同作者在同一主题上强调的内容，以及他们如何呈现信息以突出重点。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Analyze how literary elements in stories and dramas interact (e.g., how setting affects the characters and plot).
zh: 分析故事和戏剧中文学要素如何相互作用（例如背景如何影响人物和情节）。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Analyze the impact of sound devices, such as alliteration, assonance, repetition, rhyme, and rhythm in poems, stories, and plays in specific stanzas, sections, and scenes.
zh: 分析诗歌、故事和戏剧中特定诗节、段落和场景里语音手法（如头韵、元音谐音、重复、押韵和节奏）所产生的效果。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Analyze figurative language, such as metaphors and similes, to determine meaning.
zh: 分析暗喻和明喻等修辞性语言以确定其含义。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Determine connotative meanings of words in literary text.
zh: 确定文学文本中词语的引申义（内涵义）。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Examine how the structures of plays and poems develop deeper meaning and themes.
zh: 考察戏剧和诗歌的结构如何深化含义和主题。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Explain how authors develop the points of view of narrators, speakers, and characters.
zh: 解释作者如何刻画叙述者、说话者和人物的观点。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Examine how authors contrast the points of view of narrators, speakers, and characters.
zh: 考察作者如何对比叙述者、说话者和人物的观点。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Compare a written text to an oral, visual, audio, or multimedia version, focusing on the techniques used, such as lighting, sound, camera angles, and use of color.
zh: 将书面文本与口头、视觉、音频或多媒体版本进行比较，重点关注所用技巧，如灯光、声音、镜头角度和色彩运用。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Examine historical and fictional accounts of the same events, people, places, periods, and ideas to develop a deep understanding of how authors utilize history in their works and shape history by dramatizing it.
zh: 考察对同一事件、人物、地点、时期和思想的历史记载与虚构叙述，深入理解作者如何在作品中运用历史，并通过戏剧化加工塑造历史。

subject: English Language Arts
topic: Reading Comprehension—Nonficton and Informationa Text l
en: Effectively summarize all types of informational texts.
zh: 有效地概括各种类型的说明性文本。

subject: English Language Arts
topic: Reading Comprehension—Nonficton and Informationa Text l
en: Understand and explain the relationships and interactions between two or more individuals, events, or ideas in a text and how they influence each other.
zh: 理解并解释文本中两个或更多人物、事件或思想之间的关系与互动，以及它们如何相互影响。

subject: English Language Arts
topic: Reading Comprehension—Nonficton and Informationa Text l
en: Identify the structure of a text and how it helps develop big ideas.
zh: 识别文本结构及其如何帮助展开重要思想。

subject: English Language Arts

subject: English Language Arts
en: Students should be given opportunities to compose narratives, persuasive essays, and expository writing. Students should examine their work with attention to unity, coherence, and emphasis. Narratives should present a logical sequence of events, and include concrete details. Persuasive pieces should incorporate credible sources and consider counter arguments. Expository essays should have a main point and stick to it, and have a coherent structure, typically following the pattern of introduction, body, and conclusion. Paragraphs should have a unified focus, be developed with evidence and examples, and have transitions between them. Essays should have appropriate tone and diction, as well as correct spelling and grammar in their final form. Standards for writing apply across the disciplines.
zh: 应让学生有机会撰写记叙文、说服性文章和说明文。学生应关注作品的统一性、连贯性和重点来审视自己的作品。记叙文应按逻辑顺序呈现事件，并包含具体细节。说服性文章应纳入可信来源并考虑反面论点。说明文应有一个中心观点并紧扣该观点，结构连贯，通常遵循引言、正文和结论的模式。段落应有统一的焦点，用证据和实例展开，段落之间应有过渡。文章应有恰当的语气和措辞，最终稿还应拼写和语法正确。写作标准适用于所有学科。

subject: Visual Arts
en: Teachers: In schools, lessons on the visual arts should illustrate important elements of making and appreciating art, and emphasize important artists, works of art, and artistic concepts. When appropriate, topics in the visual arts may be linked to topics in other disciplines. The following guidelines specify a variety of artwork in different media and from various cultures in order to expose students to a wide range of art and artists. While the list is robust, it may require teachers to narrow the selection in order to adequately address the works and related skills within an academic year. In studying the works of art specified below, and in creating their own art, students should review, develop, and apply concepts introduced in previous grades, such as line, shape, form, space, texture, color, light, design, and symmetry
zh: 教师提示：在学校的视觉艺术课程中，应阐明创作与鉴赏艺术的重要元素，并强调重要的艺术家、艺术作品和艺术概念。在适当的时候，视觉艺术主题可与其他学科的主题相联系。以下指导原则列出了不同媒介、不同文化的多种艺术作品，以让学生接触广泛的艺术和艺术家。这份清单虽然丰富，但教师可能需要缩小选择范围，以便在一个学年内充分讲清这些作品及相关技能。在学习下列艺术作品和创作自己的作品时，学生应复习、发展并运用前几个年级引入的概念，如线条、形状、形体、空间、肌理、色彩、光线、设计和对称。

subject: Visual Arts
en: The guidelines here continue the organizational scheme established in sixth grade, which combined art history with analysis of specific illustrative works. Timelines may help students situate the artists, periods, and schools. Note that the periods and characteristics are not absolute distinctions but generally helpful categories (to which there are always exceptions) often used in discussions of art.
zh: 这里的指南延续了六年级确立的组织框架，即将艺术史与对具体示范作品的分析相结合。时间线可以帮助学生定位艺术家、时期和流派。请注意，这些时期和特征并非绝对界限，而是通常有用的分类（总有例外），常用于艺术讨论之中。

The focus here combines music history with appreciation of illustrative works, and continues from Grade 6 the idea of classifying Western music by periods, with examples of specific composers and works, as well as some associated musical terms. subject: Mathematics
en: Teachers: In learning the new concepts and procedures, students should use previously acquired mathematics to ensure that the procedures become automatic and habitual. Students should continue to master the use of measuring and drawing instruments, develop their mental arithmetic and their approximating abilities, become more familiar with deductive reasoning, and use calculators and computers in a thoughtful way. While teaching methods may vary, it is worth keeping in mind the psychological principle that the most effective method for learning mathematics emphasizes frequent, varied practice, and encourages multiple approaches to solving varied types of problems.
zh: 教师须知：在学习新概念和运算方法时，学生应运用已掌握的数学知识，确保这些方法变得自动化并成为习惯。学生应继续熟练掌握测量和绘图工具的使用，发展心算和估算能力，更加熟悉演绎推理，并审慎地使用计算器和计算机。虽然教学方法可以多样，但值得记住的心理原则是：学习数学最有效的方法强调经常的、多样化的练习，并鼓励采用多种方法解决不同类型的问题。

Freehand, with ruler and protractor, and with technology. Noticing when the conditions determine a unique triangle, more than one triangle, or no triangle. As in plane sections of right rectangular prisms and right rectangular pyramids.
zh: 解决涉及 p、q、r（均为特定有理数）的现实世界和数学问题。p、q、r 为特定有理数，包括根据按比例绘制的图计算实际长度和面积，以及按不同比例重新绘制比例图。徒手绘制、借助直尺和量角器，以及借助技术工具。注意判断给定条件何时确定唯一的三角形、不止一个三角形或没有三角形。例如直棱柱和直棱锥的平面截面。
details: area | volume | surface area of two- and three-dimensional objects (triangles, quadrilaterals, polygons, cubes, and right prisms) Know that the decimal form of a rational number terminates in 0s or eventually repeats.

subject: Mathematics
en: Use random sampling to draw inferences about a population.
zh: 使用随机抽样对总体进行推断。

subject: Mathematics
en: Understand that statistics can be used to gain information about a population by examining a sample of the population. • Understand that random sampling tends to produce representative samples and support valid inferences.
zh: 理解统计学可通过考察总体的样本来获取有关总体的信息。理解随机抽样往往能产生有代表性的样本，从而支持有效的推断。

subject: Mathematics
en: Use data from a random sample to draw inferences about a population with an unknown characteristic of interest. • Generate multiple samples (or simulated samples) of the same size to gauge the variation in estimates or predictions.
zh: 利用随机样本的数据，对具有未知关注特征的总体进行推断。生成多个同样大小的样本（或模拟样本），以衡量估计或预测的变化。

subject: Mathematics
en: Draw informal comparative inferences about two populations.
zh: 对两个总体进行非正式的比较推断。

subject: Mathematics
en: Informally assess the degree of visual overlap of two numerical data distributions with similar variabilities.
zh: 非正式地评估变异性相近的两个数值数据分布在视觉上的重叠程度。

subject: Mathematics
en: Use measures of center and measures of variability for numerical data from random samples to draw informal comparative inferences about two populations.
zh: 对来自随机样本的数值数据使用集中趋势度量和变异性度量，对两个总体进行非正式的比较推断。

subject: Mathematics
en: Investigate chance processes and develop, use, and evaluate probability models.
zh: 研究随机过程，并建立、使用和评估概率模型。

subject: Mathematics
en: Understand that the probability of a chance event is a number between 0 and 1 that expresses the likelihood of the event occurring. • Understand that larger numbers indicate greater likelihood.
zh: 理解随机事件的概率是介于 0 和 1 之间的数，表示事件发生的可能性。理解数值越大表示可能性越大。

subject: Mathematics
en: A probability near 0 indicates an unlikely event.
zh: 接近 0 的概率表示不太可能发生的事件。

subject: Mathematics
en: A probability around 1 2 indicates an event that is neither unlikely nor likely.
zh: 接近 1/2 的概率表示既非不太可能也非很可能发生的事件。

subject: Mathematics
en: A probability near 1 indicates a likely event.
zh: 接近 1 的概率表示很可能发生的事件。

subject: Mathematics
en: Approximate the probability of a chance event.
zh: 近似求出随机事件的概率。
details: Collect data on the chance process that produces it. | Observe its long-run relative frequency. | Predict the approximate relative frequency given the probability.

subject: Mathematics
en: Develop a probability model and use it to find probabilities of events.
zh: 建立概率模型并用它求事件发生的概率。
details: Compare probabilities from a model to observed frequencies.

subject: Mathematics
en: Develop a uniform probability model by assigning equal probability to all outcomes, and use the model to determine probabilities of events.
zh: 通过给所有结果赋予相等的概率来建立均匀概率模型，并用该模型确定事件的概率。

subject: Mathematics
en: Develop a probability model (which may not be uniform) by observing frequencies in data generated from a chance process.
zh: 通过观察随机过程产生的数据中的频率，建立概率模型（可能不是均匀的）。

subject: Mathematics
en: Find probabilities of compound events using organized lists, tables, tree diagrams, and simulation. • Understand that the probability of a compound event is the fraction of outcomes in the sample space for which the compound event occurs. • Represent sample spaces for compound events using methods such as organized lists, tables and tree diagrams.
zh: 使用有序列举、表格、树状图和模拟来求复合事件的概率。理解复合事件的概率是样本空间中该复合事件发生的结果所占的比例。用有序列举、表格和树状图等方法表示复合事件的样本空间。

subject: Mathematics
en: For an event described in everyday language, identify the outcomes in the sample space which compose the event. • Design and use a simulation to generate frequencies for compound events. Generalizations about a population from a sample are valid only if the sample is representative of that population. Measure the difference between the centers by expressing it as a multiple of a measure of variability. If the agreement is not good, explain possible sources of the discrepancy.
zh: 对于用日常语言描述的事件，指出样本空间中组成该事件的结果。设计并使用模拟来生成复合事件的频率。从样本对总体作出的概括只有在样本对该总体具有代表性时才有效。用变异性度量的倍数来表示中心之间的差异。如果吻合度不好，解释差异的可能来源。

subject: Science
en: Teachers: Effective instruction in science requires not only direct experience and observation but also book learning, which helps bring coherence and order to a student’s scientific knowledge. Only when topics are presented systematically and clearly can students make steady and secure progress in their scientific learning. The Science sequence for the middle school grades aims for more intensive and selective study of topics, a number of which were introduced in earlier grades. The Sequence continues the practice of studying topics from each of the major realms of science (physical, life, and earth science). Students are expected to do experiments and write reports on their findings.
zh: 教师须知：有效的科学教学不仅需要直接经验和观察，也需要书本学习，因为书本学习有助于使学生的科学知识连贯而有条理。只有系统、清晰地呈现主题，学生才能在科学学习上稳步而扎实地进步。中学阶段的科学知识序列旨在对主题进行更深入、有所侧重的研习，其中不少主题在更早的年级已经介绍过。该序列延续了从科学的各大领域（物理科学、生命科学和地球科学）研究主题的做法。学生应动手做实验，并撰写关于研究发现的报告。

subject: Science
en: A chemical reaction is indicated by changes in color, odor, or temperature.
zh: 化学反应可通过颜色、气味或温度的变化来识别。

subject: Science
en: In a chemical reaction, a new substance is form, called the product. The substances that interact in a chemical reaction are called reactants.
zh: 在化学反应中，会生成一种新物质，称为生成物。参与化学反应的物质称为反应物。

subject: Science
en: The total number of atoms in the reactants is the same as the total number of atoms in the product. Matter is neither created nor destroyed in chemical reactions—it is conserved.
zh: 反应物中的原子总数与生成物中的原子总数相同。化学反应中物质既不会凭空产生也不会消失——物质是守恒的。

subject: Science
en: Equations describe chemical reactions.
zh: 化学方程式描述化学反应。

subject: Science
en: Atom: consists of a nucleus and electrons.
zh: 原子：由原子核和电子组成。

subject: Science
en: Nucleus: consists of protons and neutrons, both of which are built from quarks.
zh: 原子核：由质子和中子组成，二者都由夸克构成。

subject: Science
en: Elements: substances consisting of only one kind of atom
zh: 元素：只由一种原子构成的物质

subject: Science
en: Compounds: made up of two or more atoms and have properties.
zh: 化合物：由两个或更多原子构成，并具有特定的性质。

subject: Science
en: Role of chemical bonds in formation of compounds
zh: 化学键在化合物形成中的作用

subject: Science
en: Role of electrons in formation of compounds
zh: 电子在化合物形成中的作用

subject: Science
en: Models can represent chemical compounds.
zh: 模型可以表示化合物。

subject: Science
en: When a chemical reaction occurs it will be accompanied by either absorbing energy or releasing energy. The energy may be in any of the following or any combination:
zh: 化学反应发生时，总会伴随吸收能量或释放能量。能量可能表现为以下任意一种或几种的组合：

subject: Science
en: Thermal energy
zh: 热能

subject: Science
en: Light
zh: 光

subject: Science
en: Sound
zh: 声

subject: Science
en: Motion
zh: 运动

subject: Science
en: In a chemical reaction, a new substance is form, called the product. The substances that interact in a chemical reaction are called reactants.
zh: 在化学反应中，会生成一种新物质，称为生成物。参与化学反应的物质称为反应物。

subject: Science
en: Examples: fireworks give off heat, light, odor, and sound; exploding dynamite gives off sound and motion.
zh: 例如：烟花放出热、光、气味和声音；炸药爆炸发出声音并产生运动。

subject: Science
en: Energy in any chemical reaction is never created or destroyed, it just changes form.
zh: 任何化学反应中的能量都不会凭空产生或消失，只是改变了形式。

subject: Science
en: Some chemical reactions give off heat; they release thermal energy. These are exothermic.
zh: 有些化学反应放出热量，即释放热能，这类反应称为放热反应。

subject: Science
en: Some chemical reactions need heat to be input to occur; these are called endothermic.
zh: 有些化学反应需要输入热量才能发生，这类反应称为吸热反应。

subject: Science
en: The energy released by a chemical reaction can be used to create useful products such as hand warmers, flameless heaters, and heating up food.
zh: 化学反应释放的能量可用于制造有用的产品，如暖手宝、无焰加热器，以及加热食物。

subject: Science
en: Chemical reactions may need thermal energy to occur; example. a spark needed to ignite gasoline.
zh: 化学反应可能需要热能才能发生；例如，点燃汽油需要火花。

subject: Science
en: A catalyst is something that reduces the amount of energy needed for a chemical reaction to occur.
zh: 催化剂是能降低化学反应发生所需能量的物质。

subject: Science
en: The human body takes in food and breaks down the food by the process of digestion.
zh: 人体摄入食物，并通过消化过程将食物分解。

subject: Science
en: Digestion allows carbohydrates, proteins, fats, and vitamins to become available to all the cells in the body.
zh: 消化使碳水化合物、蛋白质、脂肪和维生素能够被全身所有细胞利用。

subject: Science
en: Disruption of the processes of digestion and cell respiration can lead to disorders of human health.
zh: 消化和细胞呼吸过程受到干扰会导致人体健康失调。

subject: Science
en: Humans are omnivores and must eat plants or other animals to survive.
zh: 人类是杂食动物，必须吃植物或其他动物才能生存。

subject: Science
en: Human health requires food and other substances such as vitamins and minerals.
zh: 人体健康需要食物以及维生素和矿物质等其他物质。

subject: Science
en: Balanced diet, e.g. the food pyramid or “MyPlate,” includes carbohydrates, proteins, fats, vitamins, and minerals.
zh: 均衡饮食，例如食物金字塔或“我的餐盘”（MyPlate），包括碳水化合物、蛋白质、脂肪、维生素和矿物质。

subject: Science
en: Humans must get vitamins from external sources.
zh: 人类必须从外部来源获取维生素。

subject: Science
en: Energy for most life on earth comes from the sun.
zh: 地球上大多数生命所需的能量来自太阳。

subject: Science
en: Sunlight and the process of photosynthesis
zh: 阳光与光合作用过程

subject: Science
en: Glucose is the major source of chemical energy for living things.
zh: 葡萄糖是生物体化学能量的主要来源。

subject: Science
en: Food is both what we eat and the chemical substances cells need to perform chemical reactions.
zh: 食物既是我们吃的东西，也是细胞进行化学反应所需的化学物质。

subject: Science
en: The three classes of chemicals that make up food are carbohydrates, proteins, and fats (lipids).
zh: 构成食物的三大类化学物质是碳水化合物、蛋白质和脂肪（脂类）。

subject: Science
en: Carbon, hydrogen, and oxygen (plus many others in lesser amounts) are the main constituents of cell chemistry.
zh: 碳、氢、氧（以及含量较少的许多其他元素）是细胞化学的主要组成成分。

subject: Science
en: Cellular respiration breaks down the sugar glucose and uses released chemical energy to allow all chemical reactions in the cell.
zh: 细胞呼吸分解葡萄糖，并利用释放出的化学能来支持细胞内的所有化学反应。

subject: Science
en: Only plants photosynthesize, but all living things (including plants) have cellular respiration.
zh: 只有植物能进行光合作用，但所有生物（包括植物）都有细胞呼吸。

subject: Science
en: While most living things use oxygen for cellular respiration, some do not.
zh: 虽然大多数生物利用氧气进行细胞呼吸，但有些生物不需要氧气。

subject: Science
en: Animals must eat organic compounds from plants or other animals for energy.
zh: 动物必须摄入来自植物或其他动物的有机物以获取能量。

subject: Science
en: Humans need oxygen for most types of cellular respiration.
zh: 人体进行大多数类型的细胞呼吸都需要氧气。

subject: Science
en: Oxygen is transported from the lungs to the cells through hemoglobin in the blood.
zh: 氧气通过血液中的血红蛋白从肺部输送到细胞。

subject: Science
en: The interdependence and balance between plant and animal life is bound to the processes of photosynthesis and respiration.
zh: 动植物生命之间的相互依存与平衡与光合作用和呼吸作用的过程紧密相连。

subject: Science
en: The energy for most life comes from the sun.
zh: 大多数生命所需的能量来自太阳。

subject: Science
en: Sunlight strikes the chemical chlorophyll, which is found in the leaf and stem tissues of plants.
zh: 阳光照射到叶绿素这种化学物质上，叶绿素存在于植物的叶片和茎部组织中。

subject: Science
en: Sunlight energy is transformed into chemical energy by plant cells by a complex set of reactions called photosynthesis.
zh: 植物细胞通过一系列复杂的反应将阳光能量转化为化学能，这一过程称为光合作用。

subject: Science
en: The result of photosynthesis is the formation of the simple sugar glucose.
zh: 光合作用的结果是生成一种简单的糖——葡萄糖。

subject: Science
en: Glucose is the chemical food of life on earth.
zh: 葡萄糖是地球上生命的化学养料。

subject: Science
en: Glucose produced by plants is the food of all living things.
zh: 植物产生的葡萄糖是所有生物的食物。

subject: Science
en: Matter (glucose, food) flows from plants to all other organisms in the ecosystem in feeding chains.
zh: 物质（葡萄糖、食物）通过食物链从植物流向生态系统中的所有其他生物。

subject: Science
en: All the interacting food chains make up the food web of an ecosystem.
zh: 所有相互交错的食物链构成一个生态系统的食物网。

subject: Science
en: About 10% of the food energy flows to the next level in food chain.
zh: 大约 10% 的食物能量流向食物链的下一级。

subject: Science
en: Bacteria and fungi recycle chemical substances and return organic matter to an ecosystem using carbon, oxygen, and nitrogen cycles.
zh: 细菌和真菌通过碳、氧和氮循环回收化学物质，并将有机物归还给生态系统。

subject: Science
en: Cycles of matter occur throughout all of earth’s spheres, including the atmosphere, biosphere, geosphere, and hydrosphere.
zh: 物质循环发生在地球的所有圈层中，包括大气圈、生物圈、岩石圈和水圈。

subject: Science
en: Cycles of matter are called biogeochemical sice they involve both abiotic and biotic elements of the earth.
zh: 物质循环被称为生物地球化学循环，因为它们涉及地球的非生物和生物要素。

subject: Science
en: The carbon, oxygen, and phosphorus cycles are important biogeochemical cycles.
zh: 碳循环、氧循环和磷循环是重要的生物地球化学循环。

subject: Science
en: An ecosystem is all the biotic and abiotic factors that make up a defined area.
zh: 生态系统是构成一个特定区域的所有生物因素和非生物因素。

subject: Science
en: Abiotic: temperature, wind, precipitation, soil type, weather, water conditions
zh: 非生物因素：温度、风、降水、土壤类型、天气、水文条件

subject: Science
en: Biotic: all the living organisms in an area
zh: 生物因素：某一区域内的所有生物

subject: Science
en: Range of size of ecosystems
zh: 生态系统大小的分布范围

subject: Science
en: An ecosystem consists of individual organisms, of populations made up of member of the same species, and of all other populations of all the species in the area.
zh: 生态系统由个体生物、由同种成员组成的种群，以及该区域内所有物种的其他种群构成。

subject: Science
en: Limited resources promote competition among individuals and species.
zh: 有限的资源促使个体之间和物种之间产生竞争。

subject: Science
en: Species can interact symbiotically by mutualism, commensalism, and parasitism.
zh: 物种之间可通过互利共生、共栖和寄生等方式形成共生关系。

subject: Science
en: All ecosystems, regardless of size or nature, consist of interactions between producers and consumers and between predators and prey.
zh: 所有生态系统，无论大小或性质如何，都由生产者与消费者之间以及捕食者与被捕食者之间的相互作用构成。

subject: Science
en: Ecosystems vary widely in type, but all involve similar interaction of biotic and abiotic factors.
zh: 生态系统类型差异很大，但都涉及生物因素与非生物因素的类似相互作用。

subject: Science
en: Biotic and abiotic aspects of an ecosystem can change.
zh: 生态系统的生物和非生物方面都可能发生变化。

subject: Science
en: Ecosystem disruptions include: the immigration or emigration of new species, the arrival of prey organisms, long-term changes in precipitation, disasters such as flood or fire.
zh: 生态系统的扰动包括：新物种的迁入或迁出、猎物种群的到来、降水的长期变化，以及洪水或火灾等灾害。

subject: Science
en: Poor agricultural practices can damage ecosystems. Examples are the destruction of rain forests for the production of palm oil and t monoculture farming that harm native prairies.
zh: 不良的农业做法会破坏生态系统。例如为生产棕榈油而毁坏雨林，以及危害原生草原的单一作物种植。

subject: Science
en: Individuals and species may find the changes in conditions favorable or unfavorable.
zh: 个体和物种可能会发现环境的变化对自己有利或不利。

subject: Science
en: Humans can preserve an ecosystem’s structure, e.g. by wroking to preserve biodiversity or eliminate invasive species.
zh: 人类可以保护生态系统的结构，例如努力保护生物多样性或清除入侵物种。

subject: Science
en: Humans use the energy inherent in natural resources to live.
zh: 人类利用自然资源中蕴含的能量来生存。

subject: Science
en: Renewable resources
zh: 可再生资源

subject: Science
en: Sunlight — solar panels and solar heating devices
zh: 阳光——太阳能电池板和太阳能加热装置

subject: Science
en: Wind — windmills
zh: 风——风车

subject: Science
en: Hydroelectric power uses the gravitational effect on water.
zh: 水力发电利用水所受的重力作用。

subject: Science
en: Geothermal power uses thermal energy from Earth’s interior.
zh: 地热能利用地球内部的热能。

subject: Science
en: Tidal power uses the movement of oceanic tides.
zh: 潮汐能利用海洋潮汐的运动。

subject: Science
en: Biofuels use raw materials, such as forest resources, and are renewable if produced sustainably.
zh: 生物燃料使用森林资源等原材料，如果以可持续方式生产，就是可再生的。

subject: Science
en: Nonrenewable resources:
zh: 不可再生资源：

subject: Science
en: Fossil fuels such as oil, natural gas, and coal
zh: 化石燃料，如石油、天然气和煤

subject: Science
en: Nuclear power from uranium
zh: 来自铀的核能

subject: Science
en: Nuclear power plants—monitored for safety and accidents such as Three Mile Island and Chernobyl
zh: 核电站——需进行安全监控，以及三里岛和切尔诺贝利等事故

subject: Science
en: The use of natural resources, while necessary for modern life, can have undesired environmental effects.
zh: 自然资源的利用虽然是现代生活所必需的，但也可能产生不良的环境影响。

subject: Science
en: Fossil fuels — air pollution, including smog and greenhouse gases, causing atmospheric warming
zh: 化石燃料——造成空气污染，包括烟雾和温室气体，导致大气变暖

subject: Science
en: Nuclear power generates radioactive waste.
zh: 核能会产生放射性废物。

subject: Science
en: Wind turbines can be noisy and may affect bird life.
zh: 风力涡轮机可能噪音较大，并可能影响鸟类。

subject: Science
en: Human ingenuity and its uses to create a healthy environment.
zh: 人类的聪明才智及其在创造健康环境中的应用。

subject: Science
en: Scientific data and effective communication can be used to make informed decisions about the environment.
zh: 科学数据和有效沟通可用于就环境问题作出明智的决策。

subject: Science
en: Charles Darwin— the theory of evolution by natural selection
zh: 查尔斯·达尔文——自然选择进化论

subject: Science
en: Antoine Lavoisier—the process of oxidation
zh: 安托万·拉瓦锡——氧化过程

subject: Science
en: Lise Meitner—helped establish the process of controlled nuclear fission
zh: 莉泽·迈特纳——帮助确立了可控核裂变的过程

subject: Science
en: Dmitri Mendeleev: first widely accepted periodic table
zh: 德米特里·门捷列夫：提出首个被广泛接受的元素周期表

subject: Science
en: Francis Crick, James Watson, Severo Ochoa, Barbara McClintock, etc., elucidated the hereditary workings of the cell
zh: 弗朗西斯·克里克、詹姆斯·沃森、塞韦罗·奥乔亚、芭芭拉·麦克林托克等阐明了细胞的遗传机制

subject: English Language Arts
en: Actively participate in discussions about a variety of Grade 8 topics, ideas, and texts in a variety of settings, including partners, small and large groups, and teacher-led groups.
zh: 积极参与关于八年级各种主题、观点和课文的讨论，讨论形式多样，包括两人搭档、小组和大组以及教师带领的小组。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Prepare for discussions in advance, including researching the topic and organizing information for the discussion. Draw on preparations during the discussion to analyze ideas and explore the topic further.
zh: 提前为讨论做准备，包括研究主题和整理讨论所需信息；在讨论中运用这些准备来分析观点并进一步探讨主题。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Manage goals and deadlines, and define specific roles appropriate to a discussion.
zh: 管理目标和完成期限，并明确适合讨论的具体角色分工。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Follow rules for productive social engagement among peers; follow decision-making protocols (e.g., rubrics or principles) that help build effective social skills related to public discussions.
zh: 遵守同伴间富有成效的社交互动规则；遵循有助于培养公共讨论所需有效社交技能的决策规程（如评分标准或原则）。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Ask relevant questions to clarify conversations and ideas and to build upon remarks made by others.
zh: 提出相关问题，以澄清谈话和想法，并在他人发言的基础上进一步展开。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Use details to elaborate and comment on a topic, text, or issue being discussed; add insight to discussions or move discussions forward.
zh: 运用细节对所讨论的主题、文本或问题进行阐述和评论；为讨论增添见解或推动讨论深入。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Integrate the ideas, evidence, and viewpoints of multiple speakers before responding or posing questions during a discussion.
zh: 在讨论中作出回应或提问之前，先综合多位发言者的观点、论据和看法。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Craft responses to questions, as well as comments, so that ideas, insights, observations, and evidence are relevant to the topic or issue being discussed.
zh: 精心组织对问题的回答和评论，使观点、见解、观察和论据都与所讨论的主题或问题相关。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Demonstrate the ability to defend one’s own point of view when presented with new information; adjust one’s own point of view, if necessary, when presented with new evidence during a discussion.
zh: 展现出在面对新信息时捍卫自己观点的能力；讨论中若出现新证据，必要时调整自己的观点。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Interpret information from an array of media formats, such as visual (paintings, pictures, and animations), quantitative (graphs, charts, and diagrams), videos, and recordings.
zh: 解读多种媒体形式呈现的信息，如视觉类（绘画、图片和动画）、数据类（曲线图、图表和示意图）、视频以及录音。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Explain how information from media formats reflects, enhances, or is otherwise suitable for the discussion, issue, or topic at hand.
zh: 说明媒体形式的信息如何反映、增强或以其他方式适用于当前的讨论、问题或主题。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Identify and interpret the purposes, motives, or intentions of an array of information from media formats, such as political, commercial, and social agendas.
zh: 识别并解读各类媒体信息背后的目的、动机或意图，如政治、商业和社会方面的图谋。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Explain a speaker’s argument, distinguishing the claims, evidence, and reasons speakers give and whether the claims are adequately supported.
zh: 解释说话者的论点，区分其提出的主张、证据和理由，并判断这些主张是否得到充分支持。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Evaluate the overall quality of the reasoning used in an argument and the relevancy of the evidence provided; identify and explain when and why particular evidence may be unnecessary, unrelated, or inappropriate.
zh: 评估论证中推理的整体质量以及所提供证据的相关性；识别并说明某些证据在何时、为何可能是不必要的、无关的或不恰当的。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Give a presentation about a topic or text, tell a story, or orally relate a personal experience in a logical and organized manner, including relevant descriptions, details, and facts that support main ideas or themes.
zh: 以条理清晰、逻辑严密的方式就某一主题或文本作报告、讲故事或口头讲述个人经历，包括支持主要观点或主题的相关描述、细节和事实。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Orally present a claim-based argument supported by evidence, curated details, and solid reasoning that demonstrates a focused emphasis on the essential points.
zh: 口头陈述以主张为核心的论证，用证据、精选细节和扎实的推理加以支撑，突出要点。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Speak clearly at an understandable volume and pace; maintain eye contact.
zh: 以清晰、易于理解的音量和语速讲话；保持眼神交流。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Support claims in presentations by adding evidence from relevant multimedia such as displays, images, videos, graphics, music, and recordings.
zh: 在陈述中通过加入相关多媒体（如展品、图片、视频、图形、音乐和录音）的证据来支撑主张。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Use relevant multimedia to enhance presentations and capture viewers’/listeners’ attention.
zh: 运用相关多媒体增强陈述效果，吸引观众／听众的注意力。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Use information from several multimedia sources, synthesizing it to explain, crystalize, elaborate, or elucidate information for viewers/listeners.
zh: 运用多个多媒体来源的信息，加以综合，为观众／听众进行解释、提炼、详述或阐明。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Switch between formal and informal English as appropriate to the situation or task; adapt speech to a variety of contexts.
zh: 根据情境或任务在正式与非正式英语之间切换；使言语适应各种语境。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Show proficiency when using formal English, such as standard pronunciation when giving speeches or speaking to large groups and in formal circumstances, such as a job interview.
zh: 在使用正式英语时表现出熟练能力，例如在演讲、面对大群人讲话或在求职面试等正式场合使用标准发音。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Independently and proficiently read and comprehend longer works of fiction (stories, plays, and poems) and literary nonfiction written at the high end of grades 6 through 8.
zh: 独立且熟练地阅读并理解难度达到6至8年级上限的较长虚构作品（故事、戏剧和诗歌）以及文学性非虚构作品。

subject: English Language Arts
section: Grasping Specific Details and Key Ideas
section_zh: 把握具体细节与核心观点
en: Identify and utilize the most appropriate supporting evidence from texts when explaining them or making inferences.
zh: 在解说课文或进行推断时，找出并运用文本中最恰当的支持性证据。

subject: English Language Arts
section: Grasping Specific Details and Key Ideas
section_zh: 把握具体细节与核心观点
en: Quote or cite accurately from texts when using evidence to explain them or make inferences.
zh: 用证据解说文本或进行推断时，准确引用或标注文本出处。

subject: English Language Arts
section: Grasping Specific Details and Key Ideas
section_zh: 把握具体细节与核心观点
en: Identify the central ideas or themes in a text and explain how they develop.
zh: 识别文本的中心思想或主题，并解释其如何展开。

subject: English Language Arts
section: Grasping Specific Details and Key Ideas
section_zh: 把握具体细节与核心观点
en: Understand how the component parts in literary works or supporting ideas in informational texts build themes or big ideas.
zh: 理解文学作品中的组成部分或说明性文本中的支撑观点如何构建主题或核心思想。

subject: English Language Arts
section: Grasping Specific Details and Key Ideas
section_zh: 把握具体细节与核心观点
en: Summarize texts objectively.
zh: 客观地概括文本。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Determine the meaning of words and phrases in a literary or nonfiction text, including Tier 2 academic vocabulary and Tier 3 subject-area vocabulary.
zh: 确定文学或非虚构文本中词语和短语的含义，包括二级学术词汇和三级学科词汇。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Consider the impact of word choices on meaning and tone.
zh: 考虑用词选择对意义和语气的影响。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Analyze the structures of several texts to determine how structures create meaning and influence style; then, compare and contrast the texts, considering the impact on meaning and style each structure has.
zh: 分析若干文本的结构，确定结构如何创造意义并影响风格；然后比较和对照这些文本，考量每种结构对意义和风格的影响。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Evaluate in detail how sentences cooperate in paragraphs to build and organize key ideas, key concepts, and key details (versus extraneous information) and, in turn, how paragraphs cooperate to build ideas and organize information in texts.
zh: 详细评估句子如何在段落中配合以构建和组织核心观点、关键概念和关键细节（而非无关信息），进而评估段落如何在文本中配合以构建观点和组织信息。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Explore the advantages and disadvantages of various media, such as books or other printed materials, videos, digital photography, or recordings, to convey ideas or explore a topic.
zh: 探究各种媒介（如书籍或其他印刷材料、视频、数码摄影或录音）在传达思想或探讨主题方面的优缺点。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Compare and contrast different texts with the same topic, themes, or genre.
zh: 比较和对比主题、题材或体裁相同的不同文本。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Analyze analogies, allusions to other texts, and figurative language, such as metaphors and similes, to determine meaning.
zh: 分析类比、对其他文本的典故引用以及比喻性语言（如隐喻和明喻），以确定其含义。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Determine connotative meanings of words in literary texts.
zh: 确定文学文本中词语的引申义（内涵义）。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Consider the function of dialogue in stories and plays, focusing on how it moves a story forward, reveals aspects of a character’s personality, causes characters to take action, influences how characters interact with each other, or otherwise affects the events of the plot.
zh: 思考对话在故事和戏剧中的作用，重点分析它如何推动情节发展、揭示人物性格、促使人物采取行动、影响人物之间的互动，或以其他方式影响情节事件。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Compare and contrast a script or written version of a story to a filmed version or live performance, analyzing the extent of the departures from the original or faithfulness to it and the effectiveness of the artistic choices made by the director or actors.
zh: 将故事的剧本或文字版本与拍成电影的版本或现场演出进行比较和对照，分析其对原作的偏离或忠实程度，以及导演或演员所作艺术选择的效果。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Explore how authors use dramatic irony to
zh: 探究作者如何运用戏剧性反讽来

subject: English Language Arts
en: create a different point of view for the audience or reader than the point of view of the characters in a story or drama.
zh: 为观众或读者营造不同于故事或戏剧中人物视角的另一种视角。

subject: English Language Arts
en: create differing points of view and levels of awareness among characters in the same story or drama.
zh: 在同一故事或戏剧中的人物之间营造不同的视角和认知程度。

subject: English Language Arts
en: involve or affect the reader or audience by creating differing points of view and levels of awareness for characters in the same story or drama.
zh: 通过为同一故事或戏剧中的人物设置不同的视角和认知程度，使读者或观众产生代入感或受到影响。

subject: English Language Arts
en: build suspense or humor by contrasting points of view and levels of awareness among characters or between the reader/audience and the characters in a story or drama.
zh: 通过对比人物之间、或读者／观众与人物之间的视角和认知程度，营造悬念或幽默。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Analyze archetypal plot patterns, themes, and character types and other literary devices and allusions from foundational literary works used in modern fiction.
zh: 分析现代小说中所借鉴的经典文学作品里的原型情节模式、主题、人物类型以及其他文学手法和典故。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Compare modern fiction with the sources it draws from for inspiration, such as traditional stories, epic poetry, mythology, and religious works (e.g., the Bible), with a focused discussion on how stories from the past are modernized.
zh: 将现代小说与其汲取灵感的来源（如传统故事、史诗、神话和宗教作品，例如《圣经》）进行比较，重点讨论古老故事如何被现代化改写。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Effectively summarize all types of informational texts.
zh: 有效地概括各类信息类文本。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Analyze technical meanings, analogies, and allusions to other texts to determine meaning.
zh: 分析术语含义、类比以及对其他文本的典故引用，以确定词义。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Understand and explain the relationships and interactions between two or more individuals, events, or ideas in a text and how the author integrates them.
zh: 理解并解释文本中两个或更多人物、事件或观点之间的关系与相互作用，以及作者如何将它们整合起来。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Identify the structure of a text at the sentence and paragraph level and how it helps develop and hone big ideas and key concepts.
zh: 识别文本在句子和段落层面上的结构，以及该结构如何帮助展开和精炼核心思想与关键概念。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Identify an author’s point of view and purpose in a text.
zh: 识别作者在文本中的观点和写作目的。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Explain how an author distinguishes their own point of view from that of others in a text, focusing on how an author responds to evidence and/or viewpoints that conflict.
zh: 说明作者如何在文本中区分自己的观点与他人的观点，重点分析作者如何应对相互冲突的证据和／或观点。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Analyze the advantages and disadvantages of various mediums’ (print, digital, video, and multimedia) ability to relate information to the reader or viewer about a particular topic or idea.
zh: 分析各种媒介（印刷、数字、视频和多媒体）在向读者或观众传达特定主题或观点信息方面的优缺点。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Explain how an author supports arguments in a text by giving reasons (opinions) and evidence, such as facts, examples, and expert opinions from reliable sources.
zh: 说明作者如何通过给出理由（看法）和证据（如事实、实例以及来自可靠来源的专家意见）来支撑文本中的论证。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Distinguish between claims that are supported and those that are not.
zh: 区分有证据支持的主张和没有证据支持的主张。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Examine the overall soundness of the reasoning in an argument and the quality of the evidence supporting it; identify unnecessary, unrelated, or inappropriate evidence.
zh: 审视论证中推理的整体可靠性以及支持它的证据质量；找出不必要、不相关或不恰当的证据。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Compare and contrast texts containing conflicting information or arguments, identifying the conflict precisely and distinguishing whether the conflicting information is a matter of disparate facts, interpretations, or opinion/viewpoint.
zh: 比较和对照含有相互冲突信息或论证的文本，准确指出冲突所在，并区分冲突信息是源于事实分歧、解读差异还是观点／看法不同。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Students should be given opportunities to compose narratives, persuasive essays, and expository writing. Students should examine their work with attention to unity, coherence, and emphasis. Narratives should present a logical sequence of events, and include concrete details. Persuasive pieces should incorporate credible sources, support claims, and consider counter arguments. Expository essays should have a main point and stick to it, and have a coherent structure, typically following the pattern of introduction, body, and conclusion. Paragraphs should have a unified focus, be developed with evidence and examples, and have transitions between them. Essays should have appropriate tone and diction, as well as correct spelling and grammar in their final form. Standards for writing apply across the disciplines.
zh: 应给学生提供写作记叙文、议论文和说明文的机会。学生应审视自己的作品，注意统一性、连贯性和重点突出。记叙文应按逻辑顺序呈现事件，并包含具体细节。议论文应引用可信来源、支撑主张并考虑反驳论点。说明文应有明确的中心并紧扣中心，结构连贯，通常遵循开头、正文、结尾的模式。各段落应焦点统一，用证据和事例展开，段落之间有过渡。文章应有恰当的语气和措辞，定稿时拼写和语法正确。写作标准适用于各个学科。

subject: English Language Arts
subtopic: Writing to Reflect Audience, Purpose, and Task
en: Write routinely, clearly, and coherently, completing both short-term and long-term assignments focused on a range of different tasks, purposes, and audiences.
zh: 定期、清晰且连贯地写作，完成短期和长期作业，这些作业围绕各种不同的任务、目的和读者对象展开。

subject: English Language Arts
subtopic: Writing to Reflect Audience, Purpose, and Task
en: Strengthen existing writing skills (sentences, paragraphs, transitions, introductions, and conclusions) by applying them to longer and genre-specific writing assignments.
zh: 通过将这些技能应用于更长、更具体裁特点的写作任务，巩固已有的写作技能（句子、段落、过渡、开头和结尾）。

subject: English Language Arts
subtopic: Writing to Reflect Audience, Purpose, and Task
en: Use the steps of the writing process to develop and strengthen writing: plan, draft, share, evaluate, revise, edit, and publish.
zh: 运用写作过程的各个步骤来发展和强化写作能力：计划、起草、分享、评价、修订、编辑和发表。

subject: English Language Arts
subtopic: Writing to Reflect Audience, Purpose, and Task
en: Use conventional language standards when editing.
zh: 编辑时遵循规范的语言标准。

subject: English Language Arts
subtopic: Writing to Reflect Audience, Purpose, and Task
en: Maintain a consistent style and tone appropriate to the genre of writing and audience.
zh: 保持与写作体裁和读者对象相适应的统一风格和语气。

subject: English Language Arts
subtopic: Writing to Reflect Audience, Purpose, and Task
en: Use keyboards, tablets, the Internet, and other technologies to produce and publish writing and collaborate and communicate with others.
zh: 使用键盘、平板电脑、互联网及其他技术来创作和发布作品，并与他人协作和交流。

subject: English Language Arts
subtopic: Writing to Reflect Audience, Purpose, and Task
en: Use the Internet to research and cite sources.
zh: 利用互联网进行研究并引用来源。

subject: English Language Arts
subtopic: Writing to Analyze and Understand Text
en: Analyze literature in writing: trace archetypal plot patterns, character types, and themes in modern fiction and compare and contrast them with the sources they draw on, such as epic poetry, the Bible and other religious works, traditional stories, and myths.
zh: 以书面形式分析文学作品：追溯现代小说中的原型情节模式、人物类型和主题，并将其与所借鉴的来源（如史诗、《圣经》及其他宗教作品、传统故事和神话）进行比较和对照。

subject: English Language Arts
subtopic: Writing to Analyze and Understand Text
en: Discuss and analyze, in writing, how authors modernize the archetypal source material they use for inspiration.
zh: 以书面形式讨论并分析作者如何将其汲取灵感的原型素材现代化。

subject: English Language Arts
subtopic: Writing to Analyze and Understand Text
en: Use literary elements as evidence for analyzing literature to strengthen reflection and analysis skills.
zh: 运用文学要素作为分析文学作品的证据，以增强思考和分析能力。

subject: English Language Arts
subtopic: Writing to Analyze and Understand Text
en: Describe an analysis of informational texts in writing:
zh: 以书面形式描述对说明性文本的分析：

subject: English Language Arts
subtopic: Writing to Analyze and Understand Text
en: Explain how authors make and support their points or claims with reasons and factual evidence.
zh: 解释作者如何提出观点或主张，并用理由和事实证据加以支持。

subject: English Language Arts
subtopic: Writing to Analyze and Understand Text
en: Explain how specific pieces of evidence support specific claims.
zh: 解释具体的证据如何支持具体的主张。

subject: English Language Arts
subtopic: Writing to Analyze and Understand Text
en: Discuss, in writing, whether the reasoning and evidence in an argument are valid and adequate.
zh: 以书面形式讨论论证中的推理和证据是否有效且充分。

subject: English Language Arts
subtopic: Writing to Analyze and Understand Text
en: Discuss, in writing, why evidence is invalid (e.g., unnecessary, unrelated, or inappropriate).
zh: 以书面形式讨论证据为何无效（例如不必要、不相关或不恰当）。

subject: English Language Arts
subtopic: Writing to Analyze and Understand Text
en: Use details and facts as evidence for analyzing informational texts to strengthen research and analysis skills.
zh: 将细节和事实作为分析信息类文本的证据，以增强研究和分析能力。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Conduct short research projects focused on answering a specific research question, especially one posed by the student.
zh: 开展小型研究项目，聚焦于回答某个具体的研究问题，尤其是学生自己提出的问题。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Gather relevant information from several different print and digital sources and use it to support research.
zh: 从多种不同的纸质和数字来源收集相关信息，并用于支持研究。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Adjust the research question as appropriate throughout the information-gathering process.
zh: 在信息收集过程中酌情调整研究问题。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Use the information-gathering process to pose related questions and explore additional topics and avenues of inquiry requiring further research.
zh: 利用信息收集过程提出相关问题，并探索需要进一步研究的其他主题和探究途径。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Determine the credibility of information gathered from print and digital sources.
zh: 判断从纸质和数字来源收集的信息的可信度。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Accurately quote or paraphrase from sources without plagiarizing.
zh: 准确地引用或转述来源内容，避免抄袭。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Practice honing keywords and key phrases to produce more effective online searches.
zh: 练习打磨关键词和关键短语，以进行更有效的在线搜索。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Cite sources and provide a basic bibliography.
zh: 标注引用来源，并提供基本的参考文献书目。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Produce narrative pieces that reflect real-life or imagined experiences.
zh: 写出反映真实生活或想象经历的记叙文。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Introduce a narrator, a situation, and characters, and develop them through dialogue, pacing, and exposition, including actions, thoughts, feelings, and reactions to events in the plot.
zh: 介绍叙述者、情境和人物，并通过对话、节奏和说明加以展开，包括动作、思想、情感以及对情节中事件的反应。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Organize a well-structured logical or natural sequence of plot events following from the situation, using time-order and transitional words, phrases, and clauses to indicate and manage the event order.
zh: 围绕情境组织结构良好、符合逻辑或自然的情节事件顺序，使用时间顺序词以及过渡词、短语和从句来标示和掌控事件顺序。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Incorporate shifts in time and multiple settings, interconnecting them with events and experiences that move character development forward.
zh: 融入时间转换和多个场景，并通过推动人物发展的事件和经历将它们联系起来。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Include concrete and sensory details to make writing vivid and precise; convey a sense of experiences and/or the sensations that accompany experiences.
zh: 加入具体和感官细节，使写作生动准确；传达体验感及伴随体验的感受。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Provide a sense of closure that follows logically or artfully from the situation, character responses, and sequence of events.
zh: 给出合乎逻辑或巧妙的结尾，与情境、人物反应和事件顺序相呼应。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Write reports and other types of informational texts that clearly focus ideas and information.
zh: 撰写报告和其他类型的信息类文本，清晰地聚焦观点和信息。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Introduce a topic with information organized in related sections or paragraphs and developed with well-curated facts, definitions, quotations, examples, and details.
zh: 引入一个主题，信息按相关部分或段落组织，并用精选的事实、定义、引文、事例和细节加以展开。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Organize ideas, concepts, and information using broad categories.
zh: 用大类来组织观点、概念和信息。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Group related information logically and incorporate formatting features, such as headings, graphics, charts, and other multimedia.
zh: 按逻辑将相关信息分组，并加入标题、图形、图表等格式元素。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Include visual elements such as photos, drawings, or diagrams to help explain or present ideas or information when appropriate.
zh: 在适当的时候加入照片、图画或图表等视觉要素，以帮助解释或呈现观点和信息。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Use a variety of transitions to connect ideas and concepts from distinct categories and to clarify relationships; use transitions to create an overall sense of cohesion.
zh: 使用多种过渡手段连接不同类别的观点和概念并厘清关系；运用过渡使文章具有整体连贯感。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Establish and maintain a formal style.
zh: 建立并保持正式的文体风格。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Use Tier 2 and/or Tier 3 domain-specific vocabulary to explain or elaborate topics.
zh: 使用二级和/或三级学科词汇来解释或详述主题。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Write a conclusion that wraps up ideas in the text.
zh: 写出总结全文观点的结论。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Write persuasive essays with well-defined theses and arguments that use clear reasons, examples, and relevant evidence to support claims.
zh: 撰写论点明确的说服性文章，用清晰的理由、实例和相关证据支持主张。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Follow through with an organizational structure that supports the purpose of the text, grouping ideas, reasons, counterclaims, and evidence in a logical way.
zh: 采用有助于实现写作目的的结构，按逻辑组织观点、理由、反驳论点和证据。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Demonstrate the use of logical reasoning to support claims throughout the essay.
zh: 在整篇文章中运用逻辑推理来支持主张。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Demonstrate a clear understanding of the topic and argument.
zh: 表现出对主题和论证的清晰理解。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Anticipate and answer counterarguments.
zh: 预判并回应反面论点。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Distinguish evidence from opinion and claims from counterclaims.
zh: 区分证据与看法、主张与反驳论点。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Use linking words, phrases, and clauses to connect opinions with reasons and evidence, distinguish a counterclaim, and create an overall sense of cohesion.
zh: 使用连接词、短语和从句将看法与理由和证据联系起来，标明反驳论点，并使文章具有整体连贯感。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Establish and maintain a formal style and reasonable tone.
zh: 建立并保持正式的文体和合理的语气。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Identify and use accurate, credible sources.
zh: 识别并使用准确、可信的来源。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Write a conclusion that effectively and logically wraps up the argument.
zh: 写出有效且合乎逻辑地收束论证的结论。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Use knowledge of language conventions when reading, writing, speaking, and listening.
zh: 在阅读、写作、口语和倾听中运用语言规范知识。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Use active and passive verbs and voice to portray the conditional and subjunctive mood—that is, states and actions tied to hypothetical scenarios (e.g., if . . . then, wish, would) of varying degrees of possibility.
zh: 使用主动和被动的动词及语态来表现条件语气和虚拟语气，即与不同可能性程度的假设情境（例如“如果……那么”、希望、会）相联系的状态和动作。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Use the conditional and subjunctive mood to create desired effects, express uncertainty, or communicate the fantastical.
zh: 运用条件语气和虚拟语气来营造预期效果、表达不确定性或传达奇幻的想象。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Use the conditional and subjunctive mood to emphasize both the person hypothesizing and the ideas being hypothesized.
zh: 运用条件语气和虚拟语气来强调进行假设的人以及被假设的观点。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Apply known spelling strategies when writing.
zh: 写作时运用已知的拼写策略。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Apply known morphology skills (roots, prefixes, suffixes, and spelling changes) to correctly spell words.
zh: 运用已掌握的构词法知识（词根、前缀、后缀和拼写变化）正确拼写单词。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Continue work with spelling, with special attention to commonly misspelled words. C. Grammar Teachers: Students should have a working understanding of the following terms and be able to use them to discuss and analyze writing.
zh: 继续学习拼写，特别关注常见拼写错误词。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Understand and apply the basic rules of English grammar and conventions when writing or speaking.
zh: 在写作或口语中理解并运用英语语法和语言规范的基本规则。

subject: English Language Arts

zh: 不定式及不定式短语
details: Adjective and adverb: find the word it modifies. | Noun: tell its use in the sentence.

subject: English Language Arts
en: Form cohesive sentences using both passive and active verbs and voice.
zh: 运用被动和主动的动词及语态写出连贯的句子。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Form and use verbs in the indicative, imperative, interrogative, conditional, and subjunctive mood.
zh: 构成并使用陈述语气、祈使语气、疑问语气、条件语气和虚拟语气的动词。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Correct erroneous shifts in verb voice and mood.
zh: 纠正动词语态和语气上的错误转换。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Understand and apply the basic rules of capitalization and punctuation when writing or speaking.
zh: 在写作或口语中理解并运用大小写和标点的基本规则。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Use punctuation (comma, dash, and ellipsis) to indicate a pause or break.
zh: 使用标点（逗号、破折号和省略号）表示停顿或中断。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Use an ellipsis to indicate an omission.
zh: 使用省略号表示省略内容。

zh: 利用句子的整体意思作为线索，推断句中单词的含义。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Figure out the meaning of words based on the word’s position and function within a sentence, such as part of speech, subject, predicate, object, etc.
zh: 根据单词在句子中的位置和作用来判断其含义，如词性、主语、谓语、宾语等。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Use a dictionary, thesaurus, or glossary—print or digital—to answer questions about the meanings and usage of unfamiliar words.
zh: 使用词典、同义词词典或词汇表（纸质或数字版）来回答有关生词含义和用法的问题。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Know how to use a dictionary—print or digital—to pronounce words correctly and determine a word’s part of speech.
zh: 知道如何使用词典（纸质或数字版）正确发音并确定单词的词性。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Use a dictionary to find the precise meaning of words and phrases.
zh: 使用词典查找单词和短语的确切含义。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Infer the meaning of words by using context, and then confirm the meaning in a dictionary.
zh: 利用上下文推断词义，然后在词典中确认。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Make accurate interpretations of similes and metaphors and other types of figurative language, such as personification, based on context.
zh: 根据上下文准确理解明喻、暗喻以及其他修辞手法（如拟人）的含义。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Interpret figures of speech based on context, especially verbal irony and puns.
zh: 根据上下文理解修辞格，尤其是言语反讽和双关语。

subject: English Language Arts
en: Discern nuances in word meanings.
zh: 辨别词义的细微差别。

zh: 区分外延意义相近词语之间的内涵或语义细微差别（例如 picky、fickle、discerning、sophisticated、fastidious、persnickety）。

zh: 掌握符合年级水平的第二层通用学术词汇和第三层学科专业词汇及短语，并准确使用。

In the listings here, L = Latin, G = Greek. No single form of the Latin or Greek words is consistently used here, but rather the form that is most similar to related English words. Latin /Greek Word Meaning Examples punctum \[L\] point punctual, punctuation rego \[L\] to rule regular, regency sanguis \[L\] blood sanguine satis \[L\] enough satisfy scio \[L\] know science, conscious solus \[L\] alone solo, desolate sonus \[L\] a sound unison, consonant sophos \[G\] wise philosophy, sophomore spiritus \[L\] breath inspire, spirit totus \[L\] whole totalitarianism tractum \[L\] drawn, pulled distract, tractor usus \[L\] use abuse, utensil vacuus \[L\] empty evacuate, vacuum verbum \[L\] word verbal verto \[L\] turn avert, convert, anniversary via \[L\] way, road deviate, viaduct
zh: 运用希腊语和拉丁语词根及词缀的知识推断新词的含义。下表列出拉丁语／希腊语词根、含义和例词（L＝拉丁语，G＝希腊语；表中采用的是与相关英语单词最相近的形式）：aequus [L] 相等的——equal, equation；ago, acta [L] 做、已做之事——agent, enact, transact；anthropos [G] 人、人类——anthropology, misanthrope；ars [L] 艺术——artist, artifact；brevis [L] 短的——brevity, abbreviate；canto [L] 唱——chant, cantor；caput [L] 头——captain, decapitate；clino [L] 倾斜、弯曲——incline, decline；cognito [L] 知道——cognizant, recognize；copia [L] 丰富——copy, copious；credo [L] 相信——credible, incredulous；culpa [L] 责备——culpable, culprit；dominus [L] 主人、主宰——dominate, dominion；duco [L] 领导——abduct, introduce；fido [L] 信任、相信——confide, infidel；fundo, fusum [L] 倾倒、倒出之物——effusive, transfusion；genus [L] 种类、起源——generic, congenital；holos [G] 整体——holistic, catholic；jungo [L] 连接——junction, conjugal；lego, lectum [L] 读、读物——intellect, legible；locus [L] 地点——local, dislocate；loquor [L] 说话——eloquent, loquacious；medius [L] 中间——mediate, mediocrity；missio [L] 派遣——emissary, mission；morior [L] 死——mortal；nego [L] 否认——negate；nihil [L] 无、虚无——nihilism, annihilate；occido [L] 杀——homicide, suicide；pathos [G] 痛苦、情感——sympathy, apathy；pendo [L] 称量、悬挂——depend, pendant；per [L] 穿过——perceive, persist, persevere；phobos [G] 恐惧——phobia, claustrophobia；positum [L] 放置——position, opposite；porto [L] 携带——transport, export；possum [L] 能够——possible, potent；pugno [L] 战斗——impugn, pugnacious；punctum [L] 点——punctual, punctuation；rego [L] 统治——regular, regency；sanguis [L] 血——sanguine；satis [L] 足够——satisfy；scio [L] 知道——science, conscious；solus [L] 单独——solo, desolate；sonus [L] 声音——unison, consonant；sophos [G] 智慧——philosophy, sophomore；spiritus [L] 呼吸——inspire, spirit；totus [L] 整体——totalitarianism；tractum [L] 拉、拖——distract, tractor；usus [L] 使用——abuse, utensil；vacuus [L] 空——evacuate, vacuum；verbum [L] 词——verbal；verto [L] 转——avert, convert, anniversary；via [L] 路、道路——deviate, viaduct。注：六年级和七年级还列出了更多拉丁语和希腊语单词及词根。

subject: English Language Arts
topic: Foreign Phrases Commonly Used in English
en: Students should learn the meaning of the following French words and phrases that are commonly used in English speech and writing. au revoir - goodbye, until we see each other again avant-garde - a group developing new or experimental concepts, a vanguard bête noire - a person or thing especially dreaded and avoided \[literally, “black beast”\] c’est la vie - that’s life, that’s how things happen carte blanche - full discretionary power \[literally, “blank page”\] cause célèbre - a very controversial issue that generates fervent public debate \[literally, a “celebrated case”\] coup de grâce - a decisive finishing blow coup d’état - overthrow of a government by a group déjà vu - something overly familiar \[literally, “already seen”\] enfant terrible - one whose remarks or actions cause embarrassment, or someone strikingly unconventional \[literally, “terrible child”\] fait accompli - an accomplished fact, presumably irreversible faux pas - a social blunder \[literally, “false step”\] Madame, Mademoiselle, Monsieur - Mrs., Miss, Mr. merci - thank you pièce de résistance - the principal part of the meal, a showpiece item raison d’être - reason for being savoir-faire - the ability to say or do the right thing in any situation, polished sureness in society \[literally, “to know (how) to do”\] tête-à-tête - private conversation between two people \[literally, “head to head”\]
zh: 学生应学习以下常用于英语口语和书面语中的法语词语及短语的含义：au revoir——再见，直到再相见；avant-garde——提出新观念或实验性概念的群体，先锋派；bête noire——特别令人畏惧和回避的人或事物〔字面义“黑兽”〕；c’est la vie——这就是生活，事情就是这样；carte blanche——完全的自由处置权〔字面义“空白页”〕；cause célèbre——引发激烈公众辩论的极具争议的问题〔字面义“著名案件”〕；coup de grâce——决定性的最后一击；coup d’état——政变（某一集团推翻政府）；déjà vu——似曾相识〔字面义“已经见过”〕；enfant terrible——言行令人尴尬的人，或极其标新立异的人〔字面义“可怕的孩子”〕；fait accompli——既成事实，大致不可逆转；faux pas——社交失礼〔字面义“错步”〕；Madame, Mademoiselle, Monsieur——夫人、小姐、先生；merci——谢谢；pièce de résistance——正餐的主菜，引申为最出彩的重头戏；raison d’être——存在的理由；savoir-faire——在任何场合都能恰当地说话或做事的能力，社交中的老练自信〔字面义“知道（如何）做”〕；tête-à-tête——两人之间的私下交谈〔字面义“头对头”〕。
