zh: 古典晚期的主要城市包括：墨西哥尤卡坦半岛的奇琴伊察；墨西哥的帕伦克和卡拉克穆尔；伯利兹的卡拉科尔；洪都拉斯的科潘；以及危地马拉的几处大型中心，包括蒂卡尔

subject: History and Geography
en: Construction of pyramids
zh: 金字塔的建造

subject: History and Geography
en: Religious beliefs—three distinct but linked realms—sky, earth, underworld
zh: 宗教信仰——三个不同但相互关联的领域——天空、大地、地下世界

subject: History and Geography
en: Popol Vuh collection of Maya religious stories
zh: 《波波尔·乌》，玛雅宗教故事的合集

subject: History and Geography
en: Human sacrifice
zh: 人祭

subject: History and Geography
en: Maya planned rituals on a regular schedule, using a calendar called the Tzolkin (the count of days)
zh: 玛雅人按固定日程安排祭祀仪式，使用一种名为卓尔金历（Tzolkin，意为“日子的计数”）的历法

subject: History and Geography
en: Used astronomical observation to plan buildings
zh: 利用天文观测来规划建筑

subject: History and Geography
en: Decline began around 800 CE; unclear as to why
zh: 约公元800年开始衰落；原因不明

subject: History and Geography
en: After Maya Classic Period ended around 900 CE, Mesoamerica underwent transitions as new population centers arose
zh: 玛雅古典时期约于公元900年结束后，随着新的人口中心出现，中美洲经历了变迁

subject: History and Geography
en: After several centuries, a new civilization arose in Central Mexico
zh: 几个世纪后，一个新的文明在墨西哥中部兴起

subject: History and Geography
en: Timeline
zh: 时间线

subject: History and Geography
en: From around 1300 CE, the Aztec rose in power through military successes; united most of northern region of Mesoamerica into an empire containing millions of people
zh: 从约公元1300年起，阿兹特克人凭借军事胜利崛起；将中美洲北部大部分地区统一为一个拥有数百万人口的帝国

subject: History and Geography
en: The Aztec built an empire centered in capital city of Tenochtitlán, where Mexico City stands today; Templo Mayor
zh: 阿兹特克人建立了一个以首都特诺奇蒂特兰为中心的帝国，即今墨西哥城所在地；大神庙（Templo Mayor）

subject: History and Geography
en: Lake Texcoco site of Tenochtitlán
zh: 特斯科科湖，特诺奇蒂特兰的所在地

subject: History and Geography
en: The Aztec believed in Pantheon of gods
zh: 阿兹特克人信奉万神殿般的众神

subject: History and Geography
en: Like the Maya, the Aztec had a calendar system
zh: 与玛雅人一样，阿兹特克人也有历法系统

subject: History and Geography
en: Aztec army contained skilled soldiers
zh: 阿兹特克军队拥有技艺高超的士兵

subject: History and Geography
en: Sophisticated taxation system
zh: 完善的税收制度

subject: History and Geography
en: Human sacrifice
zh: 人祭

subject: History and Geography
en: Montezuma came to power in 1502 CE; expanded Aztec empire
zh: 蒙特祖马于公元1502年掌权；扩张了阿兹特克帝国

subject: History and Geography
en: Spanish arrive in 1519 CE led by Hernán Cortés
zh: 西班牙人于公元1519年在埃尔南·科尔特斯率领下到来

subject: History and Geography
en: Montezuma taken hostage; submits to Cortés; Montezuma killed
zh: 蒙特祖马被扣为人质；向科尔特斯屈服；蒙特祖马遇害

subject: History and Geography
en: Spanish conquer Tenochtitlán
zh: 西班牙人征服特诺奇蒂特兰

subject: History and Geography
en: Spread of European diseases causes decline in Aztec population
zh: 欧洲疾病的传播导致阿兹特克人口减少

subject: History and Geography
en: The Inca—one of several groups who lived in the Andes region
zh: 印加人——生活在安第斯地区的若干族群之一

subject: History and Geography
en: In late 1300s CE, they began to conquer neighbors.
zh: 公元14世纪末，他们开始征服周边邻族。

subject: History and Geography
en: Between 1400 and 1533 CE they established largest empire in the Americas.
zh: 公元1400年至1533年间，他们建立了美洲最大的帝国。

subject: History and Geography
en: Heart of Inca Empire was city of Cuzco, in modern Peru.
zh: 印加帝国的核心是现代秘鲁的库斯科城。

subject: History and Geography
en: Inca rulers used labor of those conquered to build infrastructure—roads and bridges that connected the empire
zh: 印加统治者利用被征服者的劳动力修建基础设施——连接帝国的道路和桥梁

subject: History and Geography
en: Highly skilled stoneworkers
zh: 技艺高超的石匠

subject: History and Geography
en: Macchu Picchu
zh: 马丘比丘

subject: History and Geography
en: Social structure; empire divided into four parts with four governors
zh: 社会结构；帝国分为四个部分，由四位总督治理

subject: History and Geography
en: Tax system
zh: 税收制度

subject: History and Geography
en: Use of a quipu used for communicating information
zh: 使用奇普（quipu）来传递信息

subject: History and Geography
en: Distinctive art style; geometric shapes
zh: 独特的艺术风格；几何图案

subject: History and Geography
en: Ruler Atahualpa held hostage and then killed.
zh: 统治者阿塔瓦尔帕被扣为人质，随后被杀。

subject: History and Geography
en: Spanish invaders led by Francisco Pizarro killed thousands of Inca.
zh: 弗朗西斯科·皮萨罗率领的西班牙入侵者杀害了数千名印加人。

subject: History and Geography
en: Conquered Cuzco in 1533
zh: 公元1533年征服库斯科

subject: History and Geography
en: European diseases weakened the Inca.
zh: 欧洲疾病削弱了印加人。

subject: History and Geography
en: Last Inca ruler captured and killed by Spanish in 1572; Inca realm absorbed by Spanish crown
zh: 最后一位印加统治者于1572年被西班牙人俘获并杀害；印加领土被西班牙王室吞并

subject: History and Geography
en: North and south finally united by northern general, Yang Jian, who became Emperor Wendi
zh: 北方将领杨坚最终统一南北，成为隋文帝。

subject: History and Geography
en: Rise of Sui dynasty in 581 CE
zh: 隋朝于公元581年兴起

subject: History and Geography
en: China united and ruled once again from old capital, Chang’an
zh: 中国再度统一，并以旧都长安为统治中心

subject: History and Geography
en: Emperor Wendi establishes new administrative bureaucracy; exam based placement in civil service
zh: 隋文帝建立新的行政官僚体系；以考试选拔文官

subject: History and Geography
en: Sui dynasty falls due to failed military campaigns and financial excess
zh: 隋朝因军事征讨失败和财政挥霍而灭亡

subject: History and Geography
en: Emperor Wendi’s son, Emperor Yangdi, killed by government official in 618 CE
zh: 隋文帝之子隋炀帝于公元618年被朝廷官员所杀

subject: History and Geography
en: Chang’an captured by general Li Yuan; Li Yuan becomes known as Gaozu; first emperor of new Tang dynasty
zh: 长安被将领李渊攻占；李渊被称为高祖；成为新唐朝的第一位皇帝

subject: History and Geography
en: Gazozu creates new legal code.
zh: 高祖（Gaozu）制定新的法典。

subject: History and Geography
en: The Tang rule from 618 to 907 CE.
zh: 唐朝统治时期为公元618年至907年。

subject: History and Geography
en: Empress Wu Zhao a Tang ruler; only woman to have ruled China
zh: 武则天（武曌），唐朝统治者；中国历史上唯一一位女皇帝

subject: History and Geography
en: Golden age in China, particularly during reign of Emperor Xuanzong; cultural achievements; woodblock printing; poets Li Bai and Du Fu
zh: 中国的黄金时代，尤其在唐玄宗统治时期；文化成就；雕版印刷；诗人李白和杜甫

subject: History and Geography
en: Tea merchants gain great wealth.
zh: 茶商积累了巨额财富。

subject: History and Geography
en: World’s first paper money and gunpowder
zh: 世界上最早的纸币和火药

subject: History and Geography
en: Period after the Tang is called the Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period.
zh: 唐朝之后的时期称为五代十国时期。

subject: History and Geography
en: Zhao Kuangyin establishes Song dynasty; becomes Emperor Taizu
zh: 赵匡胤建立宋朝；成为宋太祖

subject: History and Geography
en: Increasing use of machinery and advances in agriculture
zh: 机械使用日益增多，农业取得进步

subject: History and Geography
en: New technologies such as magnetic compass, sternpost ship rudders, and movable type printing press
zh: 新技术，如指南针、船尾舵和活字印刷机

subject: History and Geography
en: Temüjin was born in the 1160s to nomads who lived on the steppe north of China, in the region now called Mongolia; better known as Genghis Khan; elected as ruler of all Mongolia
zh: 铁木真于1160年代出生于生活在中国北方草原的游牧家庭，该地区今称蒙古；他更为人熟知的名字是成吉思汗；被推举为整个蒙古的统治者

subject: History and Geography
en: Genghis Khan creates a law code; has Mongol language written down
zh: 成吉思汗制定法典；命人将蒙古语记录下来

subject: History and Geography
en: Mongols traveled, hunted, and fought on horseback.
zh: 蒙古人骑马出行、狩猎和作战。

subject: History and Geography
en: Launched successful assaults on cities in northern China; attacked Korean peninsula, and lands in modern-day Russia, Ukraine, and Poland
zh: 成功攻打中国北方城市；进攻朝鲜半岛以及今俄罗斯、乌克兰和波兰的土地

subject: History and Geography
en: Genghis Khan died in 1227; sons inherited parts of his empire; most powerful part inherited by grandson Kublai Khan
zh: 成吉思汗于1227年去世；诸子继承了帝国的一部分；最强大的部分由孙子忽必烈继承

subject: History and Geography
en: Between 1260 and 1271 CE, Kublai Khan’s forces conquered Song Empire in south China
zh: 公元1260年至1271年间，忽必烈的军队征服了中国南方的宋帝国

subject: History and Geography
en: Kublai Khan declares himself emperor of China; establishes capital at Beijing; adopts imperial name Shizu; his dynasty known as Yuan
zh: 忽必烈宣布自己为中国皇帝；定都北京；采用帝号世祖；其王朝称为元朝

subject: History and Geography
en: Expansion of trade
zh: 贸易扩张

subject: History and Geography
en: Marco Polo (c.1254–1324) visits China; later wrote of his adventures Il milione (The million)
zh: 马可·波罗（约1254–1324）访问中国；后来在《马可·波罗游记》（Il milione，意为“百万”）中记述了他的冒险经历

subject: History and Geography
en: Yuan dynasty declines after death of Kublai Khan
zh: 忽必烈去世后，元朝开始衰落

subject: History and Geography
en: New emperor, Hongwu, establishes Ming dynasty; distinctive style of pottery
zh: 新皇帝洪武建立明朝；独具特色的瓷器风格

subject: History and Geography
en: Great Wall construction
zh: 长城的修筑

subject: History and Geography
en: Construct new palace complex in Beijing, known as Forbidden City
zh: 在北京修建新的宫殿建筑群，即紫禁城

subject: History and Geography
en: Zheng He’s fleet
zh: 郑和的船队

subject: History and Geography
en: Ming dynasty taken over by the Manchu; they establish China’s final dynasty as the Qing.
zh: 明朝被满族接管；他们建立了中国最后一个王朝——清朝。

subject: History and Geography
topic: Civilizations of Korea, Japan, and Southeast Asia
en: East Asia and Southeast Asia includes China and lands to the north, south, and east; present-day Korea and Japan typically considered part of East Asia, as well as Vietnam, Cambodia, Thailand, Laos, Malaysia, Indonesia, and the Philippines
zh: 东亚和东南亚包括中国及其以北、以南和以东的土地；现今的韩国和日本通常被视为东亚的一部分，越南、柬埔寨、泰国、老挝、马来西亚、印度尼西亚和菲律宾亦然

subject: History and Geography
topic: Civilizations of Korea, Japan, and Southeast Asia
en: East and Southeast Asia lie in and along the coast of Pacific Ocean.
zh: 东亚和东南亚位于太平洋及其沿岸。

subject: History and Geography
topic: Civilizations of Korea, Japan, and Southeast Asia
en: Peninsulas and archipelagos; western curve of Ring of Fire
zh: 半岛与群岛；环太平洋火山带的西侧弧线

subject: History and Geography
topic: Civilizations of Korea, Japan, and Southeast Asia
en: Tsunamis; typhoons
zh: 海啸；台风

subject: History and Geography
topic: Civilizations of Korea, Japan, and Southeast Asia
en: Mount Fuji
zh: 富士山

subject: History and Geography
topic: Civilizations of Korea, Japan, and Southeast Asia
en: Many early settlements emerged on or near coastline
zh: 许多早期聚居地出现在海岸线上或附近

subject: History and Geography
topic: Civilizations of Korea, Japan, and Southeast Asia
en: Agriculture developed in river valleys and limited plains regions.
zh: 农业在河谷和有限的平原地区发展起来。

subject: History and Geography
topic: Civilizations of Korea, Japan, and Southeast Asia
en: 2000 BCE, people began to live in more concentrated farming villages; dolmens
zh: 公元前2000年，人们开始生活在更为集中的农耕村落；支石墓（dolmens）

subject: History and Geography
topic: Civilizations of Korea, Japan, and Southeast Asia
en: 700 BCE rice is grown as a staple; 300s BCE bronze metalwork given way to iron; jade and pottery Timeline
zh: 公元前700年，水稻成为主要作物；公元前300年代，青铜铸造让位于铁器；玉器与陶器 时间线

subject: History and Geography
topic: Civilizations of Korea, Japan, and Southeast Asia
en: 700s to 400s BCE, some towns united into first complex state in the peninsula, Gojoseon
zh: 公元前700年至400年间，一些城镇联合成为半岛上第一个复杂的国家——古朝鲜

subject: History and Geography
topic: Civilizations of Korea, Japan, and Southeast Asia
en: 108 BCE north of Korea conquered by Han dynasty of China; later, four rival states emerged (18 BCE to 660 CE); referred to as Three Kingdoms period
zh: 公元前108年，朝鲜北部被中国汉朝征服；后来出现四个敌对政权（公元前18年至公元660年）；称为三国时期

subject: History and Geography
topic: Civilizations of Korea, Japan, and Southeast Asia
en: Societal class system
zh: 社会等级制度

subject: History and Geography
topic: Civilizations of Korea, Japan, and Southeast Asia
en: Korea unified by Silla kingdom in late 600s CE, aided by Chinese Tang dynasty; called Unified Silla kingdom
zh: 公元7世纪末，朝鲜在中国唐朝帮助下由新罗王国统一，称为统一新罗王国。

subject: History and Geography
topic: Civilizations of Korea, Japan, and Southeast Asia
en: Unified Silla monarchs came from Kim clan; organized kingdom into nine provinces run by governors appointed by the king
zh: 统一新罗的君主出自金氏家族；将王国划分为九个州，由国王任命的总督治理

subject: History and Geography
topic: Civilizations of Korea, Japan, and Southeast Asia
en: Unified Silla kingdom declines in 900s CE; replaced by Goryeo (or Koryo) dynasty
zh: 统一新罗王国于公元10世纪衰落；被高丽王朝（Goryeo 或 Koryo）取代

subject: History and Geography
en: Yayoi began in 300 BCE
zh: 弥生时代始于公元前300年

subject: History and Geography
en: Increased rice and vegetable production due to introduction of irrigation
zh: 由于灌溉的引入，水稻和蔬菜产量增加

subject: History and Geography
en: Yayoi divided among clans
zh: 弥生时代的人群分为各个氏族

subject: History and Geography
en: Kofun period lasted from 250 to 538 CE; burial mounds; introduction of Shinto beliefs; kami
zh: 古坟时代从公元250年持续到538年；墓葬土丘；神道信仰的引入；神（kami）

subject: History and Geography
en: Yamato clan establishes power in regions around present-day Kyoto, Nara, and Osaka
zh: 大和氏族在现今京都、奈良和大阪周边地区确立权势

subject: History and Geography
en: Emperor Kimmei, 539 to 571 CE; beginning of Asuka period
zh: 钦明天皇，公元539年至571年；飞鸟时代的开始

subject: History and Geography
en: Japanese emperors believed to be direct descendants of sun goddess, Amaterasu
zh: 日本天皇被认为是太阳女神天照大神的直接后裔

subject: History and Geography
en: Prince Shotoku ruled as regent when Empress Suiko was on throne
zh: 推古天皇在位时，圣德太子以摄政身份执政

subject: History and Geography
en: Well organized bureaucratic government cap system
zh: 组织严密的官僚政府；冠位制度

subject: History and Geography
en: Emperors ruled from city of Nara from 710 to 794 CE
zh: 公元710年至794年间，天皇从奈良城进行统治

subject: History and Geography
en: Emperor Shomu (724 to 749 CE), established Buddhist temple in every province in Japan
zh: 圣武天皇（公元724年至749年），在日本每个藩国建立佛教寺庙

subject: History and Geography
en: Heian period established major central rule at city now called Kyoto
zh: 平安时代在现今称为京都的城市建立了重要的中央统治

subject: History and Geography
en: Heian nobility and cultural achievements including establishment of Japanese writing system; The Tale of Genji by Murasaki Shikibu
zh: 平安时代的贵族与文化成就，包括日本文字体系的建立；紫式部的《源氏物语》

subject: History and Geography
en: Regional landlords raise private armies of warriors, called samurai
zh: 地方领主组建私人武士军队，称为武士（samurai）

subject: History and Geography
en: Samurai bound to serve regional lords, called daimyo
zh: 武士必须效忠地方领主，称为大名（daimyo）

subject: History and Geography
en: Genpei War (1180 to 1185 CE); clash between rival daimyo
zh: 源平合战（公元1180年至1185年）；敌对大名之间的冲突

subject: History and Geography
en: Minamoto Yoritomo declares himself shogun; Kamakura period, improvements to infrastructure
zh: 源赖朝自称征夷大将军（shogun）；镰仓时代，基础设施得到改善

subject: History and Geography
en: Samurai develop code of ethics and cultural practices known as bushido.
zh: 武士形成了被称为武士道（bushido）的道德准则和文化习俗。

subject: History and Geography
en: Tea ceremony and ink-brush calligraphy developed in this period
zh: 茶道和毛笔书法在这一时期发展起来

subject: History and Geography
en: Mongols and dynastic changes
zh: 蒙古人与王朝更迭

subject: History and Geography
en: Japan entered warring states period between 1467 to 1615 CE; ongoing civil war
zh: 日本于公元1467年至1615年间进入战国时期；内战持续不断

subject: History and Geography
en: Portuguese trade; firearms; Christianity
zh: 葡萄牙贸易；火器；基督教

subject: History and Geography
en: Tokugawa clan take power in early 1600s; ruled from Edo, present-day Tokyo
zh: 德川氏族于17世纪初掌权；从江户（今东京）进行统治

subject: History and Geography
en: Tokugawa shogunate closed off Japan to rest of world
zh: 德川幕府使日本与世界其他地区隔绝

subject: History and Geography
en: Modern country of Vietnam located on Indochinese peninsula
zh: 现代越南位于中南半岛（印度支那半岛）上

subject: History and Geography
en: Khmer ethnic group built an empire; Angkor Wat
zh: 高棉族建立了一个帝国；吴哥窟

subject: History and Geography
en: Khmer empire ended when capital Angkor captured by Thai people in 1432 CE
zh: 公元1432年，都城吴哥被泰族人攻占，高棉帝国灭亡

subject: History and Geography
en: 1350 CE, Thai kingdom called Ayutthaya rose to power; capital Bangkok
zh: 公元1350年，名为阿瑜陀耶的泰国王国崛起；首都曼谷

subject: History and Geography
en: Ayutthaya kingdom ruled over large area of Southeast Asia for four centuries
zh: 阿瑜陀耶王国统治东南亚大片地区达四个世纪

subject: History and Geography
en: Malay people emerged in Malay peninsula, now modern country of Indonesia; eventually rule of Java and Sumatra Timeline
zh: 马来人出现在马来半岛，即今印度尼西亚所在地；最终统治了爪哇和苏门答腊 时间线

subject: History and Geography
en: Continent of Europe
zh: 欧洲大陆

subject: History and Geography
en: Russia
zh: 俄罗斯

subject: History and Geography
en: Atlantic Ocean, Mediterranean Sea
zh: 大西洋、地中海

subject: History and Geography
en: Middle East; north Africa
zh: 中东；北非

subject: History and Geography
en: Eastern Europe
zh: 东欧

subject: History and Geography
en: Moscow
zh: 莫斯科

subject: History and Geography
en: Novgorod and Kyiv
zh: 诺夫哥罗德和基辅

subject: History and Geography
en: Dnieper River
zh: 第聂伯河

subject: History and Geography
en: Also called the medieval period, the Middle Ages lasted from about 500 CE to 1500 CE
zh: 中世纪又称中古时期，大约从公元500年延续到公元1500年

subject: History and Geography
en: The term Middle Ages designates an era of European history between the classical period of ancient Greece and Rome and the Renaissance
zh: “中世纪”一词指欧洲历史上介于古希腊罗马古典时期与文艺复兴之间的时代

subject: History and Geography
en: Historians generally break the Middle Ages into three periods: the early Middle Ages (500 CE to 1000 CE), the High Middle Ages (1000 CE to 1300 CE), and the late Middle Ages (1300 CE to 1500 CE)
zh: 历史学家一般将中世纪分为三个时期：早期中世纪（公元500年至1000年）、盛期中世纪（公元1000年至1300年）和晚期中世纪（公元1300年至1500年）

subject: History and Geography
en: Aristocracy originated from Roman nobles
zh: 贵族阶层起源于罗马的贵族

subject: History and Geography
en: Aristocratic status was largely hereditary.
zh: 贵族身份基本上是世袭的。

subject: History and Geography
en: Aristocracy held most of the land, and virtually all military and political power.
zh: 贵族占有大部分土地，并几乎掌握了全部军事和政治权力。

subject: History and Geography
en: Roman Empire had established many aspects of social structure which largely fell apart after fall of Rome
zh: 罗马帝国确立的社会结构在许多方面于罗马灭亡后基本瓦解

subject: History and Geography
en: Groups such as the Alemanni, Franks, Angles, Saxons, Vandals, Visigoths, and others began to migrate into the empire’s territory in the third century CE, establishing their own regional cultures.
zh: 公元三世纪，阿勒曼尼人、法兰克人、盎格鲁人、撒克逊人、汪达尔人、西哥特人等部落开始迁入帝国领土，建立起自己的地域文化。

subject: History and Geography
en: With the decline of the Western Roman Empire, the only European-wide system was the Christian Church.
zh: 随着西罗马帝国的衰落，基督教教会成为全欧洲唯一的广泛体系。

subject: History and Geography
en: Constantine made Christianity the official religion of the Roman Empire in 380 CE.
zh: 公元380年，君士坦丁将基督教定为罗马帝国的国教。

subject: History and Geography
en: Most important bishop within the hierarchy of the Church was the bishop of Rome (pope).
zh: 教会等级体系中最重要的主教是罗马主教（教皇）。

subject: History and Geography
en: In the eighth century CE, the kingdom of the Franks was one of the strongest in Europe; one of its kings rose to power—Charles the Great or Charlemagne.
zh: 公元八世纪，法兰克王国是欧洲最强大的王国之一；其一位国王崛起掌权——即查理大帝（查理曼）。

subject: History and Geography
en: Under Charlemagne, monastic libraries grew.
zh: 在查理曼统治下，修道院图书馆得到了发展。

subject: History and Geography
en: Growth of Charlemagne’s empire
zh: 查理曼帝国的扩张

subject: History and Geography
en: Parts of Charlemagne’s lands eventually became lands of Germany and France.
zh: 查理曼的部分领土最终成为德国和法国的土地。

subject: History and Geography
en: New period of greater calm began in Europe in 1000 CE.
zh: 公元1000年，欧洲开始了一段更为安定的新时期。

subject: History and Geography
en: Population increased, as did life expectancy.
zh: 人口增长，预期寿命也提高了。

subject: History and Geography
en: Growth of towns and economy
zh: 城镇与经济的发展

subject: History and Geography
en: High Middle Ages saw development of organized feudal system
zh: 盛期中世纪出现了有组织的封建制度

subject: History and Geography
en: Feudalism evolved into complex hierarchy dominated by royals and nobles
zh: 封建制度演变为由王室和贵族主导的复杂等级体系

subject: History and Geography
en: Europe was politically divided into kingdoms (ruled by a king) and principalities (ruled by a prince, duke, or count).
zh: 欧洲在政治上分为王国（由国王统治）和公国（由亲王、公爵或伯爵统治）。

subject: History and Geography
en: Gatherings of political advisors evolved into parliaments.
zh: 政治顾问的集会逐渐演变为议会。

subject: History and Geography
en: Timeline
zh: 时间线

subject: History and Geography
en: Bond of loyalty a defining feature of feudalism
zh: 忠诚的纽带是封建制度的一个决定性特征

subject: History and Geography
en: Distribution of land, and expansion of agricultural lands
zh: 土地的分配与农业用地的扩张

subject: History and Geography
en: Development of a new plow, and changing farming methods; three-field rotation
zh: 新式犁的发明与耕作方法的改变；三圃轮作制

subject: History and Geography
en: Military structure of the High Middle Ages dominated by mounted, armored knights and infantry
zh: 盛期中世纪的军事结构以骑马披甲的骑士和步兵为主

subject: History and Geography
en: Castle strongholds
zh: 城堡要塞

subject: History and Geography
en: The English introduced longbows into warfare.
zh: 英格兰人将长弓引入战争。

subject: History and Geography
en: Introduction of gunpowder
zh: 火药的引入

subject: History and Geography
en: By the end of the thirteenth century there were over a dozen universities in Europe.
zh: 到十三世纪末，欧洲已有十几所大学。

subject: History and Geography
en: A manor was a rural, self-contained farming unit.
zh: 庄园是一个自给自足的乡村农业单位。

subject: History and Geography
en: Peasants worked on the manorial lands and were bound to the manorial lands by contract
zh: 农民在庄园土地上劳作，并通过契约被束缚于庄园土地

subject: History and Geography
en: Peasants had little social power (serfs).
zh: 农民几乎没有社会权力（农奴）。

subject: History and Geography
en: Inhabited by trades people, artisans, craftspeople
zh: 居住着商人、工匠和手艺人

subject: History and Geography
en: By 1100s, many towns had established guilds.
zh: 到12世纪，许多城镇已建立了行会。

subject: History and Geography
en: Apprenticeship system
zh: 学徒制

subject: History and Geography
en: Merchants and expanded trade links across Europe
zh: 商人与遍及欧洲的贸易网络的扩展

subject: History and Geography
en: Silk road continued to be an important trade route for goods and ideas.
zh: 丝绸之路仍然是货物与思想交流的重要贸易路线。

subject: History and Geography
en: The Church reached its greatest influence in the High Middle Ages.
zh: 教会在盛期中世纪达到了最大的影响力。

subject: History and Geography
en: Nearly everyone’s life revolved around the Church.
zh: 几乎所有人的生活都围绕着教会展开。

subject: History and Geography
en: Clergy were the main source of education and held great social and political power.
zh: 神职人员是教育的主要来源，并拥有巨大的社会和政治权力。

subject: History and Geography
en: Church architecture began to change during this period; abbey church of Saint-Denis
zh: 这一时期教会建筑开始发生变化；圣但尼修道院教堂

subject: History and Geography
en: Mechanical clock developed for the Church in second half of thirteenth century
zh: 十三世纪下半叶为教会研制了机械钟

subject: History and Geography
en: In High Middle Ages Europeans had expanded interest in the Holy Land.
zh: 盛期中世纪，欧洲人对圣地的兴趣日益增加。

subject: History and Geography
en: Rise of Islam
zh: 伊斯兰教的兴起

subject: History and Geography
en: In 1096 CE, the pope called for a crusade to take back the Holy Land for Christianity.
zh: 公元1096年，教皇号召发动十字军东征，为基督教夺回圣地。

subject: History and Geography
en: Christians captured Jerusalem in 1099 CE.
zh: 公元1099年，基督徒攻占了耶路撒冷。

subject: History and Geography
en: Knights Templars were a Christian military order founded around 1118 CE.
zh: 圣殿骑士团是约公元1118年成立的基督教军事修会。

subject: History and Geography
en: Europe’s population began to slow around 1300 CE.
zh: 公元1300年前后，欧洲人口增长开始放缓。

subject: History and Geography
en: Crop failure, famine, and population decline
zh: 庄稼歉收、饥荒与人口下降

subject: History and Geography
en: Black Death, 1347 CE; drastic decline in population
zh: 黑死病，公元1347年；人口急剧下降

subject: History and Geography
en: Social and Political upheaval
zh: 社会与政治动荡

subject: History and Geography
en: Hundred Year’s War (1337–1453 CE); Peasant’s Revolt, 1381 CE
zh: 百年战争（公元1337–1453年）；农民起义，公元1381年

subject: History and Geography
en: System of feudalism began to decline.
zh: 封建制度开始衰落。

subject: History and Geography
en: Johannes Gutenberg printing press 1440 CE
zh: 约翰内斯·古腾堡印刷机，公元1440年

subject: History and Geography
en: Some of the patterns that defined medieval Europe were also part of medieval Russia, but there were ways in which Russia was quite different.
zh: 定义中世纪欧洲的一些模式也存在于中世纪俄罗斯，但俄罗斯在某些方面截然不同。

subject: History and Geography
en: While many peoples lived in the region in and around Russia, the Slavs and the Rus were two groups that became important.
zh: 虽然有许多民族生活在俄罗斯及其周边地区，但斯拉夫人和罗斯人成为两个重要的族群。

subject: History and Geography
en: Byzantine missionaries brought Christianity to Russia around 900 CE.
zh: 公元900年前后，拜占庭传教士将基督教带入俄罗斯。

subject: History and Geography
en: By the eleventh century Russia incorporated more long-distance trade than the West, and the cultural touchstones of art, literature, and architecture were more developed.
zh: 到十一世纪，俄罗斯的长途贸易比西方更为发达，艺术、文学和建筑等文化标志也更成熟。

subject: History and Geography
en: Mongols defeated Rus in 1223 CE.
zh: 公元1223年，蒙古人击败了罗斯人。

subject: History and Geography
en: Mongols created the largest contiguous empire the world has ever known.
zh: 蒙古人建立了有史以来最大的连绵帝国。

subject: History and Geography
en: The Mongol invasion of Kievan Rus in 1223 CE left Russia with only a few small areas, such as Novgorod, remaining outside of Mongol control.
zh: 公元1223年蒙古人入侵基辅罗斯，使俄罗斯仅剩下诺夫哥罗德等少数小地区未受蒙古控制。

subject: History and Geography
en: The prince of Novgorod, Alexander Nevsky, maintained independence by negotiating with the Mongols. From this arose a new country, the Grand Principality of Moscow, or Muscovy.
zh: 诺夫哥罗德公爵亚历山大·涅夫斯基通过与蒙古人谈判维持了独立。由此产生了一个新的国家——莫斯科大公国（Muscovy）。

subject: History and Geography
en: A strong ruler named Ivan became the grand prince of Muscovy in 1462 CE (Ivan the Great).
zh: 公元1462年，一位强有力的统治者伊凡成为莫斯科大公国的君主（伊凡大帝）。

subject: History and Geography
en: Ivan the Great demonstrated military and political strength; developed strong central government; foundations of modern Russia
zh: 伊凡大帝展现出军事和政治实力；建立了强大的中央政府；奠定了现代俄罗斯的基础

subject: History and Geography
en: Continent of Africa
zh: 非洲大陆

subject: History and Geography
en: Great diversity of climate and geographical zones across the continent of Africa including grassy savannas
zh: 非洲大陆气候和地理区域极为多样，包括草木茂盛的热带稀树草原

subject: History and Geography
en: Atlantic Ocean, Indian Ocean, Mediterranean Sea, Red Sea
zh: 大西洋、印度洋、地中海、红海

subject: History and Geography
en: Middle East
zh: 中东

subject: History and Geography
en: Sahara Desert; Kalahari Desert; Sahel
zh: 撒哈拉沙漠；卡拉哈里沙漠；萨赫勒地区

subject: History and Geography
en: Sinai Peninsula
zh: 西奈半岛

subject: History and Geography
en: Nile, Niger, and Congo Rivers
zh: 尼罗河、尼日尔河和刚果河

subject: History and Geography
en: Atlas Mountains
zh: 阿特拉斯山脉

subject: History and Geography
en: Mount Kilimanjaro
zh: 乞力马扎罗山

subject: History and Geography
en: Madagascar (fourth largest island on earth) B. Background The vast continent of Africa has a great diversity of landscapes, resources, and cultures. Between the sixth and sixteenth centuries CE, several civilizations in North and West Africa served as important centers of trade and cultural exchange. The three great West African empires of Ghana, Mali, and Songhai rose to power in part because they controlled gold mines, salt mines, and the trade routes that linked these valuable resources to the rest of the world.
zh: 马达加斯加（世界第四大岛）B. 背景 广袤的非洲大陆拥有极其多样的景观、资源和文化。公元六世纪至十六世纪间，北非和西非的若干文明成为重要的贸易与文化交流中心。西非三大帝国——加纳、马里和桑海——之所以崛起，部分原因在于它们控制了金矿、盐矿以及将这些宝贵资源与世界其他地区连接起来的贸易路线。

subject: History and Geography
en: Several African civilizations enjoyed incredible prosperity, growing trade, and cross cultural connections.
zh: 一些非洲文明享有令人难以置信的繁荣、不断增长的贸易以及跨文化联系。

subject: History and Geography
en: This growth was helped by greater contact between Africans and the empires that ruled the regions surrounding Africa.
zh: 这种增长得益于非洲人与统治非洲周边地区的帝国之间更密切的接触。

subject: History and Geography
en: Spread of Christianity and Islam
zh: 基督教与伊斯兰教的传播

subject: History and Geography
en: Trans-Saharan trade fueled the rise of three mighty empires in West Africa. The Ghana, Mali, and Songhai Empires emerged in succession between the 400s and the 1400s CE
zh: 跨撒哈拉贸易推动了西非三个强大帝国的崛起。加纳、马里和桑海帝国在公元5世纪至15世纪间相继出现

subject: History and Geography
en: West Africa was an important regional trade center that connected different parts of Africa as well as China, India, Arabia, and Europe
zh: 西非是重要的区域贸易中心，连接非洲不同地区以及中国、印度、阿拉伯和欧洲。

subject: History and Geography
en: Each of the three empires benefited from the region’s deposits of gold and salt
zh: 这三个帝国都受益于该地区的金矿和盐矿资源

subject: History and Geography
en: Situated south of the Sahara in the relatively less arid region of the Sahel, the Ghana Empire began as a regional kingdom of the Soninke people, who were part of a larger ethnic and language group called the Mande. Timeline
zh: 加纳帝国位于撒哈拉以南相对干旱程度较低的萨赫勒地区，最初是索宁克人的一个地区性王国，索宁克人属于一个更大的族群和语言群体——曼德人。时间线

subject: History and Geography
en: Most of what is known about the Ghana Empire has been passed down through either oral tradition or texts written by Arab merchants.
zh: 关于加纳帝国的大多数已知信息，都是通过口述传统或阿拉伯商人撰写的文献流传下来的。

subject: History and Geography
en: It is likely that the main city was Koumbi Saleh (located in present-day Mauritania), which was home to thousands of people.
zh: 其主要城市很可能是库姆比萨莱赫（位于今天的毛里塔尼亚），那里居住着数千人。

subject: History and Geography
en: The people of the Ghana Empire originally practiced an animist religion, as was common throughout West Africa.
zh: 加纳帝国的人民最初信奉万物有灵论宗教，这在整个西非都很常见。

subject: History and Geography
en: As Islamic civilization began to spread in the 700s CE, more and more Muslim merchants, diplomats, and others made their way to the Ghana Empire.
zh: 随着伊斯兰文明在公元8世纪开始传播，越来越多的穆斯林商人、外交官和其他人来到加纳帝国。

subject: History and Geography
en: By the end of the twelfth century CE, the Ghana Empire was an Islamic society.
zh: 到十二世纪末，加纳帝国已成为一个伊斯兰社会。

subject: History and Geography
en: Conflict with various external groups weakened the empire, as did a change in climate and weather patterns.
zh: 与各种外部群体的冲突削弱了帝国，气候和天气模式的变化也造成了同样的后果。

subject: History and Geography
en: Rise of West African kingdom of Mali began in 1235 CE when Mandinka leader called Sundiata Keita (Lion Prince or Hungering Prince) became the mansa, or emperor
zh: 西非马里王国的崛起始于公元1235年，当时曼丁卡人领袖松迪亚塔·凯塔（狮子王子或饥饿王子）成为“曼萨”（即皇帝）

subject: History and Geography
en: Sundiata Keita fortified trade routes and took control of the gold mines.
zh: 松迪亚塔·凯塔加固了贸易路线并控制了金矿。

subject: History and Geography
en: City of Timbuktu became an important cosmopolitan center of the Mali Empire.
zh: 廷巴克图城成为马里帝国重要的国际化中心。

subject: History and Geography
en: Mali Empire taxed the goods that came through Timbuktu and their other cities
zh: 马里帝国对经过廷巴克图及其他城市的货物征税

subject: History and Geography
en: Most powerful ruler of the Mali Empire was Mansa Musa, who reigned from 1312 to 1337 CE; doubled size of the empire; became one of the richest men in the world
zh: 马里帝国最强大的统治者是曼萨·穆萨，他在公元1312年至1337年在位；使帝国面积扩大了一倍；成为世界上最富有的人之一

subject: History and Geography
en: Around 1324 CE, Mansa Musa undertook a pilgrimage to Mecca.
zh: 约公元1324年，曼萨·穆萨前往麦加朝圣。

subject: History and Geography
en: Mansa Musa supported the construction of mosques, Islamic schools, libraries, and universities.
zh: 曼萨·穆萨支持修建清真寺、伊斯兰学校、图书馆和大学。

subject: History and Geography
en: A combination of factors led to the eventual decline of Mali’s power. F. Songhai Empire: Background The vast continent of Africa has a great diversity of landscapes, resources, and cultures. Between the sixth and sixteenth centuries CE, several civilizations in North and West Africa served as important centers of trade and cultural exchange. The three great West African empires of Ghana, Mali, and Songhai rose to power in part because they controlled gold mines, salt mines, and the trade routes that linked these valuable resources to the rest of the world.
zh: 多种因素共同导致了马里势力的最终衰落。F. 桑海帝国：背景 广袤的非洲大陆拥有极其多样的景观、资源和文化。公元六世纪至十六世纪间，北非和西非的若干文明成为重要的贸易与文化交流中心。西非三大帝国——加纳、马里和桑海——之所以崛起，部分原因在于它们控制了金矿、盐矿以及将这些宝贵资源与世界其他地区连接起来的贸易路线。

subject: History and Geography
en: Songhai kings attacked and raided Mali cities.
zh: 桑海国王们袭击并劫掠了马里的城市。

subject: History and Geography
en: One king, named Sunni Ali, used his strong army and naval force to control travel on the Niger.
zh: 一位名叫桑尼·阿里的国王利用其强大的陆军和水军控制了尼日尔河上的通行。

subject: History and Geography
en: By 1468, Sunni Ali had conquered most of the territory once held by the Mali Empire.
zh: 到1468年，桑尼·阿里已征服了曾属于马里帝国的大部分领土。

subject: History and Geography
en: By 1500, the Songhai Empire stretched even farther to the north and east than Mali had.
zh: 到1500年，桑海帝国的疆域向北和向东延伸得比马里还要远。

subject: History and Geography
en: Askia Muhammad, the first Songhai emperor, developed more trade with Asia and Europe.
zh: 桑海第一位皇帝阿斯基亚·穆罕默德发展了与亚洲和欧洲的更多贸易。

subject: History and Geography
en: Askia Muhammad sought to increase the influence of Islam in the empire; he supported the building of mosques and brought many Arab scholars to the university in Timbuktu, which created a golden age of learning in the region.
zh: 阿斯基亚·穆罕默德力图扩大伊斯兰教在帝国中的影响力；他支持修建清真寺，并将许多阿拉伯学者带到廷巴克图的大学，从而在该地区创造了学术的黄金时代。

subject: History and Geography
en: The Tomb of Askia, a grand structure that is part of the Great Mosque of Gao, is said to be his place of burial. It is the largest historical monument in West Africa.
zh: 阿斯基亚陵墓是一座宏伟的建筑，属于加奥大清真寺的一部分，据说是他的安葬之地。它是西非最大的历史古迹。

subject: History and Geography
en: In the late 1500s, internal strife, drought, and disease began to fray the Songhai Empire.
zh: 16世纪后期，内乱、干旱和疾病开始削弱桑海帝国。

subject: History and Geography
en: New influences entered West Africa as Portuguese and other European traders and explorers gained the ability to travel to the region in the 1400s.
zh: 15世纪，葡萄牙和其他欧洲商人与探险家获得了前往该地区的能力，新的影响力随之进入西非。

subject: History and Geography
en: The arrival of Europeans changed the form and scale of the African slave trade.
zh: 欧洲人的到来改变了非洲奴隶贸易的形式和规模。

subject: History and Geography
en: Portuguese explorers and traders began to set up trading posts on the African coast in the 1440s.
zh: 15世纪40年代，葡萄牙探险家和商人开始在非洲海岸设立贸易站。

subject: History and Geography
en: The Portuguese traded in goods that the local trading networks produced; included trade of enslaved people
zh: 葡萄牙人交易当地贸易网络生产的商品；包括奴隶贸易

subject: History and Geography
subtopic: Ibn Battuta, Griots and Oral Traditions
en: A geographer and avid traveler, Ibn Battuta was a fourteenth-century Muslim scholar from Morocco; his travels in West Africa took place from 1349 to 1354 CE.
zh: 伊本·白图泰是一位地理学家和热衷的旅行者，是来自摩洛哥的14世纪穆斯林学者；他在西非的旅行发生在公元1349年至1354年。

subject: History and Geography
subtopic: Ibn Battuta, Griots and Oral Traditions
en: He wrote detailed accounts about his experiences and drew maps of his voyages.
zh: 他详细记录了自己的经历，并绘制了旅行地图。

subject: History and Geography
subtopic: Ibn Battuta, Griots and Oral Traditions
en: Griots are important figures in West African cultures.
zh: 格里奥特（说书人）是西非文化中的重要人物。

subject: History and Geography
subtopic: Ibn Battuta, Griots and Oral Traditions
en: Griots serve as historians, genealogists, storytellers, poets, musicians, praise singers, and authority figures.
zh: 格里奥特充当历史学家、谱系学家、说书人、诗人、音乐家、赞颂歌手和权威人物。

subject: History and Geography
subtopic: Ibn Battuta, Griots and Oral Traditions
en: The role of griot was hereditary and a position of honor.
zh: 格里奥特的角色是世袭的，也是受人尊敬的职位。

subject: History and Geography
subtopic: Ibn Battuta, Griots and Oral Traditions
en: Griots told social and family histories that were passed down from one generation to the next through stories and songs.
zh: 格里奥特讲述社会史和家族史，这些历史通过故事和歌曲代代相传。

subject: History and Geography
subtopic: Ibn Battuta, Griots and Oral Traditions
en: Instruments such as the kora (similar to a harp) and the balafon (similar to a xylophone) accompanied the words and lyrics.
zh: 科拉琴（类似竖琴）和巴拉丰琴（类似木琴）等乐器为说唱和歌词伴奏。

subject: History and Geography
subtopic: Ibn Battuta, Griots and Oral Traditions
en: The tale of Sundiata Keita was preserved by griots for centuries.
zh: 松迪亚塔·凯塔的故事由格里奥特保存了数百年。

subject: History and Geography
subtopic: Ibn Battuta, Griots and Oral Traditions
en: Griots also functioned as record keepers for births, deaths, and marriages.
zh: 格里奥特还负责记录出生、死亡和婚姻。

subject: History and Geography
en: Atlantic Ocean, Mediterranean Sea, Arabian Sea, Adriatic Sea B. Background The word Renaissance means rebirth. It is used to describe the years 1300 to 1600 CE in Italy and 1450 to 1650 CE in northern Europe. This era was a “rebirth” because it involved the rediscovery of things learned in centuries past, particularly in ancient Greece and Rome. The government of the Western Roman Empire fell apart in the fifth century CE. Its education system also collapsed. The new rulers of western Europe were warriors and warlords. After the fall of Rome, western Europe fell out of contact with the Greek speaking Eastern Roman Empire. Greek was read and spoken less and less in the western part of the empire, and the knowledge of many subjects formerly taught in Greek faded. The Catholic Church was the main institution that survived the fall of Rome, and learning was preserved by Catholic monks in monasteries. By the twelfth century, the increasing wealth and power of European kingdoms had led to a new demand for learning.
zh: 大西洋、地中海、阿拉伯海、亚得里亚海 B. 背景 “文艺复兴”一词意为“重生”。它用来描述意大利公元1300年至1600年以及北欧公元1450年至1650年的时期。这个时代之所以被称为“重生”，是因为它涉及对过去几个世纪所学知识的重新发现，尤其是古希腊和罗马的知识。西罗马帝国的政府在公元五世纪垮台，其教育体系也随之崩溃。西欧新的统治者是武士和军阀。罗马灭亡后，西欧与讲希腊语的东罗马帝国失去联系。希腊语在帝国西部被阅读和使用的越来越少，许多过去用希腊语教授的学科知识逐渐失传。天主教会是罗马灭亡后幸存下来的主要机构，知识由修道院中的天主教修士保存下来。到十二世纪，欧洲王国日益增长的财富和权力引发了对知识的新需求。

subject: History and Geography
en: Monks in western Europe had preserved Latin writing; Greek texts were copied, read, and studied widely in areas under Muslim rule.
zh: 西欧的修士保存了拉丁文著作；在穆斯林统治的地区，希腊文献被广泛抄写、阅读和研究。

subject: History and Geography
en: Followers of Islam conquered most of the Eastern Roman Empire in the seventh and eighth centuries CE; they absorbed the Greek-speaking upper class of East Rome.
zh: 公元七、八世纪，伊斯兰教信徒征服了东罗马帝国的大部分地区；他们吸纳了东罗马讲希腊语的上层阶级。

subject: History and Geography
en: Muslims prized Greek texts for their contributions to medicine, philosophy, and science. Schools flourished for centuries in the Islamic Middle East, North Africa, and Iberia.
zh: 穆斯林珍视希腊文献，因为它们对医学、哲学和科学做出了贡献。学校在伊斯兰中东、北非和伊比利亚繁荣了数百年。

subject: History and Geography
en: Muslim scholars translated the writings of Aristotle, Euclid, Ptolemy, and more into Arabic.
zh: 穆斯林学者将亚里士多德、欧几里得、托勒密等人的著作翻译成阿拉伯语。

subject: History and Geography
en: Muslim scholars also wrote new works that advanced knowledge beyond that of the Greeks. Timeline
zh: 穆斯林学者还撰写了新的著作，将知识推进到超越希腊人的水平。时间线

subject: History and Geography
en: European scholars traveled to places such as Córdoba in search of Greek texts; also impressed and influenced by Muslim thinkers and their texts
zh: 欧洲学者前往科尔多瓦等地寻找希腊文献；同时也受到穆斯林思想家及其著作的打动和影响

subject: History and Geography
en: European scholars brought texts from the Muslim world to European centers of learning (universities).
zh: 欧洲学者将穆斯林世界的文献带回欧洲的学术中心（大学）。

subject: History and Geography
en: Europe’s economy had begun to grow quickly during the eleventh century. Italian cities, especially the port cities of Venice and Genoa, were among the first to display this new wealth, which came from trade.
zh: 11世纪，欧洲经济开始快速增长。意大利的城市，尤其是威尼斯和热那亚等港口城市，最先展现出这种来自贸易的新财富。

subject: History and Geography
en: Italy comprised of several kingdoms or states; each Italian city had its own government
zh: 意大利由若干王国或城邦组成；每个意大利城市都有自己的政府

subject: History and Geography
en: Trade caused more Italian cities to grow. Florence began to produce high-quality woolen fabric, often using wool from English sheep; rise of merchant class
zh: 贸易促使更多意大利城市成长。佛罗伦萨开始生产高质量的羊毛织物，通常使用英国绵羊的羊毛；商人阶层崛起

subject: History and Geography
en: Venetians excelled in trade; dominated ports of eastern and southern Mediterranean Sea
zh: 威尼斯人擅长贸易，主导了地中海东部和南部的港口。

subject: History and Geography
en: Florence developed an international trade in woolen cloth.
zh: 佛罗伦萨发展了毛织品的国际贸易。

subject: History and Geography
en: Florentines and other Italian bankers developed international banking networks.
zh: 佛罗伦萨人和其他意大利银行家建立了国际银行业网络。

subject: History and Geography
en: Guilds were organizations formed by skilled laborers called artisans. The guilds of Florence were wealthy and influential.
zh: 行会是由被称为工匠的熟练劳动者组成的组织。佛罗伦萨的行会富有且有影响力。

subject: History and Geography
en: Rome remained capital of the Catholic Church administration; papacy was part of European politics
zh: 罗马仍是天主教会行政中心；教皇制度是欧洲政治的一部分。

subject: History and Geography
en: Italy was the home of a new movement in literature and learning that transformed European thought.
zh: 意大利是一场改变欧洲思想的文学与学术新运动的发源地。

subject: History and Geography
en: Humanists began reading, collecting, and translating ancient Greek texts. Works by Homer, Sophocles, Thucydides, and more became more available to readers across Europe.
zh: 人文主义者开始阅读、收集和翻译古希腊文献。荷马、索福克勒斯、修昔底德等人的作品逐渐为全欧洲的读者所更易获得。

subject: History and Geography
en: Francis Petrarch (1304–74) was an important early humanist.
zh: 弗朗西斯·彼特拉克（1304–1374）是一位重要的早期人文主义者。

subject: History and Geography
en: Humanist study of languages extended to Hebrew and, by the late fifteenth century, included new scholarship on the Bible.
zh: 人文主义者的语言研究扩展到希伯来语，到十五世纪末，还包括对《圣经》的新研究。

subject: History and Geography
en: The Renaissance is famous for its artistic developments, which were the product of wealth and growth in the Italian cities.
zh: 文艺复兴以其艺术成就而闻名，这些成就是意大利城市财富与发展的产物。

subject: History and Geography
en: Humanists influenced the development of new architectural styles based on ancient buildings.
zh: 人文主义者影响了基于古代建筑的新建筑风格的发展。

subject: History and Geography
en: Painters of this era worked in shops and were members of guilds; learned by working as apprentices to a master painter
zh: 这一时期的画家在作坊里工作，并且是行会成员；通过给大师画家当学徒来学习

subject: History and Geography
en: Introduction of perspective in art
zh: 艺术中透视法的引入

subject: History and Geography
en: Banking made Cosimo de’ Medici (1389–1464) the wealthiest and most powerful man in Florence.
zh: 银行业使科西莫·德·美第奇（1389–1464）成为佛罗伦萨最富有、最有权势的人。

subject: History and Geography
en: Medici family dominated politics in Florence
zh: 美第奇家族主导了佛罗伦萨的政治

subject: History and Geography
en: Cosimo de’ Medici (1389–1464) a patron of the arts
zh: 科西莫·德·美第奇（1389–1464），艺术赞助人

subject: History and Geography
en: Lorenzo de’ Medici (1449–1492) patron to Sandro Botticelli (1445–1510), Andrea del Verrocchio (1435–88), Michelangelo Buonarotti (1475–1564), and Leonardo da Vinci (1452–1519)
zh: 洛伦佐·德·美第奇（1449–1492）是桑德罗·波提切利（1445–1510）、安德烈亚·德尔·韦罗基奥（1435–1488）、米开朗基罗·博纳罗蒂（1475–1564）和列奥纳多·达·芬奇（1452–1519）的赞助人

subject: History and Geography
en: Leonardo da Vinci painted the Last Supper, Mona Lisa
zh: 列奥纳多·达·芬奇创作了《最后的晚餐》和《蒙娜丽莎》

subject: History and Geography
en: Michelangelo Buonarroti (1475–1564) carved the Pietà and marble statue of David
zh: 米开朗基罗·博纳罗蒂（1475–1564）雕刻了《圣殇》和大理石雕像《大卫》

subject: History and Geography
en: Niccolò Machiavelli (1469–1527) known for his work the The Prince
zh: 尼可罗·马基雅维利（1469–1527）以其著作《君主论》而闻名

subject: History and Geography
en: Johannes Gutenberg (d. 1468), a German goldsmith by trade, began to print with movable type during the 1440s.
zh: 约翰内斯·古腾堡（卒于1468年）是一位德国金匠，于15世纪40年代开始使用活字印刷。

subject: History and Geography
en: The new printing process spread quickly to other cities; humanists welcomed the chance to print copies of ancient texts.
zh: 新的印刷工艺迅速传播到其他城市；人文主义者欣然接受印刷古籍副本的机会。

subject: History and Geography
en: Printing made all types of writing available to more people and enabled writers to profit from book sales.
zh: 印刷术使各类著作能为更多人所获得，并使作家能够从图书销售中获利。

subject: History and Geography
en: The most famous and influential religious reformer was Martin Luther (1483–1546); challenged the Roman Catholic Church
zh: 最著名、最有影响力的宗教改革家是马丁·路德（1483–1546）；他挑战了罗马天主教会

subject: History and Geography
en: Luther composed a list of ninety-five disagreements with Church doctrine (ninety-five theses); attached to church door October, 1517
zh: 路德列出了对教会教义的九十五条异议（九十五条论纲）；于1517年10月将其贴在教堂门上

subject: History and Geography
en: Luther condemned by Catholic Church as a heretic, someone who preaches heresy, in 1521
zh: 1521年，路德被天主教会谴责为异端，即宣扬异端邪说的人

subject: History and Geography
en: Luther translated the New Testament into German and wrote works that were printed and widely read.
zh: 路德将《新约》翻译成德语，并撰写了被印刷且广为阅读的著作。

subject: History and Geography
en: Some of the princes who ruled areas of the Holy Roman Empire supported Luther’s reforms.
zh: 统治神圣罗马帝国部分地区的一些诸侯支持路德的改革。

subject: History and Geography
en: In the cities of northern Europe, other religious leaders preached reform and sought to change their regional church practices with the help of their local governments.
zh: 在北欧的城市中，其他宗教领袖宣扬改革，并寻求在当地政府的帮助下改变本地区的教会习俗。

subject: History and Geography
en: John Calvin (1509–64) was the most important of the next generation of reformers.
zh: 约翰·加尔文（1509–1564）是下一代改革家中最重要的一位。

subject: History and Geography
en: Era in which European religion was dominated by a single united church was over, allowing dozens of religious beliefs to emerge.
zh: 欧洲宗教由单一统一教会主导的时代结束了，使得数十种宗教信仰得以出现。

subject: History and Geography
en: During and after the Reformation, periods of unrest and violence ensued.
zh: 在宗教改革期间及之后，出现了动荡和暴力的时期。

subject: History and Geography
en: Each Christian group often viewed others as heretical
zh: 每个基督教团体常常将其他团体视为异端

subject: History and Geography
en: In order to obtain a divorce, Catholic monarch Henry VIII of England, declared himself head of the Church of England; Protestantism arose in England.
zh: 为了获得离婚许可，英格兰的天主教君主亨利八世宣布自己为英格兰教会的领袖；新教由此在英格兰兴起。

subject: History and Geography
en: As part of his reforms, Henry VIII dissolved England’s monasteries and seized Church land and wealth.
zh: 作为改革的一部分，亨利八世解散了英格兰的修道院，并没收了教会的土地和财富。

subject: History and Geography
en: Astronomer and physicist, Galileo Galilei (1564–1642), supported theories held by Nicolaus Copernicus (1473–1543); confirming the Sun, not the Earth at the center of Solar System, conflicting with Roman theologians
zh: 天文学家和物理学家伽利略·伽利雷（1564–1642）支持尼古拉·哥白尼（1473–1543）的理论；证实太阳而非地球处于太阳系中心，与罗马神学家发生冲突

subject: History and Geography
en: Roman court condemned Galileo
zh: 罗马法庭谴责了伽利略

zh: 大西洋、太平洋、印度洋

zh: 刚果河
