subject: History and Geography
topic: East and Southeast Asia in the Second Half of Twentieth Century
en: Sea of Japan (East Sea) B. Globalization Communist governments rose to power in several Southeast Asian countries after World War II. Communist ideals appealed to people who had experienced little opportunity under the colonial system in Southeast Asia. Others in those countries, however, rejected communism and actively fought against it. Wars in Southeast Asia became theaters of conflict in the Cold War.
zh: 日本海（东海）B. 全球化 二战后，东南亚数国的共产党政府上台执政。共产主义理想吸引了那些在东南亚殖民制度下几乎没有任何机会的人们。然而，这些国家中另一些人拒绝共产主义并积极与之抗争。东南亚的战争成为冷战的冲突舞台。

subject: History and Geography
topic: East and Southeast Asia in the Second Half of Twentieth Century
en: Inspired by the ideas of Marx and Lenin, the Chinese Communist Party was formed; Mao Zedong was a leading member.
zh: 在马克思和列宁思想的启发下，中国共产党成立；毛泽东是主要成员之一。

subject: History and Geography
topic: East and Southeast Asia in the Second Half of Twentieth Century
en: Outbreak of Chinese Civil War (1927–1949) in which National Party and Communist Party opposed each other
zh: 国共内战（1927–1949）爆发，国民党与共产党相互对抗

subject: History and Geography
topic: East and Southeast Asia in the Second Half of Twentieth Century
en: Jiang Jieshi leader of the Nationalist Party
zh: 蒋介石为国民党领袖

subject: History and Geography
topic: East and Southeast Asia in the Second Half of Twentieth Century
en: Mao became the leader of the Communist Party; led his army on the longest wartime military march ever recorded (the Long March).
zh: 毛泽东成为共产党领袖；率领军队进行了有记录以来最长的战时行军（长征）。

subject: History and Geography
topic: East and Southeast Asia in the Second Half of Twentieth Century
en: Chinese Civil War paused in 1937; Nationalists and Communists united to fight expansionist aggression from Japan. Timeline
zh: 国共内战于1937年暂停；国民党与共产党联合抗击日本的扩张侵略。时间线

subject: History and Geography
topic: East and Southeast Asia in the Second Half of Twentieth Century
en: Major part of World War II in Asia, the Second Sino-Japanese War, began with attacks on Chinese cities such as Beijing, Shanghai, and Nanjing; alliance between Nationalists and Communists continued through World War II; the civil war resumed after 1945
zh: 二战在亚洲的主要部分——抗日战争（第二次中日战争）——以日军进攻北京、上海和南京等中国城市开始；国共联盟在二战期间持续；1945年后内战重启

subject: History and Geography
topic: East and Southeast Asia in the Second Half of Twentieth Century
en: After four years of post–World War II fighting, Mao’s forces won; declared China to be the People’s Republic of China
zh: 经过二战后四年的战斗，毛泽东的军队获胜；宣布中国为中华人民共和国

subject: History and Geography
topic: East and Southeast Asia in the Second Half of Twentieth Century
en: Jiang’s Nationalists fled to the island of Taiwan; set up an anti-communist, authoritarian government and continued calling it the Republic of China
zh: 蒋介石的国民党逃往台湾岛；建立了反共的威权政府，并继续称其为中华民国

subject: History and Geography
en: Mao remakes China into a communist nation; seized lands from private ownership; collectivization; forced increase of coal mining and steel production.
zh: 毛泽东将中国改造为共产主义国家；没收私人土地；实行集体化；强制增加煤炭开采和钢铁生产。

subject: History and Geography
en: Communist Party outlawed Confucianism, Buddhism, Christianity, and other religions.
zh: 共产党取缔儒教、佛教、基督教及其他宗教。

subject: History and Geography
en: Implementation of the Great Leap Forward in late 1950s; five-year plan; use of untested methods in irrigation and farming; people forced to join communes; crop yields fell; millions of people died during period of famine; changes in industrial production also failed; five-year plan halted after three years
zh: 20世纪50年代末实施“大跃进”；五年计划；在灌溉和农业中采用未经检验的方法；人们被迫加入公社；粮食产量下降；数百万人在饥荒期间死亡；工业生产改革也告失败；五年计划三年后中止

subject: History and Geography
en: Mao resigned as chairman of the People’s Republic of China; remained chairman of the Chinese Communist Party, a more powerful role than chairman of the country
zh: 毛泽东辞去中华人民共和国主席职务；仍担任中国共产党主席，这一职务比国家主席权力更大。

subject: History and Geography
en: Mao embarked on the Great Proletarian Cultural Revolution; aimed to defeat enemies and remake Chinese society; schools closed; young people told to speak out against bourgeois values and the people who represented them; youths organized into paramilitary groups called the Red Guards; Red Guards dispersed to rural areas
zh: 毛泽东发动“无产阶级文化大革命”；旨在击败敌人并改造中国社会；学校停课；年轻人被鼓动公开反对资产阶级价值观及其代表者；青年被组织成名为红卫兵的准军事团体；红卫兵被派往农村

subject: History and Geography
en: Lin Biao named as Mao’s successor; Lin Biao and other military leaders planned coup to unseat Mao; Lin Biao died in 1971; Mao dies in 1976
zh: 林彪被指定为毛泽东的接班人；林彪和其他军队领导人策划政变推翻毛泽东；林彪于1971年身亡；毛泽东于1976年去世

subject: History and Geography
en: Starting in 1977, Mao’s successor, Deng Xiaoping, favored allowing more free market practices to guide China’s development; he led the country for the next twenty years, opening its market to trade with the United States and other Western countries; allowed more personal liberty; quashed democratic movements
zh: 自1977年起，毛泽东的接班人邓小平主张允许更多自由市场做法来引导中国发展；他在接下来的二十年里领导国家，向美国和其他西方国家开放市场进行贸易；允许更多个人自由；镇压民主运动

subject: History and Geography
en: In 1989, students gathered in Beijing’s Tiananmen Square to peacefully demonstrate for greater freedom; Deng sent in military forces to control the crowd; hundreds of peaceful demonstrators killed
zh: 1989年，学生聚集在北京天安门广场，和平示威争取更大自由；邓派军队控制人群；数百名和平示威者丧生

subject: History and Geography
en: China became the largest manufacturing country and the second-largest economy in the world.
zh: 中国成为世界第一大制造国和第二大经济体。

subject: History and Geography
en: After its World War II defeat, Japan surrendered Korea, which it had occupied since the early 1900s, to the Soviet Union and the United States; the Soviets occupied the northern half; the United States took control of the southern half
zh: 二战后战败，日本将自20世纪初以来占领的朝鲜交给苏联和美国；苏联占领北半部；美国控制南半部

subject: History and Geography
en: By the end of the 1940s, the North was a communist country and the South was an anti communist nation; both led by dictators
zh: 到20世纪40年代末，北方成为共产主义国家，南方成为反共国家；两国均由独裁者领导

subject: History and Geography
en: In 1950, North Korean leader Kim Il-sung sent troops to invade South Korea; North Korean troops, with the support of the Soviet Union, quickly conquered almost all the peninsula.
zh: 1950年，朝鲜领导人金日成派兵入侵韩国；在苏联支持下，朝鲜军队迅速占领了几乎整个半岛。

subject: History and Geography
en: The United Nations sent military forces to assist South Korea; mostly American troops led by United States general Douglas MacArthur
zh: 联合国派兵援助韩国；主要是美军，由美国将领道格拉斯·麦克阿瑟指挥

subject: History and Geography
en: Concerned UN forces might cross the border, Mao Zedong sent Chinese troops to assist the North Koreans; by early 1951, the communists had pushed UN forces back to the thirty-eighth parallel
zh: 由于担心联合国军越过边境，毛泽东派中国军队援助朝鲜；到1951年初，共产党军队已将联合国军逼回三八线

subject: History and Geography
en: In 1953, two sides agreed to a cease-fire; South Korea, which encompassed all Korean territory south of the thirty-eighth parallel, continued to be a key ally of the United States in East Asia; North Korea, called the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea, remained communist; both Koreas were simultaneously admitted to the United Nations in 1991
zh: 1953年，双方同意停火；韩国（涵盖三八线以南所有朝鲜领土）继续成为美国在东亚的重要盟友；朝鲜（称朝鲜民主主义人民共和国）保持共产主义；1991年，朝韩两国同时加入联合国

subject: History and Geography
en: First president of South Korea, Syngman Rhee, was anti-communist, but an authoritarian; political and economic instability caused by growing opposition forced Rhee out of power in 1960.
zh: 韩国首任总统李承晚反对共产主义，但实行威权统治；日益壮大的反对派引发政治和经济动荡，迫使李承晚于1960年下台。

subject: History and Geography
en: Land reforms approved during Rhee’s reign opened property ownership to more people and helped create strong economic growth from the 1960s onward; population boomed; more people gained an education; a middle class emerged; growth of urbanization; enormous population growth of South Korea’s capital, Seoul
zh: 李承晚执政期间通过的土地改革使更多人获得土地所有权，并助力20世纪60年代以来的强劲经济增长；人口激增；更多人接受教育；中产阶级出现；城市化发展；韩国首都首尔人口急剧增长

subject: History and Geography
en: People of South Korea lived under repressive rule for decades; South Koreans directly elected a president for the first time in 1987.
zh: 韩国人民在高压统治下生活了数十年；1987年，韩国人首次直接选举总统。

subject: History and Geography
en: In 1988, the Olympic Games were held in Seoul; changed the world view of South Korea
zh: 1988年，奥运会在首尔举行；改变了世界对韩国的看法。

subject: History and Geography
en: Today, South Korea is one of the ten largest economies in the world.
zh: 如今，韩国是世界十大经济体之一。

subject: History and Geography
en: Dictator Kim Il-sung continued to rule North Korea after the Korean War.
zh: 独裁者金日成在朝鲜战争后继续统治朝鲜。

subject: History and Geography
en: Propaganda glorified Kim as the “Great Leader”; he isolated North Korea from the rest of the world.
zh: 宣传将金日成美化成“伟大领袖”；他使朝鲜与世界隔绝。

subject: History and Geography
en: Kim Il-sung died in 1994; he was replaced by his son Kim Jong-il; collapse of Soviet Union impacted North Korea’s economy; economic hardship and starvation
zh: 金日成于1994年去世；由其子金正日接替；苏联解体影响了朝鲜经济；经济困难和饥荒随之而来

subject: History and Geography
en: Kim Jong-il died in 2011; replaced by his son Kim Jong-un
zh: 金正日于2011年去世；由其子金正恩接替

subject: History and Geography
en: Vietnam became a colony of France in the late 1800s; after World War II, communist Vietnamese leader Ho Chi Minh led an independence movement to end French rule; during the war, Ho led opposition forces in the use of guerilla tactics against occupying Japanese troops
zh: 19世纪末越南成为法国殖民地；二战后，越南共产党领袖胡志明领导独立运动以结束法国统治；战争期间，胡志明领导反抗力量使用游击战术对抗占领的日军

subject: History and Geography
en: In 1954, Ho’s forces defeated the French at the Battle of Dien Bien Phu; France withdrew and Vietnam gained independence.
zh: 1954年，胡志明的军队在奠边府战役中击败法军；法国撤出，越南获得独立。

subject: History and Geography
en: Vietnam split into two countries; communist government in the North; anti-communist government in the South; leaders from both agreed to hold elections to reunite Vietnam; not supported by United States; in 1959, Ho Chi Minh and North Korea declared war on South Korea
zh: 越南分裂为两国；北方为共产主义政府；南方为反共政府；双方领导人同意举行选举以统一越南；但美国不支持；1959年，胡志明和朝鲜对韩国宣战

subject: History and Geography
en: United States viewed Vietnam as part of larger Cold War struggle against communism; U.S. president Dwight Eisenhower believed that the fall of Vietnam to communists would lead to the spread of communism across Southeast Asia
zh: 美国将越南视为更大的反共冷战斗争的一部分；美国总统德怀特·艾森豪威尔认为，越南落入共产党之手将导致共产主义在东南亚蔓延

subject: History and Geography
en: U.S. Congress sent hundreds of millions of dollars to help the South Vietnamese government of Ngo Dinh Diem fight communist guerillas (Viet Cong).
zh: 美国国会拨款数亿美元，帮助吴廷琰的南越政府对抗共产党游击队（越共）。

subject: History and Geography
en: In 1964, the United States’ involvement increased in 1964; an American warship in the Gulf of Tonkin reported it had been attacked by the North Vietnamese (Historians now accept that this attack never happened).
zh: 1964年，美国的介入加深；一艘美国军舰在北部湾报告称遭到北越攻击（历史学家现在认为这次攻击并未发生）。

subject: History and Geography
en: U.S. forces began bombing North Vietnam.
zh: 美军开始轰炸北越。

subject: History and Geography
en: In January 1968, the Viet Cong launched the Tet Offensive; series of attacks on South Vietnamese cities conducted during Tet, the Vietnamese new year
zh: 1968年1月，越共发动春节攻势；在越南新年（春节）期间对南越城市发动一系列袭击。

subject: History and Geography
en: American soldiers brutally killed and tortured more than five hundred people in the My Lai massacre; public opinion in the United States began to turn against the war
zh: 美军士兵在美莱村大屠杀中残酷杀害和折磨了五百多人；美国舆论开始转向反对这场战争

subject: History and Geography
en: President Lyndon Johnson succeeded by Richard Nixon in 1968
zh: 1968年，理查德·尼克松接替林登·约翰逊总统

subject: History and Geography
en: Cease-fire agreement finally reached in1973; the United States began to pull its troops out of Vietnam; two years later, the South Vietnamese capital of Saigon fell to communist forces; North and South Vietnam united under communist rule
zh: 1973年终于达成停火协议；美国开始从越南撤军；两年后，南越首都西贡被共产党军队攻占；北越和南越在共产主义统治下统一

subject: History and Geography
en: Saigon renamed Ho Chi Minh City
zh: 西贡更名为胡志明市

subject: History and Geography
en: Many Vietnamese people who opposed communism fled the country.
zh: 许多反对共产主义的越南人逃离该国。

subject: History and Geography
en: Vietnam opened its doors to Western countries in 1986. H. Japan
zh: 越南于1986年向西方国家开放。H. 日本

subject: History and Geography
en: After World War II, the Allies placed Japan under military occupation for seven years; occupation largely directed by the United State under leadership of General Douglas MacArthur
zh: 二战后，盟军对日本实行了七年军事占领；占领主要由美国在道格拉斯·麦克阿瑟将军的领导下主导

subject: History and Geography
en: During the occupation, the political system of Japan was transformed; new constitution included a bill of rights that said the country would no longer maintain a military, except for self-defense
zh: 占领期间，日本的政治体制被改造；新宪法包含权利法案，规定除自卫外，日本不再维持军队

subject: History and Geography
en: Land reforms included the transfer of ownership of farmland from landlords to farmers, ended last remnants of feudal system
zh: 土地改革包括将农田所有权从地主转移给农民，终结了封建制度的最后残余

subject: History and Geography
en: Workers granted more rights; establishment of unions; women granted right to vote; academic freedom guaranteed
zh: 工人获得更多权利；建立工会；妇女获得选举权；保障学术自由

subject: History and Geography
en: Population moved from countryside to cities such as Tokyo
zh: 人口从农村迁往东京等城市

subject: History and Geography
en: Economy of Japan experienced rapid growth as mechanization led to greater efficiencies in industry and agriculture; huge success producing goods for export such as cars, cameras, and televisions
zh: 随着机械化提高工业和农业效率，日本经济快速增长；汽车、相机和电视等出口商品的生产取得巨大成功

subject: History and Geography
en: Japan experienced recession and recovery; remains one of world’s economic powerhouses
zh: 日本经历了经济衰退与复苏；仍是世界经济强国之一

subject: History and Geography
topic: Europe in the Second Half of the Twentieth Century
en: Europe
zh: 欧洲

subject: History and Geography
topic: Europe in the Second Half of the Twentieth Century
en: Balkans
zh: 巴尔干地区

subject: History and Geography

subject: History and Geography
topic: Europe in the Second Half of the Twentieth Century
en: Canada B. Globalization The end of World War II did not mean the end of conflict and competition in Europe. After the war’s end, the clash of ideas between democratic capitalism and authoritarian communism threatened to plunge Europe into another conflict. The next forty-five years were characterized by a long-simmering tension between two armed camps. The Cold War shaped European politics through the early 1990s, and its consequences are still seen to this day.
zh: 加拿大 B. 全球化 第二次世界大战的结束并不意味着欧洲冲突与竞争的终结。战后，民主资本主义与极权共产主义之间的思想冲突有可能将欧洲再次拖入冲突。此后的四十五年里，两大武装阵营之间长期酝酿着紧张局势。冷战一直影响到20世纪90年代初的欧洲政治，其后果至今仍可见。

subject: History and Geography
en: In eastern Europe, after World War II, local communist parties gained support among the citizens.
zh: 二战后在东欧，当地共产党在民众中获得了支持。

subject: History and Geography
en: Western nations feared communist revolutions in Western countries; Western leaders, especially in the United States, viewed rebuilding Europe as way to counter the threat of communism
zh: 西方国家担心西方国家发生共产主义革命；西方领导人，尤其是美国领导人，将重建欧洲视为抵御共产主义威胁的一种方式。

subject: History and Geography
en: Czechoslovak Communist Party won 39 percent of the vote in 1946 elections; seized full control in 1948; arrested their political opponents; Czechoslovakia fully under Soviet control
zh: 捷克斯洛伐克共产党在1946年选举中获得39%的选票；1948年夺取全部控制权；逮捕政治对手；捷克斯洛伐克完全处于苏联控制之下。

subject: History and Geography
en: Several countries, such as Estonia and Belarus, fully absorbed into Soviet Union
zh: 爱沙尼亚和白俄罗斯等数个国家被完全并入苏联。

subject: History and Geography
en: In 1948, President Truman established the European Recovery Program, (the Marshall Plan), named for Truman’s secretary of state, George C. Marshall (1880–1959). Timeline
zh: 1948年，杜鲁门总统设立了欧洲复兴计划（即马歇尔计划），以杜鲁门的国务卿乔治·C·马歇尔（1880–1959）的名字命名。时间线

subject: History and Geography
en: European countries that took aid from the program saw their gross domestic product (GDP) grow during the three and a half years the Marshall Plan was in effect.
zh: 接受该计划援助的欧洲国家，在马歇尔计划实施的三年半期间，其国内生产总值（GDP）均有增长。

subject: History and Geography
en: In the West, in 1946, British leader Winston Churchill said that an “iron curtain” had been lowered across Europe, along the borders of the region under Soviet control; wanted western European and American leaders to strengthen themselves politically and militarily
zh: 在西方，1946年英国领导人温斯顿·丘吉尔称，一道“铁幕”已沿着苏联控制区的边界横跨欧洲降落；他希望西欧和美国领导人在政治和军事上加强自身。

subject: History and Geography
en: Stalin blamed World War II on problems within and between capitalist countries; argued that war was inevitable as long as capitalism existed; believed capitalist competition led to constant struggle for resources and caused “uneven development”
zh: 斯大林将第二次世界大战归咎于资本主义国家内部及彼此之间的问题；认为只要资本主义存在，战争就不可避免；相信资本主义竞争导致对资源的持续争夺，并造成“发展不平衡”。

subject: History and Geography
en: Germany reflected this divide; had been divided in half by the occupying Allies; West Germany, officially known as the Federal Republic of Germany, was democratic, capitalist; East Germany, or the German Democratic Republic, was communist and part of the Soviet alliance
zh: 德国体现了这种分裂；它被占领的盟国一分为二；西德，正式名称为德意志联邦共和国，是民主、资本主义的；东德，即德意志民主共和国，是共产主义国家，属于苏联阵营。

subject: History and Geography
en: In 1948, the Western alliance of the United States, Great Britain, and France began to plan a new West German state; began issuing deutsche marks in West Berlin; Soviet leaders, were not been consulted; responded by setting up a blockade of West Berlin; Western nations flew large quantities of food and supplies over East German territory to Berlin; blockaded East Germany; blockades lifted in 1949
zh: 1948年，由美国、英国和法国组成的西方联盟开始筹划建立一个新的西德国家；开始在西柏林发行德国马克；苏联领导人并未被征询意见；作为回应，他们对西柏林实行封锁；西方国家经由东德领空向柏林空运大量食品和物资；并对东德实行封锁；封锁于1949年解除。

subject: History and Geography
en: In 1949, creation of the North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO), a formal military alliance among the Western allied nations
zh: 1949年，成立北大西洋公约组织（北约），这是西方盟国之间的正式军事联盟。

subject: History and Geography
en: Communist countries of eastern Europe entered a similar agreement in 1955; the Warsaw Treaty Organization, or Warsaw Pact, originally consisted of Albania, Bulgaria, Czechoslovakia, Hungary, Poland, Romania, and the Soviet Union.
zh: 东欧的共产主义国家于1955年签订了类似的协定；华沙条约组织，即华约，最初由阿尔巴尼亚、保加利亚、捷克斯洛伐克、匈牙利、波兰、罗马尼亚和苏联组成。

subject: History and Geography
en: After the United States bombed Hiroshima and Nagasaki in August 1945, the Soviets launched a special project to develop nuclear technology; achieved success in 1949; other world powers joined the atomic race; Great Britain conducted its first nuclear test in 1952; France followed in 1960
zh: 1945年8月美国轰炸广岛和长崎后，苏联启动了一项发展核技术的特别工程；1949年取得成功；其他世界大国也加入了核竞赛；英国于1952年进行了首次核试验；法国于1960年紧随其后。

subject: History and Geography
en: One rationale behind the development of nuclear weapons was deterrence.
zh: 发展核武器的一个基本理由就是威慑。

subject: History and Geography
en: Tense first phase of the Cold War ended with the death of Joseph Stalin on March 5, 1953; Stalin’s successor, Nikita Khrushchev (1894–1971)
zh: 冷战紧张的第一阶段随着约瑟夫·斯大林于1953年3月5日去世而结束；斯大林的继任者是尼基塔·赫鲁晓夫（1894–1971）。

subject: History and Geography
en: In 1956, Hungarian prime minister Imre Nagy (1896–1958) declared that non-Communists would be allowed to participate in running the government; also declared Hungary’s neutrality in the contest between West and East; the Soviets invaded Hungary
zh: 1956年，匈牙利总理纳吉·伊姆雷（1896–1958）宣布允许非共产党人参与政府管理；还宣布匈牙利在东西方对抗中保持中立；苏联出兵入侵匈牙利。

subject: History and Geography
en: Construction of the Berlin Wall in 1961
zh: 1961年修建柏林墙。

subject: History and Geography
en: Baby boom of the postwar period, especially large number of births from 1945 to 1952, added millions of young people to Europe.
zh: 战后时期的婴儿潮，尤其是1945年至1952年间的大量出生，使欧洲增加了数百万年轻人。

subject: History and Geography
en: Advertising, pop culture, and social events targeted young adults, viewed as the leaders of new cultural and social moment
zh: 广告、流行文化和社会活动都以年轻人为目标，他们被视为新文化和社会运动的引领者。

subject: History and Geography
en: Youth culture and youth politics; in May 1968, a French student-led protest became an uprising that included participants from across society; in 1968, citizens of Czechoslovakia rose up during a period called the Prague Spring; Soviet troops and their allies invaded Czechoslovakia on August 20–21, 1968
zh: 青年文化与青年政治；1968年5月，法国一场由学生主导的抗议演变成有社会各界人士参与的起义；1968年，捷克斯洛伐克公民在被称为“布拉格之春”的时期奋起反抗；苏联军队及其盟友于1968年8月20日至21日入侵捷克斯洛伐克。

subject: History and Geography
en: European economic boom led to the rise of European welfare states, in which governments provided benefits such as free university education, free health care, and generous pensions; Great Britain established the National Health Service to provide health care to all citizens.
zh: 欧洲经济繁荣促成了欧洲福利国家的兴起，政府提供免费大学教育、免费医疗和丰厚养老金等福利；英国建立了国民保健署（National Health Service），为全体公民提供医疗服务。

subject: History and Geography
en: From 1968 to 1998, a conflict called the Troubles erupted in the six counties of Northern Ireland (part of Great Britain); unionist and republican paramilitaries fought campaigns of terrorism against each other and the British; the two sides agreed to end the conflict in 1998; peace deal, called the Good Friday Agreement F. The Soviet Union Collapses
zh: 1968年至1998年间，一场被称为“北爱尔兰问题”（The Troubles）的冲突在北爱尔兰六个郡（英国的一部分）爆发；联合派和共和派的准军事组织相互之间以及与英国人之间展开恐怖活动；双方于1998年同意结束冲突；这项和平协议被称为《耶稣受难日协议》(Good Friday Agreement)。F. 苏联解体

subject: History and Geography
en: Between 1989 and 1992, the Soviet Union was abolished, the Soviet bloc broke up, and the Cold War ended; reasons: economic, social, and political
zh: 1989年至1992年间，苏联被废除，苏联集团解体，冷战结束；原因包括经济、社会和政治方面。

subject: History and Geography
en: Soviet economic crisis put pressure on the Soviet government to enact reforms; resistance to change dominated by elderly Soviet men who prioritized building military power above the needs of Russian citizens; years of stagnation began after Leonid Brezhnev (1906–82) became leader of the Soviet Union in 1964
zh: 苏联经济危机迫使苏联政府进行改革；抵制变革的主要是年长的苏联男性，他们把建设军事力量置于俄罗斯公民的需求之上；1964年列昂尼德·勃列日涅夫（1906–82）成为苏联领导人后，开始了多年的停滞时期。

subject: History and Geography
en: In 1978, Afghanistan’s government was replaced in a coup led by communist army officers; opposition resulted in Russian invasion in 1979; Soviet army failed to control anything beyond the major cities of Afghanistan; thousands of Afghans were killed, and millions more fled to neighboring countries such as Pakistan; Western powers sold weapons to Afghan fighters; Soviet Union withdrew in 1989
zh: 1978年，阿富汗政府在一次由共产党军官领导的政变中被推翻；反对派的活动导致1979年俄国入侵；苏联军队未能控制阿富汗主要城市以外的任何地区；成千上万的阿富汗人被杀，另有数百万人逃往巴基斯坦等邻国；西方列强向阿富汗抵抗力量出售武器；苏联于1989年撤军。

subject: History and Geography
en: Mikhail Gorbachev (b. 1931), became the leader of the Soviet Union in 1985; worked to modernize and streamline the Soviet economy and government; proposed a series of cultural reforms called glasnost (openness); eventually, Soviet leadership allowed democratic reforms, including contested elections and secret ballots, for the first time in its history
zh: 米哈伊尔·戈尔巴乔夫（生于1931年）于1985年成为苏联领导人；致力于使苏联经济和政府现代化并精简机构；提出了一系列称为“公开性”（glasnost）的文化改革；最终，苏联领导层有史以来第一次允许民主改革，包括竞争性选举和无记名投票。

subject: History and Geography
en: In the 1980s, independent trade unions in Poland led campaigns for workers’ rights and social change; the largest union, led by Lech Wałęsa (b. 1943), helped force the Polish government to restore a democratic parliament and hold elections in 1989
zh: 20世纪80年代，波兰的独立工会发起了争取工人权利和社会变革的运动；最大的工会由莱赫·瓦文萨（生于1943年）领导，迫使波兰政府恢复民主议会并于1989年举行选举。

subject: History and Geography
en: November 9, 1989, Berlin Wall collapsed
zh: 1989年11月9日，柏林墙倒塌。

subject: History and Geography
en: The Soviet Union reacted to popular movements by removing troops from countries that were becoming democratic, such East Germany, Hungary, Czechoslovakia, and Poland; in 1990, Gorbachev agreed that East and West Germany should be reunited
zh: 苏联对民众运动的反应是从正在走向民主的国家撤军，如东德、匈牙利、捷克斯洛伐克和波兰；1990年，戈尔巴乔夫同意东西德应统一。

subject: History and Geography
en: The former Soviet Union broke up into fifteen independent countries, including Russia, Armenia, and Estonia.
zh: 前苏联分裂为十五个独立国家，包括俄罗斯、亚美尼亚和爱沙尼亚。

subject: History and Geography
en: New Russian president Boris Yeltsin (1931–2007) in charge of ending the Soviet system and beginning a transition to a liberal, democratic, and capitalist country
zh: 俄罗斯新总统鲍里斯·叶利钦（1931–2007）负责终结苏联体制，并开始向自由、民主和资本主义国家过渡。

subject: History and Geography
en: Between June 1991 and May 1992, the five Yugoslavian regions— Slovenia, Croatia, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Serbia, and Macedonia—declared their independence; population came from many ethnicities
zh: 1991年6月至1992年5月间，南斯拉夫的五个地区——斯洛文尼亚、克罗地亚、波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那、塞尔维亚和马其顿——宣布独立；其人口由多个民族构成。

subject: History and Geography
en: Conflict arose between the majority and minority ethnic and religious populations; Serbs in Croatia wanted to join Serbia; Serbs in Bosnia and Herzegovina wanted independence from the Muslim majority
zh: 多数与少数的民族和宗教群体之间发生冲突；克罗地亚的塞尔维亚人想加入塞尔维亚；波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那的塞尔维亚人希望脱离穆斯林占多数的统治而独立。

subject: History and Geography
en: After two years of fighting, the United Nations sent humanitarian aid to civilians and set up safe zones for refugees; UN forces did not defend safe zones; Serbian forces massacred their opponents; fighting stopped in 1995 after NATO agreed to send troops to stop Serbs from attacking Bosnian forces
zh: 经过两年的战斗，联合国向平民提供人道主义援助，并为难民设立安全区；联合国部队没有保卫安全区；塞尔维亚军队屠杀了对手；1995年北约同意派兵阻止塞尔维亚人进攻波斯尼亚军队后，战斗停止。

subject: History and Geography
en: In Serbia, ethnically Albanian and Muslim citizens formed the Kosovo Liberation Army (KLA); rebellion prompted brutal attacks by the Yugoslav army, Serbian police, and Serbian soldiers; thousands of Kosovans driven from their homes; United Nations and NATO forces helped establish a fragile peace; Kosovo declared itself independent in 2008; neither Serbia nor Russia recognized its status as a separate state
zh: 在塞尔维亚，阿尔巴尼亚族和穆斯林公民组成了科索沃解放军（KLA）；起义招致南斯拉夫军队、塞尔维亚警察和塞尔维亚士兵的残酷镇压；成千上万的科索沃人被赶出家园；联合国和北约部队帮助建立了脆弱的和平；科索沃于2008年宣布独立；塞尔维亚和俄罗斯均未承认其作为独立国家的地位。

subject: History and Geography
en: The formation of the European Economic Community (EEC) in 1957 created a common market among the member nations; EEC also began process of creating Europe-wide institutions; the European Parliament has power to consult on European laws and policies; the European Court of Justice hears cases that affect member nations
zh: 1957年欧洲经济共同体（EEC）的成立在成员国之间建立了共同市场；欧共体还开始了创建全欧洲范围机构的进程；欧洲议会有权就欧洲法律和政策提供咨询；欧洲法院审理影响成员国的案件。

subject: History and Geography
en: European Union (EU), the successor to the EEC, formed in 1993 and today has twenty seven member countries; unit of currency the euro
zh: 欧洲联盟（EU），欧共体的继承者，成立于1993年，现有二十七个成员国；统一货币为欧元。

zh: 阿拉伯半岛

subject: History and Geography
en: Sinai Peninsula B. Background Before World War I, Africa and the Middle East were divided up among European empires. Following the collapse of these empires after World War II, a wave of independence movements in Africa and the Middle East brought new nations into existence. The colonial era had left some areas richer and more developed than others. Colonial governments had divided people along racial, religious, and ethnic lines. In the postcolonial era, the former empires—and the new superpowers, the United States and the Soviet Union—had business and military interests in Africa and the Middle East that caused them to interfere with the newly free nations.
zh: 西奈半岛 B. 背景 第一次世界大战前，非洲和中东被欧洲各帝国瓜分。第二次世界大战后这些帝国崩溃，非洲和中东掀起独立运动浪潮，新的国家纷纷诞生。殖民时代使一些地区比其他地区更富裕、更发达。殖民政府按种族、宗教和民族划分人群。在后殖民时代，昔日的帝国以及新的超级大国——美国和苏联——在非洲和中东拥有商业和军事利益，这导致它们干涉这些新独立的国家。

subject: History and Geography
en: Colonization of Africa via private companies (British East Africa Company), governed directly by home nation (direct rule), indirect rule; settler colonies (South Africa, Zimbabwe)
zh: 通过私营公司（英国东非公司，British East Africa Company）对非洲进行殖民；由宗主国直接统治（直接统治）、间接统治；移民殖民地（南非、津巴布韦）

subject: History and Geography
en: Infrastructure developed to transport valuable raw materials from mines and plantations to markets and ports
zh: 基础设施建设起来，用于将矿场和种植园的贵重原材料运往市场和港口。

subject: History and Geography
en: World War II weakened colonial rule in Africa; many Africans had fought as part of the Allied armies against the Axis Powers.
zh: 第二次世界大战削弱了非洲的殖民统治；许多非洲人曾作为盟军的一部分与轴心国作战。

subject: History and Geography
en: In 1954, Algerian nationalists launched a war of independence; bloody war against French followed; in 1962, France accepted Algerian independence
zh: 1954年，阿尔及利亚民族主义者发动独立战争；随后是对法国人的血腥战争；1962年，法国接受阿尔及利亚独立。

subject: History and Geography
en: Kenyans seek independence from the British; Mau Mau independence fighters; fighting ended in 1960; British allowed elections to take place early the next year; elections created a government that wrote a new constitution for an independent Kenya
zh: 肯尼亚人寻求脱离英国独立；茅茅党（Mau Mau）独立战士；战斗于1960年结束；英国允许次年早些时候举行选举；选举产生的政府为独立的肯尼亚制定了新宪法。

subject: History and Geography
en: Jomo Kenyatta (1894–1978), a leader in the movement for independence, became Kenya’s first prime minister.
zh: 乔莫·肯雅塔（1894–1978）是独立运动的领袖，成为肯尼亚首任总理。

subject: History and Geography
en: Kwame Nkrumah (1909–72) formed the Convention People’s Party (CPP), which gained mass support among the people of the Gold Coast.
zh: 克瓦米·恩克鲁玛（1909–72）创建了人民大会党（CPP），该党在黄金海岸人民中获得了广泛支持。

subject: History and Geography
en: Nkrumah won election to the Gold Coast’s new parliament and became prime minister in 1952; the CPP’s independence platform gave the party a large majority of seats in the Gold Coast parliament; used this power to formally gain the Gold Coast’s independence
zh: 恩克鲁玛在黄金海岸新议会选举中获胜，并于1952年成为总理；人民大会党的独立纲领使该党在黄金海岸议会中占据绝大多数席位；他利用这一权力正式争取黄金海岸的独立。

subject: History and Geography
en: In 1957, the Gold Coast was recognized as an independent nation and renamed Ghana.
zh: 1957年，黄金海岸被承认为独立国家，并改名为加纳。

subject: History and Geography
en: Fourteen former French colonies in Africa became independent in 1960, as well as two British colonies and one Belgian colony; the year 1960 came to be known as the “Year of Africa.” Timeline D. Struggles and Civil Wars
zh: 1960年，非洲十四个前法国殖民地以及两个英国殖民地和一个比利时殖民地获得独立；1960年因而被称为“非洲年”。时间线D. 斗争与内战

subject: History and Geography
en: Newly independent African nations faced challenges; borders had been drawn by European powers; many of the new countries contained conflicting ethnic and religious groups
zh: 新独立的非洲国家面临挑战；边界是由欧洲列强划定的；许多新国家内部存在相互冲突的民族和宗教群体。

subject: History and Geography
en: New nations aimed to use independence to benefit their own people; continuing trade in African resources helped grow the economy; foreign nations, however, maintained economic and political influence
zh: 新国家旨在利用独立为本国人民谋利；非洲资源的持续贸易有助于经济增长；然而，外国仍保持着经济和政治影响力。

subject: History and Geography
en: Libya gained independence in 1951; in 1959 oil discovered; king of Libya favored western powers; Libya’s military staged a coup in 1969, bringing Muammar al- Qaddafi (1942–2011) to power
zh: 利比亚于1951年独立；1959年发现石油；利比亚国王亲西方；1969年利比亚军方发动政变，使穆阿迈尔·卡扎菲（1942–2011）上台。

subject: History and Geography
en: Rwanda gained independence in 1961; two main groups in Rwanda—the Tutsi and the Hutu; traditionally, the Tutsi are smaller, wealthier group; the Hutu majority poor farmers
zh: 卢旺达于1961年独立；卢旺达有两大群体——图西族和胡图族；传统上，图西族是人数较少、较富裕的群体；占多数的胡图族是贫穷的农民。

subject: History and Geography
en: In 1994, Hutu extremists launched campaign of mass murder directed at Tutsis and moderate Hutus.
zh: 1994年，胡图族极端分子发动了针对图西族和温和派胡图族的大屠杀运动。

subject: History and Geography
en: Mobutu Sese Seko (1930–97) ruled the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) as a dictator from 1965 to 1997; Idi Amin (1924–2003) in Uganda
zh: 蒙博托·塞塞·塞科（1930–97）从1965年到1997年以独裁者身份统治刚果民主共和国（DRC）；伊迪·阿明（1924–2003）统治乌干达。

subject: History and Geography
en: In Ghana, Jerry Rawlings took power in a coup in 1981; was democratically elected in 1992; Rawlings brought political stability to the country and implemented economic reforms
zh: 在加纳，杰里·罗林斯于1981年通过政变上台；1992年通过民主选举当选；罗林斯为国家带来政治稳定并实施了经济改革。

subject: History and Geography
en: Namibia gained independence from South Africa in 1990; established politically stable democracy; has one of the strongest economies in Africa
zh: 纳米比亚于1990年脱离南非获得独立；建立了政治稳定的民主制度；拥有非洲最强经济体之一。

subject: History and Geography
en: South Africa won its independence from Great Britain in 1910, but most of its people were not free; Black population did not have the same rights and power as the white minority that controlled the government and the economy
zh: 南非于1910年脱离英国获得独立，但大多数人民并不自由；黑人人口没有享有与控制政府和经济白人少数群体相同的权利和权力。

subject: History and Geography
en: In 1913, South Africa’s government passed the Land Act; led to the forced removal of Black South Africans from their land; their property sold by the government to white farmers at a reduced cost; Black South Africans were relocated to other areas, where they lived in poverty
zh: 1913年，南非政府通过《土地法》；导致南非黑人被强制迁离其土地；他们的财产被政府以低价出售给白人农民；南非黑人被迁往其他地区，在那里过着贫困生活。

subject: History and Geography
en: The white minority officially imposed a system called apartheid in 1948; under this system, white and non-white people were required to live in separate areas and could not use the same public facilities.
zh: 白人少数群体于1948年正式推行名为种族隔离（apartheid）的制度；在这一制度下，白人和非白人被要求居住在分开的地区，且不能使用相同的公共设施。

subject: History and Geography
en: Organization of Black South Africans, the African National Congress (ANC), fought apartheid policies
zh: 南非黑人的组织——非洲人国民大会（非国大，ANC）——反对种族隔离政策。

subject: History and Geography
en: South African government tried to silence the ANC; in 1960, police forces killed sixty nine unarmed demonstrators (Sharpeville massacre); government outlawed the ANC
zh: 南非政府试图压制非国大；1960年，警察杀害了六十九名手无寸铁的示威者（沙佩维尔惨案）；政府取缔了非国大。

subject: History and Geography
en: Nelson Mandela, who had first led peaceful protests against apartheid, became the leader of an armed wing of the ANC, called Umkhonto we Sizwe (Spear of the Nation).
zh: 纳尔逊·曼德拉最初领导反对种族隔离的和平抗议，后来成为非国大武装组织“民族之矛”（Umkhonto we Sizwe，Spear of the Nation）的领导人。

subject: History and Geography
en: In 1964, Mandela and other ANC leaders sentenced to life in prison
zh: 1964年，曼德拉和其他非国大领导人被判无期徒刑。

subject: History and Geography
en: South African police killed about six hundred Black South Africans during protests in the township of Soweto in 1976.
zh: 1976年，南非警察在索韦托镇的抗议活动中杀害了约六百名南非黑人。

subject: History and Geography
en: International community outraged; began to pressure South African government to end apartheid and release Mandela from prison; introduction of sanctions
zh: 国际社会感到愤怒；开始向南非政府施压，要求结束种族隔离并释放曼德拉；实施制裁。

subject: History and Geography
en: President F. W. de Klerk, in 1990, legalized the ANC and freed Nelson Mandela and other ANC leaders.
zh: 1990年，总统弗雷德里克·威廉·德克勒克使非国大合法化，并释放了纳尔逊·曼德拉和其他非国大领导人。

subject: History and Geography
en: South African government began to end apartheid; in 1994 allowed South Africans of every race to vote; Nelson Mandela elected president
zh: 南非政府开始结束种族隔离；1994年允许各种族的南非人投票；纳尔逊·曼德拉当选总统。

subject: History and Geography
en: Apartheid had done lasting damage to Black South Africans; by the early twenty-first century, white South Africans still controlled almost three-quarters of the country’s farmland.
zh: 种族隔离给南非黑人造成了持久的伤害；到21世纪初，南非白人仍控制着该国近四分之三的农田。

subject: History and Geography
en: African cities and nations have emerged as global leaders in science and technology in the new millennium; the cities of Algiers in Algeria, Lagos in Nigeria, Nairobi in Kenya, and Johannesburg in South Africa are all considered major international centers for business and culture.
zh: 在新千年里，非洲的城市和国家已成为科技领域的全球领导者；阿尔及利亚的阿尔及尔、尼日利亚的拉各斯、肯尼亚的内罗毕和南非的约翰内斯堡都被视为重要的国际商业和文化中心。

subject: History and Geography
en: Innovators across the continent have come up with new solutions to age-old problems: how to transport water and bring medical care to rural areas; addressed new challenges; expanding mobile and Internet access; many inventions rooted in computer and mobile technology, an area in which African nations are leading the rest of the world
zh: 整个非洲大陆的创新者提出了解决古老问题的新方案：如何向农村地区输送水并提供医疗；应对新的挑战；扩大移动和互联网接入；许多发明植根于计算机和移动技术，在这一领域非洲国家正领先于世界其他地区。

subject: History and Geography
en: The Middle East is not a distinctive geographic zone or a continent; it is a region defined primarily by European and American observers in the nineteenth and twentieth centuries.
zh: 中东并非一个独特的地理区域或大洲；它主要是十九、二十世纪由欧美观察者定义的一个地区。

subject: History and Geography
en: Large proportion of the world’s proven oil reserves are in the Middle East—principally in Saudi Arabia, Iran, Iraq, the United Arab Emirates, and Kuwait.
zh: 世界已探明石油储量的很大一部分位于中东——主要在沙特阿拉伯、伊朗、伊拉克、阿拉伯联合酋长国和科威特。

subject: History and Geography
en: Prior to World War I, the Ottoman Empire controlled the land of Palestine; Palestine had a large Arab population.
zh: 第一次世界大战前，奥斯曼帝国控制着巴勒斯坦地区；巴勒斯坦有大量阿拉伯人口。

subject: History and Geography
en: European anti-Semitism and a desire for self-determination led some Jews to seek a national homeland.
zh: 欧洲的反犹太主义和对民族自决的渴望使一些犹太人寻求建立民族家园。

subject: History and Geography
en: Great Britain received a mandate to rule Palestine; in 1917, during the First World War, the British issued the Balfour Declaration, which officially supported the creation of a Jewish homeland in Palestine.
zh: 英国获得了统治巴勒斯坦的委任统治权；1917年第一次世界大战期间，英国发表《贝尔福宣言》，正式支持在巴勒斯坦建立犹太人家园。

subject: History and Geography
en: Many Jewish people fled to Palestine to escape persecution by the Nazis and their allies before and during World War II; Jewish population in Palestine grew to about six hundred thousand by 1945; Arabs numbered around a million; violence broke out between the two groups—and both sides attacked the British
zh: 二战前和二战期间，许多犹太人逃往巴勒斯坦以躲避纳粹及其盟友的迫害；到1945年巴勒斯坦的犹太人口增长到约六十万；阿拉伯人约有一百万；两个群体之间爆发暴力冲突——双方都袭击了英国人。

subject: History and Geography
en: After World War II, British give up mandate in Palestine
zh: 二战后，英国放弃对巴勒斯坦的委任统治。

subject: History and Geography
en: The UN created two states, one Jewish and one Arab, in 1947; the Jewish state declared its independence as Israel in 1948.
zh: 联合国于1947年建立了两个国家，一个犹太国家，一个阿拉伯国家；1948年犹太国家宣布独立，成为以色列。

subject: History and Geography
en: After the signing of the Israeli Declaration of Independence in 1948, armies from neighboring Arab countries of Egypt, Jordan, Iraq, Syria, and Lebanon launched a war against Israel; Israelis also seized land from Palestinians; fighting lasted for ten months; when conflict ended, Israel had expanded its territory beyond the land that had been designated for the Jewish state; many people had been displaced
zh: 1948年《以色列独立宣言》签署后，来自埃及、约旦、伊拉克、叙利亚和黎巴嫩等邻国的阿拉伯军队向以色列发动战争；以色列人也夺取了巴勒斯坦人的土地；战斗持续了十个月；冲突结束时，以色列的领土已扩展到指定给犹太国家的土地之外；许多人流离失所。

subject: History and Geography
en: The division of Palestine set up a long-running conflict between the Jewish state and the Arab population that is still ongoing, both within Israel and in surrounding countries.
zh: 巴勒斯坦的分割造成了犹太国家与阿拉伯人口之间长期的冲突，这场冲突在以色列境内和周边国家至今仍在持续。

subject: History and Geography
en: One trigger for violence is the status of Jerusalem; as part of the division, the holy city of Jerusalem was divided in half; Jews and Muslims both consider Jerusalem to be among the holiest cities in the world
zh: 引发暴力的一个导火索是耶路撒冷的地位问题；作为分割的一部分，圣城耶路撒冷被一分为二；犹太人和穆斯林都认为耶路撒冷是世界上最神圣的城市之一。

subject: History and Geography
en: After the establishment of Israel in 1948 and the war that immediately followed, approximately 750,000 Palestinians fled the land they considered their home; Palestinians spread across different neighboring countries; were not organized politically; in 1964, Palestinian leaders formed the Palestine Liberation Organization (PLO);Yasser Arafat became the leader of the PLO in 1969
zh: 1948年以色列建国及随即爆发的战争之后，约75万巴勒斯坦人逃离了他们视为家园的土地；巴勒斯坦人散居在不同的邻国；在政治上没有组织；1964年，巴勒斯坦领导人成立了巴勒斯坦解放组织（巴解组织，PLO）；1969年亚西尔·阿拉法特成为巴解组织领导人。

subject: History and Geography
en: In 1967, Israel fought the Six-Day War against Syria and Egypt.
zh: 1967年，以色列与叙利亚和埃及打了六日战争（第三次中东战争）。

subject: History and Geography
en: In 1973, Egypt launched a surprise attack on Israel during Yom Kippur.
zh: 1973年，埃及在赎罪日（Yom Kippur）之际对以色列发动突然袭击。

subject: History and Geography
en: In 1979, Egypt and Israel signed a peace treaty to end the off-and-on war that had been fought for thirty years; Israel returned the Sinai Peninsula to Egypt; Egypt agreed that Israel had the right to exist
zh: 1979年，埃及和以色列签署和平条约，结束了持续三十年、断断续续的战争；以色列将西奈半岛归还埃及；埃及承认以色列有生存权。

subject: History and Geography
en: From 1987 to 1991, Palestinians participated in a series of protests and riots called the first intifada to protest the occupation of Gaza and the West Bank; led to a peace agreement called the Oslo Accords, which established the Palestinian National Authority as the governing body of parts of Gaza and the West Bank
zh: 1987年至1991年，巴勒斯坦人参加了一系列被称为第一次起义（intifada）的抗议和暴动，抗议对加沙和约旦河西岸的占领；由此达成了名为《奥斯陆协议》(Oslo Accords) 的和平协议，该协议设立了巴勒斯坦民族权力机构，作为加沙和约旦河西岸部分地区的管理机构。

subject: History and Geography
en: Peace process halted during the second intifada—2000 to 2005; Israel withdrew from Gaza toward the end of 2005
zh: 第二次起义（2000年至2005年）期间和平进程中断；2005年底以色列从加沙撤军。

subject: History and Geography
en: Egyptian revolution, started in 1919, led to the end of British rule in Egypt in 1922.
zh: 1919年开始的埃及革命导致1922年英国在埃及的统治结束。

subject: History and Geography
en: British and the French refused to give up control of the Suez Canal; caused tension over thirty year period; led to second revolution in 1952
zh: 英国和法国拒绝放弃对苏伊士运河的控制；在三十年间造成紧张局势；导致1952年第二次革命。

subject: History and Geography
en: Gamal Abdel Nasser (1918–70) orchestrated the overthrow of King Farouk.
zh: 贾迈勒·阿卜杜勒·纳赛尔（1918–70）策划推翻了法鲁克国王。

subject: History and Geography
en: In 1956, Nasser’s government took control of the Suez Canal.
zh: 1956年，纳赛尔政府控制了苏伊士运河。

subject: History and Geography
en: Britain, France, and Israel invade Egypt to seize back control of the canal in October, 1956; eventual withdrawal of forces due to threat of sanctions
zh: 1956年10月，英国、法国和以色列入侵埃及，企图夺回运河控制权；由于面临制裁威胁，最终撤军。

subject: History and Geography
en: Nasser died in 1970 and was succeeded by Anwar al-Sadat; he signed Camp David Accords with Israel in 1979; assassinated in 1981
zh: 纳赛尔于1970年去世，由安瓦尔·萨达特继任；他于1979年与以色列签署《戴维营协议》；1981年遇刺身亡。

subject: History and Geography
en: Hosni Mubarak ruled Egypt from 1981 until 2021; removed from office during Arab Spring
zh: 胡斯尼·穆巴拉克从1981年到2021年统治埃及；在阿拉伯之春期间被免职。

subject: History and Geography
en: In 1941, Mohammad Reza Pahlavi became the shah, or king, of Iran; favored having strong ties with Great Britain and the United States
zh: 1941年，穆罕默德·礼萨·巴列维成为伊朗的沙阿（国王）；倾向于与英国和美国保持紧密关系。

subject: History and Geography
en: Mohammad Mosaddegh disagreed with shah; wanted Iran’s oil wealth to be used to fund development programs to benefit ordinary Iranians; Mosaddegh built political support for a program to nationalize Iran’s oil company
zh: 穆罕默德·摩萨台与沙阿意见相左；希望将伊朗的石油财富用于资助惠及普通伊朗人的发展项目；摩萨台为将伊朗石油公司国有化的计划争取了政治支持。

subject: History and Geography
en: In 1951, Mosaddegh’s oil nationalization law passed; the shah made him the country’s premier.
zh: 1951年，摩萨台的石油国有化法案通过；沙阿任命他为总理。

subject: History and Geography
en: In 1953, the United States and Great Britain orchestrated a coup, overthrew Mosaddegh and returned the shah to total control of Iran; Iranian oil profits renegotiated; shah brutal ruler; secret police
zh: 1953年，美国和英国策划政变，推翻摩萨台，使沙阿重新完全控制伊朗；伊朗石油利润被重新谈判；沙阿是残暴的统治者；设有秘密警察。

subject: History and Geography
en: Ayatollah Ruhollah Khomeini, a fundamentalist, advocated the overthrow of the shah; wanted to transform Iran into an Islamic state; shah removed Ayatollah from the country
zh: 原教旨主义者阿亚图拉·鲁霍拉·霍梅尼主张推翻沙阿；希望将伊朗变成伊斯兰国家；沙阿将霍梅尼驱逐出境。

subject: History and Geography
en: In mid-1970s, Islamic leaders grew angrier with the rule of the shah; more members of the public support Ayatollah Khomeini
zh: 20世纪70年代中期，伊斯兰领袖对沙阿的统治愈发愤怒；更多民众支持阿亚图拉·霍梅尼。

subject: History and Geography
en: In September, 1978, shah ordered security forces to fire into a crowd of demonstrators; hundreds killed, thousands wounded; riots broke out two months later; Khomeini called for the overthrow of the shah
zh: 1978年9月，沙阿命令安全部队向示威人群开火；数百人死亡，数千人受伤；两个月后爆发骚乱；霍梅尼号召推翻沙阿。

subject: History and Geography
en: In December, 1978, the governing regime fell; the shah fled the country.
zh: 1978年12月，执政政权倒台；沙阿逃离该国。

subject: History and Geography
en: Khomeini became the leader of the new Islamic Republic of Iran in 1979; new government set up a theocracy based on religious beliefs and implemented Islamic laws
zh: 1979年，霍梅尼成为新成立的伊朗伊斯兰共和国的领导人；新政府建立了以宗教信仰为基础的神权政体，并实施伊斯兰法律。

subject: History and Geography
en: In late 1979, student revolutionaries stormed the United States embassy in Tehran; took more than fifty American hostages; were held for 444 days before their release
zh: 1979年末，学生革命者冲入美国驻德黑兰大使馆；扣押了五十多名美国人质；他们被关押444天后才获释。

subject: History and Geography
en: Iraq ruled from 1979 to 2003 by Saddam Hussein (1937–2006); Iraq’s ruling party was secular
zh: 伊拉克从1979年到2003年由萨达姆·侯赛因（1937–2006）统治；伊拉克的执政党是世俗的。

subject: History and Geography
en: Iraq and Iran hostile to each other throughout the 1970s
zh: 整个20世纪70年代，伊拉克和伊朗相互敌对。

subject: History and Geography
en: In 1980, Saddam Hussein ordered an invasion of Iran; war lasted until 1988
zh: 1980年，萨达姆·侯赛因下令入侵伊朗；战争持续到1988年。

subject: History and Geography
en: In 1990, Iraq invaded and annexed the neighboring country of Kuwait to claim its oil fields; United States–led coalition of international forces repelled Hussein’s forces from Kuwait in the 1991 Persian Gulf War.
zh: 1990年，伊拉克入侵并吞并邻国科威特，以攫取其油田；在1991年波斯湾战争中，美国领导的国际联军将侯赛因的军队赶出科威特。

subject: History and Geography
en: On September 11, 2001, terrorists belonging to the Islamic fundamentalist group al-Qaeda launched attack on the United States; hijacked and flew planes into the twin towers of the World Trade Center in New York City, the Pentagon, and a field in Pennsylvania
zh: 2001年9月11日，伊斯兰原教旨主义组织基地组织（al-Qaeda）的恐怖分子对美国发动袭击；他们劫持飞机并撞向纽约世界贸易中心双子塔、五角大楼以及宾夕法尼亚州的一处田野。

subject: History and Geography
en: United States responded by launching a war against the Taliban, the de facto government of Afghanistan, which had allowed al-Qaeda to use the country as its headquarters.
zh: 美国以发动对塔利班的战争作为回应，塔利班是阿富汗事实上的政府，曾允许基地组织将该国作为其总部。

subject: History and Geography
en: The United States removed the Taliban from power; set up new government friendly to its interests
zh: 美国推翻了塔利班政权；建立了符合其利益的新政府。

subject: History and Geography
en: Concurrently, the United States invaded Iraq in 2003 based on claims that Iraq had weapons of mass destruction.
zh: 与此同时，美国以伊拉克拥有大规模杀伤性武器为由，于2003年入侵伊拉克。

subject: History and Geography
en: Hussein forced from power, tried for war crimes, and eventually executed; Hussein’s removal left Iraq without a strong leader; different factions of Shiites and Sunnis violently vied for power
zh: 侯赛因被迫下台，因战争罪受审，最终被处决；侯赛因的下台使伊拉克失去了强有力的领导人；什叶派和逊尼派的不同派系激烈争夺权力。

subject: History and Geography
en: U.S. troops left Iraq in 2011; weapons of mass destruction never found
zh: 美军于2011年撤离伊拉克；大规模杀伤性武器从未被发现。

subject: History and Geography
en: In 2011, U.S. soldiers in Pakistan found Osama bin Laden, the al-Qaeda leader responsible for the September 11 attacks, and killed him.
zh: 2011年，美军在巴基斯坦找到了应对9·11袭击负责的基地组织领导人奥萨马·本·拉登，并将其击毙。

subject: History and Geography
en: The war in Afghanistan continued until 2021, when the United States and Great Britain withdrew troops; the Taliban quickly returned to power.
zh: 阿富汗战争持续到2021年，美国和英国撤军；塔利班迅速重新掌权。

subject: History and Geography
topic: Latin America in the Second Half of the Twentieth Century
en: Caribbean B. Background In the second half of the twentieth century, many Latin American nations began to transition from military dictatorships to democracies. Populist leaders tapped into the energy of the working classes and took control in many places. The United States continued its involvement in Latin America as the Cold War accelerated. In the 1970s, military dictatorships took control of many Latin American countries, but democracy eventually returned in most places. The United States inserted itself into Central American and Caribbean commerce and governance in the early twentieth century. It intervened more than thirty times before Timeline 1933, at which point President Franklin Roosevelt adopted the Good Neighbor Policy, which called for an end to armed U.S. intervention in Latin America.
zh: 加勒比地区 B. 背景 20世纪下半叶，许多拉丁美洲国家开始从军事独裁过渡到民主。民粹主义领导人利用工人阶级的力量，在许多地方掌权。随着冷战加剧，美国继续介入拉丁美洲。20世纪70年代，军事独裁政权控制了拉美许多国家，但最终大多数地方都恢复了民主。20世纪初，美国介入中美洲和加勒比的商业与治理，在1933年之前干预了三十多次。1933年，富兰克林·罗斯福总统采取了“睦邻政策”，呼吁结束美国对拉丁美洲的武装干预。时间线

subject: History and Geography
topic: Latin America in the Second Half of the Twentieth Century
en: Mexican Revolution veteran Venustiano Carranza (1859–1920) became the first president of the new Mexican republic in 1917; oversaw rewriting of Mexican constitution
zh: 墨西哥革命老兵贝努斯蒂亚诺·卡兰萨（1859–1920）于1917年成为新墨西哥共和国的首任总统；主持重写墨西哥宪法。

subject: History and Geography
topic: Latin America in the Second Half of the Twentieth Century
en: Carranza eventually succeeded by Lázaro Cárdenas (1895–1970) in 1934; Cárdenas was first Mexican president to truly implement the economic and social reforms outlined in the 1917 constitution
zh: 1934年卡兰萨最终由拉萨罗·卡德纳斯（1895–1970）继任；卡德纳斯是第一位真正落实1917年宪法所概述的经济和社会改革的墨西哥总统。

subject: History and Geography
topic: Latin America in the Second Half of the Twentieth Century
en: Institutional Revolutionary Party (PRI) took over as the nation’s dominant political force after Cárdenas’s presidency ended in 1940.
zh: 1940年卡德纳斯总统任期结束后，革命制度党（PRI）成为该国的主导政治力量。

subject: History and Geography
topic: Latin America in the Second Half of the Twentieth Century
en: PRI eventually taken down by charges of corruption; devastating 1985 earthquake in Mexico City revealed political leaders’ corruption
zh: 革命制度党（PRI）最终因腐败指控而下台；1985年墨西哥城毁灭性地震揭露了政治领导人的腐败。

subject: History and Geography
topic: Latin America in the Second Half of the Twentieth Century
en: In 2000, Vicente Fox, businessman and right-wing populist, won the presidency as a member of the National Action Party (PAN)
zh: 2000年，商人、右翼民粹主义者维森特·福克斯作为国家行动党（PAN）成员赢得总统选举。

subject: History and Geography
topic: Latin America in the Second Half of the Twentieth Century
en: Today, Mexico is an important economic and political player in Latin America; booming industry and service sectors; mineral resources
zh: 如今，墨西哥是拉丁美洲重要的经济和政治角色；工业和服务业蓬勃发展；矿产资源丰富。

subject: History and Geography
en: First peaceful transition of power in Guatemala in 1950; Jacobo Arbenz replaced Juan José Arévalo as president; embraced idea of agrarian reform; in 1952, passed reform to redistribute uncultivated land from wealthy estates to rural workers
zh: 1950年危地马拉首次和平权力交接；哈科沃·阿本斯接替胡安·何塞·阿雷瓦洛担任总统；接受土地改革理念；1952年通过改革，将富裕庄园的未耕地重新分配给农村劳动者。

subject: History and Geography
en: Concept of land reform alarmed U.S. government; believed communists would use the policy to organize the population; instructed CIA to undermine and destabilize the Guatemalan government; authorized the U.S. Air Force to provide arms to Guatemalan military officer Colonel Carlos Castillo Armas (1914–57)
zh: 土地改革的概念惊动了美国政府；美国认为共产党会利用这一政策来组织民众；指示中央情报局（CIA）削弱并颠覆危地马拉政府；授权美国空军向危地马拉军官卡洛斯·卡斯蒂略·阿马斯上校（1914–57）提供武器。

subject: History and Geography
en: Castillo Armas staged military coup against the democratically elected Arbenz in 1954; claimed the presidency; returned all confiscated land to the United Fruit Company; thwarted farmworkers’ attempts to unionize; assassinated in 1957
zh: 1954年，卡斯蒂略·阿马斯对民选的阿本斯发动军事政变；自立为总统；将所有被没收的土地归还联合果品公司；挫败农场工人组织工会的企图；1957年遇刺身亡。

subject: History and Geography
en: Military governments ruled Guatemala for several decades; 1996 peace agreement restored the nation’s representative government
zh: 军政府统治危地马拉数十年；1996年和平协议恢复了国家的代议制政府。

subject: History and Geography
en: Ernesto “Che” Guevara (1928–67), Argentine physician working in Guatemala, took up arms against the U.S.-backed Guatemalan military to fight for Arbenz; as well as Raúl Castro (b. 1931) and Fidel Castro (1926–2016); Guevara one of the leaders of the 1959 Cuban Revolution
zh: 埃内斯托·“切”·格瓦拉（1928–67）是在危地马拉工作的阿根廷医生，他拿起武器反对美国支持的危地马拉军队，为阿本斯而战；劳尔·卡斯特罗（生于1931年）和菲德尔·卡斯特罗（1926–2016）也是如此；格瓦拉是1959年古巴革命的领导人之一。

subject: History and Geography
en: Recognized as independent nation by the United States in 1903 after it allowed joint control of the Canal Zone
zh: 1903年在允许共同控制运河区后，被美国承认为独立国家。

subject: History and Geography
en: In 1977, U.S. president Jimmy Carter signed a treaty that promised to return the Canal Zone to Panama on December 31, 1999.
zh: 1977年，美国总统吉米·卡特签署条约，承诺于1999年12月31日将运河区归还巴拿马。

subject: History and Geography
en: In 1989, during the presidency of George H. W. Bush, the United States helped overthrow Panamanian military dictator Manuel Noriega.
zh: 1989年，在乔治·H·W·布什总统任内，美国帮助推翻了巴拿马军事独裁者曼努埃尔·诺列加。

subject: History and Geography
en: Nicaragua subject to United States intervention many times during the nineteenth and twentieth centuries
zh: 尼加拉瓜在十九和二十世纪多次遭受美国干预。

subject: History and Geography
en: Between 1934 and 1979, Somoza dynasty ruled Nicaragua; known for violence against enemies and for corruption
zh: 1934年至1979年间，索摩查王朝统治尼加拉瓜；以对敌人的暴力和腐败而闻名。

subject: History and Geography
en: In 1979, rebel group called the Sandinistas carried out a successful socialist revolution against the Somoza regime
zh: 1979年，名为桑地诺民族解放阵线（桑解阵）的叛乱组织成功发动了反对索摩查政权的社会主义革命。

subject: History and Geography
en: Sandinistas confiscated and redistributed land owned by the Somoza family.
zh: 桑解阵没收并重新分配了索摩查家族拥有的土地。

subject: History and Geography
en: President Ronald Reagan and his administration helped fund and train a counterrevolutionary military force called the Contras to defeat the Sandinistas.
zh: 罗纳德·里根总统及其政府帮助资助和训练了一支名为反政府武装（Contras）的反革命军事力量，以击败桑解阵。

subject: History and Geography
en: In the Nicaraguan presidential election of 1984, Sandinista leader Daniel Ortega (b. 1945) won 67 percent of vote; following year, the United States imposed a five-year trade embargo
zh: 在1984年尼加拉瓜总统选举中，桑解阵领导人丹尼尔·奥尔特加（生于1945年）赢得67%的选票；次年，美国实施了为期五年的贸易禁运。

subject: History and Geography
en: U.S. Congress passed bills that called for an end to Contra funding; Reagan administration continued to secretly support the counterrevolutionaries.
zh: 美国国会通过了要求停止资助反政府武装的法案；里根政府继续秘密支持这些反革命力量。

subject: History and Geography
en: In 1986, revealed that the U.S. National Security Council had illegally sold weapons to Iran at inflated prices; used profits to fund the Contras; the Iran-Contra Affair
zh: 1986年，曝光美国国家安全委员会以高价非法向伊朗出售武器；用所得利润资助反政府武装；即“伊朗门事件”（Iran-Contra Affair）。

subject: History and Geography
en: In 1990, Nicaraguans elected Violeta Barrios de Chamorro (b. 1929).
zh: 1990年，尼加拉瓜人选举比奥莱塔·巴里奥斯·德·查莫罗（生于1929年）为总统。

subject: History and Geography
en: Daniel Ortega re-elected in 2006; implementation of conservative laws, support for extreme right-wing ideology, and suppression of the press
zh: 丹尼尔·奥尔特加于2006年再次当选；实施保守法律、支持极右翼意识形态并压制新闻自由。

subject: History and Geography
en: El Salvador’s economy largely agricultural in the early twentieth century; rural workers exploited by influential landowners; Salvadorian students protested; Catholic priests worked to improve lives of rural population
zh: 20世纪初萨尔瓦多的经济以农业为主；农村劳动者受到有势力地主的剥削；萨尔瓦多学生提出抗议；天主教神父致力于改善农村人口的生活。

subject: History and Geography
en: Catholic Church viewed as enemy of the ruling elite, the armed forces, and the landowning oligarchy
zh: 天主教会被视为统治精英、武装部队和地主寡头的敌人。

subject: History and Geography
en: In 1960s, guerrilla and anti-government forces in El Salvador drew support from the rural population; success of Sandinistas inspired Salvadorans to rise against oppressive government; between 1979 and 1985, rebel group called Farabundo Martí National Liberation Front (FMLN) almost overthrew Nicaragua’s ruling elite
zh: 20世纪60年代，萨尔瓦多的游击队和反政府力量获得了农村人口的支持；桑解阵的成功鼓舞了萨尔瓦多人奋起反抗压迫性政府；1979年至1985年间，名为法拉本多·马蒂民族解放阵线（FMLN）的叛乱组织几乎推翻了尼加拉瓜的统治精英。

subject: History and Geography
en: Reagan administration supported the Salvadoran military in its fight against the FMLN guerrillas; between 1980 and 1992, the United States sent El Salvador’s government more than $4 billion in economic and military aid
zh: 里根政府支持萨尔瓦多军队对抗 FMLN 游击队；1980年至1992年间，美国向萨尔瓦多政府提供了超过40亿美元的经济和军事援助。

subject: History and Geography
en: Assassination of Archbishop Óscar Romero in 1980 and murder of eight people, including six Catholic priests, in 1989, prompted international pressure
zh: 1980年大主教奥斯卡·罗梅罗遇刺以及1989年包括六名天主教神父在内的八人遇害，促使国际社会施加压力。

subject: History and Geography
en: United Nations brokered a peace agreement between the Salvadoran government and the FMLN in 1992
zh: 1992年，联合国斡旋达成萨尔瓦多政府与 FMLN 之间的和平协议。

subject: History and Geography
en: Brazilian economy impacted by the global depression of 1930s
zh: 巴西经济受到20世纪30年代全球经济大萧条的影响。

subject: History and Geography
en: Getúlio Vargas (1882–1954), Brazilian politician, represented the reform party in the 1930 presidential election; he lost; led armed revolution that overthrew Brazil’s oligarchic government
zh: 热图利奥·瓦加斯（1882–1954）是巴西政治家，在1930年总统选举中代表改革党参选；他落败了；随后领导武装革命推翻了巴西的寡头政府。

subject: History and Geography
en: Vargas centralized power; replaced corrupt coffee barons who ruled southern part of the nation
zh: 瓦加斯将权力集中；取代了统治该国南部的腐败咖啡巨头。

subject: History and Geography
en: In 1937, with help of the Brazilian military, he assumed dictatorial powers; rewrote the country’s constitution; period known as the New State
zh: 1937年，在巴西军方的帮助下，他攫取了独裁权力；重写了国家宪法；这一时期被称为“新国家”（Estado Novo）。

subject: History and Geography
en: Inspired by Mussolini’s rule in Italy, Vargas imposed an authoritarian regime; prohibited political parties that opposed his government; made improvements to educational system; enacted social security laws; established a minimum wage; gave women the right to vote
zh: 受墨索里尼在意大利统治的启发，瓦加斯建立了威权政权；禁止反对他政府的政党；改进教育体系；颁布社会保障法；设立最低工资；给予妇女选举权。

subject: History and Geography
en: Vargas overthrown in 1945 military coup; still maintained widespread public support; was elected president of Brazil in 1951; until his death in 1954, led in a more democratic manner; this approach followed by subsequent presidents; in 1964, military took control of the country
zh: 瓦加斯在1945年军事政变中被推翻；但仍拥有广泛的公众支持；1951年当选巴西总统；直到1954年去世前，他以较为民主的方式领导国家；后续总统沿袭了这一做法；1964年，军方控制了国家。

subject: History and Geography
en: Populist Juan Domingo Perón (1895–1974), Argentine military officer, rose to power during 1943 government coup; recognized workers as important political force; seen as a threat, Domingo Perón arrested and jailed; supporters protested; Perón freed on October 17, 1945; known in Argentina as Loyalty Day; elected president in 1946
zh: 民粹主义者胡安·多明戈·庇隆（1895–1974）是阿根廷军官，在1943年政府政变中掌权；他承认工人是重要的政治力量；被视为威胁后，多明戈·庇隆被捕入狱；支持者抗议；庇隆于1945年10月17日获释；这一天在阿根廷被称为“忠诚日”；1946年他当选总统。

subject: History and Geography
en: Perón rewrote Argentina’s constitution in 1949; bill of rights; free speech restricted; authoritarian regime; prohibited opposing parties
zh: 庇隆于1949年重写阿根廷宪法；包含权利法案；限制言论自由；实行威权政权；禁止反对党。

subject: History and Geography
en: Eva “Evita” Duarte de Perón (1919–52), wife of Juan Perón, powerful female leader in Latin America; helped establish national vote for women in 1947
zh: 埃娃·“艾维塔”·杜阿尔特·德·庇隆（1919–52）是胡安·庇隆的妻子，是拉丁美洲有影响力的女性领袖；帮助在1947年确立了妇女的全国选举权。

subject: History and Geography
en: Military overthrew Peron in 1955; attempted to “de-Perónize” society; prohibited any politician belonging to the Peronist party from holding office; Perón exiled to Spain
zh: 军方于1955年推翻庇隆；试图对社会进行“去庇隆化”；禁止任何庇隆主义党派的政治家担任公职；庇隆被流放到西班牙。

subject: History and Geography
en: Political tensions of Cold War, and economic turmoil of 1970s fragmented Argentine society; Peron returned to Argentina; reelected president in 1973; died in office
zh: 冷战的政治紧张局势和20世纪70年代的经济动荡使阿根廷社会分裂；庇隆返回阿根廷；1973年再次当选总统；在任内去世。

subject: History and Geography
en: Colombia experienced waves of violence after assassination of popular leftist politician and presidential hopeful Jorge Eliécer Gaitán in 1948; period known as La Violencia, or the Era of Violence
zh: 1948年受欢迎的左翼政治家和总统候选人豪尔赫·埃利塞尔·盖坦遇刺后，哥伦比亚经历了多轮暴力浪潮；这一时期被称为“La Violencia”，即“暴力时代”。

subject: History and Geography
en: Laureano Gómez (1889–1965), conservative politician, accused of being involved in Gaitán’s assassination, elected president of Colombia in 1950; censored the press, restricted courts, persecuted Protestants; Gómez overthrown by Colombian military in 1953
zh: 劳雷亚诺·戈麦斯（1889–1965）是保守派政治家，被指控参与盖坦遇刺，1950年当选哥伦比亚总统；他审查新闻、限制法院、迫害新教徒；1953年戈麦斯被哥伦比亚军方推翻。

subject: History and Geography
en: Gómez replaced by General Gustavo Rojas Pinilla (1900–75); corrupt authoritarian; his presidency even more restrictive than Gómez’s
zh: 古斯塔沃·罗哈斯·皮尼利亚将军（1900–75）取代了戈麦斯；他是腐败的独裁者；其总统任期比戈麦斯时期更加严苛。

subject: History and Geography
en: Guerrilla insurgent groups faded away in most of Latin America after the Cold War; not in Columbia; Revolutionary Armed Forces of Colombia (FARC) and other groups waged war in countryside
zh: 冷战结束后，游击叛乱组织在拉丁美洲大部分地区逐渐消失；但在哥伦比亚并非如此；哥伦比亚革命武装力量（FARC）等组织在乡村地区继续作战。

subject: History and Geography
en: Álvaro Uribe (b. 1952) elected president of Colombia in 2002; waged war against rebel groups; more than two hundred thousand Colombians died; millions displaced; Uribe reelected and served until 2010
zh: 阿尔瓦罗·乌里韦（生于1952年）于2002年当选哥伦比亚总统；对叛乱组织发动战争；超过二十万哥伦比亚人死亡；数百万人流离失所；乌里韦连任并执政至2010年。

subject: History and Geography
en: Democratic governments of several South American countries ruthlessly overthrown in the 1960s and 1970s; often political parties banned, legislatures shut down, and press censored; lawmaking by decree
zh: 20世纪60年代和70年代，几个南美洲国家的民主政府被无情推翻；政党经常被取缔，立法机构被关闭，新闻受到审查；通过法令进行立法。

subject: History and Geography
en: Dictators reversed populist policies that benefited workers; banned unions, strikes, and other public demonstrations; anti-communist
zh: 独裁者废除了惠及工人的民粹主义政策；禁止工会、罢工和其他公开示威；持反共产主义立场。

subject: History and Geography
en: Regimes set up special security forces to kidnap and kill anyone suspected of leftist or anti-government activities
zh: 这些政权建立了特别安全部队，绑架并杀害任何被怀疑从事左翼或反政府活动的人。

subject: History and Geography
en: In Argentina, historians estimate up to thirty thousand people were “disappeared,” or kidnapped.
zh: 在阿根廷，历史学家估计有多达三万人“失踪”，即被绑架。

subject: History and Geography
en: United States worked to prevent spread of communist ideology across Latin America; between 1955 and 1976, Argentina received almost $400 million in military support from the United States; in Chile, the U.S. Navy and CIA provided military support for September 11, 1973, coup that replaced socialist president Salvador Allende (1908–73) with dictator Augusto Pinochet (1915–2006)
zh: 美国努力阻止共产主义意识形态在拉丁美洲蔓延；1955年至1976年间，阿根廷从美国获得了近4亿美元的军事援助；在智利，美国海军和中情局为1973年9月11日的政变提供了军事支持，该政变用独裁者奥古斯托·皮诺切特（1915–2006）取代了社会主义总统萨尔瓦多·阿连德（1908–73）。

subject: History and Geography
en: Pinochet embraced capitalism; rewrote the nation’s constitution; universities put under control of military men, who controlled course curricula and hiring and firing of faculty; by 1980, Chile the most privatized and unregulated economy in the world
zh: 皮诺切特拥抱资本主义；重写了国家宪法；大学被置于军方人员控制之下，他们控制课程设置以及教师的聘用和解聘；到1980年，智利成为世界上私有化程度最高、监管最少经济体。

subject: History and Geography
en: Pinochet lost the election in 1988; maintained role as head of the armed forces until 1998
zh: 皮诺切特在1988年选举中落败；但一直保留武装部队总司令的职位直到1998年。

subject: History and Geography
en: Falkland Islands, also called Malvinas Islands; conflict in 1982 between Argentina and Britain
zh: 福克兰群岛，也称马尔维纳斯群岛；1982年阿根廷与英国之间爆发冲突。

subject: History and Geography
en: Raúl Alfonsín (1927–2009) democratically elected president of Argentina in 1983; created the National Commission on the Disappeared; Mothers of the Plaza de Mayo
zh: 劳尔·阿方辛（1927–2009）于1983年通过民主选举当选阿根廷总统；设立了失踪人员全国委员会；五月广场母亲组织（Mothers of the Plaza de Mayo）。

subject: History and Geography
en: In Brazil, military regime began slow transition to democracy in the 1970s during period known as the abertura, or opening
zh: 在巴西，军政府在20世纪70年代开始缓慢向民主过渡，这一时期被称为“开放”（abertura）。

subject: History and Geography
en: Across Latin America, Catholic Church turned against the military due to many human rights abuses
zh: 在整个拉丁美洲，天主教会因军队诸多侵犯人权行为而转而反对军政府。

subject: History and Geography
en: Aftermath of dictatorships resulted in many challenges for South American countries
zh: 独裁统治的后果给南美洲国家带来了许多挑战。

subject: History and Geography
en: Cuban Revolution in 1959 highlighted Cold War tensions
zh: 1959年古巴革命凸显了冷战紧张局势。

subject: History and Geography
en: Cuban alliance with the Soviet Union during the Cold War; Cuba experienced four hundred years of Spanish colonialism, followed by U.S. involvement in its affairs
zh: 冷战期间古巴与苏联结盟；古巴经历了四百年的西班牙殖民统治，随后美国介入其事务。

subject: History and Geography
en: In 1903, the United States passed the Platt Amendment; stated that the U.S. government had political authority over Cuba; authority lasted until 1934; ended by the Good Neighbor Policy; next quarter century, Cuba led by rulers friendly to American interests
zh: 1903年，美国通过《普拉特修正案》；宣称美国政府对古巴拥有政治权力；这一权力持续到1934年；随“睦邻政策”而终止；此后四分之一世纪，古巴由亲美利益的统治者领导。

subject: History and Geography
en: In 1933, Fulgencio Batista (1901–73) led coup that overthrew the government; maintained influence over next presidents for a period
zh: 1933年，富尔亨西奥·巴蒂斯塔（1901–73）领导政变推翻政府；在一段时间内对后续总统保持影响力。

subject: History and Geography
en: In 1940, Batista elected president; increasingly bound to the United States; after serving full term, moved to the United States; Batista returned to Cuba in 1952; staged successful coup with the support of Cuban military; worked with leaders of organized crime in the United States to promote tourism
zh: 1940年，巴蒂斯塔当选总统；与美国的关系日益紧密；任期届满后移居美国；1952年巴蒂斯塔返回古巴；在古巴军方支持下成功发动政变；与美国有组织犯罪头目合作发展旅游业。

subject: History and Geography
en: Middle-class law student, Fidel Castro, leading opponent of Batista; on July 26, 1953, Castro led failed insurrection in eastern Cuba; many Cubans killed; Fidel and his brother Raúl arrested; upon their release, in 1955, go into exile in Mexico; meet Ernesto “Che” Guevara; organize revolutionary group, the 26th of July Movement
zh: 中产阶级法律系学生菲德尔·卡斯特罗是巴蒂斯塔的主要反对者；1953年7月26日，卡斯特罗在古巴东部领导了一次失败的起义；许多古巴人被杀；菲德尔和他的弟弟劳尔被捕；1955年获释后流亡墨西哥；结识埃内斯托·“切”·格瓦拉；组织革命团体“七二六运动”（26th of July Movement）。

subject: History and Geography
en: Castros, Guevara, and seventy-nine other revolutionaries sailed to Cuba from Mexico in 1956; many killed; three leaders and some revolutionaries survive; lived in the Sierra Maestra mountains and attracted more members; waged a guerilla battle against Batista’s forces; on January 1, 1959, the rebels entered Cuban capital, Havana
zh: 1956年，卡斯特罗兄弟、格瓦拉和其他七十九名革命者从墨西哥乘船返回古巴；许多人被杀；三位领导人和部分革命者幸存；他们在马埃斯特腊山区生活并吸引了更多成员；对巴蒂斯塔军队开展游击战；1959年1月1日，起义者进入古巴首都哈瓦那。

subject: History and Geography
en: Fidel Castro pushed back against U.S. economic dominance; in 1960, Castro made deal to sell Cuban sugar to Soviet Union; U.S. president Dwight D. Eisenhower’s administration retaliated; ended diplomatic relations with Castro; U.S. organize Cuban dissidents to return to Cuba; attempt to overthrow Castro—Bay of Pigs, April 17, 1961; attempt fails; U.S. operation Mongoose also fails
zh: 菲德尔·卡斯特罗抵制美国的经济支配；1960年，卡斯特罗达成协议向苏联出售古巴糖；美国总统德怀特·D·艾森豪威尔政府予以报复；与卡斯特罗断绝外交关系；美国组织古巴异见人士返回古巴；试图推翻卡斯特罗——1961年4月17日的猪湾事件；行动失败；美国的“猫鼬行动”（Operation Mongoose）也告失败。

subject: History and Geography
en: Castro declares revolution socialist
zh: 卡斯特罗宣布革命为社会主义革命。

subject: History and Geography
en: In October 1962, U.S. spy planes take satellite photos of installation of Soviet nuclear warheads in Cuba
zh: 1962年10月，美国间谍飞机的卫星照片显示苏联在古巴部署核弹头。

subject: History and Geography
en: Soviet leader Nikita Khrushchev (1894–1971) had installed weapons in Cuba in response to U.S. weapons placed in Turkey
zh: 苏联领导人尼基塔·赫鲁晓夫（1894–1971）在古巴部署武器，以回应美国在土耳其部署武器。

subject: History and Geography
en: President Kennedy demands withdrawal of Soviet nuclear warheads; Cuban missile crisis; Soviet Union withdraws missiles in exchange for U.S. assurance not to invade Cuba; thousands of Cubans migrate to the United States; Mariel boatlift, 1980
zh: 肯尼迪总统要求撤走苏联核弹头；古巴导弹危机；苏联撤走导弹，以换取美国不入侵古巴的保证；成千上万的古巴人移民美国；1980年马里埃尔船运事件（Mariel boatlift）。

subject: History and Geography
en: Cuba entered period of economic hardship in 1990s; U.S. maintains economic embargo against Cuba
zh: 古巴在20世纪90年代进入经济困难时期；美国继续对古巴实施经济禁运。

subject: History and Geography
en: Fidel Castro died in 2016; Raúl Castro becomes president
zh: 菲德尔·卡斯特罗于2016年去世；劳尔·卡斯特罗出任总统。

subject: History and Geography
en: United States Marines stationed in Haiti from 1915 until 1934
zh: 美国海军陆战队从1915年到1934年驻扎在海地。

subject: History and Geography
en: In 1957, United States supported François “Papa Doc” Duvalier (1907–71) as Haiti’s president; supportive of U.S.; corruption; exploitation of Haitian resources; after his death, his son, Jean-Claude “Baby Doc” Duvalier (1951–2014) installed in office; ousted in 1986
zh: 1957年，美国支持弗朗索瓦·“老杜瓦利埃”（Papa Doc）·杜瓦利埃（1907–71）出任海地总统；他亲美；腐败；剥削海地资源；他死后，其子让-克洛德·“小杜瓦利埃”（Baby Doc）·杜瓦利埃（1951–2014）被安插上台；1986年被推翻。

subject: History and Geography
en: In 1965, the United States sent troops to the Dominican Republic to end a civil war and install an authoritarian government friendly to its interests.
zh: 1965年，美国向多米尼加共和国派兵，以结束内战并扶植一个符合其利益的威权政府。

subject: History and Geography
topic: Modern World Events, Challenges, and Successes
en: Map of the World B. Globalization
zh: 世界地图B. 全球化

subject: History and Geography
topic: Modern World Events, Challenges, and Successes
en: Modern globalized economy is result of end of the Cold War
zh: 现代全球化经济是冷战结束的结果。

subject: History and Geography
topic: Modern World Events, Challenges, and Successes
en: Networks of production, distribution, trade; fast communications technology; capacity for goods to crisscross the planet; just-in-time supply chain; opportunity for ideas and culture to spread around the world; global influence of American popular culture
zh: 生产、分销和贸易网络；快速的通信技术；商品能够纵横全球的能力；即时供应链（just-in-time）；思想和文化传播到世界各地的机会；美国流行文化的全球影响力。

subject: History and Geography
topic: Modern World Events, Challenges, and Successes
en: World Trade Organization (WTO) formed in 1995 to set standards for global trade and exchange
zh: 世界贸易组织（WTO）于1995年成立，为全球贸易和交流制定标准。

subject: History and Geography
topic: Modern World Events, Challenges, and Successes
en: Rise of China as industrial power
zh: 中国作为工业强国的崛起。

subject: History and Geography
topic: Modern World Events, Challenges, and Successes
en: China became world’s leading exporter of textiles, furniture, toys
zh: 中国成为世界最大的纺织品、家具和玩具出口国。

subject: History and Geography
topic: Modern World Events, Challenges, and Successes
en: China’s industrial expansion shifted focus to infrastructure in 1999; high-speed rail, highways, building materials, ships
zh: 1999年中国的工业扩张将重点转向基础设施；高铁、公路、建筑材料、船舶。

subject: History and Geography
topic: Modern World Events, Challenges, and Successes
en: China admitted into the WTO in 2001
zh: 中国于2001年加入世界贸易组织。

subject: History and Geography
topic: Modern World Events, Challenges, and Successes
en: Growing use of offshore, or foreign, labor; business leaders investing in developing countries such as India and China; workers paid less than workers in the United States and Europe
zh: 越来越多地使用海外（外国）劳动力；商业领袖在印度和中国等发展中国家投资；这些工人的工资低于美国和欧洲的工人。

subject: History and Geography
topic: Modern World Events, Challenges, and Successes
en: Developing countries had fewer safety and environmental regulations, favorable tax rates
zh: 发展中国家的安全和环保法规较少，税率优惠。

subject: History and Geography
topic: Modern World Events, Challenges, and Successes
en: Type of labor performed overseas changed; developing nations had improved systems of education; produced greater numbers of skilled workers and university graduates; caused increase in the amount of skilled labor that was outsourced to the developing world
zh: 在海外从事的劳动类型发生了变化；发展中国家的教育体系得到改善；培养出更多技术工人和大学毕业生；导致外包到发展中国家的技术劳动力数量增加。

subject: History and Geography
topic: Modern World Events, Challenges, and Successes
en: Internet communications technology connects billions of people; satellites; mobile phones
zh: 互联网通信技术连接了数十亿人；卫星；移动电话。

subject: History and Geography
topic: Modern World Events, Challenges, and Successes
en: Criticism of globalization; blamed for weakening national economic strength
zh: 对全球化的批评；被指责削弱了国家经济实力。

subject: History and Geography
topic: Modern World Events, Challenges, and Successes
en: Global financial crisis 2007-2009
zh: 2007—2009年全球金融危机。

subject: History and Geography
topic: Modern World Events, Challenges, and Successes
en: Global trade and travel contribute to spread of infectious diseases; COVID-19; vaccinations developed by international teams of scientists
zh: 全球贸易和旅行助长传染病的传播；新冠疫情（COVID-19）；由国际科学家团队研发疫苗。

subject: History and Geography
en: Estimated 7.7 billion people lived on Earth in 2019; increase of 1 billion people since 2007 and 2 billion since 1994; growth slowing; birth rate decreasing
zh: 据估计，2019年地球上生活着77亿人；比2007年增加10亿人，比1994年增加20亿人；增长正在放缓；出生率下降。

subject: History and Geography
en: United Nations predicts world’s population will reach a peak of about 11 billion people by 2100
zh: 联合国预测，到2100年世界人口将达到约110亿的峰值。

subject: History and Geography
en: Life expectancy increasing; aging population trends
zh: 预期寿命延长；人口老龄化趋势。

subject: History and Geography
en: Larger global population and interconnected world economy have contributed to increased human migration
zh: 全球人口增加和相互关联的世界经济促成了人口迁移的增加。

subject: History and Geography
en: Migration factors: economic, conflicts, wars, persecution, disasters in home countries; United Nations estimated in 2021, 26.6 million people in the world were refugees seeking safety from conflicts and disasters; increase in anti-immigrant rhetoric
zh: 迁移因素：经济、冲突、战争、迫害、本国的灾害；联合国估计，2021年世界上有2660万人是为躲避冲突和灾难而寻求安全的难民；反移民言论增多。

subject: History and Geography
en: Major lingering issue from the end of the Cold War—the handling of the world’s nuclear weapons
zh: 冷战结束遗留的一个重大问题——如何处理世界核武器。

subject: History and Geography
en: Conflicts in former Russian regions of Chechnya, Georgia, Crimea, Ukraine
zh: 前俄罗斯地区车臣、格鲁吉亚、克里米亚、乌克兰的冲突。

subject: History and Geography
en: Following global financial crisis of 2007–9, wave of pro-democracy protests in North Africa and Southwest Asia in 2010–11; protests triggered by economic crises and demands for political reform; in Tunisia, President Zine al-Abidine Ben Ali forced to resign in 2011; in Egypt, President Hosni Mubarak forced to resign in 2011; uprisings in Syria, Libya, and Yemen (Arab Spring)
zh: 继2007—2009年全球金融危机之后，2010—2011年北非和西亚掀起一波亲民主抗议浪潮；抗议由经济危机和政治改革诉求引发；2011年突尼斯总统宰因·阿比丁·本·阿里被迫辞职；2011年埃及总统胡斯尼·穆巴拉克被迫辞职；叙利亚、利比亚和也门也爆发起义（阿拉伯之春）。

subject: History and Geography
en: Arab Spring largely unable to replace authoritarian leaders with democratic governments
zh: 阿拉伯之春基本上未能用民主政府取代威权领导人。

subject: History and Geography
en: In Syria, under government of Bashar al-Assad, rebel uprising turned into extended civil war; more than seven million Syrians have fled the country
zh: 在叙利亚，巴沙尔·阿萨德政府执政期间，叛乱演变为长期内战；超过七百万叙利亚人逃离该国。

subject: History and Geography
en: In Libya, dictator Muammar al-Qaddafi removed from power after European and U.S. forces gave military aid to Libyan rebels
zh: 在利比亚，欧洲和美国军队向利比亚叛军提供军事援助后，独裁者穆阿迈尔·卡扎菲被赶下台。

subject: History and Geography
en: The Islamic State of Iraq and Syria (ISIS) emerged between 2011 and 2014; at the height of its power, the Islamic State controlled 30 percent of Syria and 40 percent of Iraq
zh: 伊拉克和叙利亚伊斯兰国（ISIS）于2011年至2014年间出现；在其势力鼎盛时期，伊斯兰国控制了叙利亚30%和伊拉克40%的领土。

subject: History and Geography
en: Changes in weather patterns; extremes; changing levels of individual gases impacts individual functions and capabilities of the atmosphere; carbon dioxide and methane
zh: 天气模式的变化；极端天气；个别气体含量的变化影响大气的个别功能和能力；二氧化碳和甲烷。

subject: History and Geography
en: Deforestation in world’s rain forests (Amazon)
zh: 世界雨林（亚马逊）的森林砍伐。

subject: History and Geography
en: Global initiatives have attempted to tackle issue by lowering emissions; making plans to transition to renewable, clean energy sources
zh: 全球性倡议试图通过降低排放来解决问题；制定向可再生、清洁能源过渡的计划。

subject: History and Geography
en: Kyoto Protocol, signed in 1997, put into effect in 2005, committed industrialized nations to cut greenhouse gas emissions; requested developing nations also do so
zh: 《京都议定书》于1997年签署、2005年生效，要求工业化国家削减温室气体排放；并要求发展中国家也这样做。

subject: History and Geography
en: Paris Agreement, signed in 2015, put into effect in 2016, commits all parties to reduction of emissions
zh: 《巴黎协定》于2015年签署、2016年生效，要求所有缔约方减少排放。

subject: History and Geography
en: Revived interest in space exploration
zh: 对太空探索的兴趣重新兴起。

subject: History and Geography
en: Robotic explorer rover, Curiosity, landed on Mars in 2012; began to transmit images and data from the red planet’s surface back to Earth; Curiosity mission followed by others; Perseverance, landed on Mars in 2021
zh: 机器人探测车“好奇号”（Curiosity）于2012年登陆火星；开始将这颗红色星球表面的图像和数据传回地球；“好奇号”任务之后还有其他任务；“毅力号”（Perseverance）于2021年登陆火星。

subject: History and Geography
en: China showing increased interest in its space program; in 2020, Chang’e-5 lander touched down on the moon’s surface
zh: 中国对其航天计划的兴趣日益增加；2020年，嫦娥五号着陆器在月球表面着陆。

subject: History and Geography
en: Medical breakthroughs in 21st Century helping to eradicate disease and illness around the world
zh: 21世纪的医学突破有助于在全世界根除疾病。

subject: Visual Arts
en: Teachers: In schools, lessons on the visual arts should illustrate important elements of making and appreciating art, and emphasize important artists, works of art, and artistic concepts. When appropriate, topics in the visual arts may be linked to topics in other disciplines. The following guidelines specify a variety of artwork in different media and from various cultures in order to expose students to a wide range of art and artists. While the list is robust, it may require teachers to narrow the selection in order to adequately address the works and related skills within an academic year. In studying the works of art specified below, and in creating their own art, students should review, develop, and apply concepts introduced in previous grades, such as line, shape, form, space, texture, color, light, design, and symmetry
zh: 教师提示：在学校的视觉艺术课程中，应阐明创作与鉴赏艺术的重要元素，并强调重要的艺术家、艺术作品和艺术概念。在适当的时候，视觉艺术主题可与其他学科的主题相联系。以下指导原则列出了不同媒介、不同文化的多种艺术作品，以让学生接触广泛的艺术和艺术家。这份清单虽然丰富，但教师可能需要缩小选择范围，以便在一个学年内充分讲清这些作品及相关技能。在学习下列艺术作品和创作自己的作品时，学生应复习、发展并运用前几个年级引入的概念，如线条、形状、形体、空间、肌理、色彩、光线、设计和对称。

subject: Visual Arts
en: The guidelines here continue the organizational scheme established in sixth and seventh grades, which combined art history with analysis of specific illustrative works. Timelines may help students situate the artists, periods, and schools. Note that the periods and characteristics are not absolute distinctions but generally helpful categories (to which there are always exceptions) often used in discussions of art.
zh: 这里的指南延续了六、七年级确立的组织框架，即将艺术史与对具体代表性作品的分析相结合。时间线有助于学生确定艺术家、时期和流派的位置。请注意，时期和特征并非绝对的区分，而是通常用于艺术讨论的、大体上有帮助的分类（总有例外）。

subject: Visual Arts
en: Examine representative artists and works, including
zh: 考察代表性的艺术家和作品，包括

subject: Visual Arts
en: Regionalism, including:
zh: 地方主义（Regionalism），包括：
details: Grant Wood, American Gothic (1930) | Edward Hopper, Nighthawks (1942) | Andrew Wyeth, Christina’s World (1948)

subject: Visual Arts
en: Diego Rivera, Detroit Industry
zh: 迭戈·里维拉（Diego Rivera），《底特律工业》(Detroit Industry)

subject: Visual Arts
en: Jacob Lawrence, a work from his Builder series (1947) or Migration of Negroes series (1941)
zh: 雅各布·劳伦斯（Jacob Lawrence），其《建造者》系列（Builder series，1947）或《黑人迁徙》系列（Migration of Negroes series，1941）中的一件作品

subject: Visual Arts
en: Horace Pippin, Sunday Morning Breakfast, (1943)
zh: 霍勒斯·皮平（Horace Pippin），《星期日早晨的早餐》(Sunday Morning Breakfast)（1943）
