subject: Music
en: The Music guidelines for Grades 6–8 share a basic vocabulary of the elements of music that can inform the discussion, appreciation, and study of selected musical works. Following these guidelines are recommendations in each grade for a core of musical content, broadly organized as a history of music from early to modern times, with attention to specific periods, composers, and genres. While these guidelines focus on musical vocabulary, appreciation, and history, musical performance should be encouraged and emphasized as local resources allow.
zh: 6—8年级的音乐指南共享一套关于音乐要素的基本词汇，可用于指导对所选音乐作品的讨论、欣赏和学习。在这些指南之后，各年级都推荐了核心音乐内容，大致按从早期到现代的音乐史来组织，并关注特定时期、作曲家和体裁。虽然这些指南侧重于音乐词汇、欣赏和历史，但在当地条件允许的情况下，应鼓励并重视音乐表演。

en: These guidelines focus on influential modern musicians, but this list is not intended to be exhaustive. Review lyrics and/or video performances of any song by these performers prior to sharing with students to ensure it is appropriate with the culture and standards of your classroom. When introducing the individual/band and work, highlight how this artist was influential and what examples from his/her/their music inspired later musicians. Aretha Franklin The Beatles Bob Dylan Carol King Chuck Berry Elvis Presley James Brown Joan Baez Joni Mitchell Little Richard Miles Davis Nat King Cole Ray Charles

subject: Mathematics
en: Teachers: In learning the new concepts and procedures, students should use previously acquired mathematics to ensure that the procedures become automatic and habitual. Students should continue to master the use of measuring and drawing instruments, develop their mental arithmetic and their approximating abilities, become more familiar with deductive reasoning, and use calculators and computers in a thoughtful way. While teaching methods may vary, it is worth keeping in mind the psychological principle that the most effective method for learning mathematics emphasizes frequent, varied practice, and encourages multiple approaches to solving varied types of problems.
zh: 教师须知：在学习新概念和运算方法时，学生应运用已掌握的数学知识，确保这些方法变得自动化并成为习惯。学生应继续熟练掌握测量和绘图工具的使用，发展心算和估算能力，更加熟悉演绎推理，并审慎地使用计算器和计算机。虽然教学方法可以多样，但值得记住的心理原则是：学习数学最有效的方法强调经常的、多样化的练习，并鼓励采用多种方法解决不同类型的问题。

subject: Mathematics
en: Know that there are numbers that are not rational, and approximate them by rational numbers.
zh: 知道存在非有理数（无理数），并能用有理数近似表示它们。

subject: Mathematics
en: Know that numbers that are not rational are called irrational.
zh: 知道非有理数称为无理数。
details: Understand (informally) that every number has a decimal expansion. | Show that for rational numbers the decimal expansion eventually repeats. | Convert a decimal expansion which repeats eventually into a rational number.

subject: Mathematics
en: Use rational approximations of irrational numbers to compare the size of irrational numbers. • Identify approximate location on a number line diagram • Estimate the value of expressions
zh: 用有理数近似值比较无理数的大小。• 在数轴上标出无理数的大致位置 • 估算算式的值

subject: Mathematics
en: Work with radicals and integer exponents.
zh: 学习根式与整数指数。

subject: Mathematics
en: Know and apply the properties of integer exponents to generate equivalent numerical expressions.
zh: 掌握并运用整数指数的性质，构造等价的数值表达式。

subject: Mathematics
en: Use square root and cube root symbols to represent solutions to equations of the form x2 = p and x3 = p, where p is a positive rational number. • Evaluate square roots of small perfect squares. • Evaluate cube roots of small perfect cubes. • Know that √2 is irrational.
zh: 用平方根与立方根符号表示 x² = p 和 x³ = p（p 为正有理数）形式方程的解。• 求较小的完全平方数的平方根 • 求较小的完全立方数的立方根 • 知道 √2 是无理数。

subject: Mathematics
en: Use numbers expressed in the form of a single digit times an integer power of 10 to estimate very large or very small quantities. • Express how many times as much one is than the other.
zh: 用“一位数乘以 10 的整数次幂”的形式表示数，以估算极大或极小的量。• 表示一个量是另一个量的多少倍。

subject: Mathematics
en: Perform operations with numbers expressed in scientific notation.
zh: 对用科学记数法表示的数进行运算。
details: Use scientific notation and choose units of appropriate size for measurements of very large or very small quantities. | Interpret scientific notation that has been generated by technology.

subject: Mathematics
en: Understand the connections between proportional relationships, lines, and linear equations.
zh: 理解比例关系、直线与线性方程之间的联系。

subject: Mathematics
en: Graph proportional relationships.
zh: 画出比例关系的图像。
details: Interpret the unit rate as the slope of the graph. | Compare two different proportional relationships represented in different ways.

subject: Mathematics
en: Use similar triangles to explain why the slope m is the same between any two distinct points on a non-vertical line in the coordinate plane. • Derive the equation y = mx for a line through the origin • Derive the equation y = mx + b for a line intercepting the vertical axis at b.
zh: 利用相似三角形解释：在坐标平面中，非竖直直线上任意两个不同点之间的斜率 m 都相同。• 推导过原点的直线方程 y = mx • 推导与纵轴交于 b 的直线方程 y = mx + b

subject: Mathematics
en: Analyze and solve linear equations and pairs of simultaneous linear equations.
zh: 分析并求解一元一次方程及二元一次方程组（联立线性方程组）。

subject: Mathematics
en: Solve linear equations in one variable. Include problems where both decimal and scientific notation are used. • Give examples of linear equations in one variable with one solution, infinitely many solutions, or no solutions.
zh: 解一元一次方程，包括同时使用小数与科学记数法的问题。 • 举例说明一元一次方程有一个解、无穷多个解或无解的情形。

subject: Mathematics
en: Show which of these possibilities is the case by successively transforming the given equation into simpler forms. • Solve linear equations with rational number coefficients.
zh: 通过逐步将给定方程化为更简单的形式，判断属于哪种情形。• 解系数为有理数的一元一次方程。

subject: Mathematics
en: Analyze and solve pairs of simultaneous linear equations.
zh: 分析并求解二元一次方程组。
details: Understand that solutions to a system of two linear equations in two variables correspond to points of intersection of their graphs. | Solve systems of two linear equations in two variables algebraically.

subject: Mathematics
en: Estimate solutions by graphing the equations.
zh: 通过画出方程图像估算解。

subject: Mathematics
en: Solve simple cases by inspection.
zh: 用观察法解简单的情形。
details: Solve real-world and mathematical problems leading to two linear equations in two variables.

subject: Mathematics
en: Define, evaluate, and compare functions.
zh: 定义、求值和比较函数。

subject: Mathematics
en: Understand that a function is a rule that assigns to each input exactly one output.
zh: 理解函数是一种规则：对每个输入都恰好指定一个输出。

subject: Mathematics
en: Compare properties of two functions each represented in a different way.
zh: 比较以不同方式表示的两个函数的性质。

subject: Mathematics
en: Interpret the equation y = mx + b as defining a linear function (a straight line).
zh: 把方程 y = mx + b 理解为定义了一个线性函数（一条直线）。
details: Give examples of functions that are not linear.

subject: Mathematics
en: Use functions to model relationships between quantities.
zh: 用函数为数量之间的关系建模。

subject: Mathematics
en: Construct a function to model a linear relationship between two quantities.
zh: 构造一个函数，为两个量之间的线性关系建模。
details: Determine the rate of change and initial value of the function from a description of a relationship or from two (x, y) values. | Interpret the rate of change and initial value of a linear function in terms of the situation it models. | Interpret the rate of change and initial value of a linear function in terms of its graph or a table of values.

subject: Mathematics
en: Describe qualitatively the functional relationship between two quantities by analyzing a graph. • Sketch a graph that exhibits the qualitative features of a function that has been described verbally.
zh: 通过分析图像，定性描述两个量之间的函数关系。• 根据对函数的文字描述，草绘出体现其定性特征的图像。

subject: Mathematics
en: Understand congruence and similarity using physical models, transparencies, or geometry software.
zh: 借助实物模型、透明胶片或几何软件理解全等与相似。

subject: Mathematics
en: Verify experimentally the properties of rotations, reflections, and translations:
zh: 通过实验验证旋转、轴对称（反射）和平移的性质：
details: Lines are taken to lines, and line segments to line segments of the same length. | Angles are taken to angles of the same measure. | Parallel lines are taken to parallel lines.

subject: Mathematics
en: Understand that a two-dimensional figure is congruent to another if the second can be obtained from the first by a sequence of rotations, reflections, and translations. • Given two congruent figures, describe a sequence that exhibits the congruence between them.
zh: 理解：若一个二维图形可经过一系列旋转、反射和平移由另一个图形得到，则二者全等。• 给定两个全等图形，描述体现其全等关系的一系列变换。

subject: Mathematics
en: Describe the effect of dilations, translations, rotations, and reflections on two dimensional figures using coordinates.
zh: 用坐标描述伸缩（位似）、平移、旋转和反射对二维图形的影响。

subject: Mathematics
en: Understand that a two-dimensional figure is similar to another if the second can be obtained from the first by a sequence of rotations, reflections, translations, and dilations. • Given two similar two-dimensional figures, describe a sequence that exhibits the similarity between them. Transforming into simpler forms until an equivalent equation of the form x = a, a = a, or a = b results. Including, equations whose solutions require expanding expressions using the distributive property and collecting like terms. Points of intersection satisfy both equations simultaneously. The graph of a function is the set of ordered pairs consisting of an input and the corresponding output. Represented algebraically, graphically, numerically in tables, or by verbal descriptions. Including reading these from a table or from a graph.
zh: 理解：若一个二维图形可经过一系列旋转、反射、平移和伸缩由另一个图形得到，则二者相似。• 给定两个相似的二维图形，描述体现其相似关系的一系列变换。将其化为更简单的形式，直到得到形如 x = a、a = a 或 a = b 的等价方程，包括解需要用分配律展开表达式并合并同类项的方程。交点同时满足两个方程。函数的图像是由输入及其对应输出组成的有序对构成的集合。可用代数式、图像、表格中的数值或文字描述来表示，包括从表格或图中读出这些信息。

subject: Mathematics
en: Use informal arguments to establish facts about the angle sum and exterior angle of triangles.
zh: 用非正式的推理说明三角形内角和与外角的相关结论。

subject: Mathematics
en: Use informal arguments to establish facts about the angles created when parallel lines are cut by a transversal.
zh: 用非正式的推理说明平行线被截线所截形成的角的相关结论。

subject: Mathematics
en: Use informal arguments to establish facts about the angle-angle criterion for similarity of triangles.
zh: 用非正式的推理说明三角形相似的“角角（AA）判定准则”。

subject: Mathematics
en: Understand and apply the Pythagorean theorem.
zh: 理解并运用勾股定理（毕达哥拉斯定理）。

subject: Mathematics
en: Explain a proof of the Pythagorean Theorem and its converse.
zh: 解释勾股定理及其逆定理的一个证明。

subject: Mathematics
en: Apply the Pythagorean Theorem to determine unknown side lengths in right triangles in real-world and mathematical problems in two and three dimensions.
zh: 在二维和三维的实际问题与数学问题中，运用勾股定理求直角三角形的未知边长。

subject: Mathematics
en: Apply the Pythagorean Theorem to find the distance between two points in a coordinate system.
zh: 运用勾股定理求坐标系中两点之间的距离。

subject: Mathematics
en: Solve real-world and mathematical problems involving volume of cylinders, cones and spheres.
zh: 解决涉及圆柱、圆锥和球体积的实际问题与数学问题。

subject: Mathematics
en: Know the formulas for the volumes of cones, cylinders, and spheres and use them to solve real-world and mathematical problems.
zh: 掌握圆锥、圆柱和球的体积公式，并用其解决实际问题与数学问题。

subject: Mathematics
en: Investigate patterns of association in bivariate data.
zh: 探究双变量数据中的关联模式。

subject: Mathematics
en: Construct and interpret scatter plots for bivariate measurement data to investigate patterns of association between two quantities. • Describe patterns such as clustering, outliers, positive or negative association, linear association, and nonlinear association.
zh: 为双变量测量数据绘制并解读散点图，以探究两个量之间的关联模式。• 描述诸如聚集、离群值、正相关或负相关、线性关联与非线性关联等模式。

subject: Mathematics
en: Know that straight lines are widely used to model relationships between two quantitative variables. • For scatter plots that suggest a linear association, informally fit a straight line, and informally assess the model fit by judging the closeness of the data points to the line.
zh: 知道直线被广泛用于为两个数量变量之间的关系建模。• 对于显示线性关联的散点图，非正式地拟合一条直线，并通过数据点与直线的接近程度来非正式地评估模型的拟合效果。

subject: Mathematics
en: Use the equation of a linear model to solve problems in the context of bivariate measurement data, interpreting the slope and intercept.
zh: 在双变量测量数据的情境中，运用线性模型的方程解决问题，并解释斜率与截距的含义。

subject: Mathematics
en: Understand that patterns of association can also be seen in bivariate categorical data by displaying frequencies and relative frequencies in a two-way table. • Construct and interpret a two-way table summarizing data on two categorical variables collected from the same subjects. • Use relative frequencies calculated for rows or columns to describe possible association between the two variables.
zh: 理解：通过在双向表中显示频数与相对频数，也可以在双变量分类数据中看到关联模式。• 编制并解读双向表，汇总从同一批对象收集的两个分类变量的数据。• 用按行或按列计算的相对频数描述两个变量之间可能的关联。

subject: Science
en: Teachers: Effective instruction in science requires not only direct experience and observation but also book learning, which helps bring coherence and order to a student’s scientific knowledge. Only when topics are presented systematically and clearly can students make steady and secure progress in their scientific learning. The Science sequence for the middle school grades aims for more intensive and selective study of topics, a number of which were introduced in earlier grades. The Sequence continues the practice of studying topics from each of the major realms of science (physical, life, and earth science). Students are expected to do experiments and write reports on their findings.
zh: 教师须知：有效的科学教学不仅需要直接经验和观察，也需要书本学习，因为书本学习有助于使学生的科学知识连贯而有条理。只有系统、清晰地呈现主题，学生才能在科学学习上稳步而扎实地进步。中学阶段的科学知识序列旨在对主题进行更深入、有所侧重的研习，其中不少主题在更早的年级已经介绍过。该序列延续了从科学的各大领域（物理科学、生命科学和地球科学）研究主题的做法。学生应动手做实验，并撰写关于研究发现的报告。

subject: Science
en: Measures of motion:
zh: 运动的度量：

subject: Science
en: Speed: distance per unit of time
zh: 速度：单位时间内通过的距离

subject: Science
en: Velocity: distance per unit of time in a particular direction
zh: 速度：沿特定方向的单位时间内通过的距离

subject: Science
en: Changes in velocity can involve changes in speed and/or direction
zh: 速度的变化可能涉及速率和/或方向的变化

subject: Science
en: A force is a push or pull on an object.
zh: 力是对物体的推或拉。

subject: Science
en: A contact force is a push or pull on objects that touch each other.
zh: 接触力是相互接触的物体之间的推或拉。

subject: Science
en: A force has both direction and magnitude.
zh: 力既有方向，也有大小。

subject: Science
en: Newton’s mathematical expression of force; a newton is the measure of force in the metric system, pound-force in the English system.
zh: 牛顿对力的数学表达；牛顿（newton）是公制中力的单位，英制中则为磅力（pound-force）。

subject: Science
en: If an object is at rest or there is no change in its movement, then the forces acting on it are balanced.
zh: 如果物体静止或其运动状态没有变化，那么作用在它上面的力是平衡的。

subject: Science
en: Unbalanced forces result in changes of an object’s velocity.
zh: 不平衡的力会导致物体速度发生变化。

subject: Science
en: The kinetic energy of a moving object is related to its mass.
zh: 运动物体的动能与其质量有关。

subject: Science
en: Newton’s Third Law of Motion can be applied to collisions.
zh: 牛顿运动第三定律可应用于碰撞。

subject: Science
en: The forces acting on object in a collision, and the change the motion of the objects, involves the velocity of each object and its mass.
zh: 碰撞中作用在物体上的力以及物体运动的变化，涉及每个物体的速度及其质量。

subject: Science
en: The use of engineering design processes can help us design ways to minimize damage when objects collide.
zh: 运用工程设计流程可以帮助我们设计出在物体碰撞时尽量减少损伤的方法。

subject: Science
en: Difference between a sound and a sound wave: Sound is the result of sound waves. E.g., a ringing bell causes a sound wave, which a person recognizes as a sound.
zh: 声音与声波的区别：声音是声波产生的结果。例如，铃铛响动会产生声波，人将其感知为声音。

subject: Science
en: Vibrating objects establish sound waves when not in a vacuum.
zh: 在非真空环境中，振动的物体会产生声波。

subject: Science
en: Common vibrating objects: human voice box, siren, bell, parts of a cell phone or television
zh: 常见的振动体：人的声带、警笛、铃铛、手机或电视机的部件

subject: Science
en: Sound waves, when interacting with matter, can be reflected, absorbed, or transmitted.
zh: 声波与物质相互作用时，可能被反射、吸收或透射。

subject: Science
en: Because sound waves transmit energy, they can often interact with matter to cause it to move, such as making our eardrums vibrate.
zh: 由于声波传递能量，它们常能与物质相互作用使其运动，例如使我们的鼓膜振动。

subject: Science
en: Like all forms of energy, a sound wave can be transformed into another energy form— the engineering basis for many practical devices.
zh: 与所有形式的能量一样，声波可以转化为另一种能量形式——这是许多实用装置的工程学基础。

subject: Science
en: Characteristics of a sound wave include:
zh: 声波的特性包括：

subject: Science
en: Speed
zh: 声速

subject: Science
en: Frequency
zh: 频率

subject: Science
en: Amplitude
zh: 振幅

subject: Science
en: A force is a push or pull on an object.
zh: 力是对物体的推或拉。

subject: Science
en: A non-contact force is a push or pull on objects that do not touch each other.
zh: 非接触力是彼此不接触的物体之间的推或拉。

subject: Science
en: Examples: magnetism, electrical forces, gravity
zh: 例如：磁力、电力、引力

subject: Science
en: Non-contact forces involve fields that surround object, magnetic fields, electrical fields, gravitational fields.
zh: 非接触力涉及包围物体的场：磁场、电场、引力场。

subject: Science
en: If an object is at rest or there is no change in its movement then, the forces acting on it are balanced.
zh: 如果物体静止或其运动状态没有变化，那么作用在它上面的力是平衡的。

subject: Science
en: Unbalanced forces result in changes of an object’s velocity.
zh: 不平衡的力会导致物体速度发生变化。

subject: Science
en: Magnets exert a non-contact force on objects made of certain metals.
zh: 磁体对由某些金属制成的物体施加非接触力。

subject: Science
en: A metal object becomes magnetic when all its electrons spin in the same direction.
zh: 当金属物体中所有电子沿同一方向自旋时，该物体就带有磁性。

subject: Science
en: Some objects are naturally magnetic, others can be made by subjecting certain metals to an electrical field.
zh: 有些物体天然具有磁性，另一些则可通过将某些金属置于电场中而获得磁性。

subject: Science
en: All magnets have two poles, north and south.
zh: 所有磁体都有两个磁极：南极和北极。

subject: Science
en: Similar magnetic poles repel; opposite magnetic poles attract.
zh: 同名磁极相斥，异名磁极相吸。

subject: Science
en: The entire Earth is a magnet, and therefore surrounded by a magnetic field.
zh: 整个地球是一个磁体，因此周围存在磁场。

subject: Science
en: Electrical forces are the result of charged particles acting upon one another.
zh: 电力是带电粒子之间相互作用的结果。

subject: Science
en: Electrical and magnetic forces can be described by the activity of the field associated with each force.
zh: 电力和磁力可以通过与各自相关的场的活动来描述。

subject: Science
en: Gravity is a force that acts upon any two objects in the universe.
zh: 引力是作用于宇宙中任意两个物体之间的力。

subject: Science
en: Gravity results because any mass causes the space around it to curve.
zh: 引力的产生是因为任何质量都会使其周围的空间发生弯曲。

subject: Science
en: Newton’s law of universal gravitation
zh: 牛顿万有引力定律

subject: Science
en: Effects of universal gravitation on objects in the universe
zh: 万有引力对宇宙中物体的影响

subject: Science
en: Earth, the moon, and sun form a system.
zh: 地球、月球和太阳构成一个系统。

subject: Science
en: Earth revolves around the sun and the moon revolves around Earth
zh: 地球绕太阳公转，月球绕地球公转

subject: Science
en: Solar and lunar eclipses are the result of Earth, moon, sun system.
zh: 日食和月食是地球—月球—太阳系统运行的结果。

subject: Science
en: Day, night, and seasons are the result of the earth in relationship to the sun.
zh: 昼夜和四季是地球与太阳相对关系的结果。

subject: Science
en: Tides are the result of the interaction of Earth and moon.
zh: 潮汐是地球与月球相互作用的结果。

subject: Science
en: Solar system: at least one star and its orbiting objects
zh: 太阳系：至少一颗恒星及其绕行天体

subject: Science
en: Objects in a solar system include planets, moons, asteroids, and comets.
zh: 太阳系中的天体包括行星、卫星、小行星和彗星。

subject: Science
en: Origins of solar systems
zh: 太阳系的起源

subject: Science
en: Eclipses, lunar phases, and seasons: results of the cyclic patterns of movement of the sun, planets, and moons C. Stars and Galaxies
zh: 日食、月相和四季：太阳、行星与卫星周期性运动模式的结果。 C. 恒星与星系

subject: Science
en: The sun is a star.
zh: 太阳是一颗恒星。

subject: Science
en: Red giants and white dwarfs
zh: 红巨星与白矮星

subject: Science
en: Life cycle of the stars, including novae, supernovae, black holes, and quasars
zh: 恒星的生命周期，包括新星、超新星、黑洞和类星体

subject: Science
en: The apparent movement of stars is a result of the rotation of Earth.
zh: 恒星的视运动是地球自转的结果。

subject: Science
en: Constellations such as the Big Dipper and Orion, are visual groupings of stars into imagined images.
zh: 星座（如北斗七星和猎户座）是人们将恒星在视觉上组合成想象中的图像。

subject: Science
en: Definition of light year
zh: 光年的定义

subject: Science
en: Galaxy: enormous number of stars held together by gravitation
zh: 星系：由引力维系在一起的巨大恒星集合

subject: Science
en: About 125 billion galaxies in the universe
zh: 宇宙中约有 1250 亿个星系

subject: Science
en: Our knowledge of stars, solar systems, galaxies, and the universe is the result of observations and data collected by earth-based instruments, space-based instruments, and spacecraft.
zh: 我们对恒星、太阳系、星系和宇宙的认识，来自地面仪器、太空仪器和航天器收集到的观测与数据。

subject: Science
en: Gregor Mendel’s experiments with purebred and hybrid peas and subsequent discoveries about inherited traits
zh: 格雷戈尔·孟德尔（Gregor Mendel）关于纯种与杂交豌豆的实验，以及后来关于遗传性状的发现

subject: Science
en: Role of genes (segments of DNA on a chromosome) in inherited traits
zh: 基因（染色体上的 DNA 片段）在遗传性状中的作用

subject: Science
en: Traits of an offspring are the result of half of an offspring’s genes coming from the mother, and half coming from the father.
zh: 子代的性状源于其基因一半来自母亲、一半来自父亲。

subject: Science
en: Alleles, dominant and recessive
zh: 等位基因：显性与隐性

subject: Science
en: An offspring
zh: 子代

subject: Science
en: Role, structure, and organization of DNA
zh: DNA 的作用、结构与组织方式

subject: Science
en: DNA is the template for RNA, which in turn directs the development of proteins
zh: DNA 是 RNA 的模板，而 RNA 进而指导蛋白质的形成

subject: Science
en: A mutation is a structural change to a gene.
zh: 突变是基因结构上的改变。

subject: Science
en: Mutations can be harmful, neutral, or beneficial.
zh: 突变可能是有害的、中性的或有益的。

subject: Science
en: Mutations change the structure of DNA, which in turn can affect RNA and thus the formation of proteins.
zh: 突变改变 DNA 的结构，进而可能影响 RNA，从而影响蛋白质的形成。

subject: Science
en: Sexual reproduction results in offspring with a mixture of genes from each parent.
zh: 有性生殖产生的子代带有来自双亲的混合基因。

subject: Science
en: Sexual reproduction results in new combination of genes and thus results in variation of traits in offspring.
zh: 有性生殖产生新的基因组合，因而使子代出现性状变异。

subject: Science
en: Asexual reproduction is not the result of the combination of genes and thus does not result in genetic variation between parent and offspring.
zh: 无性生殖不是基因组合的结果，因此不会造成亲代与子代之间的遗传变异。

subject: Science
en: Definition of natural selection
zh: 自然选择的定义

subject: Science
en: Definition of population, and a knowledge of variation of traits among individuals
zh: 种群的定义，以及个体之间性状变异的知识

subject: Science
en: Percentages of genes and alleles in a population
zh: 种群中基因与等位基因所占的百分比

subject: Science
en: Abiotic and biotic changes in the environment and their favorable or unfavorable effects on individuals with certain traits
zh: 环境中的非生物与生物变化，以及它们对具有某些性状的个体的有利或不利影响

subject: Science
en: Survival and greater reproduction of individuals with favorable traits, or adaptations
zh: 具有有利性状（即适应）的个体得以存活并更多地繁殖

subject: Science
en: Others will not reproduce as effectively or will die; pass on their genes at a lower rate changing the genetic structure of a population over time.
zh: 其他个体则繁殖效率较低或死亡；它们传递基因的比例较低，从而随时间推移改变种群的遗传结构。

subject: Science
en: Many lines of evidence indicate all living things have a common ancestry.
zh: 多条证据表明所有生物都有共同祖先。

subject: Science
en: Fossil evidence, rock strata and chemical dating process show that the processes of evolution: from origin to extinction, were the same in the past as they are now.
zh: 化石证据、岩层与化学测年过程表明，进化过程（从起源到灭绝）在过去与现在是一样的。

subject: Science
en: Comparison of structural similarities and differences between fossils and between fossils and living organisms is one basis for the common ancestry of all living things.
zh: 比较化石之间以及化石与生物之间的结构异同，是支持所有生物具有共同祖先的依据之一。

subject: Science
en: Comparison of the DNA of differing organisms and other cellular chemical analyses indicate concept that all living things have a common ancestry.
zh: 比较不同生物的 DNA 及其他细胞化学分析表明，所有生物具有共同祖先。

subject: Science
en: Definition, theory, and process of evolution
zh: 进化的定义、理论与过程

subject: Science
en: Study of the process of evolution includes the comparing genetic makeup and biochemistries of large numbers of different organisms, comparing the anatomy of organisms living and past, and comparative embryology.
zh: 对进化过程的研究包括：比较大量不同生物的基因组成与生物化学特征，比较现生与远古生物的解剖结构，以及比较胚胎学。

subject: Science
en: The history of the study of how organisms are related goes back to the beginning of scientific thought.
zh: 研究生物之间亲缘关系的历史可追溯到科学思想的开端。

subject: Science
en: Charles Darwin, and his On the Origin of Species by Means of Natural Selection, or the Preservation of Favoured Races in the Struggle for Life (1859) and historical and scientific importance
zh: 查尔斯·达尔文（Charles Darwin）及其《物种起源：通过自然选择，或在生存斗争中保存有利种族》（On the Origin of Species by Means of Natural Selection, or the Preservation of Favoured Races in the Struggle for Life，1859），以及其历史与科学意义
work: 物种起源：通过自然选择，或在生存斗争中保存有利种族

subject: Science
en: Albert Einstein — advancements in the study of space, matter, energy, time, and gravity
zh: 阿尔伯特·爱因斯坦（Albert Einstein）——在空间、物质、能量、时间和引力研究方面的进展

subject: Science
en: Dorothy Hodgkin — structure of vitamin B12
zh: 多萝西·霍奇金（Dorothy Hodgkin）——维生素 B12 的结构

subject: Science
en: James Maxwell —the basic laws of electromagnetism
zh: 詹姆斯·麦克斯韦（James Maxwell）——电磁学的基本定律

subject: Science
en: Charles Steinmetz —the theory of electric power appendices
zh: 查尔斯·斯坦梅茨（Charles Steinmetz）——电力理论（附录）
